create procedure O7CRADD1
   @sEventNo	    nvarchar(100),
   @sEventOrg		nvarchar(15),
   @sStw			nvarchar(100),
   @sChk            nvarchar(4)		OUTPUT 
   
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nContinue				int
	declare @nCount					int
	declare @nReturn				int
	declare @sAddrentity            nvarchar(4)	--R5ADDETAILS.ADD_RENTITY%TYPE
	declare @sAddentity             nvarchar(4)	--R5ADDETAILS.ADD_ENTITY%TYPE
	declare @sAddrtype              nvarchar(4)	--R5ADDETAILS.ADD_RTYPE%TYPE
	declare @sAddtype               nvarchar(4)	--R5ADDETAILS.ADD_TYPE%TYPE
	declare @sCheckresult           nvarchar(4)	
	declare @dtAddCreated           datetime

	/* Initialize */
	set @sChk         = N'0'
	set @sAddrentity = N'EVNT'
	set @sAddrtype   = N'*'
	set @sAddtype    = N'*'

	/* Check mandatory parameters */
	IF @sEventNo IS NULL  OR @sStw IS NULL 
		Begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		End

	/* Get entity type */
	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sAddrentity OUTPUT, @sAddentity OUTPUT, N'ENT', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
		begin
			set @sChk = N'2'
			return
		end
	else
		begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sAddentity OUTPUT, @sAddrentity, N'ENT', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
		end 

	set @dtAddCreated = dbo.o7gttime2(@sEventOrg)	

	--Note could not use cursor here since add_text was of type long (image in T-SQL).  Could not declare this variable local.
	INSERT INTO r5addetails
	(	add_rentity,
		add_entity,
		add_rtype,
		add_type,
		add_code,
		add_lang,
		add_line,
		add_print,
		add_text, 
		add_created,
		add_updatecount)
	(SELECT @sAddrentity,@sAddentity, @sAddrtype, @sAddtype, @sEventNo, add_lang, add_line, add_print, add_text, @dtAddCreated, -1 
				FROM   r5addetails
				WHERE  add_rentity = 'STWO'
				AND    add_code    = @sStw )

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CRADD2
    @sCquotation       nvarchar(100),
    @sCseqnonew        nvarchar(100),
    @sCseqnoold        nvarchar(100),
    @sChk              nvarchar(5) OUTPUT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sAdd_text	nvarchar(4000)
	declare @sAdd_lang	nvarchar(2)
	declare @sAdd_line	numeric(12,0)
	declare @sAdd_print	nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn  	int

    declare @sCaddrentity   nvarchar(4)        /*  R5ADDETAILS.ADD_RENTITY%TYPE  */
    declare @sCaddentity    nvarchar(4)        /*  R5ADDETAILS.ADD_ENTITY%TYPE	*/
    declare @sCaddrtype     nvarchar(4)        /*  R5ADDETAILS.ADD_RTYPE%TYPE	*/
    declare @sCaddtype      nvarchar(4)        /*  R5ADDETAILS.ADD_TYPE%TYPE	*/
    declare @sCheckresult   nvarchar(4)        /*  VARCHAR2( 4 )				*/
    declare @sAddcode       nvarchar(100)      /*  R5ADDETAILS.ADD_CODE%TYPE	*/
    declare @sAddtext       nvarchar(4000)     /*  R5ADDETAILS.ADD_TEXT%TYPE	*/
    declare @sAddlang       nvarchar(2)        /*  R5ADDETAILS.ADD_LANG%TYPE	*/
    declare @nAddline       numeric(12,0)      /*  NUMBER						*/
    declare @sAddprint      nvarchar(1)        /*  R5ADDETAILS.ADD_PRINT%TYPE	*/
BEGIN
	/* Initialize */
    set @sChk         = N'0'
    set @sCaddrentity = N'QUOT'
    set @sCaddrtype   = N'*'
    set @sCaddtype    = N'*'
	/* Check mandatory parameters */
    IF @sCquotation IS NULL
    OR @sCseqnoold  IS NULL
    OR @sCseqnonew  IS NULL
	begin
        set @sChk = N'1'
        RETURN
    end
	/* Get entity type */
	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sCaddrentity OUTPUT, @sCaddentity OUTPUT, N'ENT', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
    IF @sCheckresult <> N'0'
	begin
        set @sChk = N'2'
        RETURN
	end
    ELSE
	begin
		execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sCaddentity OUTPUT, @sCaddrentity, N'ENT', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
	end
   
	DECLARE cText CURSOR LOCAL FOR
    SELECT add_text,
           add_lang,
           add_line,
           add_print
    FROM   r5addetails
    WHERE  add_rentity = N'QUOT'
    AND    add_code    = @sCquotation + N'#' + @sCseqnoold
    
    OPEN cText
    loop:
    FETCH NEXT FROM cText INTO @sAddtext,
                   @sAddlang,
                   @nAddline,
                   @sAddprint
    IF @@ROWCOUNT  > 0
	begin
        INSERT INTO r5addetails
         (
          add_rentity,
          add_entity,
          add_rtype,
          add_type,
          add_code,
          add_lang,
          add_line,
          add_print,
          add_text
         )
        VALUES
         (
          @sCaddrentity,
          @sCaddentity,
          @sCaddrtype,
          @sCaddtype,
          @sCquotation + N'#' + @sCseqnonew,
          @sAddlang,
          @nAddline,
          @sAddprint,
          @sAddtext
         )
        GOTO loop
	end
    ELSE
	begin
        CLOSE cText
	    DEALLOCATE cText
	end

    CLOSE cText
	DEALLOCATE cText
  
  
    /* Now the service quotation lines */
    set @sCaddrentity = N'QUOL'
	set @sCaddentity  =  NULL
	/* Get entity type */
	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sCaddrentity OUTPUT, @sCaddentity OUTPUT, N'ENT', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
    IF @sCheckresult <> N'0'
	begin
        set @sChk = N'2'
        RETURN
	end
    ELSE
	begin
		execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sCaddentity OUTPUT, @sCaddrentity, N'ENT', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
	end
  
    DECLARE cText2 CURSOR LOCAL FOR
    SELECT REPLACE( add_code, N'#' + @sCseqnoold + N'#', N'#' + @sCseqnonew + N'#' ),
           add_text,
           add_lang,
           add_line,
           add_print
    FROM   r5addetails
    WHERE  add_rentity = N'QUOL'
    AND    add_code LIKE @sCquotation + N'#' + @sCseqnoold + N'%'

    OPEN cText2
    loop2:
    FETCH NEXT FROM cText2 INTO @sAddcode,
                    @sAddtext,
                    @sAddlang,
                    @nAddline,
                    @sAddprint
    IF @@ROWCOUNT  > 0
	begin
        INSERT INTO r5addetails
         (
          add_rentity,
          add_entity,
          add_rtype,
          add_type,
          add_code,
          add_lang,
          add_line,
          add_print,
          add_text
         )
        VALUES
         (
          @sCaddrentity,
          @sCaddentity,
          @sCaddrtype,
          @sCaddtype,
          @sAddcode,
          @sAddlang,
          @nAddline,
          @sAddprint,
          @sAddtext
         )
        GOTO loop2
	end
    ELSE
	begin
        CLOSE cText2
		DEALLOCATE cText2
    end

    CLOSE cText2
	DEALLOCATE cText2


END

create PROCEDURE O7CRAPO1
	@sObject         nvarchar(30),
	@sObjectorg      nvarchar(15),
	@sObrtype        nvarchar(4),
	@sObtype         nvarchar(4),
	@sPoint          nvarchar(30),
	@sPointtype      nvarchar(30),
	@sDesc           nvarchar(80),
	@sChk            nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
AS

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nCountit                  int

BEGIN
	SET @sChk = N'0'

	IF @sObject    IS NULL
	OR @sObjectorg IS NULL
	OR @sObrtype   IS NULL
	OR @sObtype    IS NULL
	OR @sPoint     IS NULL
	OR @sPointtype IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

	SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
	FROM   r5points p
	WHERE  p.poi_object     = @sObject
	AND    p.poi_object_org = @sObjectorg
	AND    p.poi_obtype     = @sObtype
	AND    p.poi_point      = @sPoint
	AND    p.poi_pointtype  = @sPointtype

	IF @nCountit = 0 
		INSERT INTO r5points  (
			 poi_object,
			 poi_object_org,
			 poi_obrtype,
			 poi_obtype,
			 poi_point,
			 poi_desc,
			 poi_pointtype  )
		SELECT @sObject,
			 @sObjectorg,
			 @sObrtype,
			 @sObtype,
			 @sPoint,
			 coalesce( @sDesc, ptp_desc ),
			 @sPointtype
		FROM   r5pointtypes
		WHERE  ptp_code = @sPointtype
END

create PROCEDURE O7CRASWO
                        @sSessionId    numeric(38,0),
                        @sWorkOrder     nvarchar(30),
                        @sTempWorkOrder  nvarchar(30)
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sTjb_part      nvarchar(30) 
    declare @sTjb_part_org  nvarchar(15)
    declare @sTjb_byasset   nvarchar(1)
    declare @sTjb_active    nvarchar(1)
    declare @nTjb_qty       numeric(24,6)
    declare @sTjb_store     nvarchar(15)

    declare @nObjNum        integer
    declare @sObjCode       nvarchar(30) 
    declare @sObjOrg        nvarchar(15) 
    declare @sObjbin        nvarchar(15)
    declare @sObjLot        nvarchar(12)

    declare @nBis_repairqty     numeric(24,6) 
    declare @sBis_lot           nvarchar(12)
    declare @nNDBis_repairqty   numeric(24,6) 
    declare @sNDBis_bin         nvarchar(15) 
    declare @sNDBis_lot         nvarchar(12)
    declare @sALLBis_repairqty  numeric(24,6) 
    declare @sALLBis_bin        nvarchar(15) 
    declare @sALLBis_lot        nvarchar(12)

    declare @nMaxRepairQty      numeric(24,6)
    declare @sDefaultBin        nvarchar(15) 
    declare @sAutoAssign        nvarchar(1) 
    declare @sActive            nvarchar(1) 
    declare @nRemainingToBeAssignedQty  numeric(24,6)
    declare @nJobLineQty                numeric(24,6)--r5joblines.jbl_qty%TYPE := 0;
    declare @nQtyAlreadyAssigned        numeric(24,6)--r5repairbins.rpb_qty%TYPE;
    declare @nQtyToAssign               numeric(24,6)--r5repairbins.rpb_qty%TYPE;
    
    declare @nReturn            integer
    declare @sUser              nvarchar( 255 )

	declare @sRspComp			nvarchar(200) --R5INSTALL.INS_DESC%TYPE;
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCompletedQty		numeric(24,6) 

    set @nRemainingToBeAssignedQty = 0.00000
    set @nJobLineQty = 0.00000
    set @nMaxRepairQty = 0.00000
    set @sAutoAssign = N'-'
    set @sActive = N'-'
    set @sDefaultBin = null
    set @nCompletedQty = 0 
    execute O7SESS_CUR_USER @sUser OUTPUT
    set @sUser = ISNULL( @sUser, 'R5' )

	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sRspComp OUTPUT, N'RSPCOMP', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	DECLARE cTempjobline CURSOR local FOR SELECT tjb_part, tjb_part_org,tjb_byasset, tjb_active,tjb_qty,tjb_store
	                                         FROM   r5tempjoblines
	                                         WHERE tjb_sessionid = @sSessionId AND tjb_event = @sTempWorkOrder
	OPEN cTempjobline
	FETCH NEXT FROM cTempjobline INTO @sTjb_part, @sTjb_part_org, @sTjb_byasset, @sTjb_active, @nTjb_qty, @sTjb_store


	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
            set @sActive = N'-'  
            -- get data from temporary job lines
            set @nMaxRepairQty = dbo.O7CRASWO_GETMAXREP(@sWorkOrder,@sTjb_part, @sTjb_part_org,@sTjb_store)
            IF @nMaxRepairQty < @nTjb_qty 
                begin
                    set @nRemainingToBeAssignedQty =  @nMaxRepairQty
                    set @nJobLineQty = @nMaxRepairQty
                end
            ELSE
                begin
                    set @nRemainingToBeAssignedQty = @nTjb_qty
                    set @nJobLineQty = @nTjb_qty
                end

            IF @nRemainingToBeAssignedQty <= 0 
                begin
                    DELETE FROM r5tempjoblines WHERE tjb_sessionid = @sSessionId AND tjb_event = @sTempWorkOrder
	                CLOSE cTempjobline
	                DEALLOCATE cTempjobline
                    RETURN
                end

            -- get repairable part setttings
            SELECT @sDefaultBin = sto_repdefaultbin, @sAutoAssign = sto_repautoassign
            FROM   r5stock
            WHERE sto_store  = @sTjb_store AND sto_part = @sTjb_part AND sto_part_org = @sTjb_part_org

            IF @sTjb_byasset ='-' 
                begin
                    -- doing repairable parts bin assignmnet for normal parts
                    IF @sAutoAssign = N'+' 
                        begin
                            IF @sDefaultBin IS NOT NULL 
                                begin
                                    -- assgin from default repair bin
	                                DECLARE cDefbinQty CURSOR local FOR SELECT bis_repairqty, bis_lot
                                                                            FROM   r5binstock
                                                                            WHERE bis_store  = @sTjb_store AND bis_part = @sTjb_part AND bis_part_org = @sTjb_part_org and bis_bin = @sDefaultBin 
                                                                            AND   coalesce(bis_repairqty,0) > 0
                                                                            ORDER BY bis_lot
	                                OPEN cDefbinQty
	                                FETCH NEXT FROM cDefbinQty INTO @nBis_repairqty, @sBis_lot
	                                WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		                                BEGIN
                                            -- Get the actual quantity that can be repaired from this store/part/bin/lot
                                            set @nQtyAlreadyAssigned = dbo.o7gtasqy( @sTjb_store, @sTjb_part, @sTjb_part_org, @sWorkOrder, null, null, @sDefaultBin, @sBis_lot )
                                            -- If all parts are already assigned from the bin/lot, then skip
                                            IF( ( @nBis_repairqty - @nQtyAlreadyAssigned ) > 0 )
                                                begin
                                                    set @nQtyToAssign = @nBis_repairqty - @nQtyAlreadyAssigned
                                                    IF @nQtyToAssign <= @nRemainingToBeAssignedQty 
                                                        begin
                                                            execute @nReturn = O7CRASWO_CREATEREPAIRBINRECORD @sWorkOrder,@sTjb_part, @sTjb_part_org,@sTjb_store, @sDefaultBin,@sBis_lot,@nQtyToAssign 
                                                            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                                                begin
                                                                    close cTempjobline
                                                                    deallocate cTempjobline
	                                                                close cDefbinQty
	                                                                deallocate cDefbinQty
                                                                    return -1
                                                                end
                                                            set @nRemainingToBeAssignedQty = @nRemainingToBeAssignedQty - @nQtyToAssign
                                                        end
                                                    ELSE
                                                        begin
                                                            IF @nRemainingToBeAssignedQty > 0 
                                                                begin
                                                                    execute @nReturn = O7CRASWO_CREATEREPAIRBINRECORD @sWorkOrder,@sTjb_part, @sTjb_part_org,@sTjb_store, @sDefaultBin,@sBis_lot,@nRemainingToBeAssignedQty 
                                                                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                                                        begin
                                                                            close cTempjobline
                                                                            deallocate cTempjobline
	                                                                        close cDefbinQty
	                                                                        deallocate cDefbi

create function O7CRASWO_GETMAXREP(@sEvent    nvarchar(30),
				   @sPart     nvarchar(30),
				   @sPartorg  nvarchar(15),
				   @sStore    nvarchar(15))
returns numeric(24,6)
as
begin
	declare    @dSys_date 	datetime
    declare     @nBis       numeric(24,6)
    declare     @nMaxqty    numeric(24,6)

    SELECT @nBis = coalesce(SUM( bis_repairqty ), 0)
    FROM   r5binstock
    WHERE  bis_store     = @sStore
    AND    bis_part      = @sPart
    AND    bis_part_org  = @sPartorg

    set @nMaxqty = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( coalesce( @nBis, 0 ) - dbo.o7gtasqy(@sStore,@sPart,@sPartorg,@sEvent,null,null,null,null), 0 )

    RETURN  @nMaxqty
end

create procedure O7CRBREP	@nSessionid		int,
							@sCode			nvarchar(76),
							@sOrg			nvarchar(15),
							@sEntity		nvarchar(4)
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare @nRowid			int
	declare @dToday			datetime
	declare @dMindate		datetime
	declare @sReportname	nvarchar(6)
	declare @sEvtrstatus	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sAdvRept		nvarchar(200)--R5INSTALL.INS_DESC%TYPE;

	declare @sReportSubID   nvarchar(45)
	declare @sPKCode        nvarchar(30)


	set @sAdvRept = UPPER(dbo.O7DFLT2(N'ADVREPT')) 
	set @dToday = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2( @sOrg ), N'DD' )

	-- If the code has # embedded then split the first
	-- to the code and the later part will be the report record identifier
	-- This logic is only applicable for REQ, ORD, and PTW
	IF charindex(N'#', @sCode) != 0 
		begin
			set @sPKCode = SUBSTRING(@sCode,1,charindex(N'#', @sCode)-1)
			set @sReportSubID = SUBSTRING(@sCode,charindex(N'#',@sCode)+1, len(@sCode))
		end
	ELSE
		begin
			set @sPKCode = @sCode
			set @sReportSubID = null
		end

	if @sEntity = N'REQ'
		begin
			select @nRowid = req_sqlidentity from r5requisitions where req_code = @sPKCode
			IF @sAdvRept = N'YES' 
				set @sReportname = N'SZREQF'
			ELSE
				set @sReportname = N'STREQF'
		end

	if @sEntity = N'ORD'
		begin
			select @nRowid = ord_sqlidentity from r5orders where ord_code = @sPKCode and ord_org = @sOrg
			IF @sAdvRept = N'YES'
				set @sReportname = N'PZORDF'
			ELSE
				set @sReportname = N'PTORDF'
		end

	if @sEntity = N'EVNT'
		begin
			select @nRowid = evt_sqlidentity, @sEvtrstatus = evt_rstatus from r5events where evt_code = @sPKCode
			IF @sAdvRept = N'YES'
				set @sReportname = N'WZJOBF'
			ELSE
				set @sReportname = N'WTJOBF'

		end

	if @sEntity = N'PTW'
		begin
			select @nRowid = ptw_sqlidentity from r5permittowork where ptw_code = @sPKCode
			set @sReportname = N'WZPTWR'
		end

	SELECT @dMindate = MIN( trx_date )
	FROM   r5temprepxfer
	if @dMindate < @dToday - 6
		DELETE FROM r5temprepxfer
		WHERE  trx_date < @dToday - 6
		AND    trx_session < 0

	IF @sEntity = N'EVNT' AND @sEvtrstatus = N'B'  
        RETURN
  		
	INSERT INTO r5temprepxfer (trx_session, trx_rowid, trx_date,trx_function,trx_data3)
	VALUES (@nSessionid, cast(@nRowid as nvarchar(38)), @dToday, @sReportname,@sReportSubID)

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CRCON1
    @sCconcode       nvarchar(100),
    @sCconcopy       nvarchar(100),
    @sClang          nvarchar(2),
    @sChk            nvarchar(5) OUTPUT,
    @nNsqlcode       int  OUTPUT,
    @sCoramsg        nvarchar(2000) OUTPUT   
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @sCheckresult  nvarchar(4)
    declare @sX            nvarchar(1)

	/* Initialise */
    set @nNsqlcode    = 0
    set @sCheckresult = N'0'
    set @sChk         = N'0'
    set @sX           = NULL
	/* Check for missing Mandatory Parameters */
    IF @sCconcode       IS  NULL
    OR @sClang          IS  NULL
    OR @sCconcopy       IS  NULL
	begin
        set @sChk = N'1'
        RETURN
    end
	/* C10241 - Add associated data to r5addetails entity   */
	INSERT INTO r5addetails
	    (
	        add_entity,
	        add_rentity,
	        add_type,
	        add_rtype,
	        add_code,
	        add_lang,
	        add_line,
	        add_print ,
	        add_text
	    )
    SELECT a.add_entity,
          a.add_rentity,
          a.add_type,
          a.add_rtype,
		  @sCconcode,
		  @sClang,
          a.add_line,
          a.add_print,
          a.add_text
    FROM   r5addetails  a
    WHERE  a.add_rentity   = N'CONT'
    AND    a.add_code      = @sCconcopy
    AND    a.add_lang      = @sClang 

	set @nNsqlcode = @@ERROR

	if @nNsqlcode <> 0
		begin
			set @sChk = N'5'
			set @sCoramsg  = N'SQL Server Error Code: ' + cast( @nNsqlcode as nvarchar(38))
			RETURN
		end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CRCON2
    @sCconcode       nvarchar(100),
    @sCconclass      nvarchar(100),
    @sCconclsorg     nvarchar(100),
    @sClang          nvarchar(2),
    @sCwherefrom     nvarchar(200),
    @sCclause        nvarchar(8),
    @sCprint         nvarchar(1),
    @sLtext          nvarchar(4000) OUTPUT,
    @sChk            nvarchar(5)    OUTPUT,
    @nNsqlcode       int 	        OUTPUT,
    @sCoramsg        nvarchar(200)  OUTPUT    
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sCrtype        nvarchar(4)			/*	R5ENTITIES.ENT_RENTITY%TYPE  Rapier type */
    declare @sCucont        nvarchar(4)			/*	R5ENTITIES.ENT_ENTITY%TYPE   User type for 'CONT' */
    declare @sCheckresult   nvarchar(4)
    declare @sX             nvarchar(1)
    declare @nTmax          int
    declare @sCdes          nvarchar(80)          /* r5descriptions.des_text%TYPE */
    declare @nLine_no       numeric(12,0)
    declare @nLine_inc      numeric(12,0)
    declare @sRtn           nvarchar(1)
    declare @sNspace        nvarchar(10)
    declare @sText          nvarchar(4000)  		/*	R5ADDETAILS.ADD_TEXT%TYPE */
    declare @sText2         nvarchar(4000)  		/*	R5ADDETAILS.ADD_TEXT%TYPE */
    declare @nRec           int
	declare @sAdd_print		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCcy_claus		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sAdd_print1	nvarchar(1)
	declare @sAdd_print2	nvarchar(1)
	declare @sNspacecur		nvarchar(10)
	declare @nReturn		int
	/*  cursor variable */
	declare @sAdd_code		nvarchar(100)
	declare @sAdd_rentity	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sAdd_type		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sAdd_lang		nvarchar(2)
	declare @nAdd_line		numeric(12, 0)
	declare @ptrval 		varbinary(16)
	declare @ptrval1 		varbinary(16)
	declare @sBefcoltext	nvarchar(4000)
	declare @sBefcoltext1	nvarchar(4000)
	declare @nValidptr	    int
	declare @nValidptr1		int
	declare	@nLength		int
	declare	@nLength1		int
	declare @nError			int

BEGIN
	/* Initialise */
	set @nLine_inc = 10
	set @sX = null
    set @nNsqlcode    = 0
    set @sCheckresult = N'0'
    set @sChk         = N'0'
    set @sCoramsg     = NULL
    set @sLtext       = null

    SELECT @sRtn = char(10)
	/* Check for missing Mandatory Parameters */
    IF @sCconcode       IS NULL
    OR @sClang          IS NULL
    OR @sCconclass      IS NULL
	begin
        set @sChk = N'1'
        RETURN
    end
	/* -------------------------------------------------    C10251 */
	/* Find user code of 'CONT' */
    set @sCrtype = N'CONT'
    set @sCucont = @sX
	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sCrtype OUTPUT, @sCucont OUTPUT, N'ENT', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
    IF @sCheckresult <> 0
	begin
        set @sChk = N'3'
        RETURN
    end
	/* Insert various additional details of source contract
   	into additional details of target contract:           */
    set @nLine_no = 0
    IF @sCwherefrom = N'TRIG'
	begin
	/* 1. insert additional details of contract class. */
		DECLARE cClasstext CURSOR FOR
    	SELECT a.add_code,
        	   a.add_rentity,  
           	   a.add_type,
           	   a.add_lang,
               a.add_line,
               a.add_print
    	FROM   r5addetails   a
    	WHERE  a.add_rentity = N'CLAS'
    	AND    a.add_code    = @sCconclass + N'#'+ @sCconclsorg
    	AND    a.add_lang    = @sClang
    	AND    a.add_rtype   = N'CONT'
    	ORDER BY a.add_line 
		OPEN cClasstext
		FETCH NEXT FROM cClasstext INTO @sAdd_code, @sAdd_rentity, @sAdd_type, @sAdd_lang, @nAdd_line, @sAdd_print
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS =  0
		BEGIN
	         set @nLine_no = @nLine_no + @nLine_inc
	         INSERT INTO r5addetails
	            (
	                add_entity,
	                add_rentity,
	                add_rtype,
	                add_type,
	                add_code,
	                add_lang,
	                add_line,
	                add_print,
	                add_text
	            )
	         SELECT
	               @sCucont,
	                N'CONT',
	                N'*',
	                N'+',
	                @sCconcode,
	                @sClang,
	                @nLine_no,
	                @sAdd_print,
	                a.add_text
	             
			 FROM   r5addetails   a
             WHERE a.add_code =    @sAdd_code
             AND  a.add_rentity =  @sAdd_rentity  
             AND  a.add_type   =   @sAdd_type 
             AND  a.add_lang   =   @sAdd_lang
             AND  a.add_line   =   @nAdd_line
             AND  a.add_print  =   @sAdd_print
			 set @nError = @@ERROR
			 if @nError <> 0
			 begin
				 set @sChk = N'996'
				 set @sCoramsg  = null
				 set @nNsqlcode  = @nError
				 CLOSE  cClasstext
				 DEALLOCATE cClasstext
				 RETURN
			 end
			 FETCH NEXT FROM cClasstext INTO @sAdd_code, @sAdd_rentity, @sAdd_type, @sAdd_lang, @nAdd_line, @sAdd_print
		END 
		CLOSE  cClasstext
		DEALLOCATE cClasstext
    end
	/* 2. Insert descriptions of contract clause */
	DECLARE cDescline CURSOR LOCAL FOR
    SELECT c.ccy_claus,
           dbo.F_LPAD( N' ', LEN( c.ccy_claus ) + 2, N' ' )
    FROM   r5contypeclauses c
    WHERE   c.ccy_contype      = @sCconclass
    AND     c.ccy_contype_org  = @sCconclsorg
    AND     c.ccy_claus LIKE @sCclause
    UNION
    SELECT @sCclause ccy_clause, N''
    WHERE  @sCwherefrom <> N'TRIG'
	OPEN cDescline
	FETCH NEXT FROM cDescline INTO @sCcy_claus, @sNspacecur
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	begin
        set @nLine_no = @nLine_no + @nLine_inc  
        set @sText    =  N''
        set @sCdes    =  dbo.R5O7_O7GET_DESC( @sClang, N'CLAU', @sCcy_claus, null, null )
        set @sText    =  @sCcy_claus + N': ' + @sCdes + @sRtn 
        set @sText2   =  @sText 
		/* 3. Insert additional details of contract clause. */
        set @nRec = 0
		/* First to be printed clauses */
		DECLARE cClausetext CURSOR LOCAL FOR
    	SELECT a.add_code,
        	   a.add_rentity,  
           	   a.add_type,
           	   a.add_lang,
               a.add_line,
               a.add_print
    	FROM   r5addetails   a
    	WHERE  a.add_rentity = N'CLAU'
    	AND    a.add_code    = @sCcy_claus
    	AND    a.add_lang    = @sClang
		AND    a.add_print   = CASE @sCwherefrom WHEN N'TRIG' THEN a.add_print ELSE @sCprint END
    	AND    a.add_print   = N'+'
    	ORDER BY a.add_line 
		OPEN cClausetext
		FETCH NEXT FROM cClausetext INTO @sAdd_code, @sAdd_rentity, @sAdd_type, @sAdd_lang, @nAdd_line, @sAdd_print
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		begin
            set @nRec = @nRec + 1
			set @sBefcoltext = @sText + @sNspacecur
			SELECT @ptrval  = TEXTPTR(a.add_text)
			FROM   r5addetails   a
            WHERE a.add_code   =    @sAdd_code
            AND  a.add_rentity =    @sAdd_rentity  
            AND  a.add_type    =    @sAdd_type 
            AND  a.add_lang    =    @sAdd_lang
            AND  a.add_line    =    @nAdd_line 
            AND  a.add_print   =    @sAdd_print
			set @nValidptr = TEXTVALID('r5addetails.add_text', @ptrval)
			if @nValidptr = 1
			begin
				UPDATETEXT r5addetails.add_text @ptrval 0 0 @sBefcoltext
				if @@ERROR <>  0
				begin
					CLOSE cClausetext
					DEALLOCATE cClausetext
                    CLOSE cDescline
                    DEALLOCATE cDescline
                    return -1
				end
				SELECT @nLength = DATALENGTH(a.add_text)
				FROM   r5addetails  a
            	WHERE a.add_code   =    @sAdd_code
            	AND  a.add_rentity =    @sAdd_rentity  
            	AND  a.add_type    =    @sAdd_type 
            	AND  a.add_lang    =    @sAdd_lang
            	AND  a.add_line    =    @nAdd_line 
            	AND  a.add_print   =    @sAdd_print
				UPDATETEXT r5addetails.add_text @ptrval @nLength 0 @sRtn
				if @@ERROR <>  0
				begin
					CLOSE cClausetext
					DEALLOCATE cClausetext
                    CLOSE cDescline
                    DEALLOCATE cDescline
                    return -1
				end
			end
			else  /* not a valid ptr */
			begin

CREATE   PROCEDURE O7CRCORR(
			@rtype	NVARCHAR(4),
			@trans	NVARCHAR(30),
			@line	NUMERIC(8,0),
			@price	NUMERIC(24,6),
			@qty	NUMERIC(24,6),
			@lang	NVARCHAR(200),
			@usr	NVARCHAR(255),
			@obj	NVARCHAR(30) = NULL,
			@objorg	NVARCHAR(15) = NULL)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	-- New Variables
	DECLARE @nReturn	INTEGER
	DECLARE @GTTime		DATETIME
	DECLARE @gt_org	NVARCHAR(15)

	-- Oracle Variables
	DECLARE @code		NVARCHAR(30) --r5translines.trl_trans%TYPE
	DECLARE @utype		NVARCHAR(4) --r5translines.trl_type%TYPE
	DECLARE @descr		NVARCHAR(80) --r5transactions.tra_desc%TYPE
	DECLARE @language	NVARCHAR(200) --r5install.ins_desc%TYPE := lang
	DECLARE @chk		NVARCHAR(4)

	IF @language IS NULL
		BEGIN
			IF @usr IS NULL
				BEGIN
					EXECUTE @nReturn = O7DFLT @language OUTPUT, N'DEFLANG', @chk OUTPUT
				END
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					SELECT	@language = usr_lang
					FROM	r5users
					WHERE	usr_code = @usr
				END
		END

	IF @rtype <> N'CHEQ' 
		EXECUTE @nReturn = r5o7_o7maxseq @code OUTPUT, N'TRAN', N'1', @chk OUTPUT 

	SET @descr = dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @language, N'UCOD' , @rtype  , N'TRTP' , null )

	IF @rtype IN ( N'RCOR', N'RCVC' )
		BEGIN
			SELECT	@gt_org = tra_org
			FROM	r5transactions
			WHERE	tra_code = @trans

			EXECUTE @nReturn = o7gttime @GTTime OUTPUT, @gt_org

			INSERT INTO r5transactions(	tra_code,
										tra_org,
										tra_desc,
										tra_auth,
										tra_rtype,
										tra_date,
										tra_fromcode,
										tra_fromrentity,
										tra_fromrtype,
										tra_rstatus,
										tra_printed )
								SELECT 	@code,
										tra_org,
										@descr,
										ISNULL( tra_auth, 'R5' ),
										@rtype,
										CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @GTTime, 101),
										tra_tocode,
										'STOR',
										'*',
										'A',
										'-'
								FROM	r5transactions
								WHERE	tra_code = @trans
		END
	ELSE IF @rtype = N'NPC'
		BEGIN
			SELECT	@gt_org = tra_org
			FROM	r5transactions
			WHERE	tra_code = @trans

			EXECUTE @nReturn = o7gttime @GTTime OUTPUT, @gt_org

			INSERT INTO r5transactions(	tra_code,
										tra_org,
										tra_desc,
										tra_auth,
										tra_rtype,
										tra_date,
										tra_fromcode,
										tra_fromrentity,
										tra_fromrtype,
										tra_rstatus,
										tra_printed )
								SELECT 	@code,
										tra_org,
										@descr,
										ISNULL( tra_auth, 'R5' ),
										@rtype,
										CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @GTTime, 101),
										tra_fromcode,
										'STOR',
										'*',
										'A',
										'-'
								FROM	r5transactions
								WHERE	tra_code = @trans
		END
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT	@gt_org = str_org
			FROM	r5stores INNER JOIN r5fifo
								ON fif_store = str_code
			WHERE	fif_pk = CONVERT(NUMERIC(30, 0), @trans )

			EXECUTE @nReturn = o7gttime @GTTime OUTPUT, @gt_org

			INSERT INTO r5transactions(	tra_code,
										tra_org,
										tra_desc,
										tra_auth,
										tra_rtype,
										tra_date,
										tra_fromcode,
										tra_fromrentity,
										tra_fromrtype,
										tra_rstatus,
										tra_printed )
								SELECT	@code,
										str_org,
										@descr,
										ISNULL( @usr, 'R5' ),
										'CORR',
										CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @GTTime, 101),
										str_code,
										'STOR',
										'*',
										'A',
										'-'
								FROM	r5stores INNER JOIN r5fifo
													ON fif_store = str_code
								WHERE	fif_pk = CONVERT(NUMERIC(30, 0), @trans )
		END

	-- And add extra transaction line. 
	EXECUTE @nReturn = r5o7_o7ucode @utype OUTPUT, @rtype, N'TRTP', @chk OUTPUT

	IF @rtype = N'RCOR'
		BEGIN
			SELECT	@gt_org = tra_org
			FROM	r5transactions INNER JOIN r5trsanslines
									ON tra_code = trl_trans
			WHERE	trl_trans = @trans
			AND	trl_line  = @line

			EXECUTE @nReturn = o7gttime @GTTime OUTPUT, @gt_org

			INSERT INTO r5translines (	trl_part,
										trl_part_org,
										trl_store,
										trl_line,
										trl_type,
										trl_rtype,
										trl_trans,
										trl_date,
										trl_qty,
										trl_price,
										trl_bin,
										trl_lot,
										trl_io )
								SELECT	trl_part,
										trl_part_org,
										trl_store,
										1,
										@utype,
										@rtype,
										@code,
										@GTTime,
										trl_qty,
										@price,
										trl_bin,
										trl_lot,
										 N'1'
								FROM	r5transactions INNER JOIN r5translines
														ON tra_code = trl_trans
								WHERE	trl_trans = @trans
								AND	trl_line  = @line
		END

	ELSE IF @rtype IN ( N'RCVC', N'NPC' )
		INSERT INTO r5translines( 
			trl_part, trl_part_org, trl_store, trl_line, trl_type, trl_rtype, trl_trans, trl_date, trl_qty, trl_price, trl_io )
		SELECT trl_part, trl_part_org, trl_store, 1, @utype, @rtype, @code, @GTTime, @qty, @price, N'0'
		FROM   r5transactions,
				r5translines
		WHERE  tra_code  = trl_trans
		AND    trl_trans = @trans
		AND    trl_line  = @line
	ELSE IF @rtype = N'CHEQ'
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO r5translines(
				trl_part, trl_part_org, trl_store, trl_line, trl_type, trl_rtype, trl_trans, trl_date, trl_qty, trl_price,  
				trl_io, trl_object, trl_object_org, trl_obtype, trl_obrtype, trl_event, trl_act, trl_lot, trl_bin, trl_splittrans )
			SELECT obj_part, obj_part_org, trl_store, 
				( ISNULL( ( SELECT MAX( trl_line ) FROM r5translines WHERE trl_trans = @trans AND trl_line > 10000 ), 10000 ) + 1 ),
				@rtype, @rtype, @trans, trl_date, trl_qty, 
				CASE WHEN trl_rtype IN ( N'RR', N'RI' ) THEN
					ISNULL( dbo.o7gtcore2( trl_store, obj_part, obj_part_org, tra_org, NULL, NULL ), 0 )
				ELSE
					ISNULL( dbo.o7getprc2( trl_store, obj_part, obj_part_org, tra_org, N'B', NULL, NULL ), 0 )
				END,
				trl_io, obj_code, obj_org, obj_obtype, obj_obrtype, trl_event, trl_act, obj_lot, trl_bin, trl_splittrans
			FROM   r5objects,
				r5transactions,
				r5translines
			WHERE  obj_code  = @obj
			AND    obj_org   = @objorg
			AND    tra_code  = trl_trans
			AND    trl_trans = @trans
			AND    trl_line  = @line
		END
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT	@gt_org = str_org
			FROM	r5stores INNER JOIN r5fifo
								ON str_code = fif_store
			WHERE	fif_pk = CONVERT(NUMERIC(30, 0), @trans )

			INSERT INTO r5translines (	trl_part,
										trl_part_org,
										trl_store,
										trl_line,
										trl_type,
										trl_rtype,
										trl_trans,
										trl_date,
										trl_qty,
										trl_price,
										trl_io)
								SELECT	fif_part,
										fif_part_org,
										fif_store,
										1,
										@utype,
										N'CORR',
										@code,
										@GTTime,
										CASE WHEN @line IS NULL THEN fif_qty ELSE @line END,
										@price,
										 N'1'
								FROM	r5stores INNER JOIN r5fifo
													ON str_code = fif_store
								WHERE	fif_pk = CONVERT(NUMERIC(30, 0), @trans )
		END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CRDPSP   @sMrc           nvarchar(15),
                            @sProvider     nvarchar(30),
                            @sProviderorg  nvarchar(15),
                            @sSercat       nvarchar(30),
                            @sSercatorg    nvarchar(15),
                            @sSerprob      nvarchar(30),
                            @sChk          nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
AS
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sPscode        nvarchar(30)--r5departmentstructure.dps_code%TYPE
    declare @nReturn        numeric(38,0)                                  



     
   /* for all, create mrc if not exist*/
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT dps_mrc
    FROM r5departmentstructure
    WHERE dps_mrc = @sMrc
    AND dps_supplier IS NULL
    AND dps_servicecategory IS NULL
    AND dps_serviceproblem IS NULL ) 
        begin
            execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sPscode OUTPUT, N'DPS', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	            return -1
            INSERT INTO r5departmentstructure (dps_code, dps_mrc, dps_updatecount)
                                         values (@sPscode, @sMrc, 0)
        end  

    /* for scenario #5,6  create mrc and pd */
    IF( (@sProvider IS NOT NULL AND @sSercat IS NOT NULL AND @sSerprob IS NULL)
    OR (@sProvider IS NOT NULL AND @sSercat IS NULL AND @sSerprob IS NOT NULL) ) 
        begin
            IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT dps_mrc, dps_supplier
            FROM r5departmentstructure
            WHERE dps_mrc = @sMrc
            AND dps_supplier = @sProvider
            AND dps_supplier_org = @sProviderorg
            AND dps_servicecategory IS NULL
            AND dps_serviceproblem IS NULL ) 
                begin
                    execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sPscode OUTPUT, N'DPS', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	                    return -1

                    INSERT INTO r5departmentstructure (dps_code, dps_mrc, dps_supplier, dps_supplier_org, dps_updatecount)
                                         values (@sPscode, @sMrc, @sProvider, @sProviderorg, 0)
                end
        end
   
    /* for scenario #7  create mrc and sc */
    IF( @sProvider IS NULL AND @sSercat IS NOT NULL AND @sSerprob IS NOT NULL) 
        begin
            IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT dps_mrc, dps_servicecategory
            FROM r5departmentstructure
            WHERE dps_mrc = @sMrc
            AND dps_supplier IS NULL
            AND dps_servicecategory = @sSercat
            AND dps_servicecategory_org = @sSercatorg
            AND dps_serviceproblem IS NULL ) 
                begin
                    execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sPscode OUTPUT, N'DPS', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	                    return -1

                    INSERT INTO r5departmentstructure (dps_code, dps_mrc, dps_servicecategory, dps_servicecategory_org, dps_updatecount)
                    values (@sPscode, @sMrc, @sSercat, @sSercatorg, 0)
                end
        end  
  /*  for scenario #8  create mrc, pd and sc */
    IF( @sProvider IS NOT NULL AND @sSercat IS NOT NULL AND @sSerprob IS NOT NULL) 
       begin
        
            IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT dps_mrc, dps_supplier, dps_servicecategory
            FROM   r5departmentstructure
            WHERE  dps_mrc = @sMrc
            AND    dps_supplier = @sProvider
            AND    dps_supplier_org = @sProviderorg
            AND    dps_servicecategory = @sSercat
            AND    dps_servicecategory_org = @sSercatorg
            AND dps_serviceproblem IS NULL ) 
                begin
                    execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sPscode OUTPUT, N'DPS', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	                    return -1

                    INSERT INTO r5departmentstructure (dps_code, dps_mrc, dps_supplier, dps_supplier_org, dps_servicecategory, dps_servicecategory_org, dps_updatecount)
                    values (@sPscode, @sMrc, @sProvider, @sProviderorg, @sSercat, @sSercatorg, 0)
                end


            IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT dps_mrc, dps_supplier
            FROM r5departmentstructure
            WHERE dps_mrc = @sMrc
            AND dps_supplier = @sProvider
            AND dps_supplier_org = @sProviderorg
            AND dps_servicecategory IS NULL
            AND dps_serviceproblem IS NULL ) 
                begin
                    execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sPscode OUTPUT, N'DPS', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	                    return -1

                    INSERT INTO r5departmentstructure (dps_code, dps_mrc, dps_supplier, dps_supplier_org, dps_updatecount)
                    values (@sPscode, @sMrc, @sProvider, @sProviderorg, 0)
                end
        end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CREATEACTCHECKLIST
  @event      NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @act        NUMERIC( 8 ),
  @task       NVARCHAR( 20 ),
  @taskrev    NUMERIC( 4 ),
  @lotopk     NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @childwo    NVARCHAR( 30 ) = N'%',
  @routeupd   NVARCHAR( 1 ) = N'-',
  @pointupd   NVARCHAR( 1 ) = N'-',
  @objupd     NVARCHAR( 1 ) = N'-',
  @operatorcl NVARCHAR( 30 ) = NULL,
  @casetask   NVARCHAR( 30 ) = NULL,
  @nonconf    NVARCHAR( 30 ) = NULL
AS
  DECLARE @actact            NUMERIC( 8 )
  DECLARE @tchcode           NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @tchrepeating      NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @tchobjectlevel    NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @tchobjectclass    NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @tchobjectclassorg NVARCHAR( 15 )  
  DECLARE @tchobjectcategory NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @tchtype           NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @tchpointtype      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @tchaspect         NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @tchuom            NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @tchcomplocation   NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @tchpart           NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @tchpartorg        NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @tchpartcondition  NVARCHAR( 20 )
  DECLARE @tchpartclass      NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @tchpartclassorg   NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @tchpartcategory   NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @tchequipfilter    NVARCHAR( 500 )
  DECLARE @tchformula        NVARCHAR( 2000 )
  DECLARE @evtobject         NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @evtobjectorg      NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @evtfrompoint      NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @evttopoint        NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @evtroute          NVARCHAR( 20 )
  DECLARE @evtorg            NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @lrffrompoint      NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @lrftopoint        NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @lrfrefdesc        NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @lrfgeoref         NVARCHAR( 1000 )
  DECLARE @object            NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @objectorg         NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @frompoint         NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @topoint           NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @chk               NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @return            INT
  DECLARE @code              NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @occ               NUMERIC( 8 )
  DECLARE @pkey              NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @ockrentity        NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @ockorg            NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @ockjobplan        NVARCHAR( 20 )
  DECLARE @ockjobplanrev     NUMERIC( 4 )
  DECLARE @route             NVARCHAR( 20 )
  DECLARE @routerev          NUMERIC( 4 )
  DECLARE @seq               NUMERIC( 8 )
  DECLARE @ackcode           NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @acksequence       NUMERIC( 8 )
  DECLARE @ackroutesequence  NUMERIC( 8 )
  DECLARE @ackobject         NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @ackobjectorg      NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @ackformula        NVARCHAR( 2000 )
  DECLARE @str               NVARCHAR( 2000 )
  DECLARE @s                 NVARCHAR( 2000 )
  DECLARE @done              NVARCHAR( 1 ) 
  DECLARE @cnt               NUMERIC
  DECLARE @p                 NUMERIC
  DECLARE @inrange           NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @formulaused       NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @forcerenumbering  NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @chcklseq          NVARCHAR( 2000 )
  DECLARE @recordinserted    NVARCHAR( 1 )
  
BEGIN
  /* Return if no event or operator checklist has been specified. */
  IF @event IS NULL AND @operatorcl IS NULL
    RETURN

  IF @event IS NOT NULL
    /* Get the Work Order Org. */
    SELECT @evtorg   = evt_org,
           @chcklseq = opa_desc
    FROM   r5organizationoptions, r5events
    WHERE  opa_org  = evt_org
    AND    opa_code = N'CHCKLSEQ'
    AND    evt_code = @event

  SET @forcerenumbering = N'-'
  SET @recordinserted = N'-'

  IF @operatorcl IS NULL
    BEGIN
      /* First delete old records. */
      IF @pointupd = N'+'
        DELETE FROM r5actchecklists
        WHERE  ack_event = @event
        AND    ack_objectlevel = N'LR'
        AND EXISTS ( SELECT 'x'
                     FROM   r5objlinearref, r5events
                     WHERE  evt_code       = @event
                     AND    lrf_objcode    = evt_object
                     AND    lrf_objorg     = evt_object_org
                     AND    lrf_re_objcode = ack_object
                     AND    lrf_re_objorg  = ack_object_org
                     AND    lrf_refrtype   = N'RE'
                     AND  ( lrf_topoint < evt_frompoint OR lrf_frompoint > evt_topoint ) )
      ELSE IF @objupd = N'+'
        DELETE FROM r5actchecklists
        WHERE  ack_event = @event
        AND    ack_act = @act 
        AND    ack_objectlevel IN ( N'HDR', N'LR', N'LC' )
      ELSE
        DELETE FROM r5actchecklists
        WHERE  ack_event = @event
        AND    ack_act   = ISNULL( @act, ack_act )
        AND    ISNULL( ack_loto, N'x' ) = ISNULL( @lotopk, N'x' )
        AND    ISNULL( ack_casetask, N'x' ) = ISNULL( @casetask, N'x' )
        AND    ISNULL( ack_nonconformity, N'x' ) = ISNULL( @nonconf, N'x' )
        AND    @childwo   = N'%'
        AND    @routeupd  = N'-'
    
      IF @task IS NULL
        DECLARE tch CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR   
          SELECT act_act, tch_code, tch_repeating, tch_objectlevel, tch_objectclass, tch_objectclass_org, tch_objectcategory,
                 tch_type, tch_pointtype, tch_aspect, tch_uom, tch_complocation,
                 tch_part, tch_part_org, tch_partcondition, tch_partclass, tch_partclass_org, tch_partcategory, tch_equipfilter, tch_formula,
                 evt_object, evt_object_org, evt_frompoint, evt_topoint, evt_route, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL 
          FROM   r5events 
                 LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objects ON ( obj_code = evt_object AND obj_org = evt_object_org ), 
                 r5taskchecklists, 
                 r5tasks, 
                 r5activities
          WHERE  tch_task     = act_task
          AND    tch_taskrev  = act_taskrev
          AND    tsk_code     = act_task
          AND    tsk_revision = act_taskrev
          AND    evt_code     = act_event
          AND    act_event    = @event
          AND    act_act      = ISNULL( @act, act_act )
          AND    tch_notused  = N'-'
          AND    tsk_activechecklist = N'+'
          AND    @task IS NULL
          AND    ( (     tch_objectlevel = 'HDR' 
                     AND ISNULL( obj_class, N'x' )     = ISNULL( ISNULL( tch_objectclass, obj_class ), N'x' )
                     AND ISNULL( obj_class_org, N'x' ) = ISNULL( ISNULL( tch_objectclass_org, obj_class_org ), N'x' )
                     AND ISNULL( obj_category, N'x' )  = ISNULL( ISNULL( tch_objectcategory, obj_category ), N'x' ) ) OR tch_objectlevel <> 'HDR' )
      ELSE IF @lotopk IS NOT NULL
        DECLARE tch CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR   
          SELECT @act, tch_code, tch_repeating, tch_objectlevel, tch_objectclass, tch_objectclass_org, tch_objectcategory,
                 tch_type, tch_pointtype, tch_aspect, tch_uom, tch_complocation,
                 tch_part, tch_part_org, tch_partcondition, tch_partclass, tch_partclass_org, tch_partcategory, tch_equipfilter, tch_formula, 
                 NULL, NULL, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
          FROM   r5permittowork
                 LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objects ON ( obj_code = ptw_object AND obj_org = ptw_object_org ), 
                 r5taskchecklists, r5tasks
          WHERE  tsk_code     = tch_task
          AND    tsk_revision = tch_taskrev
          AND    tsk_code     = @task
          AND    tsk_revision = @taskrev
          AND    ptw_code     = @event
          AND    tch_notused  = N'-'
          AND    tsk_activechecklist = N'+'
          AND    tch_objectlevel = N'HDR' 
          AND    ISNULL( obj_class, N'x' )     = ISNULL( ISNULL( tch_objectclass, obj_class ), N'x' )
          AND    ISNULL( obj_class_org, N'x' ) = ISNULL( ISNULL( tch_objectclass_org, obj_class_org ), N'x' )
          AND    ISNULL( obj_category, N'x' )  = ISNULL( ISNULL( tch_objectcategory, obj_category ), N'x' ) 
      ELSE IF @casetask IS NO

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CREATEACTCHECKLIST_INSERT
  @itemtype      NVARCHAR( 1 ),
  @event         NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @lotopk        NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @source        NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @repeating     NVARCHAR( 1 ),
  @activity      NUMERIC( 8 ),
  @obj           NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @objorg        NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @cltype        NVARCHAR( 8 ),
  @pointtype     NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @aspect        NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @uom           NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @complocation  NVARCHAR( 80 ),
  @part          NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @partorg       NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @partcond      NVARCHAR( 20 ),
  @partclass     NVARCHAR( 8 ),
  @partclassorg  NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @partcategory  NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @equipfilter   NVARCHAR( 500 ),
  @formula       NVARCHAR( 2000 ),
  @route         NVARCHAR( 20 ),
  @frompoint     NUMERIC( 24, 6 ),
  @topoint       NUMERIC( 24, 6 ),
  @refdesc       NVARCHAR( 80 ),
  @georef        NVARCHAR( 1000 ),
  @entitykey     NVARCHAR( 100 ),
  @entity        NVARCHAR( 4 ),
  @entityorg     NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @ockjobplan    NVARCHAR( 20 ),
  @ockjobplanrev NUMERIC( 4 ),
  @casetask      NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @nonconf       NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @evtorg        NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @plinearloc    NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
AS
  DECLARE @code             NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @occ              NUMERIC( 8 )
  DECLARE @pkey             NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @apopoint         NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @apouom           NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @asprandom        NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @epartype         NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @epapart          NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @epapartorg       NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @epapartlocation  NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @epasyslevel      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @epaasmlevel      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @epacomplevel     NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @epafrompoint     NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @epatopoint       NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @eparefdesc       NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @epageoref        NVARCHAR( 1000 )
  DECLARE @return           INT
  DECLARE @chk              NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @checklistfilter  NVARCHAR( 500 )
  DECLARE @objrstatus       NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @objcategory      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @objclass         NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @objclassorg      NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @objtolsize       NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @string           NVARCHAR( 1000 )
  DECLARE @sevcount         NUMERIC
  DECLARE @posseverities    NVARCHAR( 500 )
  DECLARE @sum              NUMERIC
  DECLARE @seq              NUMERIC
  DECLARE @severity         NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @task             NVARCHAR( 20 )
  DECLARE @taskrev          NUMERIC( 4 )
  DECLARE @str              NVARCHAR( 2000 )
  DECLARE @naoptions        NVARCHAR( 500 )
  DECLARE @conoptions       NVARCHAR( 500 )
  DECLARE @naopt            NVARCHAR( 500 )
  DECLARE @conopt           NVARCHAR( 500 )
  DECLARE @s                NVARCHAR( 2000 )
  DECLARE @done             NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @p                NUMERIC( 2 )
  DECLARE @linearloc        NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
BEGIN
  SET @checklistfilter = NULL
  SET @objrstatus      = NULL
  SELECT @objrstatus      = obj_rstatus, 
         @objclass        = obj_class, 
         @objclassorg     = obj_class_org, 
         @objcategory     = obj_category, 
         @checklistfilter = obj_checklistfilter,
         @objtolsize      = obj_tolerance_size
  FROM   r5objects
  WHERE  obj_code = @obj
  AND    obj_org  = @objorg
  IF @objrstatus = N'D' 
    /* Don't create checklist items for withdrawn equipment. */
    RETURN
  IF @equipfilter IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      /* Make sure one of the codes in the tasks's equipfilter exists in the equipment's checklist filter. */
      WHILE @checklistfilter IS NOT NULL AND @checklistfilter <> N'match found'
        BEGIN
          IF CHARINDEX( N',', @checklistfilter ) = 0 
            BEGIN
              /* Last code, so set search string to entire checklist filter. Also set checklist filter to NULL, so loop will be exited. */
              SET @string = @checklistfilter
              SET @checklistfilter = NULL
            END
          ELSE
            BEGIN
              /* There are still multiple codes, set the search string to the first and remove it from the remaining checklist filter. */
              SET @string = SUBSTRING( @checklistfilter, 1, CHARINDEX( N',', @checklistfilter ) - 1 )
              SET @checklistfilter = SUBSTRING( @checklistfilter, CHARINDEX( N',', @checklistfilter ) + 1, 1000 )
            END
          IF CHARINDEX( N',' + @string + N',', N',' + @equipfilter + N',' ) > 0 
            /* If there is a match, set the checklist filter to a special value, so the loop will be exited. */
            SET @checklistfilter = N'match found'
        END
      IF @checklistfilter IS NULL 
        /* Return if no match found. */
        RETURN
    END

  /* Check if options need to be copied from the sequences used in the formula. */
  IF @formula IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      /* Get some task checklist data. */ 
      SELECT @task       = tch_task, 
             @taskrev    = tch_taskrev, 
             @naoptions  = tch_not_applicable_options, 
             @conoptions = tch_condition_options
      FROM   r5taskchecklists
      WHERE  tch_code = @source
      SET @str = @formula
      SET @done = N'-'
      /* Find all parameters (starting with :) in the current formula. */
      WHILE @done = N'-'
        BEGIN
          SET @str = SUBSTRING( @str, CHARINDEX( N':', @str ) + 1, 2000 )
          SET @s   = NULL
          SET @p   = 1
          WHILE @p <= 8
            BEGIN
              /* Find the sequence used in the formula. */
              IF SUBSTRING( @str, @p, 1 ) IN ( N'0', N'1', N'2', N'3', N'4', N'5', N'6', N'7', N'8', N'9' )
                BEGIN
                  /* If the current character is between 0 and 9, it is part of the sequence, so add it. */
                  IF @s IS NULL 
                    SET @s = SUBSTRING( @str, @p, 1 )
                  ELSE
                    SET @s = @s + SUBSTRING( @str, @p, 1 )
                END
              ELSE
                BEGIN
                  /* If the current character is not between 0 and 9, it is not part of the sequence, so exit the for loop. */
                  IF CHARINDEX( N':', @str ) = 0 
                    SET @done = N'+'
                  SET @p = 10
                END
              SET @p = @p + 1
            END 

          IF @s IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
              /* If a sequence found, find its options. */ 
              SET @naopt  = NULL
              SET @conopt = NULL
              SELECT @naopt  = tch_not_applicable_options, 
                     @conopt = tch_condition_options
              FROM   r5taskchecklists
              WHERE  tch_task     = @task
              AND    tch_taskrev  = @taskrev
              AND    tch_sequence = @s
              IF @naopt IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                  IF @naoptions IS NULL
                    SET @naoptions = @naopt
                  ELSE
                    BEGIN
                      IF LEN( @naoptions + N',' + @naopt ) <= 500 AND CHARINDEX( N',' + @naopt + N',' , N',' + @naoptions + N',' ) = 0
                        SET @naoptions = @naoptions + N',' + @naopt
                    END
                END
              IF @conopt IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                  IF @conoptions IS NULL
                    SET @conoptions = @conopt
                  ELSE
                    BEGIN
                      IF LEN( @conoptions + N',' + @conopt ) <= 500 AND CHARINDEX( N',' + @conopt + N',' , N',' + @conoptions + N',' ) = 0
                        SET @conoptions = @conoptions + N',' + @conopt
                    END
                END
            END
        END 
    END

  DECLARE apo CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT apo_point, apo_uom, N'-'
    FROM   r5

BEGIN

  DECLARE @taskrev     NUMERIC( 4 )
  DECLARE @supplier    NVARCHAR( 30 ) 
  DECLARE @supplierorg NVARCHAR( 15 ) 
  DECLARE @duration    NUMERIC( 8 )
  DECLARE @time        NUMERIC( 5, 2 )
  DECLARE @start       DATETIME
  DECLARE @special     NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @hire        NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @fixh        NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @minhours    NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @qty         NUMERIC( 10,2 )
  DECLARE @multrades   NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @ordtype     NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @ordrtype    NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @actparent   NUMERIC( 8 )
  DECLARE @routeparent NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @reusable    NVARCHAR( 1 )

  DECLARE @job         NVARCHAR( 20 )
  DECLARE @jobrev      NUMERIC( 4 )
  DECLARE @desc        NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @trade       NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @hours       NUMERIC( 14, 4 )
  DECLARE @matlist     NVARCHAR( 20 )
  DECLARE @uom         NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @rpc         NVARCHAR( 3 )
  DECLARE @wap         NVARCHAR( 3 )
  DECLARE @tpf         NVARCHAR( 3 )
  DECLARE @manufact    NVARCHAR( 24 )
  DECLARE @syslevel    NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @asmlevel    NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @complevel   NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @comploc     NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @mtlrev      NUMERIC( 4 )
  DECLARE @seq         NUMERIC( 4 )
  DECLARE @jobstart    NUMERIC( 3 )
  DECLARE @jmultrades  NVARCHAR( 1 )

  DECLARE @ptrade      NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @phours      NUMERIC( 14, 4 )
  DECLARE @ppersons    NUMERIC( 8 )
  DECLARE @phire       NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @tooldate    DATETIME
  DECLARE @pwarranty   NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @warranty    NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @preferredactsupplier    NVARCHAR( 30 ) 
  DECLARE @preferredactsupplierorg NVARCHAR( 15 ) 
  DECLARE @preferredjobsupplier    NVARCHAR( 30 ) 
  DECLARE @preferredjobsupplierorg NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @actsupp     NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @eventorg    NVARCHAR( 15 )
    
  SET @workday = dbo.O7DFLT2( N'WORKDAY' )

  /* Retrieve activity data. */
  SELECT @mrc         = act_mrc, 
         @task        = act_task,
         @taskrev     = act_taskrev,
         @supplier    = act_supplier, 
         @supplierorg = act_supplier_org, 
         @duration    = act_duration, 
         @time        = act_time, 
         @start       = act_start, 
         @special     = act_special, 
         @hire        = act_hire, 
         @fixh        = act_fixh, 
         @minhours    = act_minhours, 
         @qty         = act_qty, 
         @actparent   = act_parent,
         @ordtype     = act_ordtype,
         @ordrtype    = act_ordrtype,
         @pwarranty   = act_warranty,
         @copytool    = opa_desc,
         @multrades   = tsk_multipletrades,
         @routeparent = evt_routeparent,
         @eventorg    = evt_org,
         @preferredactsupplier = tsk_prefsup,
         @preferredactsupplierorg = tsk_prefsup_org
  FROM   r5organizationoptions,
         r5events, 
         r5activities a
         LEFT OUTER JOIN r5tasks ON ( tsk_code = act_task AND tsk_revision = act_taskrev )
  WHERE  evt_code  = act_event
  AND    opa_org   = evt_org
  AND    opa_code  = N'COPYTOOL'
  AND    act_event = @event
  AND    act_act   = @activity

  /* Delete old data first. */
  IF @deleteold = N'+'
    BEGIN
      DELETE FROM r5activities
      WHERE  act_event     = @event
      AND    act_topparent = @activity
      DELETE FROM r5toolplan
      WHERE  tpl_event     = @event
      AND    tpl_act       = @activity
      DELETE FROM r5toolreq
      WHERE  tor_event     = @event
      AND    tor_act       = @activity
    END

  /* Get lowest act number. */
  SELECT @minact = ISNULL( MIN( act_act ), 0 )
  FROM   r5activities
  WHERE  act_event = @event
  SET @minact = dbo.F_LEAST_NUMBER( 0, @minact )

  EXECUTE @return = o7getorgoption @actsupp OUTPUT, N'ACTSUPP', @eventorg, @chk2 OUTPUT 
  IF @task IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      /* Loop through all job plans. */
      DECLARE tsk CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
        SELECT tsk_code, tsk_revision, tsk_desc, tsk_trade, tsk_hours, tsk_persons, tsk_matlist, tsk_uom, tsk_rpc, tsk_wap, tsk_tpf, tsk_reusable,
               tsk_manufact, tsk_syslevel, tsk_asmlevel, tsk_complevel, tsk_complocation, tsk_multipletrades, mtl_revision, tpj_seq, tpj_start, tsk_prefsup, tsk_prefsup_org
        FROM   r5tasks 
               LEFT OUTER JOIN r5matlists ON ( mtl_code = tsk_matlist AND mtl_revrstatus = 'A' ), r5taskplanjobs
        WHERE  tsk_code       = tpj_jobplan
        AND    tsk_revrstatus = N'A'
        AND    tpj_task       = @task
        AND    tpj_taskrev    = @taskrev
        AND    tsk_code       = ISNULL( @pjob, tsk_code )
      OPEN tsk
      FETCH NEXT FROM tsk INTO @job, @jobrev, @desc, @trade, @hours, @persons, @matlist, @uom, @rpc, @wap, @tpf, @reusable,
                               @manufact, @syslevel, @asmlevel, @complevel, @comploc, @jmultrades, @mtlrev, @seq, @jobstart, @preferredjobsupplier, @preferredjobsupplierorg
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          SET @recs     = 0
          SET @minact   = @minact - 1
          SET @parent   = @minact
          SET @persons  = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( CEILING( @hours / @duration / ISNULL( @workday, 8 ) ), @persons )
          SET @ntrate   = 0
          SET @otrate   = 0
          SET @actstart = @start + @jobstart - 1
          EXECUTE @return = o7boorat @ntrate OUTPUT, @mrc, @trade, NULL, N'N', @actstart, N'ZZ', N'*', 0, 0, 0, 0, NULL, @chk2
          EXECUTE @return = o7boorat @otrate OUTPUT, @mrc, @trade, NULL, N'O', @actstart, N'ZZ', N'*', 0, 0, 0, 0, NULL, @chk2
          IF @pwarranty = N'+'
            SET @warranty = N'+'
          ELSE
            SET @warranty = dbo.o7getactwarranty( @event, @syslevel, @asmlevel, @complevel, @rpc, @wap )
            
          INSERT INTO r5activities( act_event, act_act, act_note, act_mrc, act_supplier, act_supplier_org, 
                 act_trade, act_duration, act_est, act_rem, act_task, act_taskrev, act_matlist, act_matlrev, 
                 act_persons, act_time, act_start, act_special, 
                 act_hire, act_rpc, act_wap, act_tpf, act_manufact, 
                 act_syslevel, act_asmlevel, act_complevel, act_complocation, act_fixh, act_minhours, act_ntrate, act_otrate, act_qty, act_uom, 
                 act_planninglevel, act_multipletrades, act_topparent, act_parent, act_seq, act_ordtype, act_ordrtype, act_warranty )
          VALUES( @event, @minact, CASE ISNULL(@reusable,'-') WHEN '-' THEN @desc ELSE NULL END, @mrc, 
				 CASE
                     WHEN @hire = N'+' AND @supplier IS NOT NULL THEN @supplier
					 WHEN @hire = N'+' AND @supplier IS NULL AND @actsupp = N'YES' THEN @preferredJobSupplier 
                     ELSE NULL END, 
                 CASE 
                     WHEN @hire = N'+' AND @supplier IS NOT NULL THEN @supplierorg
					 WHEN @hire = N'+' AND @supplier IS NULL AND @actsupp = N'YES' THEN @preferredJobSupplierOrg 
                     ELSE NULL END, 
                  @trade, @duration, @hours, @hours, @job, @jobrev, @matlist, @mtlrev, 
                  @persons, @time, @start + @jobstart - 1, @special, @hire, @rpc, @wap, @tpf, @manufact, 
                  @syslevel, @asmlevel, @complevel, @comploc, @fixh, @minhours, @ntrate

  /* Get some object data. */
  SELECT @objcode  = obj_code,

  FROM   r5objects
  WHERE  obj_configcode     = @configcode
  AND    obj_org            = @configorg
  AND    obj_configrevision = @configrevision
 
  IF @objcode IS NULL 
    BEGIN
      /* Not a correct config code provided, return. */
      SET @chk = N'2'
      RETURN
    END
  
  IF @newconfigcode IS NULL 
    BEGIN
      /* New revision. */
      /* Check number of Unfinished/Request Approval configs. */
      SELECT @cnt = COUNT( * )
      FROM   r5objects
      WHERE  obj_configcode = @configcode
      AND    obj_org        = @configorg
      AND    obj_configrstatus IN ( N'U', N'RA' )
  
      IF @cnt > 0 
        BEGIN
          /* There is already a Unfinished/Request Approval record, new revision is not allowed, return. */
          SET @chk = N'1'
          RETURN
        END
  
      /* Get new revision number. */
      SELECT @newrevision = MAX( obj_configrevision ) + 1
      FROM   r5objects
      WHERE  obj_configcode = @configcode
      AND    obj_org        = @configorg
      SET @actconfigcode = @configcode
    END 
  ELSE

      /* Copy revision. */
      SET @newrevision   = 0
      SET @actconfigcode = @newconfigcode
    END

  /* Get new object code. */
  EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7maxseq @newobjcode OUTPUT, N'AUTOOBJ', N'1', @chk2 OUTPUT

  SELECT @status = uco_code

         obj_acd, obj_notused, obj_safety, obj_criticality, obj_profile, obj_manufactmodel, obj_manufactrevnum, obj_value, obj_sourcesystem,

         obj_lot, obj_syslevel, obj_asmlevel, obj_complevel,  obj_updated, obj_updatedby, obj_preventevtcomp, obj_person, obj_esignature, 
         obj_updatecount, obj_dormstart, obj_dormend, obj_dormreuse, obj_gisobjid, obj_gisprofile, obj_profile_org, obj_solddate, 
         obj_transferdate, obj_cgmp, obj_testpointuom, obj_outputuom, obj_increment, obj_precision, obj_pidno, obj_piddrawing, 
         obj_serviceperc, obj_devicetolfrom, obj_devicetolto, obj_devicetoltype, obj_devicerangefrom, obj_devicerangeto, obj_outputrangefrom, 
         obj_outputrangeto, obj_processtolfrom, obj_processtolto, obj_processrangefrom, obj_processrangeto, obj_set, obj_sop, obj_loop, 
         obj_instrument, obj_instrumenttype, obj_interface, obj_linkgiswo, obj_gislayer, obj_xlocation, obj_ylocation, obj_length, 
         obj_lengthuom, obj_linearrefuom, obj_linearrefprecision, obj_georef, obj_vehicle, obj_fleetcustomer, obj_fleetcustomer_org, 
         obj_billingcode, obj_billingcode_org, obj_markupcode, obj_markupcode_org, obj_vehiclerstatus, obj_vehiclestatus, obj_issuedto, 
         obj_jecategory, obj_jesource, obj_gltransferflag, obj_gltransfer, obj_minpenalty, obj_penaltyfactor, obj_calgroup, obj_calgrouporg, 
         obj_udfchar01, obj_udfchar02, obj_udfchar03, obj_udfchar04, obj_udfchar05, obj_udfchar06, obj_udfchar07, obj_udfchar08, 
         obj_udfchar09, obj_udfchar10, obj_udfchar11, obj_udfchar12, obj_udfchar13, obj_udfchar14, obj_udfchar15, obj_udfchar16,

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CREATENONCONFORMITY
  @code    NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @event   NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @usr     NVARCHAR( 255 ),
  @repair  NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @newpk   NVARCHAR( 30 ) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @person         NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @astatus        NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @sstatus        NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @ustatus        NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @repairstatus   NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @org            NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @severity       NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @intensity      NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @size           NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @importance     NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @score          NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @index          NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @nextdate       DATETIME
  DECLARE @task           NVARCHAR( 20 )
  DECLARE @taskrev        NUMERIC( 4 )
  DECLARE @rstatus        NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @status         NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @newobservation NUMERIC( 4 )
  DECLARE @chk            NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @return         INT

  /* Get new pk. */
  EXECUTE r5o7_o7maxseq @newpk OUTPUT, N'NCFPK', N'1', @chk OUTPUT
  SET @newpk = N'PK'+@newpk

  /* Get next observation. */
  SELECT @newobservation = COALESCE( MAX( nco_observation ), 0 ) + 1
  FROM   r5nonconformobservations
  WHERE  nco_code = @code
  
  /* Get person from user. */
  SELECT @person = per_code
  FROM   r5organization, r5nonconformities, r5personnel
  WHERE  org_code = per_org
  AND    ( org_common = N'+' OR ncf_org = per_org )
  AND    ncf_code   = @code
  AND    per_user = @usr

  /* Retrieve some default user statusses. */
  EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7ucode @astatus OUTPUT, N'A', N'NOST', @chk OUTPUT
  EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7ucode @sstatus OUTPUT, N'S', N'NOST', @chk OUTPUT
  EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7ucode @ustatus OUTPUT, N'U', N'NOST', @chk OUTPUT
  EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7ucode @repairstatus OUTPUT, N'R', N'NOST', @chk OUTPUT

  /* Do actual insert of new nonconformity. */
  INSERT INTO r5nonconformobservations( nco_pk, nco_code, nco_observation, nco_task, nco_taskrev, nco_status, nco_rstatus, nco_severity, 
         nco_intensity, nco_size, nco_importance, nco_recorded, nco_recordedby, nco_conditionscore, nco_conditionindex, 
         nco_nextinspectdate, nco_nextinspectdateoverride, nco_workorder, nco_created, nco_createdby, nco_updated, nco_updatedby )
  SELECT @newpk, ncf_code, @newobservation, tsk_code, tsk_revision,  
         CASE @repair WHEN 'U' THEN @ustatus
                      WHEN 'R' THEN @repairstatus 
                      ELSE ( CASE ncp_useobsstatus WHEN N'NO' THEN @ustatus ELSE CASE COALESCE( uco_code, N'x' ) WHEN N'x' THEN @ustatus ELSE ncp_reinspectstatus END END ) END, 
         CASE @repair WHEN 'R' THEN  N'R' ELSE N'U' END,  
         CASE ncp_includecondition WHEN N'+' THEN ncf_severity ELSE NULL END, 
         CASE ncp_includecondition WHEN N'+' THEN ncf_intensity ELSE NULL END, 
         CASE ncp_includecondition WHEN N'+' THEN ncf_size ELSE NULL END, 
         CASE ncp_includecondition WHEN N'+' THEN ncf_importance ELSE NULL END, 
         dbo.o7gttime2( ncf_org ), @person, NULL, NULL, NULL,
         CASE ncp_includecondition WHEN N'+' THEN ncf_nextinspectdateoverride ELSE NULL END, 
         @event, dbo.o7gttime2( ncf_org ), @usr, NULL, NULL
  FROM   r5nonconformitysetup
           LEFT OUTER JOIN r5ucodes ON ( uco_rentity = N'NOST' AND uco_rcode = N'U' AND uco_code = ncp_reinspectstatus ), 
         r5nonconformities
           LEFT OUTER JOIN r5nonconformitytypes 
                LEFT OUTER JOIN r5tasks ON ( tsk_code = nct_chklst_task AND tsk_revrstatus = N'A' )
           ON ( nct_code = ncf_ncttype AND nct_org = ncf_ncttype_org )
  WHERE  ncp_org  = ncf_org
  AND    ncf_code = @code

  /* Retrieve some data from just created record. */
  SELECT @org        = ncf_org, 
         @severity   = nco_severity, 
         @intensity  = nco_intensity, 
         @size       = nco_size, 
         @importance = nco_importance, 
         @task       = nco_task, 
         @taskrev    = nco_taskrev, 
         @rstatus    = nco_rstatus,
         @status     = nco_status
  FROM   r5nonconformities, r5nonconformobservations
  WHERE  ncf_code = nco_code
  AND    nco_pk   = @newpk
  
  /* Update header, if necessary. */
  EXECUTE o7updatenonconformity @code, @status

  /* Retrieve the condition data. */
  EXECUTE o7getconditionscore @org, @severity, @intensity, @size, @importance, @score OUTPUT, @index OUTPUT, @nextdate OUTPUT

  /* Update the condition data. */
  IF @score IS NOT NULL OR @index IS NOT NULL OR @nextdate IS NOT NULL
    UPDATE r5nonconformobservations
    SET    nco_conditionscore  = @score, 
           nco_conditionindex  = @index, 
           nco_nextinspectdate = @nextdate
    WHERE  nco_pk = @newpk

  /* Create checklist. */
  IF @task IS NOT NULL
    EXECUTE o7createactchecklist @newpk, 0, @task, @taskrev, NULL, N'%', N'-', N'-', N'-', NULL, NULL, @newpk 
    
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CREATEORDELETEORGINVOICESEQ
        @sOperation     nvarchar(30),
        @sOrganization  nvarchar(15)
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @sStatement NVARCHAR( 200 )
  DECLARE @sOrgseq NVARCHAR( 30 )
  
  SET @sOrgseq = 'SEQ_S5'+@sOrganization+'INVOI'
  
  IF  @sOperation = N'CREATEORGINVOICESEQ'
    SET @sStatement = 'CREATE TABLE "'+@sOrgseq+'" ( SEQ_NEXTVALUE INT IDENTITY ( 10000, 1 ) CONSTRAINT "PK_SEQ_'+@sOrganization+'INVOI" PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED, SEQ_DUMMY int )';
  ELSE IF @sOperation = N'DELETEORGINVOICESEQ'
    SET @sStatement = 'DROP TABLE "'+@sOrgseq+'" ';
  ELSE IF @sOperation = N'DELETEORGCUSTINVOICESEQ'
    SET @sStatement = 'DROP TABLE "SEQ_S5'+@sOrganization+'CUSTINVOI"';
  
  IF @sStatement <>''
    EXECUTE sp_executesql @sStatement
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CREATEPARTCLAIMTRANSACTION
  @partclaim NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @eamuser   NVARCHAR( 255 ) 
AS
  DECLARE @return  INT
  DECLARE @chk     NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @cnt     NUMERIC
  DECLARE @org     NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @sup     NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @suporg  NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @tdesc   NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @trans   NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @line    NUMERIC
  DECLARE @ltype   NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @store   NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @part    NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @partorg NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @qty     NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @bin     NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @lot     NVARCHAR( 12 )
  
  EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7ucode @ltype OUTPUT, N'RECV', N'TRTP', @chk OUTPUT

  /* Check whether there are transaction lines to be created. */
  SELECT @cnt = COUNT(*)
  FROM   r5partwarrantyclaimparts, r5partwarrantyclaims
  WHERE  pwp_partclaim = pwa_code
  AND    pwa_rstatus   = N'C'
  AND    pwp_partclaim = @partclaim
  AND    pwp_settlementreplacementqty > 0
  IF @cnt = 0 
    /* No transaction to create, so return. */
    RETURN
  
  /* Get part claim data. */
  SELECT @org    = pwa_org, 
         @sup    = ISNULL( pwa_supplier, N'*' ), 
         @suporg = ISNULL( pwa_supplier_org, ins_desc ), 
         @tdesc  = atx_text
  FROM   r5alltexts, r5install, r5users, r5partwarrantyclaims
  WHERE  pwa_code     = @partclaim
  AND    usr_code     = @eamuser
  AND    ins_code     = N'DEFORG'
  AND    atx_code     = N'12830'
  AND    atx_texttype = N'BOIL'
  AND    atx_lang     = usr_lang
    
  DECLARE c_pwp CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT DISTINCT pwp_settlementreceivingstore
    FROM   r5partwarrantyclaimparts
    WHERE  pwp_partclaim = @partclaim
    AND    pwp_settlementreplacementqty > 0
  OPEN c_pwp
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_pwp INTO @store
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      /* Create transaction header for each distinct store. */
      EXECUTE @return = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @trans OUTPUT, N'TRAN', N'1', @chk OUTPUT
      INSERT INTO r5transactions( tra_code, tra_org, tra_desc, tra_auth, tra_rtype, tra_date, 
             tra_fromcode, tra_fromcode_org, tra_fromrentity, tra_fromrtype,
             tra_tocode, tra_torentity, tra_tortype, tra_rstatus, tra_printed )
      VALUES( @trans, @org, @tdesc + N' #: ' + @partclaim, @eamuser, N'RECV', dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2( @org ),  N'DD' ),
              @sup, @suporg, N'COMP', N'*',
              @store, N'STOR', N'*', N'A', N'-' )
      SET @line = 0
      DECLARE c_pwp2 CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
        SELECT pwp_part, pwp_part_org, pwp_settlementreplacementqty, pwp_settlementreceivingbin, pwp_settlementreceivinglot
        FROM   r5partwarrantyclaimparts
        WHERE  pwp_partclaim = @partclaim
        AND    pwp_settlementreceivingstore = @store
        AND    pwp_settlementreplacementqty > 0
      OPEN c_pwp2
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_pwp2 INTO @part, @partorg, @qty, @bin, @lot
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          /* Create stock record, if it does not exist yet. */
          INSERT INTO r5stock( sto_store, sto_part, sto_part_org )
          SELECT @store, @part, @partorg
          FROM   dual
          WHERE NOT EXISTS( SELECT N'x'
                            FROM   r5stock
                            WHERE  sto_store    = @store
                            AND    sto_part     = @part
                            AND    sto_part_org = @partorg )
          /* Create transaction lines. */
          SET @line = @line + 1
          INSERT INTO r5translines( trl_trans, trl_line, trl_part, trl_part_org, trl_store, trl_type, trl_rtype,
                 trl_date, trl_qty, trl_bin, trl_lot, trl_io, trl_price )
          VALUES ( @trans, @line, @part, @partorg, @store, @ltype, N'RECV',
                   dbo.o7gttime2( @org ), @qty, @bin, @lot, N'1',
                   ISNULL( dbo.o7getprc( @store, @part, @partorg, @org, N'B', NULL, NULL ), 0 ) )
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_pwp2 INTO @part, @partorg, @qty, @bin, @lot
        END
      CLOSE c_pwp2
      DEALLOCATE c_pwp2
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_pwp INTO @store
    END
  CLOSE c_pwp
  DEALLOCATE c_pwp
