CREATE PROCEDURE O7CREATEPTW
  @pevcode   NVARCHAR( 34 ),
  @wo        NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @puser     NVARCHAR( 255 ) = NULL 
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @ptw           NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @permit        NVARCHAR( 100 )
  DECLARE @lotorequired  NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @isolationtype NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @object        NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @objectorg     NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @entity        NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @evtorg        NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @r5user        NVARCHAR( 255 )
  DECLARE @pk            NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @return        INT
  DECLARE @chk           NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @olopk         NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @olomethod     NVARCHAR( 20 )
  DECLARE @tskrevision   NUMERIC( 4 )
  DECLARE @percode       NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @maxline       NUMERIC
  
  IF @puser IS NOT NULL
    SET @r5user = @puser
  ELSE  
    EXECUTE @return = o7esign_getuser @r5user OUTPUT
    
  SET @r5user = ISNULL( @r5user, 'R5' )  

  /* Get employee code of user. */
  SELECT @percode = per_code
  FROM   r5personnel
  WHERE  per_user = @r5user
    
  /* Get new ptw code. */
  EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7maxseq @ptw OUTPUT, N'PTW', N'1', @chk OUTPUT

  /* Insert new PTW record. */
  INSERT INTO r5permittowork( ptw_code, ptw_org, ptw_desc, ptw_object, ptw_object_org, ptw_type, ptw_mrc, ptw_rstatus, ptw_status,
         ptw_reviewed, ptw_reviewedby, ptw_reviewedtype, ptw_location, ptw_location_org, ptw_locationnote, ptw_class, ptw_class_org,
         ptw_typeofwork, ptw_priority, ptw_risk, ptw_lockoutbox, ptw_lockoutbox_org, ptw_unassessedconflicts, ptw_event, ptw_act, ptw_permit,
         ptw_permit_org, ptw_permitrev, ptw_replacesptw, ptw_replacedbyptw, ptw_created, ptw_createdby, ptw_requested, ptw_requestedby,
         ptw_updated, ptw_updatedby, ptw_prepared, ptw_preparedby, ptw_responsible, ptw_holder, ptw_isolated, ptw_daterequired,
         ptw_duration, ptw_extension, ptw_validuntil, ptw_durationtotal, ptw_extensioncount, ptw_suspensionreason,
         ptw_udfchar01, ptw_udfchar02, ptw_udfchar03, ptw_udfchar04, ptw_udfchar05,
         ptw_udfchar06, ptw_udfchar07, ptw_udfchar08, ptw_udfchar09, ptw_udfchar10,
         ptw_udfchar11, ptw_udfchar12, ptw_udfchar13, ptw_udfchar14, ptw_udfchar15,
         ptw_udfchar16, ptw_udfchar17, ptw_udfchar18, ptw_udfchar19, ptw_udfchar20,
         ptw_udfchar21, ptw_udfchar22, ptw_udfchar23, ptw_udfchar24, ptw_udfchar25,
         ptw_udfchar26, ptw_udfchar27, ptw_udfchar28, ptw_udfchar29, ptw_udfchar30,
         ptw_udfnum01, ptw_udfnum02, ptw_udfnum03, ptw_udfnum04, ptw_udfnum05,
         ptw_udfdate01, ptw_udfdate02, ptw_udfdate03, ptw_udfdate04, ptw_udfdate05,
         ptw_udfchkbox01, ptw_udfchkbox02, ptw_udfchkbox03, ptw_udfchkbox04, ptw_udfchkbox05 )
  SELECT @ptw, evt_org, evt_desc, evt_object, evt_object_org, pev_ptwtype, evt_mrc, N'U', uco_code,
         NULL, NULL, NULL, evt_location, evt_location_org, NULL, NULL, NULL,
         pev_typeofwork, pev_priority, pev_risk, NULL, NULL, N'-', @wo, pev_activity, pev_permit,
         pev_permit_org, pev_permitrev, NULL, NULL, dbo.o7gttime2( evt_org ), @r5user, dbo.o7gttime2( evt_org ), @percode, 
         NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, N'-', evt_target,
         NULL, NULL, NULL, 0, NULL, NULL,
         pev_udfchar01, pev_udfchar02, pev_udfchar03, pev_udfchar04, pev_udfchar05,
         pev_udfchar06, pev_udfchar07, pev_udfchar08, pev_udfchar09, pev_udfchar10,
         pev_udfchar11, pev_udfchar12, pev_udfchar13, pev_udfchar14, pev_udfchar15,
         pev_udfchar16, pev_udfchar17, pev_udfchar18, pev_udfchar19, pev_udfchar20,
         pev_udfchar21, pev_udfchar22, pev_udfchar23, pev_udfchar24, pev_udfchar25,
         pev_udfchar26, pev_udfchar27, pev_udfchar28, pev_udfchar29, pev_udfchar30,
         pev_udfnum01, pev_udfnum02, pev_udfnum03, pev_udfnum04, pev_udfnum05,
         pev_udfdate01, pev_udfdate02, pev_udfdate03, pev_udfdate04, pev_udfdate05,
         pev_udfchkbox01, pev_udfchkbox02, pev_udfchkbox03, pev_udfchkbox04, pev_udfchkbox05
  FROM   r5organizationoptions, r5ucodes, r5permevents, r5events
  WHERE  evt_code    = COALESCE(pev_relatedwo,pev_event)
  AND    pev_code    = @pevcode
  AND    uco_rentity = N'PWST'
  AND    uco_rcode   = N'U'
  AND    uco_system  = N'+'
  AND    opa_code    = N'PTWMEC'
  AND    opa_org     = evt_org

  /* Get some permit event data. */
  SELECT @permit        = pev_permit + N'#' + CAST( pev_permitrev AS NVARCHAR )+ N'#' + pev_permit_org,
         @lotorequired  = pev_lotorequired, 
         @isolationtype = pev_isolationtype, 
         @object        = evt_object, 
         @objectorg     = evt_object_org, 
         @entity        = CASE evt_obrtype WHEN N'L' THEN N'LOC' ELSE N'OBJ' END, 
         @evtorg        = evt_org
  FROM   r5events, r5permevents
  WHERE  pev_event = evt_code
  AND    pev_code  = @pevcode

  /* Copy comments from permit. */
  EXECUTE @return = o7wosafetypermit_inscomdoc N'PERM', N'PTW', @permit, @ptw, 0, N'-'

  /* Get max line number. */
  SELECT @maxline = ISNULL( MAX( add_line ), 0 )
  FROM   r5addetails
  WHERE  add_rentity = N'PTW'
  AND    add_code    = @ptw

  /* Copy comments from permit event. */
  EXECUTE @return = o7wosafetypermit_inscomdoc N'PRME', N'PTW', @pevcode, @ptw, @maxline, N'-'

  /* Create safety records. */
  EXECUTE @return = o7wosafetypermit N'PTW', @ptw, N'INSERT', N'S', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
  
  /* Create LOTO records. */
  DECLARE olo CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT olo_pk, olo_isolationmethod, tsk_revision
    FROM   r5tasks, r5objectloto
    WHERE  tsk_code          = olo_isolationmethod
    AND    tsk_revrstatus    = 'A'
    AND    olo_object        = @object
    AND    olo_object_org    = @objectorg
    AND    olo_isolationtype = @isolationtype
  OPEN olo
  FETCH NEXT FROM olo INTO @olopk, @olomethod, @tskrevision
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      /* Get new pwl code. */
      EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7maxseq @pk OUTPUT, N'PWL', N'1', @chk OUTPUT
      INSERT INTO r5permittoworkloto( pwl_pk, pwl_ptw, pwl_sequence, pwl_isolationmethod, pwl_isolationmethodrev, pwl_isolationstep,
             pwl_isolationpoint, pwl_isolationpoint_org, pwl_isolationpointrev, pwl_isolationtype, pwl_energysource, pwl_locationnote,
             pwl_numberoftags, pwl_residualenergy, pwl_residualenergy2, pwl_note, pwl_key,
             pwl_created, pwl_createdby, pwl_updated, pwl_updatedby, pwl_reviewed, pwl_reviewedby, pwl_reviewedname, pwl_reviewedtype,
             pwl_validuntil, pwl_deletepending, pwl_sourcerentity, pwl_sourcecode, pwl_sourceorg, pwl_sourcedate, pwl_sourceby,
             pwl_udfchar01, pwl_udfchar02, pwl_udfchar03, pwl_udfchar04, pwl_udfchar05,
             pwl_udfchar06, pwl_udfchar07, pwl_udfchar08, pwl_udfchar09, pwl_udfchar10,
             pwl_udfchar11, pwl_udfchar12, pwl_udfchar13, pwl_udfchar14, pwl_udfchar15,
             pwl_udfchar16, pwl_udfchar17, pwl_udfchar18, pwl_udfchar19, pwl_udfchar20,
             pwl_udfchar21, pwl_udfchar22, pwl_udfchar23, pwl_udfchar24, pwl_udfchar25,
             pwl_udfchar26, pwl_udfchar27, pwl_udfchar28, pwl_udfchar29, pwl_udfchar30,
             pwl_udfnum01, pwl_udfnum02, pwl_udfnum03, pwl_udfnum04, pwl_udfnum05,
             pwl_udfdate01, pwl_udfdate02, pwl_udfdate03, pwl_udfdate04, pwl_udfdate05,
             pwl_udfchkbox01, pwl_udfchkbox02, pwl_udfchkbox03, pwl_udfchkbox04, pwl_udfchkbox05 )
      SELECT @pk, @ptw, olo_sequence, olo_isolationmethod, @tskrevision, olo_isolationstep,
             olo_isolationpoint, olo_isolationpoint_org, isp_revision, olo_isolationtype, olo_energysource, olo_locationnote,
             olo_numberoftags, olo_residualenergy, olo_residualenergy2, NULL, NULL,
             dbo.o7gttime2( @evtorg ), @r5user, NULL, NULL, olo_reviewed, olo_reviewedby, olo_reviewedname, olo_reviewedtype,
             obj_lotoreviewrequired, olo_deletepending, @entity, @o

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CREATESURVEYEVENTS
  @entity   NVARCHAR(  4 ),
  @code     NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @org      NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @status   NVARCHAR(  4 )
AS
BEGIN

  DECLARE @svtsurvey       NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @svtsurveyorg    NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @svtentity       NVARCHAR(  4 )
  DECLARE @svtstatus       NVARCHAR(  4 )
  DECLARE @svtemailsource  NVARCHAR(  4 )
  DECLARE @pk              NVARCHAR( 50 )
  DECLARE @chk             NVARCHAR(  4 )
  DECLARE @return          INT
  DECLARE @cnt             NUMERIC
  DECLARE @ran             NVARCHAR( 30 )

  /* Loop through all related survey triggers. */
  DECLARE svt CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT svt_survey, svt_survey_org, svt_entity, svt_status, svt_emailsource
    FROM   r5organization, r5customersurveys, r5customersurveytriggers
    WHERE  org_code    = svt_survey_org
    AND    csu_code    = svt_survey
    AND    csu_org     = svt_survey_org
    AND    svt_entity  = @entity
    AND    svt_status  = @status
    AND    svt_notused = N'-'
    AND    csu_rstatus = N'A'
    AND    ( org_common = N'+' OR svt_survey_org = @org )
    AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( getdate(), N'DD' ) BETWEEN csu_effective AND csu_discontinue
  OPEN svt
  FETCH NEXT FROM svt INTO @svtsurvey, @svtsurveyorg, @svtentity, @svtstatus, @svtemailsource 
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7maxseq @pk OUTPUT, N'SEV', N'1', @chk OUTPUT      
      SET @cnt = 1
      SET @ran = ''
      WHILE @cnt < 21
        BEGIN
          SET @ran = @ran + SUBSTRING( 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789', CONVERT( int, ( rand() * 36 ) + 1 ), 1 )
          SET @cnt = @cnt + 1
        END
      SET @pk = @ran + @pk
      INSERT INTO r5customersurveyevents( sev_pk, sev_survey, sev_survey_org, sev_entity, sev_status, sev_emailsource, sev_code, sev_org, sev_date )
      VALUES( @pk, @svtsurvey, @svtsurveyorg, @svtentity, @svtstatus, @svtemailsource, @code, @org, getdate() )
      FETCH NEXT FROM svt INTO @svtsurvey, @svtsurveyorg, @svtentity, @svtstatus, @svtemailsource 
    END
  CLOSE svt
  DEALLOCATE svt
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CREATEUDSTABLE @sScreenName     NVARCHAR(6),
    @sChk       NVARCHAR(4)  OUTPUT 
AS
BEGIN

    declare @sCreateTableSql        nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sCreatePKSql           nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sCreateIdentityIndexSql nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sCreateSequence        nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sUpdateCountTrigger    nvarchar(4000)

    declare @sPostUpdateTrigger     nvarchar(4000)

    declare @sNewKeyFieldIntoList   nvarchar(1000)
    declare @sNewKeyValues          nvarchar(1000)
    declare @sKeyValues             nvarchar(1000)
    declare @sTableName             nvarchar(20)
    declare @sEntity                nvarchar(4)
    declare @sFieldDescription      nvarchar(80)
    declare @sFieldName             nvarchar(60)
    declare @sFieldLabel            nvarchar(255)
    declare @sFieldType             nvarchar(15)
    declare @sNullable              nvarchar(1)
    declare @sPrimary               nvarchar(1)
    declare @nMaxlength             numeric(4)
    declare @nSequence              numeric(3)
    declare @nPrecision             numeric(2)
    declare @nScale                 numeric(1)
    declare @nKeyFieldCount         int
    declare @sAuditpkColDataType    nvarchar(30)
    declare @nAuditsequence         numeric(3)
    
    SET @sCreateTableSql = 'CREATE TABLE '
    SET @sCreatePKSql = 'ALTER TABLE '
    SET @sNewKeyFieldList = ''
    SET @sNewKeyFieldIntoList = ''
    SET @sNewKeyValues = ''
    SET @nKeyFieldCount = 0
    SET @sPostTriggerDeclare = ''
    SET @nAuditsequence = 1
    
    DECLARE cursor_udsscreen CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT  usc_tablename, usc_entity
    FROM    r5udfscreens
    WHERE   usc_screenname = @sScreenName 
    AND     coalesce(usc_notused, '-') = '-'
    
    OPEN cursor_udsscreen
    FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_udsscreen INTO @sTableName, @sEntity 
    CLOSE cursor_udsscreen
    SET @sCreateTableSql =  @sCreateTableSql + 'U5' + @sTableName + '( '
    SET @sCreatePKSql =     @sCreatePKSql + 'U5' + @sTableName + ' ADD CONSTRAINT U5PRIK_' + @sTableName + ' PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED( '
    SET @sCreateIdentityIndexSql = 'ALTER TABLE U5' + @sTableName + ' ADD CONSTRAINT U5UNQSQL_' + @sTableName + ' UNIQUE(SQLIDENTITY) '
    
    DECLARE cursor_udsscreenfields CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
     SELECT         usf_desc,
                    usf_sequence,
                    usf_fieldname,
                    usf_fieldtype,
                    usf_maxlength,
                    usf_precision,
                    usf_scale,
                    usf_fieldlabel,
                    usf_primary,
                    usf_nullable
     FROM           r5udfscreenfields
     WHERE          usf_screenname = @sScreenName 
     ORDER BY       usf_sequence
     
     DECLARE cursor_auditdata CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
     SELECT    usf_sequence,
               usf_fieldname,
               usf_fieldtype
     FROM      r5udfscreenfields
     WHERE     usf_screenname = @sScreenName
     AND       usf_primary ='+' 
     ORDER BY  usf_sequence
     
     DECLARE cursor_auditfielddata CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
     SELECT    usf_fieldname,
               usf_fieldtype
     FROM      r5udfscreenfields
     WHERE     usf_screenname = @sScreenName
     ORDER BY  usf_sequence
    
    OPEN cursor_udsscreenfields
    FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_udsscreenfields INTO @sFieldDescription, @nSequence, @sFieldName, @sFieldType, @nMaxlength, @nPrecision, @nScale, @sFieldLabel, @sPrimary, @sNullable
    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
            IF LEN(@sCreateTableSql) + LEN(@sFieldName) > 3800 /* leave room of 200 characters for data type and common fields */
                BEGIN
                    SET @sChk = N'1'
                    RETURN
                END         
            SET @sCreateTableSql = @sCreateTableSql + @sFieldName
            IF @sFieldType = 'NUMERICFIELD' 
                BEGIN
                    IF @nScale IS NOT NULL AND @nScale  != 0
                        SET @sCreateTableSql = @sCreateTableSql + ' NUMERIC(' + cast(@nPrecision as nvarchar(2)) + ',' + cast(@nScale as nvarchar(1)) + ')'
                    ELSE
                        SET @sCreateTableSql = @sCreateTableSql + ' NUMERIC(' +  cast(@nPrecision as nvarchar(2)) +')'
                END
            ELSE
                BEGIN
                    IF @sFieldType = 'TIME' 
                        SET @sCreateTableSql = @sCreateTableSql +  ' NUMERIC(24,6) '
                    ELSE
                        BEGIN
                            IF  @sFieldType = 'TEXTFIELD'
                                SET @sCreateTableSql = @sCreateTableSql + ' NVARCHAR(' +  cast(@nMaxlength as nvarchar(4)) + ') COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN '
                            ELSE
                                BEGIN
                                    IF @sFieldType = 'CHECKBOX'
                                        SET @sCreateTableSql = @sCreateTableSql + ' NVARCHAR(1) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN '
                                    ELSE 
                                        BEGIN
                                            IF @sFieldType = 'TEXTAREAFIELD'
                                                SET @sCreateTableSql = @sCreateTableSql + ' NTEXT COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN '
                                            ELSE
                                                BEGIN
                                                    IF @sFieldType = 'DATETIMEFIELD'
                                                        SET @sCreateTableSql = @sCreateTableSql + ' DATETIME '
                                                    ELSE
                                                        BEGIN
                                                            IF @sFieldType = 'DATEFIELD'
                                                                SET @sCreateTableSql = @sCreateTableSql + ' DATETIME '
                                                        END
                                                END
                                        END
                                END
                        END
                END
            
            -- add not null constraint 
            IF COALESCE(@sNullable, '-') = '+' OR  COALESCE(@sPrimary, '-') = '-'
                SET @sCreateTableSql = @sCreateTableSql + ' NULL'
            ELSE
                SET @sCreateTableSql = @sCreateTableSql + ' NOT NULL'
            -- add comma
            SET @sCreateTableSql = @sCreateTableSql + ', '
            -- Add primary key field
            IF @sPrimary = '+' 
            begin
                SET @sCreatePKSql = @sCreatePKSql + @sFieldName + ','
                SET @nKeyFieldCount = @nKeyFieldCount + 1
                SET @sNewKeyFieldList = @sNewKeyFieldList + @sFieldName + ','
                SET @sNewKeyFieldIntoList = @sNewKeyFieldIntoList + '@keyValue' +  cast(@nKeyFieldCount as nvarchar(3))  + ','

                    SET @sPostTriggerDeclare = @sPostTriggerDeclare + ' DECLARE @keyValue' +  cast(@nKeyFieldCount as nvarchar(3)) + ' NVARCHAR(' +  cast(@nMaxlength as nvarchar(4)) + ')' + CHAR(13)
                    SET @sNewKeyValues = @sNewKeyValues + '+ @keyValue'+  cast(@nKeyFieldCount as nvarchar(3)) + ' + ''#'''

create procedure O7CREATEUSERTAB @sFunction nvarchar(6),
                                 @sTabname  nvarchar(6),
                                 @sDesc     nvarchar(255),
                                 @sType     nvarchar(15),
                                 @sRentity  nvarchar(4),
                                 @sChk      nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
AS
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @nTabseq        int
    declare @nBotnumfunc    int
    declare @nFun_class     nvarchar(16)
    declare @sCode          nvarchar(12)
    declare @sXType         nvarchar(50)

    set @sChk = '0'

    if exists( select 'x' from r5functiontabs where ftb_function=@sFunction
                                                and ftb_tab=@sTabname )
        begin
            set @sChk = '1'
            return
        end

    select @nTabseq = max(ftb_seq) from r5functIontabs where ftb_function=@sFunction and coalesce(ftb_designpopup, '-') = '-' AND FTB_SEQ>2

    set @nTabseq = coalesce( @nTabseq, 2 ) + 1

    if(@sType=N'GRID' or @sType=N'WSPROMPT')
        begin
            if ( @sTabname like 'U[1-9]' or @sTabname like 'U[1-9][0-9]' or @sTabname like 'U[1-9][0-9][0-9]')
                insert into r5functiontabs (ftb_function, ftb_tab, ftb_rentity, ftb_visible, ftb_select, ftb_insert,ftb_update,ftb_delete,ftb_altersave,ftb_mekey, ftb_seq, ftb_updatecount)
                values (@sFunction,@sTabname, @sRentity, N'+', N'?',N'+',N'*', N'X',N'+', N'YY', @nTabseq, 0)
            else
                if( @sTabname <> N'HDR')
                    begin
                        insert into r5functiontabs (ftb_function, ftb_tab, ftb_rentity, ftb_visible, ftb_select,ftb_mekey, ftb_seq, ftb_updatecount)
                        values (@sFunction,@sTabname, @sRentity, N'+', N'?', N'YY', @nTabseq, 0)
                    end
        end
    else
        begin
            -- If creating a user tabbed report, then set the xtype field
            if (@sType = N'USERTABREPORT')
                set @sXType = 'reporttabparams';

            insert into r5functiontabs (ftb_function, ftb_tab, ftb_visible, ftb_select, ftb_update, ftb_insert, ftb_delete, ftb_mekey, ftb_seq, ftb_xtype, ftb_nodesign, ftb_updatecount)
            values (@sFunction,@sTabname, N'+', N'?', N'*', N'+', N'X', N'YY',@nTabseq,@sXType,'+',0)
        end

    declare c_groups cursor local for select UGR_CODE from R5GROUPS WHERE ugr_login=N'+' and ugr_code <> N'*' and ugr_code <> N'R5DEFAULT'
    open c_groups
    fetch next from c_groups into @sCode
    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        begin
            if not exists ( SELECT 'X' FROM R5PERMISSIONS WHERE PRM_FUNCTION = @sFunction and prm_group = @sCode )
                    insert into r5permissions (prm_function, prm_group, prm_select, prm_update, prm_insert, prm_delete) SELECT @sFunction, @sCode, fun_select, fun_update, fun_insert, fun_delete FROM r5functions WHERE fun_code = @sFunction

            if ( @sTabname like 'U[1-9]' or @sTabname like 'U[1-9][0-9]' or @sTabname like 'U[1-9][0-9][0-9]')
                insert into r5tabpermissions (trp_function,trp_tab, trp_group, trp_sequence, trp_select, trp_insert,trp_update,trp_delete, trp_visible, trp_sysrequired,trp_altersave,trp_updatecount)
                values (@sFunction, @sTabname, @sCode, @nTabseq, N'?', N'+', N'*', N'X', N'+',N'+',N'+', 0)
            else
            begin
                if(@sType=N'WSPROMPT')
                begin
                    if( @sTabname <> N'HDR')
                    begin
                        insert into r5tabpermissions (trp_function,trp_tab, trp_group, trp_sequence, trp_select, trp_visible, trp_sysrequired,trp_updatecount)
                        values (@sFunction, @sTabname, @sCode, @nTabseq, N'?', N'-',N'-', 0)
                    end
                end
                else
                    insert into r5tabpermissions (trp_function,trp_tab, trp_group, trp_sequence, trp_visible, trp_sysrequired,trp_updatecount)
                    values (@sFunction, @sTabname, @sCode, @nTabseq,N'-',N'-', 0)
            end
            fetch next from c_groups into @sCode
        end
    close c_groups
    deallocate c_groups

    select @nFun_class = fun_class from r5functions where fun_code = @sFunction

    if(@nFun_class='WEBD')
    begin
        select @nBotnumfunc = max(bot_number) from r5boilertexts where bot_function = @sFunction
        set @nBotnumfunc = coalesce( @nBotnumfunc, 1) + 1
    end
    else
        begin
        select @nBotnumfunc = max(bot_number) from r5boilertexts where bot_function = @sFunction and bot_number > 5000
        set @nBotnumfunc = coalesce( @nBotnumfunc, 5000) + 1
    end

    insert into r5boilertexts (bot_function, bot_number, bot_length, bot_xpos, bot_ypos,
                                bot_lang, bot_text, bot_dest, bot_page, bot_fld1, bot_pool)
        select @sFunction, @nBotnumfunc, 255, 0, 0, lin_code, @sDesc, N'TB', 1, @sTabname, 0 from r5langinst

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CREATEWSP
AS  
BEGIN 
  DECLARE @swpfunction        NVARCHAR( 6 )
  DECLARE @swptab             NVARCHAR( 3 )
  DECLARE @wsgwsname          NVARCHAR( 200 )
  DECLARE @wsgaction          NVARCHAR( 10 )
  DECLARE @wsgorgxpath        NVARCHAR( 200 )

  DECLARE @pldelementid       NVARCHAR ( 60 )
  DECLARE @pldfieldtype       NVARCHAR ( 20 )
  DECLARE @pldxpath           NVARCHAR ( 400 )
  DECLARE @pldsystemattribute NVARCHAR ( 1 )
  DECLARE @pldonclasschange   NVARCHAR ( 500 )
  DECLARE @pldmaxlength       NUMERIC 

  DECLARE @wsp                NVARCHAR( 6 )
  DECLARE @wspdesc            NVARCHAR( 80 )  
  DECLARE @wspfun             NVARCHAR( 6 )
  DECLARE @cfkey              NVARCHAR( 500 )
  DECLARE @pagename           NVARCHAR( 40 )
  DECLARE @text               NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @ftype              NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @pattern            NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @cntrlorgfld        NVARCHAR( 500 )
  DECLARE @classorgfld        NVARCHAR( 500 )
  DECLARE @isclassorg         NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @categoryfld        NVARCHAR( 500 )
  DECLARE @iscategory         NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @destwebservice     NVARCHAR( 300 )
  DECLARE @destxpath          NVARCHAR( 300 )
  DECLARE @maxnum             NUMERIC
  DECLARE @cnt                NUMERIC
  DECLARE @line               NUMERIC
  DECLARE @minlen             NUMERIC
  DECLARE @incrlino           NUMERIC
  DECLARE @wsfline            NUMERIC

  DECLARE @processgroup       NUMERIC( 3 )
  DECLARE @wsprmcode          NVARCHAR( 6 )
  DECLARE @actioncode         NVARCHAR( 6 )
  DECLARE @function           NVARCHAR( 6 )
  DECLARE @tab                NVARCHAR( 3 )
  DECLARE @tablename          NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @ddfieldname        NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @type               NVARCHAR( 2 )
  DECLARE @datatype               NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @rec                INT
  DECLARE @drec               INT

  DECLARE @swstable           NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @swsaction          NVARCHAR( 6 )
  DECLARE @swsactive          NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @swsprompt2         NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld1         NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld1seq      NUMERIC
  DECLARE @swskeyfld1dt       NVARCHAR( 2 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld2         NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld2seq      NUMERIC
  DECLARE @swskeyfld2dt       NVARCHAR( 2 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld3         NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld3seq      NUMERIC
  DECLARE @swskeyfld3dt       NVARCHAR( 2 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld4         NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld4seq      NUMERIC
  DECLARE @swskeyfld4dt       NVARCHAR( 2 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld5         NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld5seq      NUMERIC
  DECLARE @swskeyfld5dt       NVARCHAR( 2 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld6         NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld6seq      NUMERIC
  DECLARE @swskeyfld6dt       NVARCHAR( 2 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld7         NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld7seq      NUMERIC
  DECLARE @swskeyfld7dt       NVARCHAR( 2 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld8         NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfld8seq      NUMERIC
  DECLARE @swskeyfld8dt       NVARCHAR( 2 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfldd1        NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfldd1seq     NUMERIC
  DECLARE @swskeyfldd2        NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @swskeyfldd2seq     NUMERIC

  /* Get increment line. */
  SELECT @incrlino = ins_desc
  FROM   r5install
  WHERE  ins_code = 'INCRLINO'

  /* Get highest number already used. */
  SELECT @maxnum = ISNULL( MAX( SUBSTRING( wst_code, 2, 4 ) ), 0 )
  FROM   r5wsprompts
  WHERE  wst_system = '+'

  /* Loop through all record that need WSP created. */
  DECLARE swp CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
    SELECT swp_function, swp_tab
    FROM   r5systemwsps
    WHERE  NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                       FROM   r5promptwebservices, r5wsprompts
                       WHERE  wst_code = pws_wsprmcode
                       AND    pws_function = swp_function
                       AND    ISNULL( pws_tab, 'x' ) = ISNULL( swp_tab, 'x' )
                       AND    wst_system = '+' ) 
    ORDER BY 1, 2
  OPEN swp 
  FETCH NEXT FROM swp INTO @swpfunction, @swptab
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 
    BEGIN 
      IF @swptab IS NULL
        BEGIN
          SET @wspfun   = NULL
          SET @pagename = @swpfunction
        END
      ELSE
        BEGIN
          SET @wspfun   = @swpfunction
          SET @pagename = @swpfunction + '_' + @swptab
        END
        
      SET @cnt = 1
      WHILE @cnt > 0 
        BEGIN 
          /* Construct the new WSP code. If the code already exists, try to use the next number. */
          SET @maxnum = ISNULL( @maxnum, 0 ) + 1
          SET @wsp = 'S' + dbo.F_LPAD( @maxnum, 4, '0' )
          /* Check whether the dynamic WSP code already exists. */
          SELECT @cnt = COUNT(*)
          FROM   r5wsprompts
          WHERE  wst_code LIKE @wsp + '%'
          AND    ISNULL( wst_system, '-' ) = '-'
        END 

      /* Loop through all records within the current function/tab that need a WSP created. */  
      DECLARE wsg CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
        SELECT wsg_wsname, wsg_action, wsg_orgxpath
        FROM   r5webservicemapping w1
        WHERE  wsg_function = @swpfunction
        AND    ISNULL( wsg_tab, 'x' ) = ISNULL( @swptab, 'x' )
        AND    wsg_action <> 'GET'
        AND    NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 
                           FROM   r5webservicemapping w2
                           WHERE  w2.wsg_function = w1.wsg_function
                           AND    ISNULL( w2.wsg_tab, 'x' ) = ISNULL( w1.wsg_tab, 'x' )
                           AND    w2.wsg_action = w1.wsg_action
                           AND    w2.wsg_wsname < w1.wsg_wsname )
        ORDER BY 1
      OPEN wsg  
      FETCH NEXT FROM wsg INTO @wsgwsname, @wsgaction, @wsgorgxpath
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 
        BEGIN 
          SET @wspdesc = @wsgwsname
          /* Insert the WSP record. */
          INSERT INTO r5wsprompts( wst_code, wst_desc, wst_function, wst_notused, wst_system )
          VALUES( @wsp + SUBSTRING( @wsgaction, 1, 1 ), @wspdesc, @wspfun, '-', '+' )

          /* Find the controlling org. */
          SET @cntrlorgfld = NULL
          SELECT @cntrlorgfld = pld_elementid
          FROM   r5defaultpagelayout
          WHERE  pld_pagename = @pagename
          AND    pld_xpath    = @wsgorgxpath
          IF @cntrlorgfld IS NULL 
            SELECT @cntrlorgfld = pld_elementid
            FROM   r5defaultpagelayout
            WHERE  pld_pagename = @pagename
            AND    SUBSTRING( pld_xpath, CHARINDEX( '\', pld_xpath ) + 1, 1000 ) = @wsgorgxpath

          SET @cfkey = NULL
          IF @wsgaction <> 'DELETE'
            BEGIN
              /* Find the CF Key. */
              SELECT @cfkey = pld_onclasschange
              FROM   r5defaultpagelayout
              WHERE  pld_pagename = @pagename
              AND    pld_onclasschange IS NOT NULL 
              IF CHARINDEX( '"keyFields":', @cfkey ) > 0
                BEGIN
                  SET @cfkey = SUBSTRING( @cfkey, CHARINDEX( '"keyFields":', @cfkey ) + 14, 1000 )
                  SET @cfkey = SUBSTRING( @cfkey, 1, CHARINDEX( ']', @cfkey ) - 2 )
                  SET @cfkey = REPLACE( @cfkey, '"', '' )
                  SET @cfkey = REPLACE( @cfkey, ',', '' )
                END
            END

          /* Find the class org field. */
          SET @classorgfld = NULL
          SELECT @classorgfld = pld_onclasschange
          FROM   r5defaultpagelayout
          WHERE  pld_pagename = @pagename
          AND    pld_onclasschange LIKE '%"classOrgField"%' 
          IF @classorgfld IS NOT NULL 
            BEGIN
              SET @classorgfld = SUBSTRING( @classorgfld, CHARINDEX( '"classOrgField":', @classorgfld ) + 17, 1000 )
              SET @classorgfld = SUBSTRING( @classorgfld, 1, CHARINDEX( '"', @classorgfld ) - 1 )
            END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CREATEWSPWRAPPER
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @cnt NUMERIC( 3 )
  SELECT @cnt = COUNT(*)
  FROM   r5install
  WHERE  ins_code   = N'WSPTXN'
  AND    ins_module = N'INTERNAL'
  IF @cnt = 1
    BEGIN
      /* Create the WSPs. */
      EXECUTE o7createwsp
      /* Reset install parameter, so process won't start again. */
      UPDATE r5install
      SET    ins_module = NULL
      WHERE  ins_code   = N'WSPTXN'
      /* Also disable the job. */
      UPDATE r5scheduledjobs
      SET    scj_active  = N'-'
      WHERE  scj_jobname = N'WSPTXN'
    END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE	o7crebis 
	@sBispart			nvarchar(30),
	@sBispartorg		nvarchar(15),
	@sBisstore			nvarchar(15),
	@sBisbin			nvarchar(15),
	@sBislot			nvarchar(12),
	@sBimanlot			nvarchar(24),
	@dBilotexpir		DATETIME,
	@sBitrnorg			nvarchar(15),
	@sChk				nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@sErrtype			nvarchar(15) OUTPUT,
	@sErrparm1			nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,
	@sErrmsg			nvarchar(2000) OUTPUT
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
   declare @nCountit	        integer
   declare @sX					nvarchar(1) 
   declare @sCheckresult	    nvarchar(4) 
BEGIN
   set @sChk         =  N'0'
   set @sX           =  NULL
   set @sCheckresult =  N'0'
   set @sErrtype    = N'PROC'

	IF not exists (select 1	FROM   r5parts WHERE  par_code = @sBispart AND    par_org  = @sBispartorg )
		begin
			set @sErrparm1 = @sBispart+' - N'+@sBispartorg
			set @sChk       = N'2'
			RETURN
		end

	IF not exists (select 1 	FROM   r5stores
					WHERE  str_code = @sBisstore )
		begin
			set @sErrparm1 = @sBisstore
			set @sChk       = N'3'
			RETURN
		end

	IF not exists (select 1 from r5bins WHERE  bin_code = @sBisbin )
		begin
			set @sErrparm1 = @sBisbin
			set @sChk       = N'4'
			RETURN
		end
	IF not exists (select 1  	FROM   r5lots WHERE  lot_code = @sBislot)
		INSERT INTO r5lots ( lot_code,
			lot_desc,
			lot_org,
			lot_manlot,
			lot_expired)
		VALUES ( @sBislot,
			N'-',
			@sBitrnorg,
			@sBimanlot,
			@dBilotexpir )

	INSERT INTO r5binstock
		( BIS_PART,
		BIS_PART_ORG,
		BIS_STORE,
		BIS_BIN,
		BIS_LOT,
		BIS_QTY )
	VALUES
		( @sBispart,
		@sBispartorg,
		@sBisstore,
		@sBisbin,
		@sBislot,
		0 )
	if @@ERROR <> 0
		begin
             set @sErrmsg  = null
             set @sChk      = @@ERROR
             set @sErrtype = N'ORACLE'
             RETURN
		end


END

create PROCEDURE O7CREOB1 	@sEventno		nvarchar(30),
							@sErtype		nvarchar(4),
							@sObcode		nvarchar(30),
							@sObcodeorg		nvarchar(15),
							@sObtype		nvarchar(4)	OUTPUT,
							@sObrtype		nvarchar(4)	OUTPUT,
							@sChk			nvarchar(6)	OUTPUT
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sTagnums	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nReturn	int
	declare @nCount		int
	declare @nFrompoint	numeric(24,6)
	declare @nTopoint	numeric(24,6)

	set @sChk = N'0'

	if @sEventno is null or @sErtype is null or @sObcode is null or @sObcodeorg is null or ( @sObtype is null AND @sObrtype is null )
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			return
		end

	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sObrtype OUTPUT, @sObtype OUTPUT, N'OBTP', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sChk <> N'0'
		begin
			set @sChk = N'2'
			return
		end

	if @sErtype in (N'JOB', N'PPM', N'STWO' )
		begin
      if not exists (select 1 from r5eventobjects where eob_event=@sEventno and eob_object + N'#' + eob_object_org in
          (select parent + N'#' + parent_org FROM	O7CREOB1_GET_HIERARCHY_1( @sObrtype, @sObcode, @sObcodeorg ) )) begin
  			INSERT INTO r5eventobjects
  				 (
  					 eob_event,
  					 eob_obtype,
  					 eob_obrtype,
  					 eob_object,
  					 eob_object_org,
  					 eob_rollup,
  					 eob_level,
  					 eob_downtime
  				 )
  				SELECT	@sEventno,
  						parenttype,
  						parentrtype,
  						parent,
  						parent_org,
  						N'+',
  						MAX(nLevel),
  						N'+'
  				  FROM	O7CREOB1_GET_HIERARCHY_1( @sObrtype, @sObcode, @sObcodeorg )
  				GROUP BY parenttype, parentrtype, parent, parent_org
       end

		end

	if @sErtype in ( N'STO', N'XSTO' )
		begin
      if not exists (select 1 from r5eventobjects where eob_event=@sEventno and eob_object + N'#' + eob_object_org in
          (select child + N'#' + child_org FROM	O7CREOB1_GET_HIERARCHY_2( @sObcode, @sObcodeorg ) )) begin
  			INSERT INTO r5eventobjects
  				 (
  					 eob_event,
  					 eob_obtype,
  					 eob_obrtype,
  					 eob_object,
  					 eob_object_org,
  					 eob_rollup,
  					 eob_level,
  					 eob_downtime
  				 )
  				SELECT	@sEventno,
  						childtype,
  						childrtype,
  						child,
  						child_org,
  						N'-',
  						0,
  						N'-'
  				  FROM	O7CREOB1_GET_HIERARCHY_2( @sObcode, @sObcodeorg )
  		        GROUP BY childtype, childrtype, child, child_org

			end
		end

	if @sErtype in ( N'MRC' )
		begin
      if not exists (select 1 from r5eventobjects where eob_event=@sEventno and eob_object + N'#' + eob_object_org in
          (select child + N'#' + child_org FROM	O7UPOBJM_GET_HIERARCHY( @sObcode, @sObcodeorg, @sObrtype ) )) begin
  			INSERT INTO r5eventobjects
  				 (
  					 eob_event,
  					 eob_obtype,
  					 eob_obrtype,
  					 eob_object,
  					 eob_object_org,
  					 eob_rollup,
  					 eob_level,
  					 eob_downtime
  				 )
  				SELECT	@sEventno,
  						childtype,
  						childrtype,
  						child,
  						child_org,
  						N'-',
  						0,
  						N'-'
  				  FROM	O7UPOBJM_GET_HIERARCHY( @sObcode, @sObcodeorg, @sObrtype )
  		        GROUP BY childtype, childrtype, child, child_org

			end
		end

	if @sErtype = N'STAT'
		begin
      if not exists (select 1 from r5eventobjects where eob_event=@sEventno and eob_object + N'#' + eob_object_org in
          (select child + N'#' + child_org FROM	O7CREOB1_GET_HIERARCHY_3( @sObcode, @sObcodeorg ) )) begin
  			INSERT INTO r5eventobjects
  				 (
  					 eob_event,
  					 eob_obtype,
  					 eob_obrtype,
  					 eob_object,
  					 eob_object_org,
  					 eob_rollup,
  					 eob_level,
  					 eob_downtime
  				 )
  				SELECT	@sEventno,
  						childtype,
  						childrtype,
  						child,
  						child_org,
  						N'-',
  						0,
  						N'-'
  				  FROM	O7CREOB1_GET_HIERARCHY_3( @sObcode, @sObcodeorg )
  		        GROUP BY childtype, childrtype, child, child_org

			end
		end

  if not exists (select 1 from r5eventobjects where eob_event=@sEventno and eob_object=@sObcode and eob_object_org=@sObcodeorg) begin
  	INSERT INTO r5eventobjects
  		  (
  			  eob_event,
  			  eob_obtype,
  			  eob_obrtype,
  			  eob_object,
  			  eob_object_org,
  			  eob_rollup,
  			  eob_level,
  			  eob_downtime
  		  )
  	VALUES
  		  (
  			  @sEventno,
  			  @sObtype,
  			  @sObrtype,
  			  @sObcode,
  			  @sObcodeorg,
  			  N'+',
  			  0,
  			  N'+'
  		  )
  end


	execute @nReturn = R5O7CONS_VALUE_OF @sTagnums OUTPUT, N'OPTION', N'TAGS'
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sTagnums = N'+' and @sErtype in ( N'JOB', N'PPM', N'STWO' ) and @sObrtype = N'P'
		begin
      if not exists (select 1 from r5eventobjects where eob_event=@sEventno and eob_object + N'#' + eob_object_org in
          (select stc_child + N'#' + stc_child_org FROM  r5structures
  				WHERE stc_parent     = @sObcode
  				AND   stc_parent_org = @sObcodeorg
  				AND   stc_rollup     = N'+'
  				AND   stc_childrtype = N'A' )) begin
  			INSERT INTO r5eventobjects (
  				  eob_event,
  				  eob_obtype,
  				  eob_obrtype,
  				  eob_object,
  				  eob_object_org,
  				  eob_rollup,
  				  eob_level,
  				  eob_downtime )
  				SELECT
  				  @sEventno,
  				  stc_childtype,
  				  stc_childrtype,
  				  stc_child,
  				  stc_child_org,
  				  N'+',
  				  0,
  				  N'+'
  				FROM  r5structures
  				WHERE stc_parent     = @sObcode
  				AND   stc_parent_org = @sObcodeorg
  				AND   stc_rollup     = N'+'
  				AND   stc_childrtype = N'A'

			end
		end

	if @sErtype in (N'JOB', N'PPM', N'STWO' )
		begin
			/* Check from and to point. */
			SELECT @nFrompoint = evt_frompoint, 
				@nTopoint = evt_topoint
			FROM   r5events
			WHERE  evt_code = @sEventno
			if @nFrompoint is not null and @nTopoint is not null 
				begin
					/* Try to set the event object from and to points. */
					execute @nReturn = o7eobpoints @sEventno
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1
				end
		end

create function O7CREOB1_GET_HIERARCHY_1 (	@sRtype nvarchar(4),
											@sCode	nvarchar(30),
											@sOrg	nvarchar(15) )
returns @tReturn table( parenttype	nvarchar(4)		COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						parentrtype	nvarchar(4)		COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						parent		nvarchar(30)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						parent_org	nvarchar(15)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						nLevel		int,
						child		nvarchar(30)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						child_org	nvarchar(15)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
	declare @nLevel				int
	declare @sCurrentType		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sCurrentRtype		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sCurrentChild		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sCurrentChildorg	nvarchar(15)
		
	declare @tStack table ( stc_parent		nvarchar(30), 
							stc_parent_org	nvarchar(15), 
							stc_parenttype	nvarchar(4),
							stc_parentrtype nvarchar(4),
							LevelID int,
							stc_child		nvarchar(30), 
							stc_child_org	nvarchar(15) )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack 
		select	stc_parent, 
				stc_parent_org, 
				stc_parenttype,
				stc_parentrtype,
				1,
				stc_child,
				stc_child_org
		  from	r5structures
		 where	stc_child		= @sCode					and 
				stc_child_org	= @sOrg						and
				(stc_rollup	= N'+'  OR @sRtype = N'L')	and
				(stc_rollup	= N'+'	OR stc_childrtype = N'L' AND stc_parentrtype = N'L')

	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select	@sCode = stc_parent,
							@sOrg	= stc_parent_org,
							@sCurrentType	= stc_parenttype,
							@sCurrentRtype	= stc_parentrtype,
							@sCurrentChild	= stc_child,
							@sCurrentChildorg	= stc_child_org
					  from	@tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sCurrentType, @sCurrentRtype, @sCode, @sOrg, @nLevel, @sCurrentChild, @sCurrentChildorg )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_parent = @sCode and stc_parent_org = @sOrg
					insert into @tStack	select	stc_parent, 
												stc_parent_org, 
												stc_parenttype,
												stc_parentrtype,
												@nLevel + 1,
												stc_child,
												stc_child_org
										  from	r5structures
										 where	stc_child		= @sCode	and 
												stc_child_org	= @sOrg		and
												(stc_rollup	= N'+'  OR @sRtype = N'L')	and
												(stc_rollup	= N'+'	OR stc_childrtype = N'L' AND stc_parentrtype = N'L')
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

		END

create PROCEDURE O7CRESTL  @sTrans       nvarchar(30),
	@sPart        nvarchar(30),
	@sSelorg     nvarchar(15),
	@sPartclass   nvarchar(8),
	@sStore       nvarchar(15),
	@sFacility    nvarchar(255),  --could not find definition for paramater.
	@sStktype     nvarchar(8),
	@sFrom_binloc nvarchar(15),
	@sTo_binloc   nvarchar(15),
	@sUser        nvarchar(255),
	@sOrderby     nvarchar(4),
	@dStkdate     DATETIME,
	@sAbcclass    nvarchar(1) ,
	@sFunc        nvarchar(6) ,
	@sIncludec    nvarchar(4)  



AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON

	declare @sOrg           nvarchar(15)--R5USERORGANIZATION.UOG_ORG%TYPE
	declare @nSeqno			integer 
	declare @sTratype		nvarchar(4)--R5STOCKTAKELINES.STL_TYPE%TYPE
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(3)
	declare @sDeforg		nvarchar(15)--R5USERORGANIZATION.UOG_ORG%TYPE
	declare @sChk1			nvarchar(3)
	declare @sString		nvarchar(2000)

	declare @sTempPart		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sTempPartOrg	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sTempStore		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sTempBin		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sTempLot		nvarchar(12)
	declare @nTempQty		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nReturn		integer
begin
	set @nSeqno = 0

	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT  @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk1 OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sSelorg = N'%' 
		begin
            if charindex( N'%', @sStore ) = 0
                begin
                    select @sOrg = str_org
                    from   r5stores
                    where  str_code = @sStore
			        IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
				        SET @sOrg = @sDeforg
                end
            else
                begin
			        SELECT @sOrg = uog_org
			        FROM   r5userorganization
			        WHERE  uog_user   = @sUser
			        AND    uog_default = N'+'
			        IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
				        SET @sOrg = @sDeforg
                end
		end
	else
		set @sOrg = @sSelorg


	INSERT INTO r5transactions
		( tra_code,
		tra_org,
		tra_desc,
		tra_auth,
		tra_rtype,
		tra_date,
		tra_fromcode,
        tra_fromcode_org,
		tra_fromrentity,
		tra_fromrtype,
		tra_rstatus )
	VALUES
		( @sTrans,
		@sOrg,
		N'Stocktake',
		@sUser,
		N'STTK',
		dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(dbo.o7gttime2 (@sOrg), 'DD'),
		@sStore,
        @sOrg,
		N'STOR',
		N'*',
		N'U' )


	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sTratype OUTPUT, N'STTK', N'TRTP', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if charindex( N'#',@sPart ) > 0 
		set @sString = N'#' + @sPart + N'#'
	else
		set @sString = @sPart

	if @sOrderby = N'P' 
		begin
			if charindex( N'#' , @sPart ) = 0 
				begin
					declare c_local1 cursor local for   SELECT bis_part,
															bis_part_org,
															bis_store,
															bis_bin,
															bis_lot,
															bis_qty
														FROM   r5binstock b,
															r5stock,
															r5parts
														WHERE  bis_part     = par_code
															AND    bis_part_org = par_org
															AND    sto_part     = bis_part
															AND    sto_part_org = bis_part_org
															AND    par_notused  = N'-'
															AND    par_kit      = N'-'
															AND    coalesce( par_class, N'%' )  LIKE @sPartclass
															AND    sto_store    = bis_store
															AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
																   FROM   r5stocktakelines  s
																   WHERE  s.stl_store    = b.bis_store
																   AND    s.stl_part     = b.bis_part
																   AND    s.stl_part_org = b.bis_part_org
																   AND    s.stl_bin      = b.bis_bin
																   AND    s.stl_lot      = b.bis_lot )
															
															AND (( @sIncludec = '-' AND sto_store LIKE @sStore ) OR
															( @sIncludec = '+' AND sto_store IN ( SELECT str_code FROM DBO.O7CRESTL_GET_HIERARCHY1(@sStore))))
															AND    sto_part     LIKE @sPart
															AND    sto_store IN ( SELECT str_code
																	FROM   r5userorganization, r5permissions, r5stores
																	WHERE  str_org  = uog_org
																	AND    uog_org LIKE @sSelorg
																	AND    uog_group = prm_group
																	AND    prm_select = '?'
																	AND    prm_function = @sFunc
																	AND    uog_user = @sUser )
															AND    coalesce( sto_class, N'%' ) LIKE @sStktype
															AND    coalesce( bis_bin,N'%' ) BETWEEN
															CASE @sFrom_binloc WHEN N'%' THEN N'!' else @sFrom_binloc end AND
															CASE @sTo_binloc WHEN N'%' THEN N'ZZZZZZZZZZ' else @sTo_binloc end
															AND    coalesce( sto_stocktake, convert(  datetime,  N'01-01-1900' )) <= @dStkdate
															AND    coalesce( sto_abcclass, N'%' ) LIKE @sAbcclass
															ORDER BY bis_part, bis_part_org, bis_bin, bis_lot, bis_store



					open c_local1
					fetch next from c_local1 into	@sTempPart, @sTempPartOrg, @sTempStore, @sTempBin, @sTempLot, @nTempQty

					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @nSeqno = @nSeqno + 1
							INSERT INTO r5stocktakelines
						  ( STL_PART,
							STL_PART_ORG,
							STL_TRANS,
							STL_STORE,
							STL_BIN,
							STL_LOT,
							STL_EXPQTY,
							STL_PHYQTY,
							STL_RTYPE,
							STL_TYPE,
						   STL_LINE ) VALUES
						  ( @sTempPart,
							@sTempPartOrg,
							@sTrans,
							@sTempStore,
							@sTempBin,
							@sTempLot,
							@nTempQty,
							null,
							N'STTK',
							@sTratype,
							@nSeqno )
							fetch next from c_local1 into	@sTempPart, @sTempPartOrg, @sTempStore, @sTempBin, @sTempLot, @nTempQty
						end

					close c_local1
					deallocate c_local1
				end
			else
				begin

					declare c_local3 cursor local for SELECT bis_part,
															 bis_part_org,
															 bis_store,
															 bis_bin,
															 bis_lot,
															 bis_qty
														FROM   r5binstock b,
															 r5stock,
															 r5parts
														WHERE  bis_part     = par_code
														AND    bis_part_org = par_org
														AND    sto_part     = bis_part
														AND    sto_part_org = bis_part_org
														AND    coalesce( par_class, N'%' )  LIKE @sPartclass
														AND    sto_store    = bis_store
														AND    par_notused  = N'-'
														AND    par_kit      = N'-'
														AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
																	   FROM   r5stocktakelines  s
																	   WHERE  s.stl_store    = b.bis_store
																	   AND    s.stl_part     = b.bis_part
																	   AND    s.stl_part_org = b.bis_part_org
																	   AND    s.stl_bin      = b.bis_bin
																	   AND    s.stl_lot      = b.bis_lot )
														AND (( @sIncludec = '-' AND sto_store LIKE @sStore ) OR
														( @sIncludec = '+' AND sto_store IN ( SELECT str_code FROM DBO.O7CRESTL_GET_HIERARCHY1(@sStore))))
														AND    charindex( N'#' + sto_part + N'#', @sString ) > 0
														AND    sto_store IN ( SELECT str_code
																				FROM   r5userorganization, r5permissions, r5stores
																				WHERE  str_org  = uog_org
																				AND    uog_org LIKE @sSelorg
																				AND    uog_group = prm_group
																				AND    prm_select = '?'
																				AND    prm_function = @sFunc
																				AND    uog_user = @sUser )
														AND    coalesce( sto_class, N'%' ) LIKE @sStktype
														AND    coalesce( bis_bin,N'%' ) BETWEEN
														CASE @sFrom_binloc WHEN N'%' THEN N'!' else @sFrom_binloc end AND
														CASE @sTo_binloc WHEN N'%' THEN N'ZZZZZZZZZZ' else @sTo_binloc end

create function O7CRESTL_GET_HIERARCHY1 (	@sStore	nvarchar(30) )
returns @tReturn table( str_code	nvarchar(30)		COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
	declare @nLevel			int
	declare @sChild      	nvarchar(30)        
	
	declare @tStack table ( str_code		nvarchar(30),	
							LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack 
		SELECT str_code, 1 FROM r5stores WHERE str_code   =  @sStore	

	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select	@sChild = str_code
					  from	@tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( 	@sChild)
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND str_code = @sChild 
					insert into @tStack	select	str_code, @nLevel + 1
										  from	r5stores
										 where	str_parent		= @sChild			
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

CREATE PROCEDURE  O7CRESTO 
	@sStopart       nvarchar(30),
	@sStopartorg    nvarchar(15),
	@sStostore      nvarchar(15),
	@nStoavgprice   numeric(24,6),
	@nStolastprice  numeric(24,6),
	@nStostdprice   numeric(24,6),
	@sChk           nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@sErrtype       nvarchar(15) OUTPUT,
	@sErrparm1      nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,
	@sErrmsg        nvarchar(2000)  OUTPUT  
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare		@sPricetype			nvarchar(4)	
	declare		@nAvgprice			numeric(24,6)
	declare    @nLastprice		numeric(24,6)
	declare    @nStdprice		numeric(24,6)
	declare    @nBaseprice		numeric(24,6)
	declare    @nCountit        integer
	declare    @sX              nvarchar(1) 
	declare    @sCheckresult    nvarchar(4) 
	declare    @sParent			nvarchar(15)	
	declare    @nMinlev         numeric(24,6)
	declare    @nOrdlev         numeric(24,6)
	declare    @nOrdqty         numeric(24,6)
	declare    @sPrefstore      nvarchar(15)	
	declare    @sPrefsup        nvarchar(30)	
	declare    @sPrefsuporg     nvarchar(15)	
	declare    @sPricelev		nvarchar(200)	
	declare    @sDefStock		nvarchar(200)
	declare		@nCount			integer
	declare		@nReturn		integer
    declare     @nError         int

	set @sChk         =  N'0'
	set @sX           =  NULL
	set @sCheckresult =  N'0'
	set @sErrtype    = N'PROC'


	IF not exists (select 1 from r5parts
							WHERE  par_code = @sStopart
							AND    par_org  = @sStopartorg )
		begin
			set @sErrparm1 = @sStopart
			set @sChk       = N'2'
			RETURN
		end

	IF not exists (select 1 	FROM   r5stores WHERE  str_code = @sStostore )
		begin
			set @sErrparm1 = @sStostore
			set @sChk       = N'3'
		end

	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT  @sPricelev OUTPUT, N'PRICELEV', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT  @sPricetype OUTPUT, N'PRICETYP', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	IF @sPricelev = N'S'  
		begin
			IF @sPricetype = N'A' 
				set @nBaseprice = @nAvgprice
			IF @sPricetype = N'L' 
				set @nBaseprice = @nLastprice
			IF @sPricetype = N'S' 
				set @nBaseprice = @nStdprice
			IF @sPricetype = N'LIFO' 
				set @nBaseprice = @nAvgprice
			IF @sPricetype = N'FIFO' 
				set @nBaseprice = @nAvgprice
		end

	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT  @sDefStock OUTPUT, N'DEFSTOCK', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	IF UPPER( @sDefStock ) IN ( N'+', N'YES', N'Y', N'ON' ) 
	   begin

			execute @nReturn = O7CPSTOR @sParent OUTPUT, @sStostore
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			SELECT @nMinlev = sto_minlev,
			@nOrdlev = sto_ordlev,
			@nOrdqty = sto_ordqty,
			@sPrefstore = sto_prefstore,
			@sPrefsup = sto_prefsup,
			@sPrefsuporg = sto_prefsup_org
			FROM   r5stock
			WHERE  sto_store    = @sParent
			AND    sto_part     = @sStopart
			AND    sto_part_org = @sStopartorg
		end



	INSERT INTO r5stock
		( STO_PART,
		STO_PART_ORG,
		STO_STORE,
		STO_QTY,
		STO_MINLEV,
		STO_ORDLEV,
		STO_ORDQTY,
		STO_PREFSTORE,
		STO_PREFSUP,
		STO_PREFSUP_ORG,
		STO_AVGPRICE,
		STO_LASTPRICE,
		STO_STDPRICE,
		STO_BASEPRICE,
		STO_PRICETYPE )
	SELECT @sStopart,
		@sStopartorg,
		@sStostore,
		0,
		@nMinlev,
		@nOrdlev,
		@nOrdqty,
		@sPrefstore,
		@sPrefsup,
		@sPrefsuporg,
		CASE @sPricelev WHEN N'S' THEN coalesce( @nAvgprice,  0 ) ELSE null END,
		CASE @sPricelev WHEN N'S' THEN coalesce( @nLastprice,  0 ) ELSE null END,
		CASE @sPricelev WHEN N'S' THEN coalesce( @nStdprice,  0 ) ELSE null END,
		CASE @sPricelev WHEN N'S' THEN coalesce( @nBaseprice,  0 ) ELSE null END,
		CASE @sPricelev WHEN N'S' THEN str_pricetype END
	FROM   r5stores
	WHERE  str_code = @sStostore
    
    set @nError = @@ERROR

	if @nError <> 0
		begin
             set @sErrmsg  = null
             set @sChk      = cast( @nError as nvarchar(4) )
             set @sErrtype = N'ORACLE'
             RETURN
		end

name: O7CREVT1
body:
create PROCEDURE O7CREVT1 
   @sEventno        nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,
   @dEdate          datetime,
   @sEuser          nvarchar(255),
   @sEtype          nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
   @sErtype         nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
   @sEstat          nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
   @sErstat         nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
   @sObstat         nvarchar(4),
   @sEmrc           nvarchar(15),
   @sElocation      nvarchar(30),
   @sElocationorg   nvarchar(15),
   @sEstore         nvarchar(15),
   @sLang           nvarchar(200),
   @sParentcode     nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,
   @sParentcodeorg  nvarchar(15) OUTPUT,
   @sParenttype     nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
   @sParentrtype    nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
   @sObcode         nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,
   @sObcodeorg      nvarchar(15) OUTPUT,
   @sObtype         nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
   @sObrtype        nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
   @nDuration       numeric(24,6),
   @sFixed          nvarchar(4),
   @sChk            nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sEwarranty   nvarchar( 1 )				--r5events.evt_warranty%type
	declare @dDatework    datetime					/* Event Date                 */
	declare @sLangwork    nvarchar(200)				--r5install.ins_desc%type       /* Working Language           */
	declare @nDurwork     int							/* Duration                   */
	declare @sFixedwork   nvarchar( 1 )				/* Fixed flag                 */
	declare @sDumm        nvarchar( 80)				/* Default Language, when language indicator is NULL */
	declare @sTemplate    nvarchar(250)				/* Place where Event Type Desc is stored             */
	declare @nTot_usage   numeric(24,6)				/* To define usage            */
	declare @sPrim_uom    nvarchar(30)				--r5objects.obj_primaryuom%type /* UOM for usage              */
	declare @dTempDate    datetime
	declare @sTempLang    nvarchar(200)
	declare @dDate        datetime
	declare @nReturn      int
	declare @nCount       int
	declare @sX           nvarchar(1)
	declare @nAcd         bigint
BEGIN
	set @sChk         = N'0'
	set @sDumm       = NULL
	set @sEwarranty  = N'-' /* fixed so far */

	IF     @sObcode    IS NULL
	OR     @sObcodeorg IS NULL
	OR (   @sObtype    IS NULL
	AND @sObrtype   IS NULL ) 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end


   IF  @sErstat IS NULL AND @sEstat  IS NULL 
	   begin
		  set @sErstat = N'C'
	   end

   IF @sErtype IS NULL AND @sEtype IS NULL 
	   begin
		  set @sErtype = N'JOB'
	   end

	execute @nReturn = O7LANG @sTempLang OUTPUT, @sDumm OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		RETURN -1

	set @sLangwork = coalesce( @sLang,@sTempLang)
	set @nDurwork   = coalesce( @nDuration,1 )
	set @sFixedwork = coalesce( @sFixedwork, N'-' )

	execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempDate OUTPUT, @sObcodeorg 
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			RETURN -1

	set @dDatework  = coalesce( @dEdate, @dTempDate )


	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sErtype OUTPUT, @sEtype OUTPUT, N'EVTP', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sChk <> N'0'
		begin
			set @sChk = N'2'
			return
		end


	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sErstat OUTPUT, @sEstat OUTPUT, N'EVST', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sChk <> N'0'
		begin
			set @sChk = N'9'
			return
		end

	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sObrtype OUTPUT, @sObtype OUTPUT, N'OBTP', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sChk <> N'0'
		begin
			set @sChk = N'4'
			return
		end

	execute @nReturn = o7desc @sTemplate OUTPUT, @sEtype, NULL, N'EVTP', N'UCOD', @sLangwork, @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

   IF @sChk <> N'0' 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'0'
			select @nCount = count(*) 
			FROM   r5rcodes r
			WHERE  r.rco_rcode   = @sErtype
			AND    r.rco_rentity = N'EVTP'

			if @nCount = 1
				SELECT @sTemplate = r.rco_desc
				FROM   r5rcodes r
				WHERE  r.rco_rcode   = @sErtype
				AND    r.rco_rentity = N'EVTP'
			else
				set @sTemplate = N'T.B.D.'
		end


   IF CHARINDEX(  N'$TP', @sTemplate, 0 ) <> 0 
	   begin
			IF @sParenttype IS NULL OR @sParentcode IS NULL 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'7'
					RETURN
				end

			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sParentrtype OUTPUT, @sParenttype OUTPUT, N'OBTP', @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1


			IF @sChk <> N'0' 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'8'
					RETURN
				end
	   end

	set @sTemplate = REPLACE( @sTemplate, N'$TC', isnull(@sObtype, '')       )
	set @sTemplate = REPLACE( @sTemplate, N'$CH', isnull(@sObcode, '')       )
	set @sTemplate = REPLACE( @sTemplate, N'$TP', isnull(@sParenttype, '')   )
	set @sTemplate = REPLACE( @sTemplate, N'$PA', isnull(@sParentcode, '')   )
	set @sTemplate = REPLACE( @sTemplate, N'$ST', isnull(@sObstat, '')       )
	set @sTemplate = REPLACE( @sTemplate, N'$MR', isnull(@sEmrc, '')         )
	set @sTemplate = REPLACE( @sTemplate, N'$SR', isnull(@sEstore, '')       )
	set @sTemplate = REPLACE( @sTemplate, N'$LO', isnull(@sElocation, '')    )
	set @sTemplate = REPLACE( @sTemplate, N'$OR', isnull(@sEstore, '')       )

	IF @sEventno IS NULL 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sEventno OUTPUT, N'EVENT', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
			IF @sChk <> N'0' 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'11'
					RETURN
				end
		end

   IF  @sEventno        IS NULL  
	   begin 
		   set @sChk = N'14'  
		   RETURN  
	   end
   IF  @sEtype          IS NULL  
	   begin 
		   set @sChk = N'15'  
		   RETURN  
	   end
   IF  @sErtype         IS NULL  
	   begin 
		   set @sChk = N'16'  
		   RETURN  
	   end
   IF  @dDatework       IS NULL  
	   begin 
		   set @sChk = N'17'  
		   RETURN  
	   end
   IF  @sErstat         IS NULL  
	   begin 
		   set @sChk = N'18'  
		   RETURN  
	   end
   IF  @sEstat          IS NULL  
	   begin 
		   set @sChk = N'19'  
		   RETURN  
	   end
   IF  @sEmrc           IS NULL  
	   begin 
		   set @sChk = N'20'  
		   RETURN  
	   end
   IF  @sFixed          IS NULL  
	   begin 
		   set @sChk = N'21'  
		   RETURN  
	   end
   IF  @nDuration       IS NULL  
	   begin 
		   set @sChk = N'22'  
		   RETURN  
	   end
   IF  @sEwarranty      IS NULL  
	   begin 
		   set @sChk = N'23'  
		   RETURN  
	   end
   IF  @sTemplate       IS NULL  
	   begin 
		   set @sChk = N'24'  
		   RETURN  
	   end

   set @nTot_usage = 0
   set @sPrim_uom  = N''


	select @nCount = count(*)
	FROM   r5objects
	WHERE  obj_code = @sObcode
	AND    obj_org  = @sObcodeorg

	If @nCount > 0 
		begin
			SELECT @sPrim_uom = obj_primaryuom
			FROM   r5objects
			WHERE  obj_code = @sObcode
			AND    obj_org  = @sObcodeorg

			IF @sErtype IN ('RL', N'DO')      /* If Delete */
				SELECT @nTot_usage = oud_totalusage
				FROM   r5objusagedefs
				WHERE  oud_object     = @sObcode
				AND    oud_object_org = @sObcodeorg
				AND    oud_uom        = @sPrim_uom
			ELSE
				UPDATE r5objusagedefs
				SET    oud_sinceinstall = 0
				WHERE  oud_object     = @sObcode
				AND    oud_object_org = @sObcodeorg
				AND    oud_uom        = @sPrim_uom

			execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dDate OUTPUT, @sObcodeorg 
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				RETURN -1

			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @nAcd OUTPUT, N'ACCOUNT', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			INSERT INTO r5events (
				evt_code,
				evt_org,
				evt_type,
				evt_rtype,
				evt_obtype,
				evt_desc,
				evt_obrtype,
				evt_object,
				evt_object_org,
				evt_reported,
				evt_completed,
				evt_status,
				evt_rstatus,
				evt_location,
				evt_location_org,
				evt_mrc,
				evt_date,
				evt_duration,
				evt_fixed,
				evt_warranty,
				evt_metuom,
				evt_failureusage,
				evt_enteredby,
				evt_acd  )
			VALUES (
				@sEventno,
				@sObcodeorg,
				@sEtype,
				@sErtype,
				@sObtype,
				SUBSTRING( @sTemplate, 1, 80 ),

create PROCEDURE O7CREVT2   @sEventno       nvarchar(30),
                            @sPpmcode       nvarchar(20),
                            @nRevision      numeric(4),
                            @nPpo_pk        integer,

AS
    SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @sErtype1           nvarchar(4)     -- r5entities.ent_typent%type
    declare @sEstat             nvarchar(4)     -- r5events.evt_status%type

    declare @sObrtype           nvarchar(4)     -- r5events.evt_obrtype%type

    declare @sClassorg          nvarchar(15)    -- r5events.evt_class_org%type
    declare @dCompleted         datetime        -- r5events.evt_completed%type
    declare @dDue               datetime        -- r5events.evt_due%type
    declare @nMeterdue          numeric(24,6)   -- r5events.evt_meterdue%type
    declare @nMeterdue2         numeric(24,6)   -- r5events.evt_meterdue2%type

    declare @dNewdue            datetime
    declare @dEvtdue            datetime
    declare @dPpodeactive       datetime
    declare @sUsecalendar       nvarchar(1)
    declare @sUseppodue         nvarchar(1)
    declare @sCheckresult       nvarchar(4)
    declare @sWoclassheader     nvarchar(8)     -- R5PPMS.PPM_WOCLASS%TYPE
    declare @sWoclassheader_org nvarchar(15)    -- R5PPMS.PPM_WOCLASS_ORG%TYPE
    declare @sWoclass           nvarchar(8)     -- R5PPMOBJECTS.PPO_CLASS%TYPE
    declare @sWoclass_org       nvarchar(15)    -- R5PPMOBJECTS.PPO_CLASS_ORG%TYPE
    declare @sDeforg            nvarchar(200)   -- r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
    declare @sPpm_org           nvarchar(15)    -- R5PPMS.PPM_ORG%TYPE

    declare @nCount             int
    declare @nReturn            int
    declare @dGtTime            datetime
    declare @sTmpAspect         nvarchar(30)
    declare @sCurruser          nvarchar(255)
    declare @dToday             datetime
    declare @sTemplate          nvarchar(1)
    declare @sProductionPriority        nvarchar(256)
    declare @sTrackResource         nvarchar(1)
    declare @nRequestedStartDateBuffer  numeric(4)
    declare @nRequestedEndDateBuffer    numeric(4)

    declare @sPpmnested         nvarchar(20)
    declare @sEvtperioduom      nvarchar(30)
    declare @sEvtobject         nvarchar(30)
    declare @sEvtobject_org     nvarchar(15)
    declare @sEvtobtype         nvarchar(4)
    declare @sEvtmetuom         nvarchar(30)
    declare @sEvtmetuom2        nvarchar(30)
    declare @dEvttarget         datetime
    declare @nEvtmeterdue       numeric(24,6)
    declare @nEvtfreq           numeric(8)
    declare @nEvtmeterdue2      numeric(24,6)
    declare @nPpometerdue       numeric(24,6)
    declare @nPpometerdue2      numeric(24,6)
    declare @sPpometuom         nvarchar(30)
    declare @nPpmmeter          numeric(24,6)
    declare @nPpmmeter2         numeric(24,6)
    declare @nPpmnestedtolmin   numeric(5)
    declare @nPpmnestedtolmax   numeric(5)
    declare @nPpmnestedtolmetmin    numeric(5)
    declare @nPpmnestedtolmetmax    numeric(5)
    declare @nPpmnestedtolmet2min   numeric(5)
    declare @nPpmnestedtolmet2max   numeric(5)
    declare @nCountit           int
    declare @sNewstatus         nvarchar(4)
    declare @sWorkwost          nvarchar(4)     --r5events.evt_status%type
    declare @sMWodate           nvarchar(200)   --r5install.ins_desc%TYPE := o7dflt('PMWODATE', chk);

    declare @sPmplndd           nvarchar(200)   --r5install.ins_desc%TYPE := o7dflt('PMPLNDD', chk);
    declare @sPlan              nvarchar(6)
    declare @nAcd               bigint
    declare @nFailureusage      numeric(24,6)
    declare @sObprimaryuom      nvarchar(30)

    set @sUseppodue = N'-'

    execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sMWodate OUTPUT, N'PMWODATE', @sChk OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        return -1
    execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        return -1

    execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sSyskit1 OUTPUT, N'SYSKIT1', @sChk OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        return -1

    execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sPmplndd OUTPUT, N'PMPLNDD', @sChk OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        return -1

    set @sChk = N'0'

    if @sEventno is null and @nPpo_pk is null
        begin
            set @sChk = N'1'
            return
        end

    execute @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_USER @sCurruser OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        return -1

    if @sEventno is not null
        begin
            SELECT  @sNewevent = e.evt_code,
                    @sClass = e.evt_class,
                    @sClassorg = e.evt_class_org,
                    @dCompleted = coalesce( case @sMWodate when N'PB' then e.evt_lasttimepb when N'RB' then e.evt_lasttimerb else e.evt_completed end, e.evt_completed ),
                    @dDue = e.evt_due,
                    @nMeterdue = e.evt_meterdue,
                    @nMeterdue2 = e.evt_meterdue2,
                    @sPpm = e.evt_ppm,
                    @sObtype = p.ppo_obtype,
                    @sObrtype = p.ppo_obrtype,
                    @sObject = p.ppo_object,
                    @sObjectorg = p.ppo_object_org,
                    @sPporoute = p.ppo_route,
                    @dPpodormstart = p.ppo_dormstart,
                    @dPpodormend = p.ppo_dormend,
                    @sPpodormreuse = p.ppo_dormreuse,

create procedure O7CREVT3  @sOrg             nvarchar(15),
						   @sObj             nvarchar(30),
						   @sObjorg          nvarchar(15),
						   @sObjtype         nvarchar(4),
						   @sCostcode        nvarchar(30),
						   @sMrc             nvarchar(15),
						   @sRequestor       nvarchar(15),
						   @sRapuser         nvarchar(255),
						   @dDue             datetime,
						   @sType            nvarchar(1),
						   @sSupplier        nvarchar(30),
						   @sSupplierorg     nvarchar(15),
						   @sUom             nvarchar(30),
						   @sTrade           nvarchar(15),
						   @sTask            nvarchar(20),
						   @nTaskrev         int,
						   @nTaskqty         numeric(10,2),
						   @nHours           int,
						   @sNewevent        nvarchar(30)  	OUTPUT,
						   @nNewact          int 			OUTPUT,
						   @sChk             nvarchar(4)   	OUTPUT 
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sLocation       nvarchar(30)
    declare @sLocationorg  nvarchar(15)
    declare @sDescr        nvarchar(80)
    declare @sObject       nvarchar(30)
    declare @sObjectorg    nvarchar(15)
    declare @sObtype       nvarchar(4)
    declare @sObrtype      nvarchar(4)
    declare @sJobrtype     nvarchar(4)
    declare @sStatus       nvarchar(4)
    declare @sJobtype      nvarchar(4)
    declare @sNew_event    nvarchar(30)
    declare @nNew_act      int
    declare @sObjcostcode  nvarchar(30)
    declare @sCriticality  nvarchar(8)
    declare @nReturn       int
    declare @dGreatestdate datetime
    declare @sObjwarr      nvarchar(1)	--r5events.evt_warranty%TYPE
    declare @nCount        int
    declare @nActlimit     int
    declare @nAcd          bigint
    
	/* Initialize */
	SET NOCOUNT ON

    set @nActlimit = 1000
	
	execute @nReturn = o7chkwar @sObj, @sObjorg, @sObjtype, @sObjwarr OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT, @sOrg
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	set @sJobrtype  = N'JOB'
    set @sChk       = N'0'
    set @sObtype    = @sObjtype
    set @sObject    = @sObj
    set @sObjectorg = @sObjorg
    set @sNew_event = @sNewevent

	IF @sNew_event IS NULL
	begin
	    /* Get new event number. */
        execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sNew_event OUTPUT, N'EVENT', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
	    set @sNewevent = @sNew_event
	    /* Get R5 object type */
		execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sObrtype OUTPUT, @sObtype OUTPUT, N'OBTP', @sChk OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
	    /* Get USER job type */
		if @sType is NULL
			set @sType = N'BR'
		execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sJobtype OUTPUT, @sType, N'JBTP', @sChk OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
	    /* Get USER status */
		execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sStatus OUTPUT, N'R', N'EVST', @sChk OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
	    /* Get location of object */
		SELECT @sLocation    = obj_location,
               @sLocationorg = obj_location_org,
               @sDescr       = obj_desc,
		       @sObjcostcode = obj_costcode,
		       @sCriticality = obj_criticality
        FROM  r5objects
        WHERE obj_code 	 = @sObject
        AND   obj_org  	 = @sObjectorg

		 /* Do actual insert into r5events. */
		if @dDue > dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2( @sOrg ), N'DD' )
			set @dGreatestdate = @dDue
		else
			set @dGreatestdate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2( @sOrg ), N'DD' )

		execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @nAcd OUTPUT, N'ACCOUNT', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1

		INSERT INTO r5events( EVT_CODE,
                         EVT_ORG,
                         EVT_DESC,
                         EVT_TYPE,
                         EVT_RTYPE,
                         EVT_DATE,
                         EVT_STATUS,
                         EVT_RSTATUS,
                         EVT_MRC,
                         EVT_FIXED,
                         EVT_DEPEND,
                         EVT_ISSTYPE,
                         EVT_WARRANTY,
                         EVT_DURATION,
                         EVT_LOCATION,
                         EVT_LOCATION_ORG,
                         EVT_OBJECT,
                         EVT_OBJECT_ORG,
                         EVT_OBTYPE,
                         EVT_OBRTYPE,
                         EVT_ENTEREDBY,
                         EVT_ORIGIN,
                         EVT_REPORTED,
                         EVT_JOBTYPE,
                         EVT_TARGET,
                         EVT_COSTCODE,
                         EVT_OBJCRITICALITY,
                         EVT_ACD )
        VALUES( @sNew_event,
               @sOrg,
               @sDescr,
               NULL,
               @sJobrtype,
               dbo.o7gttime2( @sOrg ),
               @sStatus,
               N'R',
               @sMrc,
               N'V',
               N'-',
               N'V',
               N'-',
               1,
               @sLocation,
               @sLocationorg,
               @sObject,
               @sObjectorg,
               @sObtype,
               @sObrtype,
               @sRapuser,
               @sRequestor,
               dbo.o7gttime2( @sOrg ),
               @sJobtype,
               @dGreatestdate,
               isnull( @sCostcode, @sObjcostcode ) ,
               @sCriticality,
               @nAcd )
	    /* Do insert into r5eventobjects */
		execute @nReturn = O7CREOB1 @sNew_event, @sJobrtype, @sObject, @sObjectorg, @sObtype OUTPUT , @sObrtype OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
    end
	-- #6002 Use install parameter INCRLINO for line number step size
	execute @nReturn = O7NEWLINE N'EVNT', @sNew_event, N'1', NULL, NULL, @sChk OUTPUT, @nNew_act OUTPUT 
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	if @sChk <> N'0'
		set @nNew_act = N'10'

    if @nNew_act >= @nActlimit
        begin
            select @nNew_act = MAX( a.act_act ) + 1
            FROM   r5activities a
            WHERE  a.act_event     = @sNew_event

            if @nNew_act >= @nActlimit
                begin
                    set @sChk = N'2'
                    return
                end
        end
    
	set @nNewact = @nNew_act

	/* Do insert into r5activities */
	if @dDue > dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2( @sOrg ), N'DD' )
		set @dGreatestdate = @dDue
	else
		set @dGreatestdate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2( @sOrg ), N'DD' )
    INSERT INTO r5activities( ACT_EVENT,
                              ACT_ACT,
                              ACT_EST,
                              ACT_REM,
                              ACT_TIME,
                              ACT_HIRE,
                              ACT_FIXH,
                              ACT_MINHOURS,
                              ACT_TRADE,
                              ACT_PERSONS,
                              ACT_DURATION,
                              ACT_SPECIAL,
                              ACT_START,
                              ACT_TASK,
                              ACT_TASKREV,
                              ACT_QTY,
                              ACT_UOM,

    VALUES( @sNew_event,
