name: O7CREVT4
body:
create procedure O7CREVT4  @dDedate          datetime,
						   @sCshutdown       nvarchar(30),
					       @sCproject        nvarchar(20),
					       @sChk             nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare	@dDatework datetime            /* Event Date */
	declare	@sCeventno nvarchar(30)       /*   r5events.evt_code%type; */
	declare	@sCertype  nvarchar(4)        /*  r5events.evt_rtype%type; */
	declare	@sCetype   nvarchar(4)        /*  r5events.evt_type%type; */
	declare	@sCerstat  nvarchar(4)        /*  r5events.evt_rstatus%type; */
	declare	@sCestat   nvarchar(4)        /*  r5events.evt_status%type; */
	declare	@sCestat1  nvarchar(4)        /*  r5events.evt_status%type; */
	declare	@nNdeforg  nvarchar(15)       /*   r5events.evt_org%type; */
	declare	@sChk1     nvarchar(3)        /*  VARCHAR2( 3 );       */
	declare	@sOrg      nvarchar(15)       /*   r5events.evt_org%type; */
	declare	@nReturn   int
	declare	@sX		   nvarchar(1)
	/* cursor variable declaration  */
	declare @sSob_object		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sSob_object_org	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sSob_obtype		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sSob_obrtype		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sSob_standwork		nvarchar(20)
	declare @sSob_projbud		nvarchar(20)
	declare @sObj_location		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sObj_location_org	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sObj_mrc			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sObj_costcode		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sStw_jobtype		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sStw_desc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @nStw_duration		int
	declare @sStw_priority		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sStw_reqm			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sStw_org			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sStw_woclass		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sStw_woclass_org	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sObj_criticality	nvarchar(8)
	declare @nAcd             	bigint

begin
	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @nNdeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	
	/* Initialize */
    set @sChk = N'0'
	/* Check mandatory parameters */
    IF @sCshutdown IS NULL OR @sCproject IS NULL
	begin
    	set @sChk = N'1'
      	return
    end
	/* Get project organization */
    SELECT @sOrg  =  prj_org
    FROM   r5projects
    WHERE  prj_code = @sCproject
	
	/* Fill in default date */
	if dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2(@sOrg), N'DD' ) > isnull( @dDedate, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2(@sOrg), N'DD' ) )
		set @dDatework = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2(@sOrg), N'DD' )
	else
		set @dDatework = isnull( @dDedate, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2(@sOrg), N'DD' ) )
    /* Get user type for 'JOB' */
    set @sCertype = N'JOB'
    set @sCetype  = NULL
	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sCertype OUTPUT, @sCetype OUTPUT, N'EVTP', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
    IF @sChk <> N'0'
	begin
       set @sChk = N'2'
       return
    end
	/* Get user type for status 'R'  */
	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sCestat OUTPUT, N'PROJWOST', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
    IF @sChk <> N'0'
	begin
       set @sChk = N'3'
       return
    end
    set @sCerstat = N'R'
	
    SELECT @sX =  N'X'
    FROM   r5ucodes
    WHERE  uco_rentity = N'EVST'
    AND    uco_rcode   = @sCerstat
    AND    uco_code    = @sCestat  
	
	if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
		set @sChk = N'1'
	else
	begin
    if @sX IS NOT NULL
        set @sChk = N'0'
	end
  
    IF @sChk <> N'0'
	begin
       set @sChk = N'3'
       return
    end

	DECLARE cShutobs CURSOR local FOR SELECT  s.sob_object,
									          s.sob_object_org,
									          s.sob_obtype,
									          s.sob_obrtype,
									          s.sob_standwork,
									          s.sob_projbud,
									          o.obj_location,
									          o.obj_location_org,
									          o.obj_mrc,
									          o.obj_costcode,
									          w.stw_jobtype,
									          w.stw_desc,
									          w.stw_duration,
									          w.stw_priority,
									          w.stw_reqm,
									          w.stw_org,
									          w.stw_woclass,
									          w.stw_woclass_org,
									          o.obj_criticality
									   FROM   r5shutdownobjects s,
									          r5objects         o,
									          r5standworks      w
									   WHERE  s.sob_shutdown  = @sCshutdown
									   AND    s.sob_standwork   IS NOT NULL
									   AND    s.sob_projbud     IS NOT NULL
									   AND    s.sob_projbud IN (
									          SELECT b.pcl_projbud
									          FROM   r5projbudclasses b
									          WHERE  b.pcl_project =  @sCproject )
									   AND    s.sob_standwork      =  w.stw_code
									   AND    s.sob_object         =  o.obj_code
									   AND    s.sob_object_org     =  o.obj_org
									   AND    s.sob_obtype         =  o.obj_obtype

	/* Create all jobs for each valid object/projbud/standwork combination */
	OPEN cShutobs
	FETCH NEXT FROM cShutobs INTO @sSob_object, @sSob_object_org, @sSob_obtype, @sSob_obrtype, @sSob_standwork, 
								  @sSob_projbud, @sObj_location, @sObj_location_org, @sObj_mrc, @sObj_costcode, 
								  @sStw_jobtype, @sStw_desc, @nStw_duration, @sStw_priority, @sStw_reqm, @sStw_org, 
								  @sStw_woclass, @sStw_woclass_org, @sObj_criticality

	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		/* Get event number */
		execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sCeventno OUTPUT, N'EVENT', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		begin
			close cShutobs
			deallocate cShutobs
			RETURN  -1
		end
		IF @sChk <> N'0'
		begin
	       set @sChk = N'4'
		   close cShutobs
		   deallocate cShutobs
	       return
	    end

		execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @nAcd OUTPUT, N'ACCOUNT', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		begin
			close cShutobs
			deallocate cShutobs
			RETURN  -1
		end

		/* Insert EVENT record */
	    INSERT INTO r5events (
					          evt_code,
					          evt_org,
					          evt_desc,
					          evt_type,
					          evt_rtype,
					          evt_obtype,
					          evt_obrtype,
					          evt_object,
					          evt_object_org,
					          evt_status,
					          evt_rstatus,
					          evt_standwork,
					          evt_location,
					          evt_location_org,
					          evt_mrc,
					          evt_date,
					          evt_duration,
					          evt_fixed,
					          evt_jobtype,
					          evt_priority,
					          evt_reqm,
					          evt_target,
					          evt_reported,
					          evt_project,
					          evt_projbud,
					          evt_costcode,
					          evt_class,
					          evt_class_org,
					          evt_schedend,
					          evt_objcriticality,
					          evt_acd )
	    VALUES (
					          @sCeventno,
					          @sOrg,
					          @sStw_desc,
					          @sCetype,
					          @sCertype,
					          @sSob_obtype,
					          @sSob_obrtype,
					          @sSob_object,
					          @sSob_object_org,
					          @sCestat,
					          @sCerstat,
					          @sSob_standwork,
					          @sObj_location,
					          @sObj_location_org,
					          @sObj_mrc,
					          dbo.o7gttime2(@sOrg),
					          @nStw_duration,
					          N'V',
					          @sStw_jobtype,
					          @sStw_priority,
					          @sStw_reqm,
					          @dDatework,
					          dbo.o7gttime2(@sOrg),
					          @sCproject,
					          @sSob_projbud,
					          @sObj_costcode ,
					          @sStw_woclass,
					          @sStw_woclass_org,
					          DATEADD( dd, @nStw_duration - 1, @dDatework ), 
					          @sObj_criticality,
					          @nAcd )

		/* Now call o7creob1 to insert the eventobjects table. */
        execute @nReturn = O7CREOB1 @sCeventno,@sCertype, @sSob_object, @sSob_object_org, @sSob_obtype OUTPUT , @sSob_obrtype OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		begin
			close cShutobs

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CREVT5
    @sCorg           nvarchar(15),
    @sCobtype        nvarchar(4),
    @sCobrtype       nvarchar(4),
    @sCobject        nvarchar(30),
    @sCobjectorg     nvarchar(15),
    @sCmrc           nvarchar(15),
    @sClocation      nvarchar(30),
    @sClocationorg   nvarchar(15),
    @sCstwo          nvarchar(20),
    @sCcomment       nvarchar(4000),
    @sCenteredby     nvarchar(255),
    @sCeventpoint    nvarchar(30),
    @sCeventno       nvarchar(30)  OUTPUT,
    @sChk            nvarchar(4)   OUTPUT
as
   SET NOCOUNT ON
   declare  @dDatework      datetime              /* Event Date */
   declare  @sCertype       nvarchar(4)           /* r5events.evt_rtype%type; */
   declare  @sCetype        nvarchar(4)           /* r5events.evt_type%type; */
   declare  @sCjobtype      nvarchar(4)           /* r5events.evt_jobtype%type; */
   declare  @sCjobrtype     nvarchar(4)           /* r5ucodes.uco_code%type; */
   declare  @sCerstat       nvarchar(4)           /* r5events.evt_rstatus%type; */
   declare  @sCestat        nvarchar(4)           /* r5events.evt_status%type; */
   declare  @sClobtype      nvarchar(4)           /* r5eventobjects.eob_obtype%type  := cobtype; */
   declare  @sClobrtype     nvarchar(4)           /* r5eventobjects.eob_obrtype%type := cobrtype; */
   declare  @sClobject      nvarchar(30)          /* r5eventobjects.eob_object%type  := cobject; */
   declare  @sClobjectorg   nvarchar(15)          /* r5eventobjects.eob_object_org%type  := cobjectorg; */
   declare  @sCdesc         nvarchar(80)          /* r5events.evt_desc%type          := SUBSTR( ccomment, 1, 80 ); */
   declare  @nNdeforg       nvarchar(200)         /*  r5install.ins_desc%type; */
   declare  @sChk1          nvarchar(3)           /* VARCHAR2(3) ; */
   declare  @sCriticality   nvarchar(8)           /* r5objects.obj_criticality%type; */
   declare @sCostcode        nvarchar(30)         /* r5objects.obj_costcode%TYPE */
   declare @nReturn         int
   /* cursor variable declaration */
   declare @sAdd_lang   nvarchar(2)
   declare @sAdd_line   numeric(12)
   declare @sAdd_print  nvarchar(1)
   declare @sAdd_text   nvarchar(4000)

   declare @sSafety     nvarchar(1)     --r5objects.obj_safety%TYPE;
   declare @sPerson        nvarchar(15) --r5objects.obj_person%TYPE;
   declare @sWarranty      nvarchar(1)      --r5events.evt_warranty%TYPE;
   declare @sType          nvarchar(4)      --r5standworks.stw_type%TYPE;
   declare @sSchedgroup nvarchar(30)    --r5events.evt_schedgrp%TYPE;

   declare @nLrfFromPoint  numeric(24,6)
   declare @nLrfToPoint    numeric(24,6)
   declare @nLinearlength  numeric(24,6)
   declare @sTorefdesc     nvarchar(80)
   declare @sTogeoref      nvarchar(1000)
   declare @sFromrefdesc   nvarchar(80)
   declare @sFromgeoref    nvarchar(1000)
   declare @nAcd           bigint

   declare @sEcperson       nvarchar(15)
   declare @sEcschedgrp     nvarchar(30)
   declare @sEccostcode     nvarchar(30)
   declare @sString         nvarchar(500)


   set @sClobtype = @sCobtype
   set @sClobrtype = @sCobrtype
   set @sClobject = @sCobject
   set @sClobjectorg = @sCobjectorg
   set @sCdesc = SUBSTRING( @sCcomment, 1, 80 )

   set @sTorefdesc   = null
   set @sTogeoref    = null
   set @sFromrefdesc = null
   set @sFromgeoref  = null

    execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @nNdeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk1 OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        return -1

    /* Initialize */
    set @sChk = N'0'
    /* Check mandatory parameters */
    IF @sCobtype    IS NULL
    OR @sCobrtype   IS NULL
    OR @sCobject    IS NULL
    OR @sCobjectorg IS NULL
    begin
        set @sChk = N'1'
        return
    end

    /* Fill in default date */
    set @dDatework = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2(@sCorg), N'DD' )

    IF @sCcomment LIKE N'EC#%#EC'
      BEGIN
        /* Called from equipment generation procedure. */
        SET @sString     = SUBSTRING( @sCcomment, 4, 1000 )
        SET @sCestat     = SUBSTRING( @sString, 1, CHARINDEX( '#', @sString ) - 1 )
        IF @sCestat = N'null'
          SET @sCestat = NULL
        SET @sString     = SUBSTRING( @sString, CHARINDEX( '#', @sString ) + 1, 1000 )
        SET @sEcperson   = SUBSTRING( @sString, 1, CHARINDEX( '#', @sString ) - 1 )
        IF @sEcperson = N'null'
          SET @sEcperson = NULL
        SET @sString     = SUBSTRING( @sString, CHARINDEX( '#', @sString ) + 1, 1000 )
        SET @sEcschedgrp = SUBSTRING( @sString, 1, CHARINDEX( '#', @sString ) - 1 )
        IF @sEcschedgrp = N'null'
          SET @sEcschedgrp = NULL
        SET @sString     = SUBSTRING( @sString, CHARINDEX( '#', @sString ) + 1, 1000 )
        SET @sEccostcode = SUBSTRING( @sString, 1, CHARINDEX( '#', @sString ) - 1 )
        IF @sEccostcode = N'null'
          SET @sEccostcode = NULL
        SET @sCdesc      = NULL
      END  
     ELSE
       BEGIN
         /* Get user status for the new work order from installation parameter INSWOST  */
         EXECUTE @nReturn = O7DFLT @sCestat OUTPUT, N'INSWOST', @sChk OUTPUT
         IF @sChk <> N'0'
           BEGIN
             SET @sChk = N'3'
             RETURN
           END 
         IF @sCcomment = N'SBRPRF'
           BEGIN
             SET @sCjobrtype = N'RP'
             SET @sCdesc     = NULL
             SET @sCjobtype  = NULL
             EXECUTE @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sCjobrtype OUTPUT, @sCjobtype OUTPUT, N'JBTP', @sChk OUTPUT
             IF @sChk <> N'0'
               BEGIN
                 SET @sChk = N'2'
                 RETURN
               END
           END
       END
        
    /* Get user type for 'JOB' */
    set @sCertype = N'JOB';
    set @sCetype  = NULL;
    execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sCertype OUTPUT, @sCetype OUTPUT, N'EVTP', @sChk OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        return -1
    IF @sChk <> N'0'
    begin
       set @sChk = N'2'
       return
    end
    execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7RCODE @sCerstat OUTPUT, @sCestat, N'EVST', @sChk OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        return -1
    IF @sChk <> N'0'
    begin
        set @sCerstat = N'R'
        execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sCestat OUTPUT, @sCerstat, N'EVST', @sChk OUTPUT
        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
            return -1

        if @sChk <> N'0'
            begin
                set @sChk = N'3'
                return
            end
    end

    /* Get object criticality */
    SELECT @sCriticality    = obj_criticality,
           @sCostcode       = obj_costcode,
           @sSafety         = obj_safety,
           @sPerson         = obj_person,
           @sSchedgroup     = mrc_schedgroup,
           @nLinearlength   = case when obj_lengthuom is null then null else dbo.O7LRF_O7GET_LINEARREFLENGTH(obj_length, obj_lengthuom, obj_linearrefuom, obj_linearrefprecision) end
    FROM   r5mrcs, r5objects
    WHERE  obj_code = @sCobject
    AND    obj_org  = @sCobjectorg
    AND    obj_mrc  = mrc_code

    IF @sCcomment LIKE N'EC#%#EC'
      BEGIN
        SET @sPerson     = ISNULL( @sEcperson, @sPerson )
        SET @sSchedgroup = ISNULL( @sEcschedgrp, @sSchedgroup )
        SET @sCostcode   = ISNULL( @sEccostcode, @sCostcode )
      END

    execute @nReturn = o7chkwar @sCobject, @sCobjectorg, @sCobtype, @sWarranty OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT, @sCorg
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        return -1

    if @nLinearlength is not null
    begin
        set @nLrfFromPoint = null
        -- get from point and to point information from r5eventpoints if @sCeventpoint is not null
        if @sCeventpoint is not null and @sCeventpoint <> '' 
        begin
            select  @nLrfFromPoint = epo_frompoint, @sFromrefdesc = epo_fromrefdesc, @sFromgeoref = epo_fromgeoref, 
                    @nLrfToPoint   = epo_topoint,   @sTorefdesc   = epo_torefdesc,   @sTogeoref   = epo_togeoref

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CREVT6
    @sEventNo nvarchar(30) ,
    @sCheck   nvarchar(10) OUTPUT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @sX                 nvarchar(1)
    declare @sFixh              nvarchar(1)--r5events.evt_fixed%type
    declare @dStart             datetime
    declare @sNewevent          nvarchar(30)--r5events.evt_code%TYPE
    declare @sCchild            nvarchar(20)--r5standworks.stw_code%TYPE
    declare @sEventtype         nvarchar(4)--r5events.evt_type%TYPE

create function O7CREVT7_GET_HIERARCHY_1 (	@sCode	nvarchar(30),
											@sOrg	nvarchar(15) )
returns @tReturn table( stc_parent		nvarchar(30)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						stc_parent_org	nvarchar(15)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
	declare @nLevel			int
	declare @sCurrentType	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sCurrentRtype	nvarchar(4)
		
	declare @tStack table ( stc_parent		nvarchar(30), 
							stc_parent_org	nvarchar(15), 
							LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack 
		select	stc_parent, 
				stc_parent_org, 
				1 
		  from	r5structures
		 where	stc_child		= @sCode	and 
				stc_child_org	= @sOrg		

	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select	@sCode	= stc_parent,
							@sOrg	= stc_parent_org
					  from	@tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sCode, @sOrg )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_parent = @sCode and stc_parent_org = @sOrg
					insert into @tStack	select	stc_parent, 
												stc_parent_org,
												@nLevel + 1
										  from	r5structures
										 where	stc_child		= @sCode	and 
												stc_child_org	= @sOrg		
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

create PROCEDURE O7CREVTX 
   @sEventno			nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,
   @dEdate				datetime,
   @sEuser				nvarchar(255),
   @sEtype				nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
   @sErtype				nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
   @sEstat				nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
   @sErstat				nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
   @sObstat				nvarchar(4),
   @sEmrc				nvarchar(15),
   @sElocation			nvarchar(30),
   @sElocationorg		nvarchar(15),
   @sEstore				nvarchar(15),
   @sLang				nvarchar(200),
   @sParentcode			nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,
   @sParenttype			nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
   @sParentrtype		nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
   @sObcode				nvarchar(30),
   @sObcodeorg			nvarchar(15),
   @sObtype				nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
   @sObrtype			nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
   @nDuration			numeric(24,6),
   @sFixed				nvarchar(4),
   @nTransorgid			numeric(24,6),
   @sTranscode			nvarchar(4),
   @nTransgroup			numeric(24,6),
   @sChk				nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
   declare @sEwarranty          nvarchar(1)		/*     r5events.evt_warranty%type */
   declare @dDatework           datetime		/* Event Date                 */
   declare @sLangwork			nvarchar(200)		/*r5install.ins_desc%type        Working Language           */
   declare @nDurwork            numeric(24,6)			/* Duration                   */
   declare @sFixedwork          nvarchar(1)		/* Fixed flag                 */
   declare @sDumm               nvarchar(80)	/* Default Language, when     */
   declare @sTemplate           nvarchar(80)	/* Place where Event Type     */
   declare @nTotusage           numeric(24,6)                        /* To define usage            */
   declare @sPrim_uom			nvarchar(30)				/*r5objects.obj_primaryuom%type  UOM for usage              */
   declare @sTempLang			nvarchar(200)
   declare @dTempDate			datetime
   declare @nReturn				integer
   declare @nCount				integer
   declare @sX 				    nvarchar(1)
   declare @nAcd				bigint
   declare @sAcdSeqno			nvarchar(30)

	set @sChk         = N'0'
	set @sDumm       = NULL
	set @sEwarranty  = N'-' /* fixed so far */

	if     @sObcode    IS NULL OR     @sObcodeorg IS NULL
	OR (   @sObtype    IS NULL  AND @sObrtype   IS NULL ) 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			return
		end

	if  @sErstat IS NULL AND @sEstat  IS NULL 
		set @sErstat = N'C'

	if @sEtype IS NULL AND @sErtype IS NULL 
		set @sErtype = N'JOB'
   
	execute @nReturn = O7LANG @sTempLang OUTPUT, @sDumm OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	set @sLangwork  = coalesce( @sLang, @sTempLang)
	set @nDurwork   = coalesce( @nDuration, 1 )
	set @sFixedwork = coalesce( @sFixedwork, N'-' )



	execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dDatework OUTPUT, @sObcodeorg 
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sErtype OUTPUT, @sEtype OUTPUT, N'EVTP', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	if @sChk <> N'0'
		begin
			set @sChk = N'2'
			return
		end


	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sErstat OUTPUT, @sEstat OUTPUT, N'EVST', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	if @sChk <> N'0'
		begin
			set @sChk = N'9'
			return
		end

	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sObrtype OUTPUT, @sObtype OUTPUT, N'OBTP', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	if @sChk <> N'0'
		begin
			set @sChk = N'4'
			return
		end

/* Get text template for event type */
	execute @nReturn = o7desc @sTemplate OUTPUT, @sEtype, NULL, N'EVTP', N'UCOD', @sLangwork, @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	

	if @sChk <> N'0' 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'0'
			select @nCount = count(*)
			FROM   r5rcodes r
			WHERE  r.rco_rcode   = @sErtype
			AND    r.rco_rentity = N'EVTP'

			if @nCount > 0 
				SELECT @sTemplate = r.rco_desc
				FROM   r5rcodes r
				WHERE  r.rco_rcode   = @sErtype
				AND    r.rco_rentity = N'EVTP'
			else
				set @sTemplate = N'T.B.D.'
		end


	if charindex( N'$TP' , @sTemplate ) <> 0 
		begin
			if @sParenttype IS NULL OR @sParentcode IS NULL 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'7'
					return
				end

			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sParentrtype OUTPUT, @sParenttype OUTPUT, N'OBTP', @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
			if @sChk <> N'0'
				begin
					set @sChk = N'8'
					return
				end
		end

	set @sTemplate = REPLACE( @sTemplate, N'$TC', isnull(@sObtype,N'')       )
	set @sTemplate = REPLACE( @sTemplate, N'$CH', isnull(@sObcode ,N'')      )
	set @sTemplate = REPLACE( @sTemplate, N'$TP', isnull(@sParenttype ,N'')  )
	set @sTemplate = REPLACE( @sTemplate, N'$PA', isnull(@sParentcode ,N'')  )
	set @sTemplate = REPLACE( @sTemplate, N'$ST', isnull(@sObstat ,N'')      )
	set @sTemplate = REPLACE( @sTemplate, N'$MR', isnull(@sEmrc  ,N'')       )
	set @sTemplate = REPLACE( @sTemplate, N'$SR', isnull(@sEstore ,N'')      )
	set @sTemplate = REPLACE( @sTemplate, N'$LO', isnull(@sElocation ,N'')  )



	if @sEventno IS NULL 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sEventno OUTPUT, N'EVENT', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1


			if @sChk <> N'0' 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'11'
					return
				end
		end

	if  @sEventno IS NULL
		begin
			set @sChk = N'14'  
			return  
		end
	if  @sEtype   IS NULL
		begin
			set @sChk = N'15'  
			return  
		end

	if  @sErtype  IS NULL
		begin
			set @sChk = N'16'  
			return  
		end

	if  @dDatework IS NULL
		begin
			set @sChk = N'17'  
			return  
		end

	if  @sErstat  IS NULL
		begin
			set @sChk = N'18'  
			return  
		end

	if  @sEstat   IS NULL
		begin
			set @sChk = N'19'  
			return  
		end

	if  @sEmrc    IS NULL
		begin
			set @sChk = N'20'  
			return  
		end

	if  @sFixed   IS NULL
		begin
			set @sChk = N'21'  
			return  
		end

	if  @nDuration IS NULL
		begin
			set @sChk = N'22'  
			return  
		end

	if  @sEwarranty IS NULL
		begin
			set @sChk = N'23'  
			return  
		end

	if  @sTemplate IS NULL
		begin
			set @sChk = N'24'  
			return  
		end

	set @nTotusage = 0
	set @sPrim_uom  = N''
   
   
	select @nCount = count(*)
	FROM   r5objects
	WHERE  obj_code = @sObcode
	AND    obj_org  = @sObcodeorg

	if @nCount > 0 
		SELECT @sPrim_uom = obj_primaryuom
		FROM   r5objects
		WHERE  obj_code = @sObcode
		AND    obj_org  = @sObcodeorg
	else
		set @sX = null        

   
	if @sErtype IN (N'RL', N'DO')      
		SELECT @nTotusage = oud_totalusage
		FROM   r5objusagedefs
		WHERE  oud_object     = @sObcode
		AND    oud_object_org = @sObcodeorg
		AND    oud_uom        = @sPrim_uom
	ELSE
		UPDATE r5objusagedefs
		SET    oud_sinceinstall = 0
		WHERE  oud_object     = @sObcode
		AND    oud_object_org = @sObcodeorg
		AND    oud_uom        = @sPrim_uom


	execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempDate OUTPUT, @sObcodeorg 
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			RETURN -1
			
    execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sAcdSeqno OUTPUT, N'ACCOUNT', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	   return -1
    set @nAcd = cast( @sAcdSeqno as bigint )

	INSERT INTO r5events (
		evt_code,
		evt_org,
		evt_type,
		evt_rtype,
		evt_obtype,
		evt_desc,
		evt_obrtype,
		evt_object,
		evt_object_org,
		evt_reported,
		evt_completed,
		evt_status,
		evt_rstatus,
		evt_location,
		evt_location_org,
		evt_mrc,
		evt_date,
		evt_duration,
		evt_fixed,
		evt_warranty,
		evt_metuom,
		evt_failureusage,
		evt_enteredby,
		evt_transorgid,
		evt_transcode,
		evt_transgroup,
		evt_acd)
	VALUES (
		@sEventno,
		@sObcodeorg,
		@sEtype,
		@sErtype,
		@sObtype,
		SUBSTRING( @sTemplate, 1, 80 ),
		@sObrtype,
		@sObcode,
		@sObcodeorg,
		@dDatework,
		@dTempDate,
		@sEstat,
		@sErstat,
		@sElocation,
		@sElocationorg,
		@sEmrc,
		@dDatework,
		@nDuration,
		N'V',
		@sEwarranty,
		@sPrim_uom,
		@nTotusage,
		@sEuser,
		@nTransorgid,
		@sTranscode,
		@nTransgroup,
		@nAcd)

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7CRFLEX
                 @sTableName NVARCHAR(128)
                ,@sAction    NVARCHAR(30) OUTPUT
AS
/*****************************************************************************************************************************************/
/* 08/20/2003 Milind Patil                                                                                                               */
/* NOTE : The current compatibility level of DSTM database is set at 80 and it is assumed that in future it will stay same or higher. At */
/*        this level or above the SQL server allows multiple triggers for a same action by default. If the compatibility level is set set*/
/*        below 70 for any reason, then the triggers must be created with "WITH APPEND" option in order to make SQL Server allow multiple*/
/*        triggers for a same action.                                                                                                    */
/*****************************************************************************************************************************************/
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @sColumn      NVARCHAR(3)
       ,@sTriggerName NVARCHAR(128)
       ,@sTenant      NVARCHAR(255)
       ,@sTenant1     NVARCHAR(255)
       ,@sTabName     NVARCHAR(128)
       ,@sSQL         NVARCHAR(4000)
       ,@sIdColName   NVARCHAR(40)
	   ,@sSQL2        NVARCHAR(4000)
       ,@sInsert      nvarchar(500)
       ,@sUpdate      nvarchar(500)

declare @sCRLF nvarchar(4)
set @sCRLF = nchar(13) + nchar(10)

SELECT @sIdColName = COL.name            /* Do not put N before the literals used here  */
  FROM sysobjects TBL                    /* since these are used for system tables that */
      ,syscolumns COL                    /* do not use the same collation as the DSTM   */
 WHERE TBL.type = 'U'                    /* database tables.                            */
   AND TBL.name = @sTableName
   AND COL.id = TBL.id
   AND COL.name LIKE '%SQLIDENTITY'

IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
   RETURN -1

IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5flextables WHERE flt_table = @sTableName)
	begin
	   IF @sAction != N'ADD'
		  DELETE FROM r5flextables WHERE flt_table = @sTableName
	end
ELSE
	begin
	   IF @sAction = N'ADD'
		  INSERT INTO r5flextables (flt_table) VALUES (@sTableName )
	end

SELECT @sColumn = SUBSTRING(@sIdColName, 1, 3)
      ,@sTenant = dbo.O7GETTEN()
IF @sTenant IS NULL
   SET @sTenant1 = N'-1'
ELSE
   SELECT @sTenant1 = @sTenant

--SQL 2005 direct recursion workaround
if exists( select 1 from sysobjects op, sysobjects oc
	        where op.name = @sTableName 
	        and oc.parent_obj = op.id and oc.type = 'TR'
	        and ObjectProperty( oc.id, 'ExecIsInsteadOfTrigger') = 1
	        and ObjectProperty( oc.id, 'ExecIsInsertTrigger') = 1 )
    set @sInsert = N'      INSERT INTO FLEX_TRIGGER_WORKAROUND VALUES ( ''' + @sTableName + N''' , ''POST-INSERT'', @sTMPStoreVal1 )' + @sCRLF
else
    set @sInsert = N'      EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7FLXPKG_O7FLXCHK ''' + @sTableName + N''' , ''POST-INSERT'', @sTMPStoreVal1 ' + @sCRLF
             + N'      IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0 ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         BEGIN ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         SET @nReturn = -1 ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         BREAK ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         END ' + @sCRLF

if exists( select 1 from sysobjects op, sysobjects oc
	        where op.name = @sTableName 
	        and oc.parent_obj = op.id and oc.type = 'TR'
	        and ObjectProperty( oc.id, 'ExecIsInsteadOfTrigger') = 1
	        and ObjectProperty( oc.id, 'ExecIsUpdateTrigger') = 1 )
    set @sUpdate = N'      INSERT INTO FLEX_TRIGGER_WORKAROUND VALUES ( ''' + @sTableName + N''' , ''POST-UPDATE'', @sTMPStoreVal1 )' + @sCRLF
else
    set @sUpdate = N'      EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7FLXPKG_O7FLXCHK ''' + @sTableName + N''' , ''POST-UPDATE'', @sTMPStoreVal1 ' + @sCRLF
             + N'      IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0 ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         BEGIN ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         SET @nReturn = -1 ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         BREAK ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         END ' + @sCRLF
--end workaround


/*****************************************************************************************************************************************/
/* POSINS_XXX_S                                                                                                                          */
/*****************************************************************************************************************************************/

SET @sTriggerName = N'POSINS_' + @sColumn + N'_S' + CASE WHEN @sTenant IS NULL THEN N'' ELSE N'_' + @sTenant END

/* handle tables for User Defined Screens */
IF SUBSTRING( @sTableName, 1, 2 ) = 'U5'
   SET @sTriggerName = 'POSIN_' + @sTableName + '_S'

SELECT @sTabName = NULL, @sSQL = NULL
SELECT @sTabName = name
  FROM sysobjects
 WHERE type = 'U'
   AND id = (SELECT parent_obj FROM sysobjects WHERE type = 'TR' AND name = @sTriggerName)

IF @sAction != N'ADD' AND @sTabName = @sTableName
   SET @sSQL = N'DROP TRIGGER ' + @sTriggerName
ELSE IF @sAction = N'ADD' AND @sTabName IS NULL
   BEGIN
   SET @sSQL = N'IF ISNULL(OBJECT_ID(''dbo.' + @sTriggerName + N'''), 0) != 0'
             + N'   DROP TRIGGER dbo.' + @sTriggerName
   EXECUTE (@sSQL)
   IF @@ERROR != 0
      RETURN -1
   SET @sSQL = N'CREATE TRIGGER '+ @sTriggerName + N' ON ' + @sTableName + N' FOR INSERT AS ' + @sCRLF
             + N'BEGIN ' + @sCRLF
             + N'DECLARE @sTMPStoreVal1   NVARCHAR(24) ' + @sCRLF
             + N'       ,@sTenant         NVARCHAR(255) ' + @sCRLF
             + N'       ,@sErrCheck       NVARCHAR(10) ' + @sCRLF
             + N'       ,@sErrMsg         NVARCHAR(240) ' + @sCRLF
             + N'       ,@nReturn         INT ' + @sCRLF
             + N'' + @sCRLF
             + N'DECLARE ScrollTMP CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT ' + @sIdColName + N'  FROM inserted' + @sCRLF
             + N'' + @sCRLF
             + N'SELECT @sErrCheck = N''0'', @sTenant = dbo.O7GETTEN() ' + @sCRLF
             + N'IF @sTenant IS NOT NULL AND CONVERT(INT, @sTenant) != ' + @sTenant1 + @sCRLF
             + N'   RETURN ' + @sCRLF
             + N'' + @sCRLF
             + N'OPEN ScrollTMP ' + @sCRLF
             + N'WHILE 1=1 ' + @sCRLF
             + N'      BEGIN ' + @sCRLF
             + N'      FETCH ScrollTMP INTO @sTMPStoreVal1 ' + @sCRLF
             + N'      IF @@FETCH_STATUS != 0 ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         BREAK ' + @sCRLF
   IF @sTableName IN (N'R5ORDERLINES', N'R5ACCOUNTDETAIL', N'R5REQUISITIONS', N'R5REQUISLINES', N'R5TRANSACTIONS', N'R5TRANSLINES', N'R5ORDERS', N'R5BOOKEDHOURS', N'R5EVENTS', N'R5OBJECTS', N'R5PARTS', N'R5PROPERTYVALUES')
    begin
      SET @sSQL = @sSQL
             + N'      EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7FLXUSR_POSINS_' + @sColumn + N'1 @sTMPStoreVal1, @sErrCheck OUTPUT, @sErrMsg OUTPUT ' + @sCRLF
             + N'      IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0 ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         BEGIN ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         SET @nReturn = -1 ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         BREAK ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         END ' + @sCRLF
             + N'      IF @sErrCheck != N''0'' ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         BEGIN ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         RAISERROR(@sErrMsg, 16, 1)' + @sCRLF
             + N'         SET @nReturn = -1 ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         BREAK ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         END ' + @sCRLF
             + @sInsert
             + N'      EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7FLXUSR_POSINS_' + @sColumn + N'2 @sTMPStoreVal1, @sErrCheck OUTPUT, @sErrMsg OUTPUT ' + @sCRLF
             + N'      IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0 ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         BEGIN ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         SET @nReturn = -1 ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         BREAK ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         END ' + @sCRLF


-- ========================================

				@scnewevent		NVARCHAR(30),
				@scisstype		NVARCHAR(1),
				@dtarget		DATETIME,
				@ddue			DATETIME,
				@nfreq			INTEGER,
				@sccalendaruom	NVARCHAR(1),
                @sPerformonweek nvarchar(1),
                @nPerformonday  numeric(1),
				@nduration		NUMERIC(8),
				@sPpm			nvarchar(20),
				@nPpmrev		int,
				@sObject		nvarchar(30),
				@sObjectorg		nvarchar(15),
				@nMeterdue      NUMERIC(24,6),
				@nMeterdue2     NUMERIC(24,6),
				@nPpopk         NUMERIC,
				@schk			NVARCHAR(4)  OUTPUT,
				@ddeactive      DATETIME = NULL
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @denddate		DATETIME
	DECLARE @ddate			DATETIME
	DECLARE @ifuturedays	INTEGER
	DECLARE @iseqno			INTEGER
	DECLARE @nCount			INTEGER
	declare @dSdate			datetime
	declare @dPpcdate		datetime
	declare @sPpcreuse		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sPpcexists		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sDummy			nvarchar(1)
	declare @dFutdate		datetime



	declare @nMeterdays		numeric(24,2)
	declare @nMeterdays2	numeric(24,2)
	declare @nFreqdays		numeric(8,0)
	declare @dMeterdate		datetime
	declare @dMeterdate2	datetime
	declare @sUsemeter		nvarchar(1)

	-- Initialise
	SET @schk = N'0'
	SET @iseqno = 1
	SET @sUsemeter = N'-'

	SELECT @ifuturedays = ins_desc
	FROM   r5install
	WHERE  ins_code = N'FUTUREPM'
	if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1 OR ISNULL( @ifuturedays, 0 ) = -1
		RETURN

	-- Delete all future events of old event.
	IF @scoldevent IS NOT NULL
		IF @scisstype = N'D'
			BEGIN	
				DELETE FROM r5futureevents
				WHERE fut_event = @scoldevent
				AND   fut_seqno = 1
			END
		ELSE
			DELETE FROM r5futureevents
			WHERE fut_event = @scoldevent

	/* Calculate calendar based. */
	IF coalesce( @nfreq, 0 ) > 0 
		begin
			set @nFreqdays= dbo.o7gtfreq( @nfreq, @sccalendaruom, @ddue )
			IF @scisstype in ( N'F', N'D')
				set @ddate  = @ddue
			ELSE
				set @ddate  = @dtarget
		end


	/* Check for meter. */
	IF @nMeterdue IS NOT NULL
		SELECT @nMeterdays = ROUND( ppo_meter / COALESCE( oud_dfltdailyusg, oud_calcdailyusg ), 2 ), 
			@dMeterdate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( getdate() + ( ( @nMeterdue - oud_totalusage ) / COALESCE( oud_dfltdailyusg, oud_calcdailyusg ) ), N'DD' )
		FROM   r5ppmobjects,
			  r5objusagedefs
		WHERE  ppo_metuom     = oud_uom
		AND    ppo_pk         = @nPpopk
		AND    ppo_revision   = @nPpmrev
		AND    oud_object     = @sObject
		AND    oud_object_org = @sObjectorg
		AND    COALESCE( oud_dfltdailyusg, oud_calcdailyusg ) <> 0

	IF @nMeterdue2 IS NOT NULL
		SELECT @nMeterdays2 = ROUND( ppo_meter2 / COALESCE( oud_dfltdailyusg, oud_calcdailyusg ), 2 ),
			  @dMeterdate2 = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( getdate() + ( ( @nMeterdue2 - oud_totalusage ) / COALESCE( oud_dfltdailyusg, oud_calcdailyusg ) ), N'DD' )
		FROM   r5ppmobjects,
			  r5objusagedefs
		WHERE  ppo_metuom2    = oud_uom
		AND    ppo_pk         = @nPpopk
		AND    ppo_revision   = @nPpmrev
		AND    oud_object     = @sObject
		AND    oud_object_org = @sObjectorg
		AND    COALESCE( oud_dfltdailyusg, oud_calcdailyusg ) <> 0

	/* Get minimum of all three. */
	IF COALESCE( @nFreqdays, 1000000 ) > dbo.F_LEAST_NUMBER( COALESCE( @nMeterdays, 1000000 ), COALESCE( @nMeterdays2, 1000000 ) )
		begin
			SET @sUsemeter = N'+'
			IF coalesce( @nMeterdays, 0 ) <= coalesce( @nMeterdays2, 1000000 ) 
				begin
					set @nFreqdays = coalesce( @nMeterdays, 0 )
					set @ddate     = dbo.F_LEAST_DATE( coalesce( @ddate, getdate() + 100000 ), @dMeterdate )
				end
			ELSE
				begin
					set @nFreqdays = coalesce( @nMeterdays2, 0 )
					set @ddate     = dbo.F_LEAST_DATE( coalesce( @ddate, getdate() + 100000 ), @dMeterdate2 )
				end
		end

    /* Delete future duplicates. */
    IF @scnewevent IS NOT NULL AND @scisstype = N'D' AND @nPpopk IS NOT NULL      
        DELETE FROM r5futureduplicates
        WHERE  fdp_ppopk = @nPpopk

	-- Create future events for new event.
   IF @scnewevent IS NOT NULL AND coalesce( @nFreqdays, 0 ) > 0 AND @ddate IS NOT NULL 
		-- Get number of days in which future events should be created.
		BEGIN
			-- Calculate end date ( 5 future events will always be created ) .
			IF @scisstype in ( N'F', N'D')
				BEGIN
					IF (@ddate + ( 5 * @nFreqdays )) >  (@ddate + @ifuturedays)
						SET @denddate = @ddate + ( 5 * @nFreqdays )
					ELSE
						SET @denddate = @ddate + @ifuturedays
				END
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					SET @ddate = @dtarget
					IF ( @ddate + ( 5 * ( @nFreqdays + @nduration - 1 ) )) >  (@ddate + @ifuturedays )
						SET @denddate = ( @ddate + ( 5 * ( @nFreqdays + @nduration - 1 ) ))
					ELSE
						SET @denddate = (@ddate + @ifuturedays )
				END

			SET @denddate = dbo.F_LEAST_DATE( @denddate, ISNULL( @ddeactive, getdate() + 10000 ) )

			set @dSdate = @ddate
            if @scisstype <> N'D'
                begin
			        SELECT @dPpcdate = ppc_date,
					        @sPpcexists = ppc_reuse
			        FROM   r5ppmcalendars
			        WHERE  ppc_object     = @sObject
			        AND    ppc_object_org = @sObjectorg
			        AND    ppc_ppm        = @sPpm
			        AND    ppc_revision   = @nPpmrev

			        SELECT @dPpcdate = ppc_date,
					        @sPpcreuse = ppc_reuse
			        FROM   r5ppmcalendars
			        WHERE  ppc_object     = @sObject
			        AND    ppc_object_org = @sObjectorg
			        AND    ppc_ppm        = @sPpm
			        AND    ppc_revision   = @nPpmrev
			        AND    ppc_reuse = N'+' 
                end

			if @sPpcreuse is null
				begin
					WHILE @ddate < @denddate
						BEGIN
							set @dPpcdate = null
							-- Do actual insert.
							INSERT INTO r5futureevents (fut_event, fut_seqno, fut_date)
									VALUES (@scnewevent, @iseqno, @ddate)

							if @sPpcexists is not null
								SELECT @dPpcdate = MIN( ppc_date )
								FROM   r5ppmcalendars
								WHERE  ppc_object     = @sObject
								AND    ppc_object_org = @sObjectorg
								AND    ppc_ppm        = @sPpm
								AND    ppc_revision   = @nPpmrev
								AND    ppc_date       > @ddate

							if @dPpcdate is not null 
								set @ddate = @dPpcdate
							else
								begin
									IF @scisstype in ( N'F', N'D')
                                        begin
                                            if @scisstype = N'F'
                                                begin
                                            		IF @sUsemeter = N'+'
					    								SET @ddate = @ddate + @nFreqdays
					    							ELSE
														SET @ddate = @ddate + dbo.o7gtfreq( @nfreq, @sccalendaruom, @ddate )
												end
                                            else
                                                begin
                                                    set @ddate = @ddate + dbo.o7gtfreq( @nfreq, @sccalendaruom, @ddate )
                                                    IF @sPerformonweek IS NOT NULL AND @sccalendaruom NOT IN ( 'D', 'W' )
                                                        set @ddate = dbo.o7gtdate( @ddate, @sPerformonweek, @nPerformonday )
                                                end
                                        end
									ELSE
										begin
											IF @sUsemeter = N'+'
												SET @ddate = @ddate + @nFreqdays + @nduration - 1
											ELSE
												SET @ddate = @ddate + dbo.o7gtfreq( @nfreq, @sccalendaruom, @ddate ) + @nduration - 1
										end
								end

							SET @iseqno = @iseqno + 1

						END
				end
			else
				begin
					declare c_ppc cursor local for SELECT ppc_date, ppc_reuse
													FROM   r5ppmcalendars
													WHERE  ppc_object     = @sObject
													AND    ppc_object_org = @sObjectorg
													AND    ppc_ppm        = @sPpm
													AND    ppc_revision   = @nPpmrev
					open c_ppc
					fetch next from c_ppc into @dPpcdate, @sPpcreuse
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							while @ddate < @denddate
								begin

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CRFUT2
  @sOldevent     NVARCHAR(30),
  @sNewevent     NVARCHAR(30),
  @sMp           NVARCHAR(30),
  @sMporg        NVARCHAR(15),
  @nMprev        NUMERIC,
  @nMpseq        NUMERIC,
  @sObj          NVARCHAR(30),
  @sObjorg       NVARCHAR(15),
  @dTarget       DATETIME,
  @nDuration     NUMERIC
AS

  SET NOCOUNT ON
  DECLARE @nCurseq        NUMERIC 
  DECLARE @sGoon          NVARCHAR(1)

  DECLARE @sMptype        NVARCHAR(4)
  DECLARE @sMetuom        NVARCHAR(30) 
  DECLARE @sReleasetype   NVARCHAR(4) 
  DECLARE @sMetuom2       NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sReleasetype2  NVARCHAR(4)
  DECLARE @dDeactive      DATETIME
  DECLARE @sSeqtype       NVARCHAR(4) 

  DECLARE @nFreqdays      NUMERIC
  DECLARE @nMeterdays     NUMERIC
  DECLARE @nMeterdays2    NUMERIC
  DECLARE @nLeastdays     NUMERIC
  DECLARE @nOldduration   NUMERIC
  DECLARE @nNewduration   NUMERIC
  DECLARE @dNewdate       DATETIME

  DECLARE @nFuturedays    NUMERIC
  DECLARE @dEnddate       DATETIME
  DECLARE @nSeqno         NUMERIC

  SET @sGoon = '+'
  SET @nSeqno = 2

  /* Get number of days in which future events should be created. */
  SELECT @nFuturedays = ins_desc
  FROM   r5install
  WHERE  ins_code = N'FUTUREPM'
  IF COALESCE( @nFuturedays, 0 ) = -1
    RETURN

  /* Delete all future events of old event. */
  IF @sOldevent IS NOT NULL
    DELETE FROM r5futureevents
    WHERE fut_event = @sOldevent

  /* If no need to create new records, return. */
  IF @sNewevent IS NULL OR @dTarget IS NULL
    RETURN

  /* More initialization. */
  SET @dEnddate     = getdate() + @nFuturedays
  SET @nCurseq      = @nMpseq
  SET @nOldduration = @nDuration
  SET @dNewdate     = @dTarget

  /* Get pattern data. */
  SELECT @sMptype       = mtp_mptype,
         @sMetuom       = mtp_metuom, 
         @sReleasetype  = mtp_releasetype,
         @sMetuom2      = mtp_metuom2,
         @sReleasetype2 = mtp_releasetype2
  FROM   r5maintenancepatterns
  WHERE  mtp_code     = @sMp
  AND    mtp_org      = @sMporg
  AND    mtp_revision = @nMprev

  /* Get pattern equipment data. */
  SELECT @dDeactive = peq_deactive
  FROM   r5patternequipment
  WHERE  peq_mp         = @sMp
  AND    peq_mp_org     = @sMporg
  AND    peq_revision   = @nMprev
  AND    peq_object     = @sObj
  AND    peq_object_org = @sObjorg

  /* Do first insert. */
  INSERT INTO r5futureevents ( fut_event, fut_seqno, fut_date, fut_mp_seq )
  VALUES ( @sNewevent, 1, @dTarget, @nCurseq )

  WHILE @sGoon = '+'
    BEGIN
      /* Retrieve next sequence. */
      SELECT @nCurseq = MIN( psq_sequence )
      FROM   r5patternsequences
      WHERE  psq_mp       = @sMp
      AND    psq_mp_org   = @sMporg
      AND    psq_revision = @nMprev
      AND    psq_sequence > @nCurseq
      AND    psq_notused  = N'-'

      IF @nCurseq IS NULL
        BEGIN
          IF @sMptype = N'R'
            /* No next found, but Repeat, so get first sequence. */
            SELECT @nCurseq = MIN( psq_sequence )
            FROM   r5patternsequences
            WHERE  psq_mp       = @sMp
            AND    psq_mp_org   = @sMporg
            AND    psq_revision = @nMprev
            AND    psq_notused  = N'-'
        END 
 
      IF @nCurseq IS NULL
        /* No sequence found, so return. */
        RETURN

      /* Retrieve sequence data. */
      SELECT @sSeqtype    = psq_seqtype, 
             @nFreqdays   = dbo.o7gtfreq( psq_freq, psq_perioduom, @dNewdate ),
             @nMeterdays  = psq_meter / CASE mtp_releasetype 
                                        WHEN N'ED' THEN o1.oud_dfltdailyusg
                                        WHEN N'AD' THEN o1.oud_calcdailyusg
                                        ELSE COALESCE( o1.oud_dfltdailyusg, o1.oud_calcdailyusg ) END,
             @nMeterdays2 = psq_meter2 / CASE mtp_releasetype2
                                         WHEN N'ED' THEN o2.oud_dfltdailyusg
                                         WHEN N'AD' THEN o2.oud_calcdailyusg
                                         ELSE COALESCE( o2.oud_dfltdailyusg, o2.oud_calcdailyusg ) END,
             @nNewduration = stw_duration
      FROM   r5maintenancepatterns
             LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objusagedefs o1
                  ON     o1.oud_object     = @sObj
                     AND o1.oud_object_org = @sObjorg 
                     AND o1.oud_uom        = @sMetuom
                     AND CASE mtp_releasetype 
                         WHEN N'ED' THEN o1.oud_dfltdailyusg
                         WHEN N'AD' THEN o1.oud_calcdailyusg
                         ELSE COALESCE( o1.oud_dfltdailyusg, o1.oud_calcdailyusg ) END <> 0
             LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objusagedefs o2
                  ON     o2.oud_object     = @sObj
                     AND o2.oud_object_org = @sObjorg 
                     AND o2.oud_uom        = @sMetuom2
                     AND CASE mtp_releasetype 
                         WHEN N'ED' THEN o2.oud_dfltdailyusg
                         WHEN N'AD' THEN o2.oud_calcdailyusg
                         ELSE COALESCE( o2.oud_dfltdailyusg, o2.oud_calcdailyusg ) END <> 0,
             r5standworks, 
             r5patternsequences
      WHERE  mtp_code     = psq_mp
      AND    mtp_org      = psq_mp_org
      AND    mtp_revision = psq_revision
      AND    stw_code     = psq_standwork
      AND    psq_mp       = @sMp
      AND    psq_mp_org   = @sMporg
      AND    psq_revision = @nMprev
      AND    psq_notused  = N'-'
      AND    psq_sequence = @nCurseq

      IF @nFreqdays IS NULL AND @nMeterdays IS NULL AND @nMeterdays2 IS NULL
        /* Can't determine interval, so return. */
        RETURN

      /* Get least interval. */
      SET @nLeastdays = dbo.F_LEAST_NUMBER( COALESCE( @nFreqdays, 999999 ), 
                                            dbo.F_LEAST_NUMBER( COALESCE( @nMeterdays, 999999 ), 
                                                                COALESCE( @nMeterdays2, 999999 ) ) )

      SET @nLeastdays = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( @nLeastdays, 1 )

      SET @dNewdate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dNewdate + @Nleastdays, N'DD' )

      IF @sSeqtype = N'AC'
        /* Add duration, if based on actual completion. */
        SET @dNewdate = @dNewdate + @nOldduration - 1
 
      IF ( @dNewdate > @dEnddate AND @nSeqno > 5 ) OR COALESCE( @dDeactive, @dNewdate + 1 ) <= @dNewdate
        /* reached end or deactivation date, so stop. */
        SET @sGoon = N'-'
      ELSE
        /* Do actual insert. */
        INSERT INTO r5futureevents ( fut_event, fut_seqno, fut_date, fut_mp_seq )
        VALUES ( @sNewevent, @nSeqno, @dNewdate, @nCurseq )

      SET @nSeqno = @nSeqno + 1
      SET @nOldduration = @nNewduration

  END


-- ========================================

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CRINVA  @nPk     numeric(38,0),
   @nQty    numeric(24,6),
   @sEvent  nvarchar(30),
   @nAct    numeric(8,0),
   @sUsr    nvarchar(255),
   @sChk    nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
AS
    SET NOCOUNT ON

   declare @nInvadays	numeric(38,0)--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE = NVL( TO_NUMBER( o7dflt( 'INVADAYS', @sChk ) ), 0 )
   declare @sCode		nvarchar(30)--r5translines.trl_trans%TYPE
   declare @nRemqty		numeric(24,6)--NUMBER
   declare @nAllocqty	numeric(24,6)--NUMBER
   declare @sInvorg		nvarchar(30)--r5invoiceallocations.ina_invoice_org%TYPE
   declare @sEvtorg		nvarchar(15)--r5events.evt_org%TYPE
   declare @sStatus		nvarchar(4)--r5events.evt_rstatus%TYPE
   declare @sJobtype	nvarchar(8)--r5events.evt_jobtype%TYPE
   declare @sUtype		nvarchar(4)--r5translines.trl_type%TYPE
   declare @dCompleted	DATETIME
   declare @nReturn		integer

    set @nInvadays = coalesce( cast( dbo.o7dflt2( N'INVADAYS' ) as numeric(38,0)), 0 )

   /* Check mandatory parameters. */
    IF @nPk    IS NULL OR  @nQty   IS NULL OR @sEvent IS NULL OR @sUsr   IS NULL 
        begin
            set @sChk = N'1'
            RETURN
        end
    
   /* Check whether provided pk is correct. */
    SELECT @nRemqty = ina_remqty, 
    @sInvorg = ina_invoice_org
    FROM   r5invoiceallocations
    WHERE  ina_pk = @nPk
    IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
        begin
            set @sChk = N'2'
            RETURN
        end

    /* Qty has to greater than 0. */
    IF @nQty = 0 
        begin
            set @sChk = N'3'
            RETURN
        end

    /* Check whether @nQty is correct ( smaller or equal to remaining @nQty ). */
    IF @nQty > coalesce( @nRemqty, 0 ) 
        begin
            set @sChk = N'4'
            RETURN
        end

	/* Check that deallocation qty is not greater than previously allocated. */
	IF @nQty < 0 
		set @nAllocqty = 0

		SELECT @nAllocqty = SUM( trl_qty )
		FROM   r5translines, r5transactions, r5invalloc
		WHERE  trl_trans = tra_code
		AND    tra_invallocation = ina_pk
		AND    ina_pk = @nPk
		AND    trl_rtype = N'INVA'
		AND    trl_part  = orl_part
		AND    trl_part_org = orl_part_org
		AND    trl_event = @sEvent
		AND    coalesce( trl_act, 0 ) = coalesce( @nAct, 0 )
		IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
			set @nAllocqty = 0

		IF ABS( @nQty ) > @nAllocqty 
			begin
				set @sChk = N'10'
				RETURN
			end
   
   /* Check whether the provide work order exists. */
    SELECT @sStatus = evt_rstatus,
        @dCompleted = evt_completed,
        @sEvtorg = evt_org,
        @sJobtype = uco_rcode
    FROM   r5ucodes, r5events
    WHERE  evt_jobtype = uco_code
    AND    uco_rentity = 'JBTP'      
    AND    evt_code    = @sEvent
    IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
        begin
            set @sChk = N'5'
            RETURN
        end

    /* Check whether completion date is not too far in the past. */
    IF @dCompleted + @nInvadays < dbo.o7gttime2( null ) 
        begin
            set @sChk = N'6'
            RETURN
        end


   /* Compare invoice and work order org. */
    IF @sInvorg <> @sEvtorg 
        begin
            set @sChk = N'7'
            RETURN
        end

    IF @sJobtype = N'IS' 
        begin
            /* For direct issues, the activity should be empty. */
            IF @nAct IS NOT NULL 
                begin
                    set @sChk = N'8'
                    RETURN
                end
        end
    ELSE
        begin
            /* Check activity. */
            IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'x'
                            FROM   r5activities
                            WHERE  act_event = @sEvent
                            AND    act_act = @nAct ) 
                begin
                    set @sChk = N'9'
                    RETURN
                end
        end
   /* reset the remaining @nQty. */
   UPDATE r5invoiceallocations
   SET    ina_remqty = ina_remqty - @nQty
   WHERE  ina_pk = @nPk

   /* Reset active flag, if remaining @nQty = 0. */
   UPDATE r5invoiceallocations
   SET    ina_active = '-',
          ina_inactivated = dbo.o7gttime2( null )
   WHERE  ina_pk = @nPk
   AND    ina_remqty = 0
   AND    ina_active = N'+'

   /* Get the next transactions number. */
    execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sCode OUTPUT, N'TRAN', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	    return -1

   /* Insert a transaction header. */
   INSERT INTO r5transactions( 
          tra_code, 
          tra_org, 
          tra_desc, 
          tra_auth, 
          tra_rtype, 
          tra_date,  
          tra_fromcode, 
          tra_fromrentity, 
          tra_fromrtype, 
          tra_tocode, 
          tra_torentity, 
          tra_tortype, 
          tra_rstatus, 
          tra_printed,
          tra_invallocation )
   SELECT @sCode,
          inv_org,
          inv_desc,
          @sUsr,
          N'INVA',
          dbo.o7gttime2( inv_org ),
          orl_store,
          N'STOR',
          N'*',
          @sEvent,
          N'EVNT',
          N'*',
          N'A',
          N'-',
          ina_pk
   FROM   r5invoices, 
          r5invoicelines, 
          r5orderlines,
          r5invoiceallocations
   WHERE  ina_invoice     = ivl_invoice
   AND    ina_invoice_org = ivl_invoice_org
   AND    ina_invline     = ivl_invline
   AND    ina_invoice     = inv_code
   AND    ina_invoice_org = inv_org
   AND    ivl_order       = orl_order
   AND    ivl_order_org   = orl_order_org
   AND    ivl_ordline     = orl_ordline
   AND    ina_pk = @nPk


    execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sUtype OUTPUT, N'INVA', N'TRTP', @sChk OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	    return -1



    /* And add a transaction line. */
    INSERT INTO r5translines( 
          trl_part, 
          trl_part_org, 
          trl_store, 
          trl_event,
          trl_act, 
          trl_line,
          trl_rtype, 
          trl_type,
          trl_trans, 
          trl_date, 
          trl_qty, 
          trl_price,
          trl_io,
          trl_splittrans )
    SELECT orl_part,
          orl_part_org,
          orl_store,
          @sEvent,
          @nAct,
          1,
          N'INVA',
          @sUtype,
          @sCode,
          dbo.o7gttime2( ivl_invoice_org ),
          @nQty,
          ina_price,
          0,
          N'A'
    FROM   r5invoicelines, 
          r5orderlines,
          r5invoiceallocations
    WHERE  ina_invoice     = ivl_invoice
    AND    ina_invoice_org = ivl_invoice_org

    AND    ivl_order_org   = orl_order_org
    AND    ivl_ordline     = orl_ordline

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CRLRQL
    @sCOrg             nvarchar(15),
    @nNSessionid       numeric(30,0),
    @sCReq             nvarchar(30),
    @sCStore           nvarchar(30),
    @sCsupplier        nvarchar(30),
    @sCsupplierorg     nvarchar(15),
    @sCCostCode        nvarchar(30),
    @sCBuyer           nvarchar(255),
    @sCUser            nvarchar(255),
    @sCDefaultApprover nvarchar(255),
    @sChk              nvarchar(5) OUTPUT AS
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sVStore            nvarchar(15) --   r5stores.str_code%TYPE
    declare @sVBuyer            nvarchar(255)	--   r5requislines.rql_buyer%TYPE
    declare @nVReqLine          numeric(8,0) --   r5requislines.rql_reqline%TYPE
    declare @sVWorkOrder        nvarchar(30)  --   r5requislines.rql_event%TYPE = ''
    declare @sVReqStatus        nvarchar(4)   --r5requisitions.REQ_STATUS%TYPE
    declare @sVReqRStatus       nvarchar(4)   --   r5requisitions.REQ_RSTATUS%TYPE
    declare @dToday             datetime	--   DATE  = TRUNC(o7gttime( @sCOrg ))
    declare @nNlinesAssigned    int   --NUMBER = 0
    declare @sCheckresult		 nvarchar(4)

	declare @sCheckresult2			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX						nvarchar(1)
	declare @nCountit				integer

	declare @sFromRentity       nvarchar(30)
	declare @sLrq_repairable	nvarchar(1)


	declare @sLrq_part nvarchar(120),
			@sLrq_part_org nvarchar(60),
			@nLrq_reqqty numeric(24,6),
			@nLrq_price	numeric(24,6),
			@sLrq_curr	nvarchar(12),
			@sLrq_exch	numeric(24,12),
			@sLrq_uom		nvarchar(120),
			@sLrq_fromentity nvarchar(16),
			@sLrq_fromcode		nvarchar(120),
			@sLrq_fromcode_org	nvarchar(60),
			@dLrq_due				datetime,
			@nLrq_sequence		numeric(8,0),
			@sLrq_costcode nvarchar(30)
	declare @nReturn int

	set @nNlinesAssigned = 0
	set @dToday = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(dbo.O7GTTIME2( @sCOrg ), N'DD')
    set @sChk = N'0'
	
	if @sCBuyer = N'' set @sCBuyer = null
    
	-- udpate requisition header if auto status is A
	SELECT @sVReqStatus = s.str_autoappvstatus
    FROM   r5stores s
    WHERE  s.str_code = @sCStore

    IF @sVReqStatus IS NOT NULL
	begin
		execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7RCODE @sVReqRStatus OUTPUT, @sVReqStatus, N'RQST', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
    end

	/*  get requisition lines */
    declare cCur_reqlines  cursor local for
      SELECT	LRQ_PART,
				LRQ_PART_ORG,
				LRQ_REQQTY,
				LRQ_PRICE,
				LRQ_CURR,
				LRQ_EXCH,
				LRQ_UOM,
				LRQ_FROMRENTITY,
				LRQ_FROMCODE,
				LRQ_FROMCODE_ORG,
				LRQ_DUE,
				LRQ_SEQUENCE, 
				lrq_repairable,
				COALESCE( lrq_costcode, @sCCostCode ) 
      FROM   r5lowstockrequisitions
      WHERE  lrq_sessionid        = @nNSessionid
      AND    lrq_store            = @sCStore
      AND    lrq_fromcode         = @sCsupplier
      AND    (lrq_fromcode_org    = @sCsupplierorg or (@sCsupplierorg is null AND lrq_fromcode_org IS NULL))
      AND    lrq_select = N'+'
      AND    isnull(lrq_buyer, N'X') = isnull(@sCBuyer,N'X')
      AND    lrq_error IS NULL
      ORDER BY lrq_part, lrq_part_org, lrq_sequence
	
	open cCur_reqlines
	fetch next from cCur_reqlines into @sLrq_part, @sLrq_part_org, @nLrq_reqqty, @nLrq_price, @sLrq_curr, @sLrq_exch,
										@sLrq_uom		,
										@sLrq_fromentity ,
										@sLrq_fromcode		,
										@sLrq_fromcode_org	,
										@dLrq_due			,
										@nLrq_sequence, @sLrq_repairable, @sLrq_costcode		
	while @@fetch_status = 0
	begin


		IF @sLrq_repairable = N'+' 
			set @sFromRentity = @sLrq_fromentity + N'REP'
		ELSE
			set @sFromRentity = @sLrq_fromentity 


        /* create requisition lines  */
        set @nNlinesAssigned = @nNlinesAssigned + 1
        execute @nReturn = o7crrql1 @sCReq, @nVReqLine OUTPUT,@sLrq_part, @sLrq_part_org,
                @nLrq_reqqty, @nLrq_price, @sLrq_curr, @sLrq_exch,
                @sLrq_uom, @sFromRentity, @sLrq_fromcode, @sLrq_fromcode_org,
                @sLrq_costcode, @sCBuyer,  @dLrq_due,     @sCStore,
                @sCUser, @sVWorkOrder, @sChk OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			begin
				close cCur_reqlines
				deallocate cCur_reqlines
				return -1
			end

        -- delete the line from r5lowstockrequsition after the requisition line created
		-- create catalog if it does not exist and delete the line from r5lowstockrequsition
       -- after the requisition line created
       

        IF @sChk = N'0'
		begin
			IF @sFromRentity <> N'STOR'
				BEGIN
					/* insert catalogue item if it does not exist (r5catalogue) */
					execute @nReturn = o7existp N'CAT', N'1', @sLrq_fromcode, @sLrq_part, @sLrq_fromcode_org,@sLrq_part_org, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult2  OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						begin
							close cCur_reqlines
							deallocate cCur_reqlines
							return -1
						end
		
					IF @nCountit = 0 
						/* record does not exist in r5catalogue for the supplier, part */
						BEGIN
							INSERT INTO r5catalogue ( 
								cat_supplier,
								cat_supplier_org,
								cat_part,
								cat_part_org,
								cat_puruom,
								cat_date,
								cat_curr,
								cat_exch,
								cat_purprice )
							VALUES (
								@sLrq_fromcode,
								@sLrq_fromcode_org,
								@sLrq_part,
								@sLrq_part_org,
								@sLrq_uom,
								@dToday,
								@sLrq_curr,
								@sLrq_exch,
								@nLrq_price )
						END
				END

            DELETE FROM r5lowstockrequisitions
            WHERE  lrq_sessionid      = @nNSessionid
            AND    lrq_sequence       = @nLrq_sequence
        end

		-- Assign bins for an External Repairable line and the Requisition status is 'Approved'
		IF (@sVReqRStatus = N'A') AND (@sLrq_repairable = N'+') 
			BEGIN
				execute @nReturn = o7asrpbn @sLrq_part, @sLrq_part_org, @sCStore, @sCReq, @nVReqLine, @nLrq_reqqty
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					begin
						close cCur_reqlines
						deallocate cCur_reqlines
						return -1
					end
			END

		fetch next from cCur_reqlines into @sLrq_part, @sLrq_part_org, @nLrq_reqqty, @nLrq_price, @sLrq_curr, @sLrq_exch,
										@sLrq_uom		,
										@sLrq_fromentity ,
										@sLrq_fromcode		,
										@sLrq_fromcode_org	,
										@dLrq_due			,
										@nLrq_sequence,
										@sLrq_repairable,
										@sLrq_costcode


										    
	end 
	close cCur_reqlines
	deallocate cCur_reqlines

    IF @nNlinesAssigned < 1
	begin
        RETURN
    end


    IF @sVReqRStatus = N'A'
		UPDATE r5requisitions
		SET    req_status       = @sVReqStatus,
			   req_rstatus      = @sVReqRStatus,
			   req_auth         = isnull (@sCDefaultApprover, @sCUser),
			   req_dateapproved = @dToday
		WHERE  req_code         = @sCReq

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CRMLP1 
	@sEventno		nvarchar(30),
	@sMrc           nvarchar(15),
	@sChk           nvarchar(4)  OUTPUT 
   
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sMrcstore       nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nCount			integer

BEGIN
/* Initialize */
   set @sChk     = N'0'
/* Check mandatory parameters */
	if @sEventno IS NULL OR @sMrc IS NULL
		begin 
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

	SELECT @sMrcstore = m.mrc_store
	FROM   r5mrcs m
	WHERE  m.mrc_code = @sMrc
	if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
		begin 
			set @sChk = N'2'
			RETURN
		end
	
	if @sMrcstore IS NULL 
		begin 
			set @sChk = N'2'
			RETURN
		end

/* W10373 - Create Variable Material List      */
		INSERT INTO r5reservations  (
			res_event,
			res_act,
			res_crit,
			res_part,
			res_part_org,
			res_qty,
			res_allqty,
			res_store,
			res_project,
			res_projbud )
		SELECT @sEventno,
			l.mtl_act,
			m.mlp_crit,
			m.mlp_part,
			m.mlp_part_org,
			m.mlp_qty,
			0,
			@sMrcstore,
			a.act_project,
			a.act_projbud
		FROM   r5matlparts  m,
			r5activities a,
			r5matlists   l
		WHERE  l.mtl_event    = @sEventno
			AND    m.mlp_matlist  = l.mtl_code
			AND    m.mlp_matlrev  = l.mtl_revision
			AND    a.act_event    = l.mtl_event
			AND    a.act_act      = l.mtl_act
			AND    m.mlp_reserv   = N'+'
			AND    m.mlp_qty IS NOT NULL
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CRMTL1 
    @sCmtlcode        nvarchar(20),
    @sCnewmtlcode     nvarchar(20),
    @sCnewmtldesc     nvarchar(80),
    @sChk             nvarchar(5)   OUTPUT 
as
begin
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @nMatlrev 	int			/*r5matlists.mtl_revision%type;*/
	declare @nReturn 	int
	declare @sMtlcoderev	nvarchar(30)
	declare @sCnewmtlcode1	nvarchar(30)
    /* Initialize                                                              */
    set @sChk = N'0'
    /* Check mandatory parameters                                              */
    IF @sCmtlcode IS NULL
    OR @sCnewmtlcode IS NULL
    OR @sCnewmtldesc IS NULL 
	begin
        set @sChk = N'1'
      	return
    end
    /* Get current approved revision */
    SELECT @nMatlrev = mtl_revision
    FROM   r5matlists
    WHERE  mtl_code = @sCmtlcode
    AND    mtl_revrstatus = N'A';
   
	IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	begin
    	set @sChk = N'2'
        return
    end
    /* Copy material records to the new material code ( r5matlists )           */
    INSERT INTO r5matlists (
		      mtl_code,
		      mtl_org,
		      mtl_revision,
		      mtl_desc,
		      mtl_class,
		      mtl_class_org )
    SELECT   @sCnewmtlcode,
             m.mtl_org,
             0,
             @sCnewmtldesc,
             m.mtl_class,
             m.mtl_class_org
    FROM     r5matlists m
    WHERE    m.mtl_code     = @sCmtlcode
    AND      m.mtl_revision = @nMatlrev
    /* Copy material parts to the new material code ( r5matlparts )            */
    INSERT INTO r5matlparts (
		      mlp_matlist,
		      mlp_matlrev,
		      mlp_line,
		      mlp_part,
		      mlp_part_org,
		      mlp_qty,
		      mlp_uom ,
		      mlp_reserv,
		      mlp_crit,
		      mlp_obtype,
		      mlp_obrtype,
		      mlp_code,
		      mlp_code_org,
		      mlp_direct,
		      mlp_equipfilter )
    SELECT @sCnewmtlcode,
           0,
           m.mlp_line,
           m.mlp_part,
           m.mlp_part_org,
           m.mlp_qty,
           m.mlp_uom ,
           m.mlp_reserv,
           m.mlp_crit,
           m.mlp_obtype,
           m.mlp_obrtype,
           m.mlp_code,
           m.mlp_code_org,
           m.mlp_direct,
           m.mlp_equipfilter
    FROM    r5matlparts m
    WHERE   m.mlp_matlist = @sCmtlcode
    AND     m.mlp_matlrev = @nMatlrev
	/* Copy FF text, properties and documents associated */
	set @sMtlcoderev = @sCmtlcode + N'#' + CAST(@nMatlrev as nvarchar(4))
	set @sCnewmtlcode1 = @sCnewmtlcode + N'#0'
	execute @nReturn = O7COPDAT @sMtlcoderev, @sCnewmtlcode1, N'MATL', N'MATL', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CRORD1
                 @sOrder       NVARCHAR(30) OUTPUT
                ,@nOrderLine   NUMERIC(8, 0) OUTPUT
                ,@sOrg         NVARCHAR(15)
                ,@dDueDate     DATETIME
                ,@sSupplier    NVARCHAR(30)
                ,@sSupplierOrg NVARCHAR(15)
                ,@sStore       NVARCHAR(15)
                ,@sOrigin      NVARCHAR(15)
                ,@sBuyer       NVARCHAR(255)
                ,@sReq         NVARCHAR(30)
                ,@nReqLine     NUMERIC(8, 0)
                ,@sPart        NVARCHAR(30)
                ,@sPartOrg     NVARCHAR(15)
                ,@dDue         DATETIME
                ,@nPrice       NUMERIC(24, 6)
                ,@sCurr        NVARCHAR(3)
                ,@nExch        NUMERIC(24, 12)
                ,@nQty         NUMERIC(24, 6)
                ,@sCostCode    NVARCHAR(30)
                ,@sProject     NVARCHAR(20)
                ,@sProjBud     NVARCHAR(20)
                ,@sEvent       NVARCHAR(30)
                ,@nAct         NUMERIC(8, 0)
                ,@sUOM         NVARCHAR(30)
                ,@sRType       NVARCHAR(4)
                ,@sType        NVARCHAR(4)
                ,@nINMultiply  NUMERIC(10, 4)
                ,@sTask        NVARCHAR(20)
                ,@nTaskQty     NUMERIC(24, 6)
                ,@nTaskRev     NUMERIC(4, 0)
                ,@sDelAddress  NVARCHAR(20)
                ,@sTrade       NVARCHAR(15)
                ,@sInspect     NVARCHAR(1)
                ,@sStatus      NVARCHAR(4)
                ,@sCheck       NVARCHAR (4) OUTPUT
                ,@dOrderDate   DATETIME
                ,@sUser		   nvarchar(255) = null
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @sORDRStatus     NVARCHAR(4)
       ,@sORLRStatus     NVARCHAR(4)
       ,@sORDType        NVARCHAR(4)
       ,@sORDDesc        NVARCHAR(80)
       ,@sORDContract    NVARCHAR(30)
       ,@sCOMCurr        NVARCHAR(3)
       ,@sCRRExch        NUMERIC(24, 12)
       ,@nORLOrdLine     NUMERIC(8, 0)
       ,@sADDEntity      NVARCHAR(4)
       ,@sADDType        NVARCHAR(4)
       ,@sADDRType       NVARCHAR(4)
       ,@sLineNo         NVARCHAR(10)
       ,@nCATTaskQty     NUMERIC(24, 6)
       ,@nCATMultiply    NUMERIC(10, 4)
       ,@nCATPurPrice    NUMERIC(24, 6)
       ,@sCATPurUOM      NVARCHAR(30)
       ,@sCATCostcode    NVARCHAR(30)
       ,@nMultiply       NUMERIC(10, 4)
       ,@nPurPrice       NUMERIC(24, 6)
       ,@sPurUOM         NVARCHAR(30)
       ,@sCATCurr        NVARCHAR(3)
       ,@sCATRef         NVARCHAR(50)
       ,@nORLDiscPerc    NUMERIC(24, 6)
       ,@nSCAMultiply    NUMERIC(10, 4)
       ,@sSCAUOM         NVARCHAR(30)
       ,@sRQLSupplier    NVARCHAR(30)
       ,@sRQLSupplierOrg NVARCHAR(15)
       ,@dORDDate        DATETIME
       ,@sDummy          NVARCHAR(100)
       ,@sChk            NVARCHAR(10)
       ,@nReturn         INT
       ,@dDate           DATETIME
       ,@sParam1         NVARCHAR(250)
       ,@sParam2         NVARCHAR(250)
       ,@sParam3         NVARCHAR(250)
       ,@sTemp			 NVARCHAR(50)
       ,@sTaxcode               NVARCHAR(20)
       ,@nPercent               numeric(24,6)
       ,@nOrltottaxamount       numeric(24,6)
       ,@sX			 nvarchar(1)
       ,@nInvcalctpercent	 numeric(24,6)
       ,@nOrlinvcalctaxamount	 numeric(24,6)
       ,@nCatleadtime           numeric(4,1)		--r5catalogue.cat_leadtime%TYPE;
       ,@dOrldue                datetime			--r5orderlines.orl_due%type;        /* Order line due time */
       ,@sRQLRef		 nvarchar(50)
       ,@sLcstatus     	 nvarchar(4)
       ,@sOrlinref		 nvarchar(50)--r5catalogue.cat_ref%TYPE;
       ,@sRqlrelatedwo		 nvarchar(30)
       ,@sRqlquotid		 nvarchar(30)
       ,@sRqlquotline		 numeric(8, 0)
       ,@sRqlmanufacturer        nvarchar(24)
       ,@sRqlmanufactpart        nvarchar(50)
       ,@nCreditCard            numeric
       ,@nOrltotamount		numeric(24,6)
       ,@sRqlnote               NVARCHAR(256)
       ,@sRqllongdescription    NVARCHAR(4000)




SET @sCheck = N'0'
EXECUTE @nReturn = O7DFLT @sLineNo OUTPUT, N'INCRLINO', @sChk
IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0
   RETURN -1
SET @sLineNo = ISNULL(@sLineNo, N'10')

/* Check mandatory parameters */
IF @sOrder IS NULL
    begin
       IF @dDueDate     IS NULL OR
          @sSupplier    IS NULL OR
          @sSupplierOrg IS NULL OR
          @sStore       IS NULL OR
          @sOrigin      IS NULL OR
          @dDue         IS NULL OR
          @nPrice       IS NULL OR
          @sCurr        IS NULL OR
          @nExch        IS NULL OR
          @nQty         IS NULL OR
          @sRType       IS NULL OR
          @sType        IS NULL
          BEGIN
		      SET @sCheck = N'1'
		      RETURN
          END
    end
ELSE
    begin
       IF @sSupplier    IS NULL OR
          @sSupplierOrg IS NULL OR
          @dDue         IS NULL OR
          @nPrice       IS NULL OR
          @sCurr        IS NULL OR
          @nExch        IS NULL OR
          @nQty         IS NULL OR
          @sRType       IS NULL OR
          @sType        IS NULL
          BEGIN
		      SET @sCheck = N'1'
		      RETURN
          END
    end

/* Get the system status for the given userstatus */
EXECUTE @nReturn = R5O7_O7RCODE @sORDRStatus OUTPUT, @sStatus, N'DOST', @sCheck OUTPUT
IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0
   RETURN -1

IF @sORDRStatus != N'R'
	SET @sORLRStatus =  @sORDRStatus
ELSE
	SET @sORLRStatus = N'U';

/* Get the system status for the orderline user status */
EXECUTE @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sLcstatus OUTPUT,@sORLRStatus, N'RLST', @sCheck OUTPUT
IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0
   RETURN -1

/* Get the user type for the given type */
EXECUTE @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sORDType OUTPUT, N'P', N'POTP', @sCheck OUTPUT
IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0
   RETURN -1

/* Check Order code, if null then create a new order before creating lines */
IF @sOrder IS NULL
   BEGIN
   EXECUTE @nReturn = O7DFLT @sORDDesc OUTPUT, N'PORDDESC', @sCheck OUTPUT
	IF @sORDDesc IS NULL or @sORDDesc =''
	   SET @sORDDesc =N'*'

   IF @sCheck != N'0'
      BEGIN
		  SET @sCheck = N'3'
		  RETURN
      END
   /* Get Supplier currency */
   SELECT @sCOMCurr = com_curr
     FROM r5companies
    WHERE com_code = @sSupplier
      AND com_org = @sSupplierOrg
   IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
      BEGIN
		  SET @sCheck = N'4'
		  RETURN
      END

   /* Get contract */
   set @sTemp = @sSupplier + N'#' + @sSupplierOrg
   set @sORDContract = @sStore
   EXECUTE @nReturn = O7GMOREC N'CONT', 11, @sTemp, @sOrg, @sCOMCurr, @sDummy, @sORDContract OUTPUT, @sDummy OUTPUT, @sDummy OUTPUT, @sDummy OUTPUT, @sDummy OUTPUT, @sDummy OUTPUT, @sDummy OUTPUT, @sDummy OUTPUT, @sCheck OUTPUT
	IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0
	   RETURN -1
   /* Get Exchange rate for supplier currency */
   /* Directly use value of parameter nexch as exchange rate. -- PVCS#19450 */
   	--PVCS#18524(Shotgun) Revaluate the excheange based on supplier currency and order org
   	set @sCRRExch = dbo.O7GTEXCH2( @sCOMCurr, @sOrg, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dORDDate, N'DD') )

    /* Retrieve default User credit card */
        SELECT @nCreditCard = crd_code
        FROM r5creditcards
        WHERE crd_active ='+'
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5creditcardusers u
        WHERE crd_code = u.ccu_code
        AND u.ccu_user = @sUser
        AND u.ccu_default = '+' )


   /* Generate order code */
   EXECUTE @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sOrder OUTPUT, N'PORD', N'1', @sCheck OUTPUT
	IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0
	   RETURN -1
   IF @sCheck != N'0'
      BEGIN
		  SET @sCheck = N'2'
		  RETURN
      END
   /* Inserting order with the newly generated order code */
   EXECUTE @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dORDDate OUTPUT, @sOrg
	IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0
	   RETURN -1
   INSERT INTO r5orders
              (ord_code
              ,ord_revision
              ,ord_org

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CRORD2
                 @sOrder        NVARCHAR(30) OUTPUT

                ,@dDueDate      DATETIME

                ,@nPrice        NUMERIC(24, 6)

                ,@sProject      NVARCHAR(20)

                ,@sEvent        NVARCHAR(30)
                ,@nAct          NUMERIC(8, 0)
                ,@sUOM          NVARCHAR(30)
                ,@sRType        NVARCHAR(4)
                ,@sType         NVARCHAR(4)
                ,@nINMultiply   NUMERIC(10, 4)
                ,@sBlanketOrder NVARCHAR(30)
                ,@nBlanketLine  NUMERIC(8, 0)
                ,@sDelAddress   NVARCHAR(20)
                ,@sStatus       NVARCHAR(4)
                ,@sCheck        NVARCHAR OUTPUT
                ,@dOrderDate    DATETIME
                ,@sUser		   nvarchar(255) = null

AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @sORDDesc              NVARCHAR(80)
       ,@sCOMCurr              NVARCHAR(3)
       ,@nCRRExch              NUMERIC(24, 12)
       ,@nORLOrdLine           NUMERIC(8, 0)
       ,@sLineNo               NVARCHAR(10)
       ,@nBLOMaxAmount         NUMERIC(24, 6)
       ,@nBLOCurAmountRel      NUMERIC(24, 6)
       ,@nBLOExch              NUMERIC(24, 12)
       ,@nBLLMaxLineQty        NUMERIC(24, 6)
       ,@nBLLCurQtyRel         NUMERIC(24, 6)
       ,@nBLLMaxLineAmount     NUMERIC(24, 6)
       ,@nBLLCurAmountRel      NUMERIC(24, 6)
       ,@sBLOBlanketOrder      NVARCHAR(30)
       ,@nRQLBlanketOrderCount INT
       ,@dDate                 DATETIME
       ,@sDummy                NVARCHAR(250)
       ,@sChk                  NVARCHAR(3)
       ,@nReturn               INT
       ,@nCATMultiply          NUMERIC(10, 4)
       ,@nCATPurPrice          NUMERIC(24, 6)
       ,@sCATPurUOM            NVARCHAR(30)
       ,@sCATCurr              NVARCHAR(3)
       ,@sCATRef               NVARCHAR(50)
       ,@sCATCostcode          NVARCHAR(30)
       ,@sPARInspect           NVARCHAR(1)
       ,@nCatleadtime         numeric(4,1)		--r5catalogue.cat_leadtime%TYPE;
       ,@dOrldue              datetime			--r5orderlines.orl_due%type;        /* Order line due time */
       ,@sRQLRef	       nvarchar(50)
       ,@sOrstatus            nvarchar(4)
       ,@sLcstatus            nvarchar(4)
       ,@sLrstatus            nvarchar(4)
       ,@sRqlrelatedwo        nvarchar(30)    --r5requislines.rql_relatedwo%TYPE;
       ,@nCreditCard          numeric
       ,@sTaxcode             NVARCHAR(20)
       ,@nPercent             numeric(24,6)
       ,@nOrltottaxamount     numeric(24,6)
       ,@nInvcalctpercent     numeric(24,6)
       ,@nOrlinvcalctaxamount numeric(24,6)

SELECT @sCheck = N'1'
      ,@sChk = N'0'
IF @sOrder IS NULL
    begin
       IF @dDueDate     IS NULL OR
          @sSupplier    IS NULL OR
          @sSupplierOrg IS NULL OR
          @sStore       IS NULL OR
          @sOrigin      IS NULL OR
          @dDue         IS NULL OR
          @nPrice       IS NULL OR
          @sCurr        IS NULL OR
          @nExch        IS NULL OR
          @nQty         IS NULL OR
          @sRType       IS NULL OR
          @sType        IS NULL
	          RETURN
    end
ELSE
    begin
       IF @sSupplier    IS NULL OR
          @sSupplierOrg IS NULL OR
          @dDue         IS NULL OR
          @nPrice       IS NULL OR
          @sCurr        IS NULL OR
          @nExch        IS NULL OR
          @nQty         IS NULL OR
          @sRType       IS NULL OR
          @sType        IS NULL
	          RETURN
    end

SET @sCheck = N'0'
EXECUTE @nReturn = O7DFLT @sLineNo OUTPUT, N'INCRLINO', @sChk OUTPUT
IF @@ERROR != 0 or @nReturn != 0
   RETURN -1
IF @sLineNo IS NULL
   SET @sLineNo = N'10'

SELECT @sCOMCurr = com_curr
  FROM r5companies
 WHERE com_code = @sSupplier
   AND com_org = @sSupplierOrg
IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
   BEGIN
	   SET @sCheck = N'4'
	   RETURN
   END

SET @nCRRExch= @nExch
SET @sBLOBlanketOrder = NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rql_blanketorder)
  FROM r5requislines
 WHERE rql_req  = @sReq
   AND rql_blanketorder IS NOT NULL

IF @nRQLBlanketOrderCount = 1
   SET @sBLOBlanketOrder = @sBlanketOrder

IF @sBlanketOrder IS NOT NULL AND @nBlanketLine IS NOT NULL
   BEGIN
	   SELECT @nBLOMaxAmount = blo_maxamount
			 ,@nBLOCurAmountRel = blo_curamountrel
			 ,@nBLOExch = blo_exch
		 FROM r5blanketorders
		WHERE blo_blanketorder = @sBlanketOrder
	   IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
		  BEGIN
			  SET @sCheck = N'7'
			  RETURN
		  END
	   IF @nBLOMaxAmount < (ISNULL(@nBLOCurAmountRel, 0) + (@nQty * @nPrice / ISNULL(@nExch, @nCRRExch) * @nBLOExch))
		  BEGIN
			  SET @sCheck = N'8'
			  RETURN
		  END
	   SELECT @nBLLMaxLineQty = bll_maxlineqty
			 ,@nBLLCurQtyRel = bll_curqtyrel
			 ,@nBLLMaxLineAmount = bll_maxlineamount
			 ,@nBLLCurAmountRel = bll_curamountrel
		 FROM r5blanketordlines
		WHERE bll_blanketorder = @sBlanketOrder
		  AND bll_blanketline  = @nBlanketLine
	   IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
		  BEGIN
			  SET @sCheck = N'9'
			  RETURN
		  END
	   IF @nBLLMaxLineQty < (ISNULL(@nBLLCurQtyRel, 0) + @nQty)
		  BEGIN
			  SET @sCheck = N'10'
			  RETURN
		  END
	   IF @nBLLMaxLineAmount < (ISNULL(@nBLLCurAmountRel, 0) + (@nQty * @nPrice))
		  BEGIN
			  SET @sCheck = N'11'
			  RETURN
		  END
   END

EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.R5O7_O7RCODE @sOrstatus OUTPUT, @sStatus, N'DOST', @sCheck OUTPUT
IF @@ERROR != 0 or @nReturn != 0
   RETURN -1

set @sLcstatus = @sStatus

EXECUTE @nReturn = R5O7_O7RCODE @sLrstatus OUTPUT, @sLcstatus, N'RLST', @sCheck OUTPUT
IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0
   RETURN -1
if @sCheck = N'3'
    begin
        set @sLrstatus = @sOrstatus
        execute @nReturn = r5o7_o7ucode @sLcstatus OUTPUT, @sLrstatus, N'RLST', @sCheck OUTPUT
        IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0
           RETURN -1

        if @sCheck = N'4'
            begin
                set @sCheck = N'999'
                return
            end
    end

IF @sOrder IS NULL
   BEGIN
	   EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7DFLT @sORDDesc OUTPUT, N'PORDDESC', @sCheck OUTPUT
		IF @@ERROR != 0 or @nReturn != 0
		   RETURN -1
	   IF @sCheck != N'0'
		  BEGIN
			  SET @sCheck = N'3'
			  RETURN
		  END
		  
	/* Retrieve default User credit card */
        SELECT @nCreditCard = crd_code
        FROM r5creditcards
        WHERE crd_active ='+'
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5creditcardusers u
        	    WHERE crd_code = u.ccu_code
        	    AND u.ccu_user = @sUser
        	    AND u.ccu_default = '+' )
        
        
	   EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sOrder OUTPUT, N'PORD', N'1', @sCheck OUTPUT
		IF @@ERROR != 0 or @nReturn != 0
		   RETURN -1
	   IF @sCheck != N'0'
		  BEGIN
			  SET @sCheck = N'2'
			  RETURN
		  END
	   EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7GTTIME @dDate OUTPUT, @sOrg
		IF @@ERROR != 0 or @nReturn != 0
		   RETURN -1
	   INSERT INTO r5orders
				  (ord_code
				  ,ord_org
				  ,ord_revision
				  ,ord_desc
				  ,ord_type
				  ,ord_rtype
				  ,ord_supplier
				  ,ord_supplier_org
				  ,ord_date
				  ,ord_due
				  ,ord_rstatus
				  ,ord_status
				  ,ord_curr
				  ,ord_exch
				  ,ord_origin
				  ,ord_store
