CREATE PROCEDURE O7CRORL2 
    @sQcode        nvarchar(30),
    @sQseqno       nvarchar(2),
    @sQdesc        nvarchar(80),
    @sQsupplier    nvarchar(30),
    @sQsupplierorg nvarchar(15),
    @sQstore       nvarchar(15),
    @sQbuyer       nvarchar(255),
    @sQorigin      nvarchar(15),
    @nQleadtime    numeric(24,12),
    @dQdue         datetime,
    @sQcurr        nvarchar(3),
    @nQexch        numeric(24,12),
    @sQuser        nvarchar(4),
    @sQorg         nvarchar(15),
    @sOrdno    	  nvarchar(30)  OUTPUT,
    @sChk      	  nvarchar(5) OUTPUT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sStatus           nvarchar(4)		/* r5orders.ord_status%type  */
    declare @sRstatus          nvarchar(4)		/* r5orders.ord_rstatus%type  */
    declare @sRtype            nvarchar(4)		/* r5orders.ord_rtype%type */
    declare @sUtype            nvarchar(4)		/* r5orders.ord_type%type */
    declare @sOrltype          nvarchar(4)		/* r5orderlines.orl_type%type */
    declare @sOrlrtype         nvarchar(4)		/* r5orderlines.orl_rtype%type */
    declare @sOrlstatus        nvarchar(4)		/* r5orderlines.orl_status%type */
    declare @sOrlrstatus       nvarchar(4)		/* r5orderlines.orl_rstatus%type */
    declare @sCrtype           nvarchar(4)		/* r5orderlines.orl_rtype%type */
    declare @nNordline         numeric(8,0)
    declare @nNordqty          numeric(24,6)
    declare @nNordprice        numeric(24,6)
    declare @nNexch            numeric(24,12)
    declare @nNprice           numeric(24,6)
    declare @nNorddiscount     numeric(24,6)
    declare @nTaxperc			numeric(24,6)
    declare @nInvcalctaxperc	numeric(24,6)
    declare @nNorddiscperc     numeric(18,0)
    declare @sCheckr           nvarchar(4)
    declare @sQdeladdress      nvarchar(20)		/* r5quotations.quo_deladdress%type */
	declare @nReturn		   int
	/* declare cursor variable */
	declare 	   @sQul_event			nvarchar(30)
    declare        @nQul_act			numeric(8,0)
    declare        @nQul_line			numeric(8,0)
    declare        @sQul_type			nvarchar(4)
    declare        @sQul_rtype			nvarchar(4)
    declare        @nQul_sqlidentity  	int
	declare 	   @nOrl_ordline		numeric(8,0)
	declare  	   @sOrl_req			nvarchar(30)
	declare        @nOrl_reqline		numeric(8,0)
	declare		   @sOrl_tax			nvarchar(20)

	/* Initialize */
    set @sChk     = N'0'
	/* Check mandatory parameters */
    IF @sQcode        IS NULL OR
        @sQseqno       IS NULL OR
        @sQdesc        IS NULL OR
        @sQsupplier    IS NULL OR
        @sQsupplierorg IS NULL OR
        @sQstore       IS NULL OR
        @sQcurr        IS NULL
	begin
        set @sChk = N'1'
        RETURN
    end
    SELECT @sQdeladdress = quo_deladdress
    FROM   r5quotations
    WHERE  quo_code = @sQcode
    AND    quo_seqno = @sQseqno
 
	set @sStatus     = N''
    set @sRstatus    = N'U'
 
	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sRstatus OUTPUT, @sStatus OUTPUT, N'DOST', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
    IF @sChk <> N'0'
	begin
        set @sChk = N'1'
        RETURN
    end
    set @sUtype      = N''
    set @sRtype      = N'P'
  
	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sRtype OUTPUT, @sUtype OUTPUT, N'POTP', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
    IF @sChk <> N'0'
	begin
        set @sChk = N'1'
        RETURN
    end
    set @sOrlstatus  = N''
    set @sOrlrstatus = N'U'
   
	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sOrlrstatus OUTPUT, @sOrlstatus OUTPUT, N'RLST', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
    IF @sChk <> N'0'
	begin
        set @sChk = N'1'
        RETURN
    end
  
	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sOrdno OUTPUT, N'PORD', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		RETURN  -1
    IF @sChk <> N'0'
	begin
        set @sChk = N'1'
        RETURN
    end
   /* Insert actual order */
      
    INSERT INTO r5orders
              ( ORD_CODE,
                ORD_ORG,
                ORD_REVISION,
                ORD_DATE,
                ORD_DESC,
                ORD_DUE,
                ORD_BUYER,
                ORD_ORIGIN,
                ORD_RSTATUS,
                ORD_STATUS,
                ORD_RTYPE,
                ORD_TYPE,
                ORD_SUPPLIER,
                ORD_SUPPLIER_ORG,
                ORD_STORE,
                ORD_CURR,
                ORD_EXCH,
		        ORD_DELADDRESS
              )
    VALUES (  @sOrdno,
                @sQorg,
                1,
                dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2(@sQorg), N'DD' ),
                @sQdesc,
                dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2(@sQorg), N'DD' ) + isnull( @nQleadtime, 0 ),
                @sQbuyer,
                @sQorigin,
                @sRstatus,
                @sStatus,
                @sRtype,
                @sUtype,
                @sQsupplier,
                @sQsupplierorg,
                @sQstore,
                @sQcurr,
                @nQexch,
      	        @sQdeladdress )
	if @@ERROR <>0
	begin
        set @sChk = N'4'
        RETURN
    end
    /* Insert attached service orderlines */
	DECLARE cAct CURSOR LOCAL FOR
    SELECT q.qul_event,
          q.qul_act,
          q.qul_line,
          q.qul_type,
          q.qul_rtype,
          q.qul_sqlidentity
    FROM   r5quotlines q
    WHERE  q.qul_quotation = @sQcode
    AND    q.qul_seqno     = @sQseqno
    AND    q.qul_price IS NOT NULL
    AND  ( q.qul_event IS NOT NULL OR q.qul_rtype = N'SH' )
    AND    q.qul_rtype LIKE N'S%'
    AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
                    FROM   r5activities a
                    WHERE  a.act_event = q.qul_event
                    AND    a.act_act   = q.qul_act
                    AND    a.act_order IS NOT NULL )
    AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
                    FROM   r5orderlines o
                    WHERE  o.orl_req      = q.qul_req
                    AND    o.orl_reqline  = q.qul_reqline
                    AND    o.orl_rstatus <> N'J' )
    AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
                    FROM   r5requislines l
                    WHERE  l.rql_req      = q.qul_req
                    AND    l.rql_reqline  = q.qul_reqline
                    AND    l.rql_rstatus <> N'A' )
	OPEN cAct
	FETCH NEXT FROM cAct INTO @sQul_event,@nQul_act,@nQul_line,@sQul_type,@sQul_rtype,@nQul_sqlidentity
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	begin
    	INSERT INTO r5orderlines ( orl_order,
                                    orl_order_org,
                                    orl_ordline,
                                    orl_event,
                                    orl_act,
                                    orl_curr,
                                    orl_exch,
                                    orl_ordqty,
                                    orl_price,
                                    orl_active,
                                    orl_rtype,
                                    orl_type,
                                    orl_rstatus,
                                    orl_status,
                                    orl_supplier,
                                    orl_supplier_org,
                                    orl_store,
                                    orl_due ,
			           	      		orl_req,
				            		orl_reqline,
				            		orl_task,
				            		orl_taskrev,
				            		orl_taskqty,
                                    orl_puruom,
				            		orl_trade,
				            		orl_deladdress,
                                    orl_costcode,
                                    orl_project,
                                    orl_projbud,
									orl_relatedwo )
        SELECT  @sOrdno,
                @sQorg,
                q.qul_line,
                q.qul_event,
                q.qul_act,
                q.qul_curr,
                q.qul_exch,

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7CRPCL1
                 @sProject NVARCHAR(20)
                ,@sProjBud NVARCHAR(6)
                ,@sCheck   NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT

AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @nLevel    INT
       ,@sProjItem NVARCHAR(30)
DECLARE @tProjects   TABLE (prj_code   NVARCHAR(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN NOT NULL)
DECLARE @tLevelItems TABLE (item       NVARCHAR(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN NOT NULL
                           ,item_level INT                                               NOT NULL)

SET @sCheck = N'1'
IF @sProject IS NULL OR @sProjBud IS NULL
   RETURN

SET @sCheck = N'0'
SELECT @nLevel = 1
      ,@sProjItem = @sProject
INSERT INTO @tLevelItems VALUES (@sProjItem, @nLevel)

/* The original PL/SQL code uses hierarchical query hence first populate a table variable in hierarchical manner */

WHILE @nLevel > 0
      BEGIN
      IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @tLevelItems WHERE item_level = @nLevel)
         BEGIN
         SELECT @sProjItem = item
           FROM @tLevelItems
          WHERE item_level = @nLevel
         INSERT INTO @tProjects VALUES (@sProjItem)
         DELETE FROM @tLevelItems
          WHERE item_level = @nLevel
            AND item = @sProjItem
         INSERT INTO @tLevelItems
         SELECT prj_code
               ,@nLevel + 1
           FROM r5projects
          WHERE prj_parent = @sProjItem
         IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
            SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
         END
      ELSE
         SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
      END

INSERT INTO r5projbudclasses
           (pcl_project
           ,pcl_projbud
           ,pcl_amount)
SELECT prj_code
      ,@sProjBud
      ,NULL
  FROM @tProjects

IF @@ERROR != 0
   SET @sCheck = N'2'
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CRPIC
	@sPiccode			nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,
	@sDescription		nvarchar(80),
	@sSupplier			nvarchar(30),
	@sSupporg			nvarchar(15),
	@sPerson			nvarchar(15),
	@sDeladdress		nvarchar(20),
	@sDfltauth			nvarchar(255),
	@sOrigin			nvarchar(255),
	@sEvent				nvarchar(30),
	@sAct				nvarchar(8),
	@sStore				nvarchar(15),
	@sPart				nvarchar(30),
	@sPartorg			nvarchar(15),
	@sMatlist			nvarchar(20),
	@nMatline			numeric(8,0),
	@dRequired			DATETIME,
	@nQty				numeric(24,6),
	@sPicstatus			nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@sChk				nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
 
AS 
    SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sPicrstatus		nvarchar(4)		
	declare @sObject			nvarchar(30)	
	declare @sObtype			nvarchar(4)		
	declare @sObrtype			nvarchar(4)		
	declare @sObjorg			nvarchar(15)	
	declare @nPrice				numeric(24,6)
	declare @sPricelev			nvarchar(200)	
	declare @sX					nvarchar(20)
	declare @nReturn			integer
	declare @dTarget			datetime

	set @sChk = N'0'
	set @sX = NULL
	
	IF @sDescription IS NULL
	OR @sStore IS NULL
	OR @nQty IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

	IF @sEvent is not null 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7GMORES N'EVNT', 2, @sEvent, @sX, @sX, @sX, @sObject OUTPUT, @sObrtype OUTPUT, @sObtype OUTPUT, @sObjorg OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                begin
                    set @sChk = N'3'
				    return
                end
			if @sChk <> N'0'
				begin
					set @sChk = N'2'
					return
				end
		end

	set @sPicrstatus = N'U'

	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sPicstatus OUTPUT, @sPicrstatus, N'PLST', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        begin
            set @sChk = N'3'
			return
        end


	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sPricelev OUTPUT, N'PRICELEV', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        begin
            set @sChk = N'3'
			return
        end

	IF @sPricelev = N'P' 
		set @nPrice = dbo.O7GETPRC( @sX, @sPart, @sPartorg, @sPartorg, N'B', N'P', null )
	ELSE
		set @nPrice = dbo.O7GETPRC( @sStore, @sPart, @sPartorg, @sPartorg, N'B', N'S', null )

	IF @sPiccode IS NULL 
		begin
			
			IF @sEvent IS NOT NULL 
			begin
				SELECT @dTarget = evt_target
				FROM   r5events
				WHERE  evt_code = @sEvent
				IF @dTarget IS NULL
					begin
						set @sChk = N'4'
						RETURN
					end
			end
			
			
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sPiccode OUTPUT, N'PICK', N'1', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                begin
                    set @sChk = N'3'
			        return
                end

            --prevent conversion error
            if @sAct is not null and isnumeric( @sAct ) = 0
                begin
                    set @sChk = N'3'
			        return
                end
                
			INSERT INTO r5picklists( pic_code,

create function O7CRPPAS(	@sTxtin	nvarchar(32) )
returns nvarchar(32)
as
begin
	declare @sCryp		nvarchar(12)
	declare @sRetcode	nvarchar(12)
	declare @nCount		int

	if len( @sTxtin ) > 12
		return( N'a' )  

	set @sRetcode = null
	select @nCount = count(*)
		FROM  r5install  
		WHERE ins_code = N'INSTCODE'

	if @nCount > 0 
		select @sCryp = isnull( ins_desc, N'SqLSyStEmSbV' )
			FROM  r5install  
			WHERE ins_code = N'INSTCODE'
	else
		set @sCryp = N'SqLSyStEmSbV'

	while isnull( len( @sCryp ), 0 ) < 12
		set @sCryp = substring( @sCryp + @sCryp, 1, 12 )

	set @nCount = 1
	while @nCount < 13 and @nCount < len(@sTxtin) + 1
		begin
			if @nCount = 1
				set @sRetcode = Char(((ascii(substring(@sTxtin, @nCount, 1)) - 33 + ascii(substring(@sCryp, @nCount, 1)) - 33) % 90) + 33)
			else
				set @sRetcode = @sRetcode + Char(((ascii(substring(@sTxtin, @nCount, 1)) - 33 + ascii(substring(@sCryp, @nCount, 1)) - 33) % 90) + 33)
			set @nCount = @nCount + 1
		end
	
	return (@sRetcode)
end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CRPPM1 
    @sCppmcode        nvarchar(20),
    @sCnewppmcode     nvarchar(20),
    @sCnewppmdesc     nvarchar(80),
    @sChk             nvarchar(5) OUTPUT  
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @nRevision    int
    declare @sStatus      nvarchar(8)      /*   r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE; */
    declare @sRstatus     nvarchar(4)      /*   r5ucodes.uco_rcode%TYPE;*/
	declare @nPpa_act	  int
	declare @sDflt		  nvarchar(200)
	declare @nReturn	  int


	/* Initialize  */
    set @sChk = N'0'
	/* Check mandatory parameters */
    IF @sCppmcode    IS NULL
    OR @sCnewppmcode IS NULL
    OR @sCnewppmdesc IS NULL
	begin
        set @sChk = N'1'
        RETURN
    end
	/* Get current approved revision. */
    SELECT @nRevision = ppm_revision
    FROM   r5ppms
    WHERE  ppm_code = @sCppmcode
    AND    ppm_revrstatus = N'A'
	if @@ERROR  <> 0
	begin
        set @sChk = N'1'
        RETURN
    end
	/* Get rstatus */
	execute @nReturn = o7dflt @sDflt OUTPUT,  N'PMRVCTRL', @sChk OUTPUT 
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	begin
		return -1
	end
	IF isnull( UPPER( @sDflt ), N'N' ) IN
      ( N'YES', N'Y', N'+', N'ON' )
        set @sRstatus = N'U'
    ELSE
        set @sRstatus = N'A'
	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sStatus OUTPUT, @sRstatus, N'RCST', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	/* Copy PPM records to the new PPM code ( r5ppms ) */
    INSERT INTO r5ppms (
      ppm_code,
      ppm_org,
      ppm_revision,
      ppm_revrstatus,
      ppm_revstatus,
      ppm_desc,
      ppm_class,
      ppm_class_org,
      ppm_isstype,
      ppm_duration,
      ppm_freq,
      ppm_meter,
      ppm_metuom,
      ppm_nested,
      ppm_priority,
      ppm_jobtype,
      ppm_special,
      ppm_okwindow,
      ppm_nearwindow,
      ppm_genwindow,
      ppm_nestedpmstatus,
      ppm_perioduom,
      ppm_nestedtolmin,
      ppm_nestedtolmax,
      ppm_meter2,
      ppm_nestedtolmetmin,
      ppm_nestedtolmetmax,
      ppm_metuom2,
      ppm_nestedtolmet2min,
      ppm_nestedtolmet2max )
    SELECT  @sCnewppmcode,
            p.ppm_org,
            0,
            @sRstatus,
            @sStatus,
            @sCnewppmdesc,
            p.ppm_class,
 	        p.ppm_class_org,
            p.ppm_isstype,
            p.ppm_duration,
            p.ppm_freq,
            p.ppm_meter,
            p.ppm_metuom,
            p.ppm_nested,
            p.ppm_priority,
            p.ppm_jobtype,
            p.ppm_special,
            p.ppm_okwindow,
            p.ppm_nearwindow,
            p.ppm_genwindow,
            p.ppm_nestedpmstatus,
            p.ppm_perioduom,
            p.ppm_nestedtolmin,
            p.ppm_nestedtolmax,
            p.ppm_meter2,
            p.ppm_nestedtolmetmin,
            p.ppm_nestedtolmetmax,
            p.ppm_metuom2,
            p.ppm_nestedtolmet2min,
            p.ppm_nestedtolmet2max
    FROM    r5ppms p
    WHERE   p.ppm_code = @sCppmcode
    AND     p.ppm_revision = @nRevision
	/* Copy the PPM records to the new PPM code ( r5ppmacts ) */
    INSERT INTO r5ppmacts (
       ppa_ppm,
       ppa_revision,
       ppa_act,
       ppa_trade,
       ppa_duration,
       ppa_est,
       ppa_task,
       ppa_matlist,
       ppa_persons,
       ppa_start,
       ppa_special,
       ppa_hire,
       ppa_rpc,
       ppa_wap,
       ppa_tpf,
       ppa_manufact,
       ppa_syslevel,
       ppa_asmlevel,
       ppa_complevel
       )
    SELECT   @sCnewppmcode,
             0,
             p.ppa_act,
             p.ppa_trade,
             p.ppa_duration,
             p.ppa_est,
             p.ppa_task,
             p.ppa_matlist,
             p.ppa_persons,
             p.ppa_start,
             p.ppa_special,
             p.ppa_hire,
             p.ppa_rpc,
             p.ppa_wap,
             p.ppa_tpf,
             p.ppa_manufact,
             p.ppa_syslevel,
             p.ppa_asmlevel,
             p.ppa_complevel
    FROM     r5ppmacts p
    WHERE    p.ppa_ppm  = @sCppmcode
    AND      p.ppa_revision = @nRevision
	/* Copy the PPM records to the new PPM code ( r5ppmcalendars )  */
    INSERT INTO r5ppmcalendars (
       ppc_ppm,
       ppc_obtype,
       ppc_obrtype,
       ppc_object,
       ppc_object_org,
       ppc_date,
       ppc_reuse,
       ppc_revision )
    SELECT @sCnewppmcode,
           ppc_obtype,
           ppc_obrtype,
           ppc_object,
           ppc_object_org,
           ppc_date,
           ppc_reuse,
           0
    FROM   r5ppmcalendars
    WHERE  ppc_ppm      = @sCppmcode
    AND    ppc_revision = @nRevision
	/* Copy the PPM records to the new PPM code ( r5ppmtools ) */
    INSERT INTO r5ppmtools (
       ppt_ppm,
       ppt_act,
       ppt_tool,
       ppt_hours,
       ppt_qty,
       ppt_revision )
    SELECT @sCnewppmcode,
           ppt_act,
           ppt_tool,
           ppt_hours,
           ppt_qty,
           0
    FROM   r5ppmtools
    WHERE  ppt_ppm      = @sCppmcode
    AND    ppt_revision = @nRevision
	/* Copy the PPM records to the new PPM code ( r5ppmobjects ) */
	execute @nReturn = o7dflt @sDflt OUTPUT,  N'PMRVCTRL', @sChk OUTPUT 
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	begin
		return -1
	end
    IF isnull( UPPER( @sDflt ), N'N' ) IN
       ( N'YES', N'Y', N'+', N'ON' )
	begin
      INSERT INTO r5ppmobjects (
        ppo_ppm,
        ppo_revision,
        ppo_object,
        ppo_object_org,
        ppo_obtype,
        ppo_obrtype,
        ppo_location,
        ppo_location_org,
        ppo_mrc,
        ppo_costcode,
        ppo_route,
        ppo_due,
        ppo_metuom,
        ppo_meterdue,
        ppo_freq,
        ppo_meter,
        ppo_fixed,
        ppo_deactive,
        ppo_changed,
        ppo_isstype,
        ppo_class,
	    ppo_class_org,
        ppo_org,
        ppo_perioduom,
        ppo_meterdue2,
        ppo_metuom2,
        ppo_meter2 )
      SELECT @sCnewppmcode,
           0,
           p.ppo_object,
           p.ppo_object_org,
           p.ppo_obtype,
           p.ppo_obrtype,
           p.ppo_location,
           p.ppo_location_org,
           p.ppo_mrc,
           p.ppo_costcode,
           p.ppo_route,
           p.ppo_due,
           p.ppo_metuom,
           p.ppo_meterdue,
           p.ppo_freq,
           p.ppo_meter,
           p.ppo_fixed,
           p.ppo_deactive,
           N'+',
           p.ppo_isstype ,
           p.ppo_class,
  	       p.ppo_class_org,
           p.ppo_org,
           p.ppo_perioduom,
           p.ppo_meterdue2,
           p.ppo_metuom2,
           p.ppo_meter2
      FROM   r5ppmobjects p
      WHERE  p.ppo_ppm = @sCppmcode
      AND    p.ppo_revision = @nRevision
    END
	/* Copy FF text, properties, doc's associated   */
	declare @sCcode        nvarchar(100)
	declare	@sCnewcode     nvarchar(50)
	set @sCcode = @sCppmcode + N'#' + cast( @nRevision as nvarchar(4))
	set @sCnewcode = @sCnewppmcode + N'#0'
    execute @nReturn = O7COPDAT  @sCcode, @sCnewcode, N'PPM', N'PPM', @sChk  OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

    DECLARE cPpa CURSOR LOCAL FOR
    SELECT ppa_act
    FROM   r5ppmacts
    WHERE  ppa_ppm      = @sCppmcode
    AND    ppa_revision = @nRevision


	OPEN cPpa
	FETCH NEXT FROM cPpa INTO @nPpa_act
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		set @sCcode = @sCppmcode + N'#' + cast( @nRevision as nvarchar(4) ) + N'#' + cast( @nPpa_act as nvarchar(4))
		set @sCnewcode = @sCnewppmcode + N'#0#' + cast( @nPpa_act as nvarchar(4) )
        execute @nReturn = O7COPDAT  @sCcode, @sCnewcode, N'PPM', N'PPM', @sChk OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			begin
				CLOSE cPpa
				DEALLOCATE cPpa
				return -1
			end
	    FETCH NEXT FROM cPpa INTO @nPpa_act
    END
	CLOSE cPpa
	DEALLOCATE cPpa

END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CRQUL2
    @sCquotation     nvarchar(30),
    @sCseqno         nvarchar(2),
    @sCpart          nvarchar(30),
    @sCpartorg       nvarchar(15),
    @nNprice         numeric(24,6),
    @sCquotuom       nvarchar(30),
    @nNleadtime      numeric(4,1),
    @sCcatref        nvarchar(50),
    @dDexpir         datetime,
    @sChk            nvarchar(5) OUTPUT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sCsupplier      nvarchar(30)         /* r5quotations.quo_supplier%TYPE;  Supplier of quotation    */
    declare @sCsupplierorg   nvarchar(15)         /*  r5quotations.quo_org%TYPE;      Supplier organization    */
    declare @nNgrossprice    numeric(24,6)        /* Gross price of quotation */
	declare @nDiscperc 		 numeric(18,0)
	declare @nDiscount 		 numeric(24,6)
BEGIN
	/* Initialise local variables */
    set @sChk = N'0'
	/* Check mandatory parameters */
    IF @sCquotation IS NULL
    OR @sCseqno     IS NULL
    OR @sCpart      IS NULL 
	begin
        set @sChk  = N'1'
        return
    end
	/* Get supplier code from r5quotation */
   	BEGIN
        SELECT @sCsupplier = q.quo_supplier,
               @sCsupplierorg = q.quo_supplier_org
        FROM   r5quotations q
        WHERE  q.quo_code   = @sCquotation
        AND    q.quo_seqno  = @sCseqno
    END
	/* ------------------------ Beginning of Gross Price Calculation */
	/* Gross price is same as quotation line price if there is no discount */
    set @nNgrossprice = isnull( @nNprice, 0 )
	/* Get discount from r5reductions and apply this on quotation line price */
	/* to get gross price                                              */
    DECLARE cCalcgrossprice CURSOR LOCAL FOR
         SELECT   isnull( r.red_discperc, 0) discperc,
                  isnull( r.red_discount, 0) discount
         FROM     r5reductions   r
         WHERE    r.red_part         = @sCpart
         AND      r.red_part_org     = @sCpartorg
         AND      r.red_supplier     = @sCsupplier
         AND      r.red_supplier_org = @sCsupplierorg
         ORDER BY r.red_line
    BEGIN
		OPEN cCalcgrossprice
		FETCH NEXT FROM cCalcgrossprice INTO @nDiscperc, @nDiscount
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
                set @nNgrossprice = ROUND((@nNgrossprice / (100 + @nDiscperc) * 100) - @nDiscount, 2)
			FETCH NEXT FROM cCalcgrossprice INTO @nDiscperc, @nDiscount
		END
		CLOSE cCalcgrossprice
		DEALLOCATE cCalcgrossprice
    END
	/* -------------------------------- End of Gross Price Calculation */
	/* Q0736: Update Catalogue                                         */
    BEGIN
        UPDATE r5catalogue
        SET    cat_date      = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2(@sCsupplierorg), N'DD' ),
               cat_quotation = @sCquotation,
               cat_quotuom   = @sCquotuom,
               cat_quotprice = @nNprice,
               cat_gross     = @nNgrossprice,
               cat_leadtime  = @nNleadtime,
               cat_expquot   = @dDexpir,
               cat_ref       = @sCcatref
        WHERE  cat_part         = @sCpart
        AND    cat_part_org     = @sCpartorg
        AND    cat_supplier     = @sCsupplier
        AND    cat_supplier_org = @sCsupplierorg
    /* if not exist, Create new catalogue for supplier and part */
        IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
		begin
            INSERT INTO r5catalogue
            (   cat_part,
                cat_part_org,
                cat_supplier,
                cat_supplier_org,
                cat_date,
                cat_quotation,
                cat_quotuom,
                cat_quotprice,
                cat_gross,
                cat_leadtime,
                cat_expquot,
                cat_ref        )
            VALUES
            (   @sCpart,
                @sCpartorg,
                @sCsupplier,
                @sCsupplierorg,
                dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2(@sCsupplierorg), N'DD' ),
                @sCquotation,
                @sCquotuom,
                @nNprice,
                @nNgrossprice,
                @nNleadtime,
                @dDexpir,
                @sCcatref        )
		end
    END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CRQUO1
   @sCode	 nvarchar(30),
   @sNewseqno nvarchar(2),
   @sOldseqno nvarchar(2),
   @sChk	 nvarchar(4)  OUTPUT
AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	/* Initialize */
	set @sChk = N'0'

	IF @sCode		IS NULL
	OR @sNewseqno	IS NULL
	OR @sOldseqno	IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

		INSERT INTO r5quotlines
		(
			qul_quotation,
			qul_seqno,
			qul_line,
			qul_type,
			qul_rtype,
			qul_req,
			qul_reqline,
			qul_part,
			qul_part_org,
			qul_catref,
			qul_puruom,
			qul_event,
			qul_act,
			qul_trade,
			qul_reqpers,
			qul_persons,
			qul_reqqty,
			qul_multiply,
			qul_task,
		qul_taskrev,
		qul_taskqty,
		qul_quottaskqty,
		qul_deladdress,
			qul_inspect            )
		SELECT q.qul_quotation,
			@sNewseqno,
			q.qul_line,
			q.qul_type,
			q.qul_rtype,
			q.qul_req,
			q.qul_reqline,
			q.qul_part,
			q.qul_part_org,
			q.qul_catref,
			q.qul_puruom,
			q.qul_event,
			q.qul_act,
			q.qul_trade,
			q.qul_reqpers,
			q.qul_persons,
			q.qul_reqqty,
			q.qul_multiply,
			q.qul_task,
		q.qul_taskrev,
		q.qul_taskqty,
		q.qul_quottaskqty,
		q.qul_deladdress,
			q.qul_inspect
		FROM   r5quotlines q
		WHERE  q.qul_quotation = @sCode
		AND    q.qul_seqno     = @sOldseqno
		AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
					  FROM   r5catalogue c,
							 r5quotations t
					  WHERE  t.quo_code         = @sCode
					  AND    t.quo_seqno        = @sNewseqno
					  AND    t.quo_supplier     = c.cat_supplier
					  AND    t.quo_supplier_org = c.cat_supplier_org
					  AND    q.qul_part         = c.cat_part
					  AND    q.qul_part_org     = c.cat_part_org
					  AND    c.cat_puruom   IS NOT NULL
					  AND    c.cat_multiply IS NOT NULL )

		INSERT INTO r5quotlines
		(
			qul_quotation,
			qul_seqno,
			qul_line,
			qul_type,
			qul_rtype,
			qul_req,
			qul_reqline,
			qul_part,
			qul_part_org,
			qul_catref,
			qul_puruom,
			qul_event,
			qul_act,
			qul_trade,
			qul_reqpers,
			qul_persons,
			qul_reqqty,
			qul_multiply,
			qul_task,
		qul_taskrev,
		qul_taskqty,
		qul_quottaskqty,
		qul_deladdress,
			qul_inspect            )
		SELECT q.qul_quotation,
			@sNewseqno,
			q.qul_line,
			q.qul_type,
			q.qul_rtype,
			q.qul_req,
			q.qul_reqline,
			q.qul_part,
			q.qul_part_org,
			c.cat_ref,
			c.cat_puruom,
			q.qul_event,
			q.qul_act,
			q.qul_trade,
			q.qul_reqpers,
			q.qul_persons,
			q.qul_reqqty * coalesce( q.qul_multiply, 1 ) / c.cat_multiply,
			c.cat_multiply,
			q.qul_task,
		q.qul_taskrev,
		q.qul_taskqty,
		q.qul_quottaskqty,
		q.qul_deladdress,
			q.qul_inspect
		FROM   r5catalogue c,
			r5quotations t,
			r5quotlines q
		WHERE  q.qul_quotation    = @sCode
		AND    q.qul_seqno        = @sOldseqno
		AND    t.quo_code         = q.qul_quotation
		AND    t.quo_seqno        = @sNewseqno
		AND    t.quo_supplier     = c.cat_supplier
		AND    t.quo_supplier_org = c.cat_supplier_org
		AND    q.qul_part         = c.cat_part
		AND    q.qul_part_org     = c.cat_part_org
		AND    c.cat_puruom   IS NOT NULL
		AND    c.cat_multiply IS NOT NULL

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CRQUO2

    @sCustatus       nvarchar(4),                 
    @sChk            nvarchar(5) OUTPUT,
    @dCquodate       datetime  
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sCrstatus 	nvarchar(4)			/* r5quotations.quo_rstatus%TYPE          -- PIR Approve_PO */
    declare @sUtype    	nvarchar(8)			/* r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE */
    declare @sLang     	nvarchar(2)			/* r5companies.com_lang%TYPE */
    declare @sCurr     	nvarchar(3)			/* r5companies.com_curr%TYPE */
    declare @nFromdual  numeric(24,12)
    declare @nTodual    numeric(24,12)
    declare @nExch      numeric(24,12)
    declare @nSeqno     numeric(24,12)
    declare @nMultiply  numeric(10,4)
    declare @sChk2      nvarchar(4)
    declare @sPuruom    nvarchar(30)				/* r5catalogue.cat_puruom%TYPE */
	declare @nReturn int
	declare @sNewevent nvarchar(255)
	/* declare cursor variable */
	declare 	@sRql_type       nvarchar(4)
    declare     @sRql_rtype      nvarchar(4)
    declare     @sRql_req        nvarchar(30)
    declare     @nRql_reqline    numeric(8,0)

    declare     @nRql_act        numeric(8, 0)
    declare     @sRql_trade      nvarchar(15)
    declare     @sRql_task       nvarchar(20)
    declare     @nRql_taskrev    numeric(4, 0)
    declare     @nRql_taskqty    numeric(10, 2)
    declare     @nAct_persons    numeric(8, 0)

	/* Initialize */
    set @sChk = N'0'
	/* Check that all mandatory parameters are supplied */
    IF @sReq IS NULL OR @nReqline IS NULL
	begin
        set @sChk = N'1'
        RETURN
    end
    IF @sQuot IS NULL 
	begin
   		/* Get new quotation number. */
		execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sQuot OUTPUT, N'QUOTAT', N'1', @sChk2 OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
   		/* Get System status */
		execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7RCODE @sCrstatus OUTPUT, @sCustatus, N'QUST', @sChk2 OUTPUT
    	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
    	/* Get USER type */
		execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sUtype OUTPUT,  N'P', N'QUTP', @sChk2 OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
   		/* Get exchange rate */
      	SELECT @sLang = com_lang,
               @sCurr = com_curr
        FROM   r5companies c
        WHERE  c.com_code = @sSupplier
        AND    c.com_org  = @sSupplierorg

		execute @nReturn = O7GTDUAL @sCurr, 1000, @nTodual OUTPUT, @nFromdual OUTPUT, 
									@nExch OUTPUT, @sSupplierorg, @dCquodate
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
        set @nSeqno = 1
   		/* Copy the req to the quot */
        INSERT INTO r5quotations (
            QUO_CODE,
            QUO_ORG,
            QUO_SEQNO,
            QUO_DESC,
            QUO_STATUS,
            QUO_RSTATUS,
            QUO_RTYPE,
            QUO_TYPE,
            QUO_SUPPLIER,
            QUO_SUPPLIER_ORG,
            QUO_LANG,
            QUO_STORE,
            QUO_ORIGIN,
            QUO_DATE,
            QUO_DUE,
            QUO_CURR,
            QUO_EXCH,
            QUO_PRINTED,
            QUO_BUYER,
            QUO_EXCHTODUAL,
            QUO_EXCHFROMDUAL,
            QUO_DELADDRESS )
        SELECT
            @sQuot,
            r.req_org,
            @nSeqno,
            r.req_desc,
            @sCustatus,
            @sCrstatus,                              /* PIR - Approve_PO */
            N'P',
            @sUtype,
            @sSupplier,
            @sSupplierorg,
            @sLang,
            @sStore,
            @sOriginator,
            dbo.o7gttime2(r.req_org),
            dbo.F_GREATEST_DATE( isnull( @dDuedate, dbo.o7gttime2(r.req_org) ), dbo.o7gttime2(r.req_org) + 10 ),
            @sCurr,
            @nExch,
            N'-',
            @sBuyer,
            @nTodual,
            @nFromdual,
            r.req_deladdress
        FROM  r5requisitions r
        WHERE r.req_code = @sReq
	end
    ELSE
	begin
        SELECT @nSeqno = quo_seqno
        FROM   r5quotations
        WHERE  quo_code         = @sQuot
        AND    quo_supplier     = @sSupplier
        AND    quo_supplier_org = @sSupplierorg
    end
	set @sNewevent = @sQuot + '#' + CAST(@nSeqno as nvarchar(255))
	execute @nReturn = O7NEWLINE N'QUOL', @sNewevent, N'1', NULL, NULL, @sChk2 OUTPUT, @nQuotline OUTPUT 
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1	
    IF @sChk2 <> N'0'
        set @nQuotline = 10
   
	/* Copy the lines */
	/* Part lines */
     SELECT @sRql_type = rql_type,
            @sRql_rtype = rql_rtype,
            @sRql_req = rql_req,
            @nRql_reqline = rql_reqline,
            @sRql_part = rql_part,
            @sRql_part_org = rql_part_org,
            @sRql_ref = rql_ref,
            @nRql_qty = rql_qty,
            @sRql_uom = rql_uom,
            @sRql_deladdress = rql_deladdress,
            @sRql_inspect = rql_inspect  -- # 6907
     FROM   r5requisitions,
            r5requislines
     WHERE  req_code         = rql_req
     AND    rql_quotflag     > 0
     AND    req_rstatus      = N'A'
     AND    rql_rstatus      = N'A'
     AND    rql_active       = N'+'
     AND    rql_rtype IN ( N'PS', N'PD', N'RE' )
     AND    rql_req          = @sReq
     AND    rql_reqline      = @nReqline

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
		begin
			set @nMultiply = null
			set @sPuruom   = null
			IF @sRql_rtype <> N'RE' 
				SELECT @nMultiply = cat_multiply,
						 @sPuruom = cat_puruom
				FROM   r5catalogue
				WHERE  cat_supplier     = @sSupplier
				AND    cat_supplier_org = @sSupplierorg
				AND    cat_part         = @sRql_part
				AND    cat_part_org     = @sRql_part_org
				AND    cat_multiply IS NOT NULL
				AND    cat_puruom   IS NOT NULL
        
			INSERT INTO r5quotlines
				  (  qul_quotation,
					 qul_seqno,
					 qul_line,
					 qul_type,
					 qul_rtype,
					 qul_req,
					 qul_reqline,
					 qul_part,
					 qul_part_org,
					 qul_catref,
					 qul_puruom,
					 qul_reqqty,
					 qul_multiply,
					 qul_deladdress,
					 qul_inspect )  
			VALUES(  @sQuot,
					 @nSeqno,
					 @nQuotline,
					 @sRql_type,
					 @sRql_rtype,
					 @sRql_req,
					 @nRql_reqline,
					 @sRql_part,
					 @sRql_part_org,
					 @sRql_ref,
					 isnull( @sPuruom, @sRql_uom ),
					 ROUND( @nRql_qty / isnull( @nMultiply, 1 ), 2 ),
					 isnull( @nMultiply, 1 ),
					 @sRql_deladdress,
					 @sRql_inspect )  
		end
	else
		begin
			declare c_serv cursor local for  SELECT rql_type,
													rql_rtype,
													rql_req,
													rql_reqline,
													rql_ref,
													rql_event,
													rql_act,
													rql_trade,
													rql_qty,
													rql_task,
													rql_taskrev,
													rql_taskqty,
													rql_uom,
													rql_deladdress,
													isnull( act_persons, 1 ) act_persons
											 FROM   r5requisitions,
													r5activities RIGHT OUTER JOIN
													r5requislines on ( rql_event        = act_event
																AND    rql_act          = act_act )
											 WHERE  req_code         = rql_req
											 AND    rql_quotflag     > 0

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CRREQ
    @sCreqcode       nvarchar(30)  OUTPUT,
    @sCdescription   nvarchar(80),
    @sCrequester     nvarchar(15),
    @sCsupplier      nvarchar(30),
    @sCsupplierorg   nvarchar(15),
    @sCstore         nvarchar(30),
    @nNprice         numeric(24,6),
    @sCcurrency      nvarchar(3),
    @nNexch          numeric(24,12),
    @sCevent         nvarchar(30),
    @sCevtrstatus    nvarchar(255),
    @nNact           numeric(8,0),
    @sCpart          nvarchar(30),
    @sCpartorg       nvarchar(15),
    @sPartprefsup    nvarchar(30),
    @sPartprefsuporg nvarchar(15),
    @dDstart         datetime,
    @nNqty           numeric(24,6),
    @sCuom           nvarchar(30),
    @sCcommodity     nvarchar(15),
    @sCtrade         nvarchar(15),
    @sCtask          nvarchar(20),
    @nNtaskrev       numeric(4,0),
    @nNtaskqty       numeric(10,2),
    @sCuser          nvarchar(255),
    @sCtype          nvarchar(4),
    @sDBsessionid     nvarchar(30),
    @sDefaultapprover nvarchar(255),
    @sDefaultCostcode nvarchar(30),
    @sChk            nvarchar(5) OUTPUT  
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON
    declare @sCstatus          nvarchar(4)		 /* r5requisitions.req_status%type   Status       */
    declare @sCfromentity      nvarchar(4)		 /* r5requisitions.req_fromentity%type From Entity  */
    declare @sCtoentity        nvarchar(4)       /* r5requisitions.req_toentity%type To Entity    */
    declare @sCreqtype         nvarchar(4)		 /* r5requisitions.req_type%type Req. Type    */
    declare @sCrqlrtype        nvarchar(4)       /* r5requislines.rql_type%type Reqline RType*/
    declare @nNrqlline         numeric(8,0)      /* r5requislines.rql_reqline%type Reqline      */
    declare @sCcostcode        nvarchar(30)      /* r5requisitions.req_costcode%type Costcode     */
    declare @sCproject         nvarchar(20)       /* r5requislines.rql_project%type Project      */
    declare @sCprojbud         nvarchar(20)       /* r5requislines.rql_projbud%type Projbud      */
    declare @sEvent            nvarchar(30)      /* r5events.evt_code%type */
    declare @sCorg             nvarchar(15)      /* r5events.evt_org%type */
    declare @nCountit          int
    declare @sCbuyer           nvarchar(255)      /* r5parts.par_buyer%type */
    declare @nExchtodual       numeric(24,12)
    declare @nExchfromdual     numeric(24,12)
    declare @nCexch            numeric(24,12)
    declare @sChk2             nvarchar(4)
    declare @sCinsp            nvarchar(1)       /* r5parts.par_inspect%TYPE#6907 On-dock enhancement */
	declare @nCount			   int
	declare @nReturn		   int
	declare @nValue			   numeric(24,12)
	declare @dOrg			   datetime
	declare @nCexchvalue            numeric(24,12)
	declare @nLeadtime			numeric(4,1)
	declare @sRelaterdwo		nvarchar(30)
    declare @sCrqlstatus        nvarchar(4)  /* Requisition line status */
	declare @sCrqlRstatus       nvarchar(4)  /* Requisition line rstatus */
    declare @sMultiequip        nvarchar(1)
    declare @sForms             nvarchar(1)
    declare @sRef               nvarchar(50)
    declare @sSup               nvarchar(30)
    declare @sSuporg            nvarchar(15)
    declare @sActStart          datetime       /* r5activities.act_start%type */
    declare @sAutoReqStatus     nvarchar(4)    /* r5requisitions.REQ_STATUS%TYPE */
    declare @sAutoReqRStatus    nvarchar(4)    /* r5requisitions.REQ_RSTATUS%TYPE */


	/* Initialize */
    set @sForms = N'-'

    if @sChk = N'FORM'
        set @sForms = N'+'

    set @sChk = N'0'

	/* Check mandatory parameters */
    IF @sCdescription IS NULL
    OR @sCrequester   IS NULL
    OR @sCstore       IS NULL
    OR @nNprice       IS NULL
    OR @nNqty         IS NULL 
	begin
	/* Mandatory parameter is missing */
      set @sChk = N'1'
      RETURN
    end
 	/* Check on event according to closure date and reqdays */
    IF @sCevent IS NOT NULL 
	begin
		execute @nReturn =  O7EXISTS	       N'EVNT',
											   N'*',     
											   @sCevent ,
											   null,
											   N'REQ',
											   null,
							                   null,
							                   null,
							                   @nCountit        OUTPUT,
							                   @sChk2            OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1

        if @nCountit < 1
		begin
            set @sChk = N'2'
            RETURN
        end
    end
	/* Get the user status for the given rstatus */
	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sCstatus OUTPUT, N'U', N'RQST', @sChk2 OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	/* Get the fromentity for the given fromrentity */
	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sCfromentity OUTPUT, N'COMP', N'ENTP', @sChk2 OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	/* Get the toentity code for the given torentity code */
	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sCtoentity OUTPUT, N'STOR', N'ENTP', @sChk2 OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	/* Get the requisline type for the given requisline rtype */
	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sCreqtype OUTPUT, N'RECV', N'RQTP', @sChk2 OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	/* Get the requisline rtype for the given requisline type */
	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7RCODE @sCrqlrtype OUTPUT, @sCtype, N'PLTP', @sChk2 OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	/* Get the requisline status for the given rstatus */
	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sCrqlstatus OUTPUT, N'U', N'RLST', @sChk2 OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
    set @sCrqlRstatus = N'U'


	set @sSup    = ISNULL( @sPartprefsup, @sCsupplier ) 
	set @sSuporg = ISNULL( @sPartprefsuporg, @sCsupplierorg ) 
	execute @nReturn =  o7gtlead @sCpart, @sCpartorg, @sSup, @sSuporg, @sCstore, @nLeadtime OUTPUT 
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	/* Get costcode from r5events */
    SELECT	@sCcostcode = evt_costcode, 
			@sCproject = evt_project, 
			@sCprojbud = evt_projbud, 
			@sCorg = evt_org, 
            @sMultiequip = evt_multiequip
    FROM   r5events
    WHERE  evt_code = @sCevent
    
    /* if generate from Generate Requisitions screen (when dbsessionid present) */
    IF @sDBsessionid IS NOT NULL AND @sDBsessionid <> N''
    begin
        /* if generate from Generate Requisitions screen(dbsessionid present) use the defaultcostcode*/
        IF @sDefaultCostcode IS NOT NULL AND @sDefaultCostcode <> N''
            SET @sCcostcode = @sDefaultCostcode

        /* Get Auto Requisition status selected on the Store */
        SELECT @sAutoReqStatus = s.str_autoappvstatus
        FROM   r5stores s
        WHERE  s.str_code = @sCStore
        /* Get the requistion status for the given status */
        execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7RCODE @sAutoReqRStatus OUTPUT, @sAutoReqStatus, N'RQST', @sChk2 OUTPUT
        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
            return -1
        execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sCrqlstatus OUTPUT, @sAutoReqRStatus, N'RLST', @sChk2 OUTPUT
        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
            return -1
        /* Get the requisline user status for the given rstatus */
        execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7RCODE @sCrqlRstatus OUTPUT, @sCrqlstatus, N'RLST', @sChk2 OUTPUT
        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
            return -1
    end
    
	
    IF @sCreqcode IS NULL or @sCreqcode = N''
	begin
   		/* Generate new requisition */
		execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sCreqcode OUTPUT, N'REQUI', N'1', @sChk2 OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
        IF @sChk2 <> N'0'
		begin
            set @sChk = N'3'
            RETURN
        end
   		/* Inserting into r5requisitions. */
        INSERT INTO r5requisitions (
          req_code,
          req_org,
          req_desc,
          req_class,
          req_class_org,
          req_date,
          req_status,
          req_rstatus,
          req_

CREATE PROCEDURE  O7CRREQ1
   @sReqcode		nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,
   @sOriginator		nvarchar(15),
   @sFromrentity	nvarchar(4),
   @sFromcode		nvarchar(30),
   @sFromorg		nvarchar(15),
   @sTorentity		nvarchar(4),
   @sTocode			nvarchar(30),
   @sCostcode		nvarchar(30),
   @sAuth			nvarchar(255),
   @sEnterby		nvarchar(255),
   @sChk			nvarchar(4)   OUTPUT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sChk2       nvarchar(4)
	declare @sToentity   nvarchar(8) 
	declare @sFromentity nvarchar(8) 
	declare @sReqrtype   nvarchar(4) 
	declare @sReqtype    nvarchar(8) 
	declare @sOrg        nvarchar(15) 
	declare @sReqstatus  nvarchar(4) 
	declare @nCount			integer
	declare	@nReturn		integer
	declare @dToday			datetime

	set @sChk = N'0'

	IF @sOriginator  IS NULL OR
		@sFromrentity IS NULL OR
		@sTorentity   IS NULL OR
		@sFromcode    IS NULL OR
		@sTocode      IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sReqcode OUTPUT, N'REQUI', N'1', @sChk2 OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1


	IF @sFromrentity = N'COMP' 
		set @sReqrtype = N'RECV'
	ELSE
		begin
			IF @sFromrentity = N'MRC' 
				set @sReqrtype = N'IREP'
			ELSE
				set @sReqrtype = N'STST'
		end


	SELECT @sOrg = str_org, @sReqstatus = str_autoappvstatus
	FROM   r5stores
	WHERE  str_code = @sTocode

	IF @sReqstatus IS NULL 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sReqstatus OUTPUT, N'U', N'RQST', @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
		end


	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sReqtype OUTPUT, @sReqrtype, N'RQTP', @sChk2 OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1


	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sToentity OUTPUT, @sTorentity, N'ENTP', @sChk2 OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sFromentity OUTPUT, @sFromrentity, N'ENTP', @sChk2 OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1


	execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dToday OUTPUT, @sOrg
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
		return -1

	INSERT INTO r5requisitions
		( req_code, req_org, req_torentity, req_toentity, req_totype, req_tocode,
		req_type, req_fromrentity, req_fromentity, req_fromtype, req_fromcode,
		req_fromcode_org, req_date, req_desc, req_origin, req_dfltauth, req_costcode,
		req_status, req_printed, req_enteredby )
	VALUES
		( @sReqcode, @sOrg, @sTorentity, @sToentity, N'*', @sTocode,
		@sReqtype, @sFromrentity, @sFromentity, N'*', @sFromcode, @sFromorg,
		dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dToday, N'DD' ), N'Automatic re-order', @sOriginator,
		@sAuth, @sCostcode, @sReqstatus, N'+', @sEnterby )

create procedure O7CRREQ2	@sReqcode		nvarchar(30)	OUTPUT,

							@sFromorg		nvarchar(15),
							@sTorentity		nvarchar(4),
							@sTocode		nvarchar(30),
							@sCostcode		nvarchar(30),
							@sAuth			nvarchar(255),
							@sEnteredby		nvarchar(255),
							@sChk			nvarchar(4)	OUTPUT
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sLchk			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sToentity		nvarchar(8)		--r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE
	declare @sFromentity	nvarchar(8)		--r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE
	declare @sReqrtype		nvarchar(4)		--r5ucodes.uco_rcode%TYPE

	declare @sOrg			nvarchar(15)	--r5stores.str_org%TYPE

	declare @nReturn		int

	set @sChk = N'0'

	if @sOriginator is null or @sFromrentity is null or @sTorentity is null
	  or @sFromcode is null or @sTocode is null
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			return 
		end

	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sReqcode OUTPUT, N'REQUI', N'1', @sLchk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	set @sReqrtype = N'STST'

	if @sFromrentity = N'COMP'
		set @sReqrtype = N'RECV'
	if @sFromrentity = N'MRC'
		set @sReqrtype = N'IREP'

	select @sOrg = str_org, @sReqstatus = str_autoappvstatus
	from r5stores
	where str_code = @sTocode

	if @sReqstatus is null
		begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sReqstatus OUTPUT, N'U', N'RQST', @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
		end

	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sReqtype OUTPUT, @sReqrtype, N'RQTP', @sLchk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	
	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sToentity OUTPUT, @sTorentity, N'ENTP', @sLchk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sFromentity OUTPUT, @sFromrentity, N'ENTP', @sLchk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	INSERT INTO r5requisitions
		 ( req_code, req_org, req_torentity, req_toentity, req_totype, req_tocode,
		   req_type, req_fromrentity, req_fromentity, req_fromtype, req_fromcode,
		   req_fromcode_org, req_date, req_desc, req_origin, req_dfltauth, req_costcode,
		   req_status, req_printed, req_enteredby )
	VALUES
		 ( @sReqcode, @sOrg, @sTorentity, @sToentity, N'*', @sTocode,
		   @sReqtype, @sFromrentity, @sFromentity, N'*',   @sFromcode,
		   @sFromorg, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2(@sOrg), N'DD' ), N'Automatic re-order', @sOriginator,
		   @sAuth, @sCostcode, @sReqstatus, N'-', @sEnteredby )

	if @@ERROR <> 0
		set @sChk = N'2'

create procedure O7CRRES1
	@sEventno       nvarchar(30),
	@nActno         int,
	@sMRC           nvarchar(30),
	@sMatlist       nvarchar(30),
	@sChk           nvarchar(4) OUTPUT

   
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nCountit                 int
	declare @sMRCstore               nvarchar(15) --r5mrcs.mrc_store%TYPE       /*  Store code of MRC        */
	declare @sStatus                 nvarchar(8) --r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE      /* Reservation status        */
	declare @sRstatus                nvarchar(4) --r5ucodes.uco_rcode%TYPE     /* Reservation rstatus       */
	declare @sRstat1                 nvarchar(4) --r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE /* Reservation status entity */
	declare @sRtype1                 nvarchar(4) --r5entities.ent_typent%TYPE  /* Reservation type entity   */
	declare @sProject                nvarchar(20) --r5events.evt_project%TYPE   /* Project Code of Event     */
	declare @sProjbud                nvarchar(20) --r5events.evt_projbud%TYPE   /* Project Budget Class of Event */
	declare @sObrtype                nvarchar(4) --r5events.evt_obrtype%TYPE   /* Object rtype of Event     */
	declare @sObject                 nvarchar(30) --r5events.evt_object%TYPE    /* Object of Event           */
	declare @sObjectorg              nvarchar(15) --r5events.evt_object_org%TYPE /* Object organization       */
	declare @sCategory               nvarchar(30) --r5objects.obj_category%TYPE  /* @sCategory of Event         */
	declare @nMatlrev                numeric(4) --r5matlparts.mlp_matlrev%TYPE /* Revision of material list */
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @nCount			int

	declare @sMlpCrit		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sMlpPart		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sMlpPart_org	nvarchar(15)
	declare @nMlpQty		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nMlpCount		int

	/* Initialize */
	set @sChk     = N'0'
	/* Check mandatory parameters */
	if @sEventno IS NULL	OR @nActno   IS NULL	OR @sMatlist IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

	/* Return when no part in material list has reserve checked. */
	if NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM  r5activities a
				WHERE act_event = @sEventno
				AND   act_act   = @nActno
				AND EXISTS(	SELECT 1 
						FROM  r5matlparts m
						WHERE m.mlp_matlist = @sMatlist
						AND m.mlp_matlrev   = a.act_matlrev
						AND m.mlp_reserv    = N'+' ) )
		RETURN

	/* W0114, W01242 - Check that mrc of event is attached to store */
	SELECT  @sMRCstore = m.mrc_store
	FROM    r5mrcs m
	WHERE   m.mrc_code = @sMRC
	if @sMRCstore IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'3'
			RETURN
		end

	/* Get @sRtype1 and @sRstat1 for the given rentity, RESV       */
	execute @nReturn = O7CKSTTP N'RESV', @sRstat1 OUTPUT, @sRtype1 OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sChk <> N'0'
		begin
			set @sChk = N'2'
			return
		end




	/* Get status for the given rstatus = N'R'  */
	set @sRstatus = N'R'
	set @sStatus  = NULL

	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sRstatus OUTPUT, @sStatus OUTPUT, @sRstat1, @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sChk <> N'0'
		begin
			set @sChk = N'2'
			return
		end

   SELECT @sObject = e.evt_object,
          @sObjectorg = e.evt_object_org,
          @sObrtype = e.evt_obrtype,
          @sProject = e.evt_project,
          @sProjbud = e.evt_projbud
   FROM   r5events e
   WHERE  e.evt_code = @sEventno

   IF @sObject IS NOT NULL 
	   SELECT @sCategory = o.obj_category
	   FROM   r5objects   o
	   WHERE  obj_obrtype = @sObrtype
	   AND    obj_code    = @sObject
	   AND    obj_org     = @sObjectorg



	/* Get revision of material list */
	select @nCount = count(*)
	FROM   r5activities
	WHERE  act_event = @sEventno
	AND    act_act   = @nActno

	
	if @nCount = 1 
		SELECT @nMatlrev = act_matlrev
		FROM   r5activities
		WHERE  act_event = @sEventno
		AND    act_act   = @nActno



	/* W0114, W01242 - Create new reservations for activity       */
	/* Reservations are created when an activity is created for   */
	/* all matlparts whose reservation has not been already made. */

	--Pitiful error handling in SQLServer has caused this part to be 
	--	written with a cursor instead of trapped duplicate key errors.

	declare c_mlp cursor local for 	SELECT m.mlp_crit,
											  m.mlp_part,
											  m.mlp_part_org,
											  sum( m.mlp_qty )
										FROM   r5matlparts    m,
											  r5stock        s,
											  r5objects      o
										WHERE  m.mlp_matlist  = @sMatlist
										AND    m.mlp_matlrev  = @nMatlrev
										AND    m.mlp_reserv   = N'+'
										AND    m.mlp_part     = s.sto_part
										AND    m.mlp_part_org = s.sto_part_org
										AND    @sMRCstore      = s.sto_store
										AND    o.obj_code       = @sObject
										AND    o.obj_org        = @sObjectorg
										AND    dbo.o7checkmatch( m.mlp_equipfilter, o.obj_checklistfilter ) = N'+'
										AND    (
												  m.mlp_code IS NULL
												  AND NOT EXISTS
													 (
														 SELECT N'X'
														 FROM   r5matlparts t
														 WHERE  t.mlp_matlist   = m.mlp_matlist
														 AND    t.mlp_matlrev   = m.mlp_matlrev
														 AND    t.mlp_part      = m.mlp_part
														 AND    t.mlp_part_org  = m.mlp_part_org
														 AND    (
																	(
																		t.mlp_obrtype  = @sObrtype
																	AND t.mlp_code     = @sObject
																	AND t.mlp_code_org = @sObjectorg
																	)
																 OR (
																		t.mlp_obrtype = N'C'
																	AND t.mlp_code    = @sCategory
																	)
																)
													 )
												  OR     (   m.mlp_obrtype = N'C'
														 AND m.mlp_code    = @sCategory
														 AND NOT EXISTS
															(
																SELECT N'X'
																FROM   r5matlparts l
																WHERE  l.mlp_matlist   = m.mlp_matlist
																AND    l.mlp_matlrev   = m.mlp_matlrev
																AND    l.mlp_part      = m.mlp_part
																AND    l.mlp_part_org  = m.mlp_part_org
																AND    l.mlp_obrtype   = @sObrtype
																AND    l.mlp_code      = @sObject
																AND    l.mlp_code_org  = @sObjectorg
															)
														 )
												  OR     (   m.mlp_obrtype  = @sObrtype
														 AND m.mlp_code     = @sObject
														 AND m.mlp_code_org = @sObjectorg
														 )
											  )
										GROUP BY m.mlp_crit,
											  m.mlp_part,
											  m.mlp_part_org

	open c_mlp 
	fetch next from c_mlp into @sMlpCrit, @sMlpPart, @sMlpPart_org, @nMlpQty	
	while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		begin
			select @nMlpCount = count(*) 
			  from r5reservations
			 where res_event		= @sEventno			AND
					res_act			= @nActno			AND
					res_part		= @sMlpPart			AND
					res_part_org	= @sMlpPart_org		AND
					res_store		= @sMRCstore		

			if @nMlpCount = 0
				INSERT INTO r5reservations (	res_event,
												res_act,
												res_crit,
												res_part,
												res_part_org,
												res_qty,
												res_allqty,
												res_store,
												res_project,
												res_projbud
											)
						VALUES (	@sEventno,
									@nActno,
									@sMlpCrit,
									@sMlpPart,
									@sMlpPart_org,
									@nMlpQty,
									0,
									@sMRCstore,
									@sProject,
									@sProjbud
								)

			fetch next from c_mlp into @sMlpCrit, @sMlpPart, @sMlpPart_org, @nMlpQty	
		end
	close c_mlp
	deallocate c_mlp

name: O7CRRQL1

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CRRQL1
	@sReq			nvarchar(30),
	@nLine			numeric(8,0) OUTPUT,
	@sPart			nvarchar(30),
	@sPartorg		nvarchar(15),
	@nQty			numeric(24,6),
	@nPrice			numeric(24,6),
	@sCurr			nvarchar(3),
	@nExch			numeric(24,12),
	@sUom			nvarchar(30),
	@sfromrentity	nvarchar(15),
	@sfromcode		nvarchar(30),
	@sfromorg		nvarchar(15),
	@sCostcode		nvarchar(30),
	@sBuyer			nvarchar(255),
	@dDue			datetime,
	@sTocode		nvarchar(30),
	@sAuth			nvarchar(30),
	@sJob			nvarchar(30),
	@sChk			nvarchar(4)  OUTPUT

AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sUstatus			nvarchar(8) --r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE
	declare @sRstatus			nvarchar(4) --r5ucodes.uco_rcode%TYPE
	declare @sAppvstatus		nvarchar(4) --r5stores.str_autoappvstatus%TYPE  /* Pre-approved status */
	declare @sCountstock		INTEGER
	declare @sParent			nvarchar(15) --r5stock.sto_store%TYPE
	declare @sMinlev			numeric(24,6)
	declare @sOrdlev			numeric(24,6)
	declare @sOrdqty			numeric(24,6)
	declare @sPrefstore			nvarchar(15) --r5stock.sto_prefstore%TYPE
	declare @sPrefsup			nvarchar(30) --r5stock.sto_prefsup%TYPE
	declare @sPrefsuporg		nvarchar(15) --r5stock.sto_prefsup_org%TYPE
	declare @sRtype				nvarchar(4) --r5ucodes.uco_rcode%TYPE
	declare @sUtype				nvarchar(8) --r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE
	declare @sfromrent			nvarchar(4) --r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE
	declare @sRqlsupl			nvarchar(30) --r5requislines.rql_supplier%TYPE
	declare @sRqlsuplorg		nvarchar(15) --r5requislines.rql_supplier_org%TYPE
	declare @sSuppref			nvarchar(50) --r5catalogue.cat_ref%type = NULL
	declare @sInsp				nvarchar(1) --r5parts.par_inspect%TYPE      -- #6907 On-dock enhancement
	declare @sMultiply			numeric(10,4) --r5requislines.rql_multiply%TYPE
	declare @sCommodity			nvarchar(15) --r5parts.par_commodity%TYPE
   	declare @sManufact			nvarchar(24) --r5partmfgs.mfp_manufacturer%TYPE;
   	declare @sManufactpart		nvarchar(50) --r5partmfgs.mfp_manufactpart%TYPE;


	declare @nCount				integer
	declare @sDefault			nvarchar(200)
	declare @dTempDate			datetime
	declare @nReturn			integer




BEGIN
	if @sfromrentity = N'COMPREP' 
		begin
			set @sfromrent = N'COMP'
			set @sRtype     = N'RE'
		end
	else
		begin
			if @sfromrentity = N'COMP'
				begin 
					set @sfromrent = N'COMP'
					set @sRtype     = N'PS'
				end
			else
				begin
					if @sfromrentity = N'MRCREP' 
						begin
							set @sfromrent = N'MRC'
							set @sRtype     = N'RI'
						end
					else
						begin
							set @sfromrent = N'STOR'
							set @sRtype     = N'PS'
						end
				end
		end

	select @sAppvstatus = str_autoappvstatus
	from   r5stores    
	where  str_code  = @sTocode
	if @sAppvstatus IS NULL 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sAppvstatus OUTPUT, N'U', N'RQST', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
		end

	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sUtype OUTPUT,@sRtype, N'PLTP', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1


	if @sfromrent = N'STOR' 
		begin
			select @sCountstock = count( * )
			from   r5stock     s
			where  s.sto_part     = @sPart
			AND    s.sto_part_org = @sPartorg
			AND    s.sto_store    = @sfromcode



			if @sCountstock  = 0 
				begin
					execute @nReturn = O7DFLT  @sDefault OUTPUT, N'DEFSTOCK', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1

					if UPPER( @sDefault ) IN ( N'+', N'YES', N'Y', N'ON' ) 
						begin
							execute @nReturn  = o7cpstor @sParent OUTPUT, @sfromcode 
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								return -1       

							select @sMinlev = sto_minlev,
								   @sOrdlev = sto_ordlev,
								   @sOrdqty = sto_ordqty,
								   @sPrefstore = sto_prefstore,
								   @sPrefsup = sto_prefsup,
								   @sPrefsuporg = sto_prefsup_org
							from   r5stock
							where  sto_store    = @sParent
							AND    sto_part     = @sPart
							AND    sto_part_org = @sPartorg

						end


					execute @nReturn = o7gttime @dTempDate,@sPartorg 
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
							return -1  
					set @dTempDate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dTempDate, N'DD' )
					
					/****Checking primary key constraints to mimic Exception call in Oracle*******/
					select @nCount = count(*) 
					from r5stock 
					where sto_store = @sfromcode and 
						sto_part_org = @sPartorg and 
						sto_part = @sPart
					
					if @nCount = 0 
						insert into r5stock (	sto_part,       sto_part_org,  sto_store,
												sto_stocktake,  sto_minlev,    sto_ordlev,
												sto_ordqty,     sto_prefstore, sto_prefsup,
												sto_prefsup_org,sto_pricetype )
						select	@sPart, @sPartorg, @sfromcode, @dTempDate, @sMinlev,
								@sOrdlev, @sOrdqty, @sPrefstore, @sPrefsup, @sPrefsuporg, str_pricetype
						from   r5stores
						where  str_code = @sfromcode
					else
						begin
							set @sChk = N'2'
							RETURN
						end
				end
		end




		execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7RCODE @sRstatus OUTPUT, @sAppvstatus, N'RQST', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1

		if @sRstatus = N'A' 
			begin
				execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sUstatus OUTPUT, N'U', N'RQST', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1


				UPDATE r5requisitions
				SET    req_rstatus = N'U',
				req_status  = @sUstatus,
				req_auth    = NULL
				where  req_code    = @sReq
			end

	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sUstatus OUTPUT,@sRstatus, N'RLST', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1



	execute @nReturn = o7newline N'REQL', @sReq, N'1', NULL, NULL, @sCheckresult OUTPUT, @nLine OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sfromrent IN ( N'STOR', N'MRC' ) 
		begin
			set @sRqlsupl    = NULL
			set @sRqlsuplorg = NULL
		end
	else
		begin
			set @sRqlsupl    = @sfromcode
			set @sRqlsuplorg = @sfromorg
		end

	if @sRqlsupl is not null 
		begin

			select @nCount = count(*)
			from    r5catalogue
			where   cat_part         = @sPart
			AND     cat_part_org     = @sPartorg
			AND     cat_supplier     = @sRqlsupl
			AND     cat_supplier_org = @sRqlsuplorg

			if @nCount = 1 
				select  @sSuppref = coalesce( CASE @sRtype when N'RE' then cat_repref when N'RI' then cat_repref else cat_ref end, cat_ref ),
						@sMultiply = cat_multiply
				from    r5catalogue
				where   cat_part         = @sPart
				AND     cat_part_org     = @sPartorg
				AND     cat_supplier     = @sRqlsupl
				AND     cat_supplier_org = @sRqlsuplorg
			else
				set @sSuppref = null
		end

    select @sInsp = par_inspect,
           @sCommodity = par_commodity
    from   r5parts
    where  par_code = @sPart
    AND    par_org  = @sPartorg


    SELECT @sManufact = mfp_manufacturer,
           @sManufactpart = mfp_manufactpart
    FROM   r5partmfgs
    WHERE  mfp_part     = @sPart
    AND    mfp_part_org = @sPartorg
    AND    mfp_primary  = N'+'

	insert into r5requislines
		( rql_reqline, rql_req,      rql_part,      rql_part_org,
		rql_qty,     rql_quotflag, rql_price,     rql_curr,
		rql_exch,    rql_uom,      rql_due,       rql_costcode,
		rql_buyer,   rql_ref,      rql_rtype,     rql_rstatus,
		rql_status,  rql_active,   rql_supplier,  rql_supplier_org,
		rql_inspect, rql_multiply, rql_type,      rql_commodity,
		rql_manufacturer,          rql_manufactpart  )
	values
		( @nLine,       @sReq,         @sPart,         @sPartorg,
		@nQty,        N'0',          coalesce(@nPrice, 0),@sCurr,
		@nExch,       @sUom,         @dDue,          @sCostcode,
		@sBuyer,      @sSuppref,     @sRtype,         @sRstatus,
		@sUstatus,    N'+' ,         @sRqlsupl,      @sRqlsuplorg,
		@sInsp,       @sMultiply,    @sUtype,         @sCommodity,
		@sManufact,	  @sManufactpart )
	set @sChk = N'0'

	if @sJob is not null 
	insert into r5joblines ( jbl_event, jbl_part, jbl_part_org, jbl_active, jbl_req,

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CRSTC1
	@sStcchild       nvarchar(30),
	@sStcchildorg    nvarchar(15),
	@sStcchildtype   nvarchar(4),
	@sStcparent      nvarchar(30),
	@sStcparentorg   nvarchar(15),
	@sStcparenttype  nvarchar(4),
	@sStcrolldown    nvarchar(1),
	@sStcrollup      nvarchar(1),
	@sDoinsert       nvarchar(1),
	@sChk            nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sChildtype					nvarchar(8) 
	declare @sChildrtype				nvarchar(4) 
	declare @sParenttype				nvarchar(8) 
	declare @sParentrtype				nvarchar(4) 
	declare @nReturn					integer
	declare	@sX							nvarchar(1)
BEGIN
	set @sChk          = N'0'
	set @sChildtype   = @sStcchildtype
	set @sParenttype  = @sStcparenttype

	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7RCODE @sChildrtype OUTPUT, @sChildtype, N'OBTP', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7RCODE @sParentrtype OUTPUT, @sParenttype, N'OBTP', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	IF @sStcchild       IS NULL
	OR @sStcchildorg    IS NULL
	OR @sStcchildtype   IS NULL
	OR @sStcparent      IS NULL
	OR @sStcparentorg   IS NULL
	OR @sStcparenttype  IS NULL
	OR @sDoinsert       IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			return
		end

	execute @nReturn = o7prestc N'INS',@sChildrtype OUTPUT,@sChildtype OUTPUT,@sStcchild,@sStcchildorg,@sParentrtype OUTPUT,@sParenttype OUTPUT,
			@sStcparent, @sStcparentorg, @sStcrolldown, @sStcrollup, N'-', N'-', @sChk OUTPUT
	
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sChk <> N'0' 
		return
      
	if @sDoinsert = N'N' 
		return

	INSERT INTO r5structures (
		stc_childtype,
		stc_childrtype,
		stc_child,
		stc_child_org,
		stc_parenttype,
		stc_parentrtype,
		stc_parent,
		stc_parent_org,
		stc_rolldown,
		stc_rollup,
		stc_equivalent,
		stc_downtime  )
	VALUES   ( @sChildtype,
		@sChildrtype,
		@sStcchild,
		@sStcchildorg,
		@sParenttype,
		@sParentrtype,
		@sStcparent,
		@sStcparentorg,
		@sStcrolldown,
		@sStcrollup,
		N'-',
		N'-'  )
	if @@ERROR <> 0
		set @sX = Null
END

create PROCEDURE O7CRSTL2   @sTrans			               nvarchar(30),
                            @sPart			               nvarchar(30),
                            @sPartorg		               nvarchar(15),
                            @sPartclass		             nvarchar(8),
                            @sStore			               nvarchar(15),
                            @sFacility		             nvarchar(80),
                            @sStktype		               nvarchar(8),
                            @sFrom_binloc	             nvarchar(15),    
                            @sTo_binloc		             nvarchar(15),
                            @sUser			               nvarchar(255),
                            @sOrderby		               nvarchar(30),
                            @dStkdate		               datetime,
                            @sAbcclass		             nvarchar(1),
                            @sChildstore               nvarchar(1),
                            @sIncludeconsignmentitem   nvarchar(1),
                            @sIncludeoutofserviceitem  nvarchar(1),
                            @sRole                     nvarchar(30) = '*'
as
    SET NOCOUNT ON 
	declare @sOrg			nvarchar(15)	--R5USERORGANIZATION.UOG_ORG%TYPE
	declare @nSeqno			int
	declare @sTratype		nvarchar(4)	--R5STOCKTAKELINES.STL_TYPE%TYPE
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(3)
	declare @sDeforg		nvarchar(15)	--R5USERORGANIZATION.UOG_ORG%TYPE
	declare @sChk1			nvarchar(3)
	declare @sString		nvarchar(2000)

	declare @sBisPart		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sBisPartorg	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sBisStore		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sBisBin		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sBisLot		nvarchar(12)
	declare @nBisQty		numeric(24,6)

	declare @nReturn	int

	set @nSeqno = 0

	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk1 OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sPartorg = N'%'
		begin
			select @sOrg = uog_org
			FROM   r5userorganization
			WHERE  uog_user   = user
			AND    uog_default = N'+'

create function O7CRSTL2_GET_HIERARCHY_R5STORES (	@sCode	nvarchar(15) )
returns @tReturn table( str_code nvarchar(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
	declare @nLevel			int
	declare @sParent		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sCstore		nvarchar(15)
	declare @tStack table ( Code nvarchar(15), Parent nvarchar(15), LevelID int )
	

    INSERT INTO @tStack select str_code, str_parent, 1 from r5stores where str_code = @sCode
	
	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select @sCstore = Code, @sParent = Parent from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values (@sCstore )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND Code = @sCstore 
					insert into @tStack	select str_code, str_parent, @nLevel + 1
										  from r5stores
										 where str_parent = @sCstore
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CRSTTL
    @sTrans       nvarchar(30),
    @sOrg         nvarchar(15)
AS
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sUtype       nvarchar(8)   /* r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE = NULL */
    declare @dSys_date    datetime 
    declare @sNeg_exists  nvarchar(1) 
    declare @sChk         nvarchar(16) 
    declare @nReturn      int
BEGIN
    set @sUtype       = NULL
    set @dSys_date    = dbo.o7gttime2(@sOrg)
    set @sNeg_exists  = N'N'
    set @sChk         = 0
   /* Need to have the user type for the db preinsert trigger to work correctly */
    execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sUtype OUTPUT, N'STTK', N'TRTP', @sChk OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        return -1
    /* Check whether negative bin qty will occur   */
    SET ROWCOUNT 1
    SELECT @sNeg_exists = N'Y'
    FROM   r5stocktakelines l,
           r5binstock b
    WHERE   l.stl_trans    = @sTrans
    AND     l.stl_part     = b.bis_part
    AND     l.stl_part_org = b.bis_part_org
    AND     l.stl_store    = b.bis_store
    AND     l.stl_bin      = b.bis_bin
    AND     l.stl_lot      = b.bis_lot
    AND     b.bis_qty - ( l.stl_expqty - l.stl_phyqty ) < 0
    
    IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
        set @sNeg_exists  = N'N'

    SET ROWCOUNT 0

    IF  @sNeg_exists = N'N'
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO r5translines
        (
            trl_part,

            trl_store,
            trl_line,
            trl_rtype,

            trl_trans,

            trl_udfchar15,
            trl_udfchar16,
            trl_udfchar17,
            trl_udfchar18,
            trl_udfchar19,
            trl_udfchar20,
            trl_udfchar21,
            trl_udfchar22,
            trl_udfchar23,
            trl_udfchar24,
            trl_udfchar25,
            trl_udfchar26,
            trl_udfchar27,
            trl_udfchar28,
            trl_udfchar29,
            trl_udfchar30,
            trl_udfnum01,
            trl_udfnum02,
            trl_udfnum03,
            trl_udfnum04,
            trl_udfnum05,
            trl_udfdate01,
            trl_udfdate02,
            trl_udfdate03,
            trl_udfdate04,
            trl_udfdate05,
            trl_udfchkbox01,
            trl_udfchkbox02,
            trl_udfchkbox03,
            trl_udfchkbox04,
            trl_udfchkbox05                
        )
        SELECT  l.stl_part,
                l.stl_part_org,
                l.stl_store,
                l.stl_line,
                @sUtype,
                N'STTK',
                l.stl_trans,
                @dSys_date,
                l.stl_expqty - l.stl_phyqty,
                l.stl_expqty,
                isnull( dbo.o7getprc( l.stl_store, l.stl_part, l.stl_part_org,
                              @sOrg, N'B', null, null ), 0 ),
                l.stl_bin,
                l.stl_lot,
                N'-1',
                l.stl_manufacturer,
                l.stl_manufactpart,
                l.stl_udfchar01,
                l.stl_udfchar02,
                l.stl_udfchar03,
                l.stl_udfchar04,
                l.stl_udfchar05,
                l.stl_udfchar06,
                l.stl_udfchar07,
                l.stl_udfchar08,
                l.stl_udfchar09,
                l.stl_udfchar10,
                l.stl_udfchar11,
                l.stl_udfchar12,
                l.stl_udfchar13,
                l.stl_udfchar14,
                l.stl_udfchar15,
                l.stl_udfchar16,
                l.stl_udfchar17,
                l.stl_udfchar18,
                l.stl_udfchar19,
                l.stl_udfchar20,
                l.stl_udfchar21,
                l.stl_udfchar22,
                l.stl_udfchar23,
                l.stl_udfchar24,
                l.stl_udfchar25,
                l.stl_udfchar26,
                l.stl_udfchar27,
                l.stl_udfchar28,
                l.stl_udfchar29,
                l.stl_udfchar30,
                l.stl_udfnum01,
                l.stl_udfnum02,
                l.stl_udfnum03,
                l.stl_udfnum04,
                l.stl_udfnum05,
                l.stl_udfdate01,
                l.stl_udfdate02,
                l.stl_udfdate03,
                l.stl_udfdate04,
                l.stl_udfdate05,
                l.stl_udfchkbox01,
                l.stl_udfchkbox02,
                l.stl_udfchkbox03,
                l.stl_udfchkbox04,
                l.stl_udfchkbox05                    
                
        FROM    r5parts p,
                r5stocktakelines l LEFT OUTER JOIN r5stock s ON l.stl_part     = s.sto_part 
                                                             AND l.stl_part_org = s.sto_part_org
                                                             AND l.stl_store    = s.sto_store
        WHERE   l.stl_trans    = @sTrans
        AND     p.par_code     = l.stl_part
        AND     p.par_org      = l.stl_part_org
        AND     p.par_byasset  = N'-'
        AND     l.stl_expqty IS NOT NULL
        AND     l.stl_phyqty IS NOT NULL

        /* Update stocktake date in r5stock table. */
        UPDATE r5stock 
        SET    sto_stocktake = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dSys_date, N'DD' )
        WHERE  ( sto_store + sto_part + sto_part_org ) IN
              ( SELECT stl_store + stl_part + stl_part_org
                FROM   r5stocktakelines 
                WHERE  stl_trans = @sTrans
                AND    stl_phyqty IS NOT NULL )

        if @@ERROR <> 0
            RETURN
    END

    ELSE IF @sNeg_exists = N'Y' 

     /* Number of items will be set to zero, since calculating the difference will result in */
     /* the preins_trl triggger returning an error code which isn't handled in reports       */
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO r5translines
        (
          trl_part,

          trl_store,
          trl_line,
          trl_rtype,
          trl_type,
          trl_trans,
          trl_date,
          trl_qty,
          trl_origqty,
          trl_price,
          trl_bin,
          trl_lot,
          trl_io,
          trl_manufacturer,
          trl_manufactpart,
          trl_udfchar01,
          trl_udfchar02,
          trl_udfchar03,
          trl_udfchar04,
          trl_udfchar05,
          trl_udfchar06,
          trl_udfchar07,
          trl_udfchar08,
          trl_udfchar09,
          trl_udfchar10,
          trl_udfchar11,
          trl_udfchar12,
          trl_udfchar13,
          trl_udfchar14,
          trl_udfchar15,
          trl_udfchar16,
          trl_udfchar17,

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CRSTW1 (
   @sEvtcode			nvarchar(30),
   @sNewstwcode			nvarchar(20),
   @sNewstwdesc			nvarchar(80),
   @sNewstworgcode		nvarchar(15),
   @sChk				nvarchar(4) OUTPUT) 
AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sOrg  nvarchar(15)
	declare @nReturn		integer

	set @sChk = N'0'

	if @sEvtcode    IS NULL	OR @sNewstwcode IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

if @sNewstworgcode IS NULL
    if dbo.o7getmos( N'STWO' ) = N'-' 
      begin
        execute @nReturn = O7DFLT  @sOrg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
          return -1
      end    
    else
      set @sOrg = null
else
      set @sOrg = @sNewstworgcode

   INSERT INTO r5standworks (
      stw_code,
      stw_org,
      stw_desc,
      stw_duration,
      stw_jobtype,
      stw_priority,
      stw_reqm
      )
   SELECT   @sNewstwcode,
            coalesce( @sOrg, e.evt_org ),
            coalesce( @sNewstwdesc, e.evt_desc ),
            coalesce(max( CASE WHEN cast(a.act_start - e.evt_target as numeric(3)) > 1 THEN cast(a.act_start - e.evt_target as numeric(3))  ELSE 1 END + a.act_duration ),e.evt_duration),
            e.evt_jobtype,
            e.evt_priority,
            e.evt_reqm
            FROM r5events e left outer join
            r5activities a
   ON       e.evt_code = a.act_event
   WHERE    e.evt_code = @sEvtcode  
   GROUP BY e.evt_org,
            e.evt_desc,
            e.evt_jobtype,
            e.evt_priority,
            e.evt_duration,
            e.evt_reqm

	INSERT INTO r5standwacts (
      wac_standwork,
      wac_act,
      wac_trade,
      wac_duration,
      wac_est,
      wac_task,
      wac_matlist,
      wac_special,
      wac_hire,
      wac_persons,
      wac_start,
      wac_rpc,
      wac_wap,
      wac_tpf,
      wac_manufact,
      wac_syslevel,
      wac_asmlevel,
      wac_complevel
      )
   SELECT   @sNewstwcode,
            a.act_act,
            a.act_trade,
            a.act_duration,
            a.act_est,
            a.act_task,
            a.act_matlist,
            a.act_special,
            a.act_hire,
            a.act_persons,
			CASE WHEN coalesce(cast(a.act_start - e.evt_target as numeric(3) ), 0) + 1 > 1 THEN cast(a.act_start - e.evt_target as numeric(3))  ELSE 1 END,
            a.act_rpc,
            a.act_wap,
            a.act_tpf,
            a.act_manufact,
            a.act_syslevel,
            a.act_asmlevel,
            a.act_complevel
   FROM     r5activities a,
            r5events e
   WHERE    a.act_event = @sEvtcode
   AND      e.evt_code  = @sEvtcode
   
	execute @nReturn = o7copdat @sEvtcode, @sNewstwcode, N'EVNT', N'STWO', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	FROM     r5standwacts s
	WHERE    s.wac_standwork  = @sStwcode

	declare c_stw_activities cursor local for	SELECT wac_act
												FROM   r5standwacts
												WHERE  wac_standwork     =  @sStwcode
	open c_stw_activities
	fetch next from c_stw_activities into	@nAct

	while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		begin
			set @sTempnewcode = @sNewstwcode + N'#' + cast(@nAct as nvarchar(8)) 
			set @sTempcode = @sStwcode + N'#' +  cast(@nAct as nvarchar(8))

			execute @nReturn = o7copdat @sTempcode,@sTempnewcode,N'STWO',N'STWO',@sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				begin
					close c_stw_activities
					deallocate c_stw_activities
					return -1  
				end

			fetch next from c_stw_activities into	@nAct
		end
	close c_stw_activities
	deallocate c_stw_activities

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CRTRA1 
    @sCstore      nvarchar(30),       	    -- r5transactions.tra_fromcode%TYPE,
    @sCcode       nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,   	-- r5transactions.tra_code%TYPE,
    @sCuser       nvarchar(255),      		-- r5users.usr_code%TYPE,
    @sCtransrtype nvarchar(4),      
    @sChk         nvarchar(4)  OUTPUT 
as
begin
SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sCheckresult   nvarchar(4)
    declare @sOrg           nvarchar(15)  	--r5stores.str_org%TYPE;
    declare @nReturn		int
	/*  Initialise local variables */
    set  @sChk = N'0'
    set  @sCheckresult = N'0'
    /*  Check mandatory parameters */
    IF @sCstore IS NULL
	begin
        set @sChk = N'1'
        return
    end
    SELECT @sOrg = str_org
    FROM   r5stores
    WHERE  str_code = @sCstore

	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sCcode OUTPUT, N'TRAN', N'1', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

    IF @sCheckresult <> N'0'
	begin
	    IF @sCheckresult = N'999'
		begin
	        set @sChk = @sCheckresult
	        return
		end
	    ELSE
		begin
	        set @sChk = N'2'
	        return
	    end
	end
    INSERT INTO r5transactions
         (
             tra_code,
             tra_org,
             tra_desc,
             tra_auth,
             tra_rtype,
             tra_date,
             tra_fromcode,
             tra_fromrentity,
             tra_fromrtype,
             tra_rstatus,
             tra_printed
         )
    VALUES
         (
             @sCcode,
             @sOrg,
			 CASE @sCtransrtype WHEN N'MPTC'THEN N'Manual Price Type Change' ELSE N'CORRECTION' END,
             @sCuser,
		     @sCtransrtype,             
             dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2(@sOrg), N'DD' ) ,
             @sCstore,
             N'STOR',
             N'*',
             N'A',
             N'-'
         )
end
