create PROCEDURE O7CRTRA2
	@sSession		nvarchar(12), 
	@sUser			nvarchar(255), 
	@sName			nvarchar(20), 
	@sChk			nvarchar(4)  OUTPUT
AS
	declare @sCheckresult       nvarchar(4)
	declare @nReturn			integer
	declare @nCount				integer
	declare @nLineno			numeric(8)                       /* Transaction line no.*/
	declare @sTranscode			nvarchar(30)					/*r5transactions.tra_code%TYPE  Transaction code    */
	declare @sPrevstore			nvarchar(15)					/*r5stock.sto_store%TYPE       Previous store code */
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)

	declare @sTempStore			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sTempPart			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sTempPartOrg		nvarchar(15)	
	declare @nTempQty			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nTempPriceDif		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nTempNewPrice		numeric(24,6)
	declare @sTransType			nvarchar(4)

BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
/* Initialise local variables */
   set @sChk         = N'0'
   set @sCheckresult = N'0'
   set @sX           = NULL


	IF @sSession   IS NULL OR @sName      IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end


	declare c_local cursor local for select s.sto_store,
											s.sto_part,
											s.sto_part_org,
											s.sto_qty,
											t.tmp_pricediff pricediff,
											t.tmp_newprice  newprice,
											t.tmp_transrtype
										FROM     r5stock s,
											r5temppricedif t,
											r5stores r
										WHERE    s.sto_store    = coalesce( t.tmp_store, s.sto_store )
											AND      s.sto_part     = t.tmp_part
											AND      s.sto_part_org = t.tmp_part_org
											AND      r.str_code     = s.sto_store
											AND      t.tmp_session  = @sSession
											AND      t.tmp_org      = r.str_org
											AND      coalesce( s.sto_qty, 0 ) > 0
											ORDER BY s.sto_store

	OPEN c_local
	FETCH NEXT FROM c_local INTO @sTempStore, @sTempPart, @sTempPartOrg, @nTempQty, @nTempPriceDif, @nTempNewPrice, @sTransType
/*****************************************************************************************/
/* 07/08/2003 Milind Patil                                                               */
/* The following code needs Transaction management in its original PL/SQL version.       */
/* We keep the code logic same as PL/SQL as this fix is beyond the scope of this project */
/*****************************************************************************************/
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
			BEGIN

				IF @sTempStore <> coalesce( @sPrevstore, N' ' ) 
				begin
					set @sPrevstore   = @sTempStore
					set @sTranscode = @sX
					set @nLineno    = 0

					execute @nReturn = o7crtra1 @sTempStore, @sTranscode OUTPUT, @sUser, @sTransType, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						begin
							CLOSE c_local
							DEALLOCATE c_local
							return -1
						end	

					IF @sCheckresult <> N'0' 
						begin
							set @sChk = N'2'
							CLOSE c_local
							DEALLOCATE c_local
							RETURN
						end
				end
				
				set @nLineno = @nLineno + 1

				execute @nReturn = o7crtrl1 @sTranscode, @sTempPart, @sTempPartOrg, @sTempStore, @nLineno, @nTempQty, @nTempPriceDif, @sX, @sX, @sTransType, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					begin
						CLOSE c_local
						DEALLOCATE c_local
						return -1
					end	
					
				
				IF @sCheckresult <> N'0' 
					begin
						set @sChk = N'3'
						CLOSE c_local
						DEALLOCATE c_local
						RETURN
					end
				 

				FETCH NEXT FROM c_local INTO @sTempStore, @sTempPart, @sTempPartOrg, @nTempQty, @nTempPriceDif, @nTempNewPrice, @sTransType

			END
	CLOSE c_local
	DEALLOCATE c_local

	DELETE
	FROM  r5temppricedif 
	WHERE tmp_session = @sSession
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CRTRL1
	@sTranscode  nvarchar(30),	
	@sPart       nvarchar(30),	
	@sPartorg    nvarchar(15),	
	@sStore      nvarchar(15),	
	@nLine       numeric(8),	
	@nQty        numeric(24,6),	
	@nPrice      numeric(24,6),	
	@sBin        nvarchar(15),	
	@sLot        nvarchar(12),	
	@sTransrtype nvarchar(4),                   
	@sChk        nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare	@sType			nvarchar(4)		
	declare	@sOrg			nvarchar(15)	
	declare	@sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare	@sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @dTempDate		datetime
	declare @nReturn		integer
	declare @nCount			integer
BEGIN
	set @sX            = NULL
	set @sChk          = N'0'
	set @sCheckresult  = N'0'
	set @sType        = @sX


	IF @sStore     IS NULL
	OR @sTranscode IS NULL
	OR @nLine      IS NULL
	OR @sPart      IS NULL
	OR @sPartorg   IS NULL
	OR @nPrice     IS NULL
	OR @nQty       IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

	SELECT @sOrg = tra_org
	  FROM r5transactions
	 WHERE tra_code = @sTranscode
	IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	   SET @sX = NULL

	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sType OUTPUT, @sTransrtype, N'TRTP', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	IF @sCheckresult = N'0' 
		set @sX= NULL
	ELSE
		begin
			IF @sCheckresult = N'999' 
				begin
					set @sChk = @sCheckresult
					RETURN
				end
			ELSE
				begin
					set @sChk = N'2'
					RETURN
				end
		end
	
	execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempDate OUTPUT, @sOrg 
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1	

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5translines WHERE trl_trans = @sTranscode AND trl_line = @nLine)
		INSERT INTO r5translines
			(
			trl_part,
			trl_part_org,
			trl_store,
			trl_line,
			trl_type,
			trl_rtype,
			trl_trans,
			trl_date,
			trl_qty,
			trl_price,
			trl_bin,
			trl_lot,
			trl_io
			)
		VALUES
			(    @sPart,
			@sPartorg,
			@sStore,
			@nLine,
			@sType,
			@sTransrtype,               
			@sTranscode,
			@dTempDate,
			@nQty,
			@nPrice,
			@sBin,
			@sLot,
			N'1'
			)
	ELSE
	   BEGIN
	   SET @sChk = N'3'
	   RETURN
	   END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CRTRL3 (	@ctranscode		NVARCHAR(30) OUTPUT,	/* r5translines.trl_trans%TYPE,*/
							@cpart			NVARCHAR(30),			/* r5translines.trl_part%TYPE,*/
							@cpartorg		NVARCHAR(15),			/* r5translines.trl_part_org%TYPE,*/
							@cstore			NVARCHAR(15),			/* r5translines.trl_store%TYPE,*/
							@cobject		NVARCHAR(30),			/* r5translines.trl_object%TYPE,*/
							@cobjectorg		NVARCHAR(15),			/* r5translines.trl_object_org%TYPE,*/
							@cobtype		NVARCHAR(4),			/* r5translines.trl_obtype%TYPE,*/
							@cobrtype		NVARCHAR(4),			/* r5translines.trl_obrtype%TYPE,*/
							@nqty			NUMERIC(24,6),			/* r5translines.trl_qty%TYPE,*/
							@nprice			NUMERIC(24,6),			/* r5translines.trl_price%TYPE,*/
							@cbin			NVARCHAR(15),			/* r5translines.trl_bin%TYPE,*/
							@clot			NVARCHAR(12),			/* r5translines.trl_lot%TYPE,*/
							@cuser			NVARCHAR(255),			/* r5users.usr_code%TYPE,*/
							@crtype			NVARCHAR(4))				/* r5transactions.tra_rtype%TYPE )*/


AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	-- New Variables
	DECLARE @TempDate			DATETIME
	DECLARE @nReturn			INTEGER

	-- Oracle Variables
	DECLARE @corg               NVARCHAR(15)	/* r5stores.str_org%TYPE*/
	DECLARE @ctype              NVARCHAR(4)		/* r5translines.trl_type%TYPE*/
	DECLARE @nline              integer
	DECLARE @checkresult        NVARCHAR(4)


	-- Initialise local variables
	SET @checkresult = N'0'
	EXECUTE @nReturn = r5o7_o7ucode @ctype OUTPUT, @crtype, N'TRTP', @checkresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	-- Get store organization.
	SELECT	@corg = str_org
	FROM	r5stores
	WHERE	str_code = @cstore

	IF @ctranscode IS NULL
		BEGIN
			EXECUTE @nReturn = o7crtra3 @cstore, @ctranscode OUTPUT, @cuser, @corg, @crtype
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			SET @nline = 1
		END
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT	@nline = ISNULL(MAX(trl_line), 0) + 1
			FROM	r5translines
			WHERE	trl_trans = @ctranscode
		END

	EXECUTE @nReturn = o7gttime @TempDate OUTPUT, @corg
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	INSERT INTO r5translines (	trl_part, trl_part_org, trl_store, trl_object, trl_object_org, trl_obtype,
								trl_obrtype, trl_line, trl_type, trl_rtype, trl_trans, trl_date, trl_qty,
								trl_price, trl_bin, trl_lot, trl_io)
					VALUES (	@cpart, @cpartorg, @cstore, @cobject, @cobjectorg, @cobtype, @cobrtype,
								@nline, @ctype, @crtype, @ctranscode, @TempDate,
								@nqty, @nprice, @cbin, @clot, N'1' )

create PROCEDURE O7CRTRL4
   @sEvent    nvarchar(30),
   @nAct      numeric(8),
   @sTrans    nvarchar(30),
   @sUType    nvarchar(4),
   @sRType    nvarchar(4),
   @dDate     datetime,
   @sPart     nvarchar(30),
   @sPartorg  nvarchar(15),
   @sObject   nvarchar(30),
   @sObjorg   nvarchar(15),
   @sObjorgrtype nvarchar(4),
   @sObjorgtype  nvarchar(4),
   @sLot		nvarchar(12),
   @sBin		nvarchar(15),
   @sStore		nvarchar(15),
   @sOrder		nvarchar(30),
   @sOrderorg	nvarchar(15),
   @nOrdline	numeric(8,0),
   @nPrice		numeric(24,6),
   @nTotqty		numeric(24,6),
   @nObjects	int ,
   @sTranrtype  nvarchar(4),
   @sRejreason  nvarchar(15),
   @nIo         numeric(38,0),
   @sSplittrans nvarchar(1),
   @sDesc       nvarchar(80),
   @sManu       nvarchar(24),
   @sManupart   nvarchar(50),
   @sDockcode   nvarchar(30),
   @nDockline   numeric(8,0),
   @sAuth       nvarchar(255) = NULL,
   @sIssuedpart nvarchar(30) = NULL
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare @sCode				nvarchar(30) --r5transactions.tra_code%TYPE
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @nQty				numeric(24,6)
	declare @nRecs				int
	declare @sEvtCode			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sEvtOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sEvtCostCode		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sEvtProject		nvarchar(20)
	declare @sEvtProjbud		nvarchar(20)
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @nLine				int
	declare @nIncrlino			numeric(8,0)--r5translines.trl_line%TYPE;
BEGIN
	set @sCheckresult  = N'0'
	set @nQty = ROUND( @nTotqty / @nObjects, 6 )
	set @nRecs = 0
	set @nIncrlino = coalesce(dbo.o7dflt2(N'INCRLINO'),10)

	DECLARE cLocal CURSOR local static FOR SELECT evt_code, evt_org, evt_costcode, evt_project, evt_projbud
									FROM   r5events
									WHERE  evt_routeparent = @sEvent
									AND    ( @sSplittrans = N'A' OR ( @sSplittrans = N'O' AND evt_rstatus <> N'C' ) )
									AND    EXISTS( SELECT N'x'
												  FROM   r5activities
												  WHERE  act_event = evt_code
												  AND    act_act   = @nAct )
									ORDER BY evt_code


	OPEN cLocal
	FETCH NEXT FROM cLocal INTO @sEvtCode, @sEvtOrg, @sEvtCostCode, @sEvtProject,@sEvtProjbud
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN

			set @nRecs = @nRecs + 1
			IF @nRecs = @nObjects
			/* Calculate the quantity for last record, to avoid rounding differences. */
				set @nQty = @nTotqty - ( @nQty * ( @nRecs - 1 ) )

			SELECT @sCode = tra_code
			FROM   r5transactions
			WHERE  tra_routeparent = @sTrans
			AND    tra_rtype        = @sTranrtype
			AND    tra_tocode       = CASE tra_torentity WHEN N'EVNT' THEN @sEvtCode ELSE tra_tocode END
			AND    coalesce( tra_tocode_org, N'x')   = coalesce( CASE tra_torentity WHEN N'EVNT' THEN @sEvtOrg ELSE  tra_tocode_org END, N'x')
			AND    tra_fromcode     = CASE tra_fromrentity WHEN N'EVNT' THEN @sEvtCode ELSE tra_fromcode END
			AND    coalesce( tra_fromcode_org, N'x') = coalesce( CASE tra_fromrentity WHEN N'EVNT' THEN @sEvtOrg ELSE tra_fromcode_org END, N'x')


			If @@ROWCOUNT = 0
				set @sCode = null

			IF @sCode IS NULL
				begin
					execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sCode OUTPUT, N'TRAN', N'1', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						begin
							CLOSE cLocal
							DEALLOCATE cLocal
							return -1
						end
					INSERT INTO r5transactions
						( tra_code,
						tra_org,
						tra_desc,
						tra_auth,
						tra_rtype,
						tra_date,
						tra_fromcode,
						tra_fromcode_org,
						tra_fromrentity,
						tra_fromrtype,
						tra_tocode,
						tra_tocode_org,
						tra_torentity,
						tra_tortype,
						tra_rstatus,
						tra_printed,
						tra_order,
						tra_order_org,
						tra_dckcode,
						tra_dckline,
						tra_advice,
						tra_routeparent,
						tra_pers )
					SELECT @sCode,
							tra_org,
							tra_desc,
							COALESCE(tra_auth,@sAuth),
							tra_rtype,
							tra_date,
							CASE tra_fromrentity WHEN N'EVNT' THEN @sEvtCode ELSE tra_fromcode END,
							CASE tra_fromrentity WHEN N'EVNT' THEN @sEvtOrg ELSE tra_fromcode_org END,
							tra_fromrentity,
							tra_fromrtype,
							CASE tra_torentity WHEN N'EVNT' THEN @sEvtCode ELSE tra_tocode END,
							CASE tra_torentity WHEN N'EVNT' THEN @sEvtOrg ELSE tra_tocode_org END,
							tra_torentity,
							tra_tortype,
							N'A',
							N'-',
							tra_order,
							tra_order_org,
							tra_dckcode,
							tra_dckline,
							tra_advice,
							tra_code,
							tra_pers
					FROM   r5transactions
					WHERE  tra_code = @sTrans

					set @nLine = @nIncrlino
				end
			else
				begin
					SELECT @nLine = coalesce( MAX( trl_line ), 0 ) + @nIncrlino
					FROM   r5translines
					WHERE  trl_trans = @sCode
					if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
						set @nLine = @nIncrlino
				end

			INSERT INTO r5translines
				(   trl_trans,
				trl_type,
				trl_rtype,
				trl_line,
				trl_date,
				trl_event,
				trl_act,
				trl_costcode,
				trl_project,
				trl_projbud,
				trl_issuedpart,
				trl_part,
				trl_part_org,
				trl_object,
				trl_object_org,
				trl_obrtype,
				trl_obtype,
				trl_lot,
				trl_bin,
				trl_store,
				trl_price,
				trl_qty,
				trl_io,
				trl_routerec,
				trl_order,
				trl_order_org,
				trl_ordline,
				trl_rejectreason,
				trl_splittrans,
				trl_manufacturer,
				trl_manufactpart,
				trl_dckcode,
				trl_dckline,
                trl_desc )
			VALUES (
				@sCode,
				@sUType,
				@sRType,
				@nLine,
				@dDate,
				@sEvtCode,
				@nAct,
				@sEvtCostCode,
				@sEvtProject,
				@sEvtProjbud,
				@sIssuedpart,
				@sPart,
				@sPartorg,
				@sObject,
				@sObjorg,
				@sObjorgrtype,
				@sObjorgtype,
				@sLot,
				@sBin,
				@sStore,
				@nPrice,
				@nQty,
				@nIo,
				N'+',
				@sOrder,
				@sOrderorg,
				@nOrdline,
				@sRejreason,
				N'N',
				@sManu,
				@sManupart,
				@sDockcode,
				@nDockline,
				@sDesc )
				/* 31306 call O7TRANS_DO_TRANSACTION here because POSINS_TRL won't fire for SQL Server 2005(recursive trigger) */
					declare @DoTransPart            nvarchar(30)
					declare @DoTransPartorg         nvarchar(15)
					declare @DoTransLot             nvarchar(12)
					declare @DoTransBin             nvarchar(15)
					declare @DoTransQty             numeric(24,6)
					declare @DoTransPrice           numeric(24,6)
					declare @DoTransIo              int
					declare @DoTransMinout          int
					declare @DoTransFromentity      nvarchar(4)

body:
create procedure O7CRTWLD	@nSessionId	integer
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @dStartDate   datetime
	declare @dEndDate     datetime

    declare @nExSessionid   int
    declare @sExMrc         nvarchar(15)
    declare @sExNewtrade    nvarchar(15)
    declare @dExLoaddate    datetime
    declare @nExHours       numeric(24,6)

	set @dStartDate   = null
	set @dEndDate     = null


	SELECT @dStartDate = coalesce(wlp_startdate, convert( datetime, '01-01-1900',101 )),
		@dEndDate = coalesce(wlp_enddate, convert( datetime, '12-31-4099',101 ))
	FROM   r5tempworkloadparameters
	WHERE  wlp_sessionid = @nSessionId


	-- Delete temp workload
	DELETE FROM R5TEMPWORKLOAD
	WHERE TWL_SESSIONID = @nSessionId

    DELETE FROM R5WORKLOAD
  
    -- create workload for reports

    INSERT INTO R5WORKLOAD(WRK_MRC,WRK_TRADE,WRK_DATE,WRK_HOURS)
    SELECT EVT_MRC,
           ACT_TRADE,
           dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( ACT_START + RPN_LINE - 1, N'DD' ),
           ROUND(SUM(isnull(ACT_REM,0)/ACT_DURATION),2)
    FROM   R5REPNUM,
           R5EVENTS,
           R5ACTIVITIES
    WHERE  ACT_EVENT = EVT_CODE
    AND    ACT_TRADE IS NOT NULL
    AND    ACT_PARENT IS NULL
    AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( ACT_START + RPN_LINE - 1, N'DD' ) BETWEEN @dStartDate AND @dEndDate
    AND    RPN_LINE <= ACT_DURATION
    AND    EVT_RSTATUS > N'C'
    GROUP BY EVT_MRC,ACT_TRADE,dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( ACT_START + RPN_LINE - 1, N'DD')
    
	-- create workload records for records in r5availability which are not in workload table yet.
	--note: MINUS operation is not supported in SQLServer - must use the NOT EXISTS clause.
	INSERT INTO R5WORKLOAD
		  (WRK_MRC,WRK_TRADE,WRK_DATE,WRK_HOURS)
	SELECT AVL_MRC,
		   AVL_TRADE,
		   AVL_DATE,
		   0
	FROM   R5AVAILABILITY
	WHERE  AVL_DATE BETWEEN  @dStartDate AND @dEndDate and 
		   not exists (select 1 
						from R5WORKLOAD 
						WHERE	AVL_MRC = WRK_MRC  AND
								AVL_TRADE = WRK_TRADE AND
								AVL_DATE = WRK_DATE AND
								WRK_DATE BETWEEN  @dStartDate AND @dEndDate )

    /* insert records into r5tempworkload */
    -- insert records that are not in workload selection list
	 
    INSERT INTO R5TEMPWORKLOAD(TWL_SESSIONID,TWL_MRC,TWL_TRADE,TWL_DATE,TWL_HOURS)
    SELECT @nSessionId,
 	       EVT_MRC,
           ACT_TRADE,
           dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( ACT_START + RPN_LINE - 1, N'DD' ),
           ROUND(SUM(isnull(ACT_REM,0)/ACT_DURATION),2)
    FROM   R5REPNUM,
           R5EVENTS,
           R5ACTIVITIES
    WHERE  ACT_EVENT = EVT_CODE
    AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( ACT_START + RPN_LINE - 1, N'DD' ) BETWEEN @dStartDate AND @dEndDate
    AND    RPN_LINE <= ACT_DURATION
    AND    EVT_RSTATUS > N'C'
    AND    ACT_TRADE IS NOT NULL
    AND    ACT_PARENT IS NULL
    AND    NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM  R5TEMPWORKLOADACTIVITIES WHERE WLA_SESSIONID = @nSessionId 
                                                                    AND WLA_EVENT = EVT_CODE 
                                                                    AND WLA_ACT = ACT_ACT)
    GROUP BY EVT_MRC,ACT_TRADE,dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( ACT_START + RPN_LINE - 1, N'DD')
	   
    -- update records that are already in r5tempworkload table

    declare c_existing cursor local for  SELECT WLW_SESSIONID,
                                                WLW_MRC,
                                                WLA_NEWTRADE,
                                                dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( WLA_NEWSTART + RPN_LINE - 1, N'DD' ),
       	                                        ROUND(SUM(isnull(WLA_REM,0)/WLA_DURATION),2)
                                         FROM   R5REPNUM,
                                                R5TEMPWORKLOADWORKORDERS,
                                                R5TEMPWORKLOADACTIVITIES
                                         WHERE  WLW_SESSIONID = @nSessionId
                                         AND    WLA_EVENT = WLW_EVENT
                                         AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( WLA_NEWSTART + RPN_LINE - 1, N'DD' ) BETWEEN @dStartDate AND @dEndDate
                                         AND    RPN_LINE <= WLA_DURATION
                                         AND    WLW_RSTATUS > N'C'
                                         AND    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM R5TEMPWORKLOAD WHERE TWL_SESSIONID = @nSessionId
                                                                                     AND   TWL_MRC = WLW_MRC
											                                         AND   TWL_TRADE = WLA_NEWTRADE
											                                         AND   TWL_DATE = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( WLA_NEWSTART + RPN_LINE - 1, N'DD' ))
                                         GROUP  BY WLW_SESSIONID,WLW_MRC,WLA_NEWTRADE,dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( WLA_NEWSTART + RPN_LINE - 1, N'DD')
    open c_existing
    fetch next from c_existing into @nExSessionid, @sExMrc, @sExNewtrade, @dExLoaddate, @nExHours
    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        begin
            UPDATE R5TEMPWORKLOAD SET TWL_HOURS = TWL_HOURS + @nExHours
            WHERE  TWL_SESSIONID = @nExSessionid
            AND    TWL_MRC       = @sExMrc
            AND    TWL_TRADE     = @sExNewtrade
            AND    TWL_DATE      = @dExLoaddate
            
            fetch next from c_existing into @nExSessionid, @sExMrc, @sExNewtrade, @dExLoaddate, @nExHours
        end
    close c_existing
    deallocate c_existing
 
    -- insert record that are not in r5tempworkload table yet

    INSERT INTO R5TEMPWORKLOAD(TWL_SESSIONID,TWL_MRC,TWL_TRADE,TWL_DATE,TWL_HOURS)
    SELECT WLW_SESSIONID,
           WLW_MRC,
           WLA_NEWTRADE,
           dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( WLA_NEWSTART + RPN_LINE - 1, N'DD' ),
           ROUND(SUM(isnull(WLA_REM,0)/WLA_DURATION),2)
    FROM   R5REPNUM,
           R5TEMPWORKLOADWORKORDERS,
           R5TEMPWORKLOADACTIVITIES
    WHERE  WLW_SESSIONID = @nSessionId
    AND    WLA_EVENT = WLW_EVENT
    AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( WLA_NEWSTART + RPN_LINE - 1, N'DD' ) BETWEEN @dStartDate AND @dEndDate
    AND    RPN_LINE <= WLA_DURATION
    AND    WLW_RSTATUS > N'C'
    AND    NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM R5TEMPWORKLOAD 
	                  WHERE TWL_SESSIONID = @nSessionId
                      AND   TWL_MRC = WLW_MRC
				      AND   TWL_TRADE = WLA_NEWTRADE
				      AND   TWL_DATE = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( WLA_NEWSTART + RPN_LINE - 1, N'DD' ))	   
    GROUP  BY WLW_SESSIONID,WLW_MRC,WLA_NEWTRADE,dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( WLA_NEWSTART + RPN_LINE - 1, N'DD')

	--note: MINUS operation is not supported in SQLServer - must use the NOT EXISTS clause.
   INSERT INTO R5TEMPWORKLOAD
          (TWL_SESSIONID,TWL_MRC,TWL_TRADE,TWL_DATE,TWL_HOURS)
   SELECT  @nSessionId,
           AVL_MRC,
     	   AVL_TRADE,
     	   AVL_DATE,
     	   0
   FROM	   R5AVAILABILITY
   WHERE   AVL_DATE BETWEEN @dStartDate AND @dEndDate AND
   NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 from R5TEMPWORKLOAD
				WHERE   AVL_MRC = TWL_MRC AND
						AVL_TRADE = TWL_TRADE AND
						AVL_DATE = TWL_DATE AND
						TWL_SESSIONID = @nSessionId AND 
						TWL_DATE BETWEEN @dStartDate AND @dEndDate  )

create function O7CRTWLW_PRJ_HIERARCHY (@sCode nvarchar(20))
returns @tReturn table( prj_code nvarchar(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
	DECLARE @nLevel			int
	DECLARE @sCurrentCode	nvarchar(20)

	declare @tStack table ( prj_code nvarchar(20), LevelID int )

	INSERT INTO @tStack select prj_code, 1 from r5projects where prj_code = @sCode
	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select @sCurrentCode = prj_code from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sCurrentCode )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND prj_code = @sCurrentCode
					insert into @tStack select prj_code, @nLevel + 1
										  from r5projects
										 where prj_parent = @sCurrentCode
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

create function O7CRTWLW_STC_HIERARCHY (	@sCode	nvarchar(30),
											@sOrg	nvarchar(15) )
returns @tReturn table( stc_child		nvarchar(30)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						stc_child_org	nvarchar(15)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
	declare @nLevel			int

	declare @tStack table ( stc_child		nvarchar(30),
							stc_child_org	nvarchar(15),
							LevelID int )

	INSERT INTO @tStack
		select	stc_child,
				stc_child_org,
				1
		  from	r5structures
		 where	stc_parent		= @sCode	and
				stc_parent_org	= @sOrg

	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select	@sCode	= stc_child,
							@sOrg	= stc_child_org
					  from	@tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sCode, @sOrg )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_child = @sCode and stc_child_org = @sOrg
					insert into @tStack	select	stc_child,
												stc_child_org,
												@nLevel + 1
										  from	r5structures
										 where	stc_parent		= @sCode	and
												stc_parent_org	= @sOrg
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

                        fetch next from c_r5permissions into @sFunction,@sSelect,@sUpdate,@sInsert,@sDelete,@sPrinter,@sScreen,@sPrfile,@slocal,@sDefQuery,@sSecurityddspyid

                close c_r5permissions

create procedure O7CRUSER	@sReturn	nvarchar(30)	OUTPUT,
							@sUser		nvarchar(255),
							@sRole		nvarchar(30),
							@sExternUser	nvarchar(256),
							@sUserDescription	nvarchar(80),
							@sEmail		nvarchar(255)
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nTemp		int
	declare @sOrg		nvarchar(15)	--r5organization.org_code%type
	declare @sChk		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sCommon	nvarchar(10)
	declare @nReturn	int
	declare @dDate		datetime
	declare @nCount		int

    declare @sFlags           nvarchar(9)
    declare @sActive          nvarchar(1)    --r5roles.rol_active%TYPE;
    declare @sRequestor       nvarchar(1)    --r5roles.rol_requestor%TYPE;
    declare @sMobile          nvarchar(1)    --r5roles.rol_mobile%TYPE;
    declare @sConnector       nvarchar(1)    --r5roles.rol_connector%TYPE;
    declare @sBarCode         nvarchar(1)    --r5roles.rol_barcode%TYPE;
    declare @sAnalytics       nvarchar(1)    --r5roles.rol_analytics%TYPE;
    declare @sConsumer        nvarchar(1)    --r5roles.rol_advrepconsumer%TYPE;
    declare @sProfessional    nvarchar(1)    --r5roles.rol_advrepauthor%TYPE;
    declare @sMobileadm       nvarchar(1)    --r5roles.rol_mobileadm%TYPE;

    declare @nAddChk          integer

    DECLARE @sRolesecu        NVARCHAR(200)  --r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
    DECLARE @sCheckResult     NVARCHAR(4)
    DECLARE @sStarRole        NVARCHAR(30)   --r5roles.rol_code%TYPE;
    DECLARE @nInsParamReturn  INT

	set @sChk = N'999'

	if charindex( N'#', @sUser ) > 0 or	   
	   charindex( N'&', @sUser ) > 0 or
	   charindex( N'''', @sUser ) > 0 or
	   charindex( N'%', @sUser ) > 0
		begin
			set @sReturn = N'11'
			return
		end

	set @sRole = UPPER(@sRole)
	set @sUser = UPPER(@sUser)
	set @sExternUser = UPPER(@sExternUser)	

	if exists (select 1 from r5users where usr_code = @sUser or usr_externcode = @sUser)
		begin
			set @sReturn = N'12'
			return
		end

	if @sExternUser is not null and exists (select 1 from r5users where usr_code = @sExternUser or usr_externcode = @sExternUser)
		begin
			set @sReturn = N'16'
			return
		end	

	if not exists (select 1 from r5roles where rol_code = @sRole)
		begin
			set @sReturn = N'14'
			return
		end

    execute @nReturn = o7chkcruserfromrole @nAddChk OUTPUT, @sRole, @sFlags OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

    IF( @nAddChk <> 0 )
		begin
			set @sReturn = cast(@nAddChk as nvarchar(30))
			return
		end

    set @sActive = SUBSTRING( @sFlags, 1, 1 )
    set @sRequestor = SUBSTRING( @sFlags, 2, 1 )
    set @sMobile = SUBSTRING( @sFlags, 3, 1 )
    set @sConnector = SUBSTRING( @sFlags, 4, 1 )
    set @sBarCode = SUBSTRING( @sFlags, 5, 1 )
	set @sAnalytics = SUBSTRING( @sFlags, 6, 1 )
	set @sConsumer = SUBSTRING( @sFlags, 7, 1 )
	set @sProfessional = SUBSTRING( @sFlags, 8, 1 )
	set @sMobileadm = SUBSTRING( @sFlags, 9, 1 )


	set @dDate = dbo.TO_DATE( N'01-31-2099', N'MM-DD-YYYY')
	execute @nReturn = o7preusr N'INS', null, null, @dDate, @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sChk <> N'0'
		begin
			set @sReturn = N'13'
			return
		end

	SELECT @sOrg = rol_defaultorg,
		   @sCommon = org_common
	FROM r5roles,
		 r5organization
	WHERE rol_defaultorg = org_code
	AND   rol_code       = @sRole

	INSERT INTO r5users
	  ( usr_buyer,
      usr_code,
      usr_externcode,
      usr_emailaddress,
      usr_desc,
      usr_firstfunc,
      usr_group,
      usr_lang,
      usr_locale,
      usr_mrc,
      usr_active,
      usr_requestor,
      usr_mobile,
      usr_connector,
      usr_barcode,
      usr_analytics,
      usr_consumer,
      usr_professional,
      usr_mobileadm,
      usr_successmsgtimeout,
      usr_router,
      usr_reqappvlimit,
      usr_pordappvlimit,
      usr_reqauthappvlimit,
      usr_pordauthappvlimit,
      usr_picappvlimit,
      usr_invappvlimit,
      usr_invappvlimitnonpo,
      usr_exppass,
      usr_expuser,
      usr_sysman ,
      usr_password,
	  usr_ewsfirstfunc )
	SELECT
      rol_buyer,
      @sUser,
      @sExternUser,
      @sEmail,
      coalesce( @sUserDescription, rol_desc ),
      rol_firstfunc,
      rol_group,
      rol_lang,
      rol_locale,
      rol_mrc,
      coalesce( @sActive, rol_active ),
      coalesce( @sRequestor, rol_requestor ),
      coalesce( @sMobile, rol_mobile ),
      coalesce( @sConnector, rol_connector ),
      coalesce( @sBarCode, rol_barcode ),
	  coalesce( @sAnalytics, rol_analytics ),
	  coalesce( @sConsumer, rol_advrepconsumer ),
	  coalesce( @sProfessional, rol_advrepauthor ),
      coalesce( @sMobileadm, rol_mobileadm ),
      rol_successmsgtimeout,
      rol_router,
      CASE @sCommon WHEN N'+' THEN null ELSE rol_reqappvlimit END,
      CASE @sCommon WHEN N'+' THEN null ELSE rol_pordappvlimit END,
      CASE @sCommon WHEN N'+' THEN null ELSE rol_reqauthappvlimit END,
      CASE @sCommon WHEN N'+' THEN null ELSE rol_pordauthappvlimit END,
      CASE @sCommon WHEN N'+' THEN null ELSE rol_picappvlimit END,
      CASE @sCommon WHEN N'+' THEN null ELSE rol_invappvlimit END,
      CASE @sCommon WHEN N'+' THEN null ELSE rol_invappvlimitnonpo END,
      @dDate,
      @dDate,
      N'-',
      N'111111',
	  rol_ewsfirstfunc
	FROM r5roles
	WHERE rol_code = @sRole

	set @nTemp = @@ROWCOUNT

    EXECUTE @nInsParamReturn = O7DFLT @sRolesecu OUTPUT, N'ROLESECU', @sCheckResult OUTPUT
    IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nInsParamReturn <> 0 OR @sRolesecu IS NULL
        SET @sRolesecu = N'OFF'
    IF @sRolesecu <> N'ON'
        SET @sStarRole = N'*'
	if @sCommon = N'-' and @sOrg is not null
		begin
			INSERT INTO r5userorganization
			  ( uog_user,
				uog_org,
				uog_common,
				uog_default,
				uog_group,
				uog_reqappvlimit,
				uog_pordappvlimit,
				uog_reqauthappvlimit,
				uog_pordauthappvlimit,
				uog_picappvlimit,
				uog_invappvlimit,
				uog_invappvlimitnonpo,
				uog_role)
			SELECT  @sUser,
					rol_defaultorg,
					N'-',
					N'+',
					rol_group,
					rol_reqappvlimit,
					rol_pordappvlimit,
					rol_reqauthappvlimit,
					rol_pordauthappvlimit,
					rol_picappvlimit,
					rol_invappvlimit,
					rol_invappvlimitnonpo,
					COALESCE(@sStarRole, rol_code)
			FROM  r5roles
			WHERE rol_code = @sRole

			set @nCount = @@ROWCOUNT
		end
	else --Note had to add this since the Oracle Code did not reset the SQLROWCOUNT.  Without this code this procedure would raise N'15'
		set @nCount = @nTemp

	if @nCount = 1 and @nTemp = 1
		set @sChk = N'0'
	else
		begin
			if @nTemp = 1 and @nCount = 0
				set @sChk = N'15'
			else
				set @sChk = N'16'
		end

	set @sReturn = @sChk


-- ========================================

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CUIVL1
    @sInsupd         nvarchar(255),
    @sCivlinvoice    nvarchar(45),
    @sCivlinvoiceorg nvarchar(15),
    @sCivlorder      nvarchar(30),
    @sCivlorderorg   nvarchar(15),
    @nNivlordline    int,
    @sChk            nvarchar(5)OUTPUT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @nCountit             int
    declare @sCheckresult         nvarchar( 4 )
    declare @sX                   nvarchar( 1 )
    declare @sCorlpart            nvarchar(30)    /* r5orderlines.orl_part%TYPE;   order part     */
    declare @sCorlpartorg         nvarchar(15)    /* r5orderlines.orl_part_org%TYPE;   order part org */
    declare @nNorlmultiply        numeric(10,4)	  /* r5orderlines.orl_multiply%TYPE;   conversion     */
    declare @sCorlpuruom          nvarchar(30)	  /* r5orderlines.orl_puruom%TYPE;     purchase uom   */
    declare @sCinvsupplier        nvarchar(30)	  /* r5invoices.inv_supplier%TYPE;     supplier       */
    declare @sCinvsupplierorg     nvarchar(15)	  /* r5invoices.inv_supplier_org%TYPE; supplier org   */
    declare @sCinvref             nvarchar(24)	  /* r5invoices.inv_ref%TYPE;  catalogue reference    */
	declare @nReturn			  int
BEGIN
	/* Initialise local variables */
    set @sChk          = N'0'
    set @sCheckresult  = N'0'
    set @sX            = NULL
    set @sCorlpart     = NULL
    set @nNorlmultiply = 0
    set @sCorlpuruom   = NULL
    set @sCinvsupplier = NULL
    set @sCinvref      = NULL
	/* Check mandatory parameters */
    IF isnull( @sInsupd,
	   N'XXX' ) NOT IN ( N'INS', N'UPD' )
    OR @sCivlinvoice  IS NULL
    OR @sCivlorder    IS NULL
    OR @nNivlordline  IS NULL 
	begin
        set @sChk = N'1'
        return 
    end
	/* get common data */
    SELECT @sCorlpart = o.orl_part,
           @sCorlpartorg = o.orl_part_org,
           @nNorlmultiply = o.orl_multiply,
           @sCorlpuruom = o.orl_puruom,
           @sCinvsupplier = i.inv_supplier,
           @sCinvsupplierorg = i.inv_supplier_org,
           @sCinvref = i.inv_ref
    FROM   r5orderlines  o,
           r5invoices    i
    WHERE  o.orl_order     = @sCivlorder
    AND    o.orl_order_org = @sCivlorderorg
    AND    o.orl_ordline   = @nNivlordline
    AND    i.inv_code      = @sCivlinvoice
    AND    i.inv_org       = @sCivlinvoiceorg
	
	if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	begin
        set @sChk = N'6'
        return
	end
  
	/* if insert then insert record in cataglogue */
    IF @sInsupd = N'INS'
	begin
	/* P1325 /P1335 insert catalogue item if it does not exist (r5catalogue) */
      	execute @nReturn = o7existp N'IVL', N'1', @sCinvsupplier, @sCorlpart, @sCinvsupplierorg,
                @sCorlpartorg, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT 
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
        IF @nCountit = -1
		begin
            set @sChk = @sCheckresult
            return
		end
        ELSE IF @nCountit = 0 
/* record does not exist in r5catalogue for the supplier, part */
        begin
            INSERT INTO r5catalogue
               (
                   cat_supplier,
                   cat_supplier_org,
                   cat_part,
                   cat_part_org,
                   cat_ref,
                   cat_puruom,
                   cat_date,
                   cat_multiply
               )
            VALUES
               (
                   @sCinvsupplier,
                   @sCinvsupplierorg,
                   @sCorlpart,
                   @sCorlpartorg,
                   @sCinvref,
                   @sCorlpuruom,
                   dbo.o7gttime2(@sCivlinvoiceorg),
                   @nNorlmultiply
               )
            IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
			begin
                set @sChk = N'4'
                return
            end
        end
    end
	/* P1326 /P1336 update catalogue item if uom is not changed (r5catalogue) */
    UPDATE r5catalogue
    SET    cat_ref          = @sCinvref,
           cat_date         = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2(@sCivlinvoiceorg), N'DD' )
    WHERE  cat_part         = @sCorlpart
    AND    cat_part_org     = @sCorlpartorg
    AND    cat_supplier     = @sCinvsupplier
    AND    cat_supplier_org = @sCinvsupplierorg
    AND    ( cat_puruom     = @sCorlpuruom OR
               cat_puruom IS NULL )

END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CUQUT1
   @sCquotation     nvarchar(30),
   @sCseqno  	    nvarchar(2),
   @nNline          int,
   @nNact		    int,
   @sCevent	        nvarchar(30),
   @sCtaskcode	    nvarchar(20),
   @sCdesc	        nvarchar(80),
   @sCupdate        nvarchar(2),
   @sChk		    nvarchar(5) OUTPUT
AS
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sCentity        nvarchar(4)		/*r5entities.ent_entity%TYPE;  entity variable */
    declare @sUstat          nvarchar(8)		/*r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE;*/
    declare @sOrg            nvarchar(15)	    /*r5quotations.quo_org%TYPE;*/
    declare @nReturn		 int
    DECLARE cText CURSOR LOCAL FOR
    SELECT add_text,
           add_lang,
           add_line,
           add_print,
           add_created,
           add_user,
           add_updated,
           add_upduser
    FROM   r5addetails
    WHERE  add_rentity = N'QUOL'
    AND    add_code    = @sCquotation + N'#' + @sCseqno + N'#' + cast( @nNline as nvarchar(38) )

    declare @sCheckresult  nvarchar(4)
    declare @sAddtext      nvarchar(4000)		/*r5addetails.add_text%TYPE;*/
    declare @sAddlang      nvarchar(2)			/*r5addetails.add_lang%TYPE;*/
    declare @nAddline      numeric(12)			/*r5addetails.add_line%TYPE;*/
    declare @sAddprint     nvarchar(1)			/*r5addetails.add_print%TYPE;*/
    declare @dAddcreated   datetime			/*r5addetails.add_created%TYPE;*/
    declare @sAdduser      nvarchar(255)		/*r5addetails.add_user%TYPE;*/
    declare @dAddupdated   datetime			/*r5addetails.add_updated%TYPE;*/
    declare @sAddupduser   nvarchar(255)		/*r5addetails.add_upduser%TYPE;*/
BEGIN
	/* Initialize	*/
    set @sChk         = N'0'
    set @sCheckresult = N'0'
	/* Check that all mandatory parameters are supplied	*/
    IF @sCquotation IS NULL
    OR @sCseqno     IS NULL
    OR @nNact       IS NULL
    OR @sCevent     IS NULL
    OR @sCtaskcode  IS NULL
    OR @sCdesc      IS NULL 
	begin
        set @sChk = N'1'
        return
    end
    IF @sCupdate = N'N'
	begin
   /* Q0841 : Create new task */
        SELECT @sOrg = quo_org
        FROM   r5quotations
        WHERE  quo_code  = @sCquotation
        AND    quo_seqno = @sCseqno
        
		execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sUstat OUTPUT, N'A', N'RCST', @sChk OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
        
		INSERT INTO r5tasks( tsk_code, tsk_org, tsk_desc, tsk_revision,
                             tsk_revrstatus, tsk_revstatus )
        VALUES( @sCtaskcode, @sOrg, @sCdesc, 0, N'A', @sUstat )
   		/* Q0842 : copy tasklines into r5addetails */
     
		execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sCentity OUTPUT, N'TASK', N'ENT', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		   return -1
        IF @sCheckresult IN (N'4', N'5' )
		begin
            set @sChk = N'2'
            return
      	end
        OPEN cText
        FETCH NEXT FROM cText INTO    @sAddtext,
				                      @sAddlang,
				                      @nAddline,
				                      @sAddprint,
				                      @dAddcreated,
				                      @sAdduser,
				                      @dAddupdated,
				                      @sAddupduser
        WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
            INSERT INTO r5addetails
            (
                add_entity,
                add_rentity,
                add_type,
                add_rtype,
                add_code,
                add_lang,
                add_line,
                add_print,
                add_text,
                add_created,
                add_user,
                add_updated,
                add_upduser
            )
            VALUES
            (
                @sCentity,
                N'TASK',
                N'*',
                N'*',
                @sCtaskcode+N'#0',
                @sAddlang,
                @nAddline,
                @sAddprint,
                @sAddtext,
                @dAddcreated,
                @sAdduser,
                @dAddupdated,
                @sAddupduser
              )
			FETCH NEXT FROM cText INTO    @sAddtext,
					                      @sAddlang,
					                      @nAddline,
					                      @sAddprint,
					                      @dAddcreated,
					                      @sAdduser,
					                      @dAddupdated,
					                      @sAddupduser
        END   
        CLOSE cText
	DEALLOCATE cText
     
	end
    ELSE
/* Q0843 : Update task of activity */
    BEGIN
         UPDATE r5activities
         SET    act_task    = @sCtaskcode,
                act_taskrev = 0
         WHERE  act_act     = @nNact
         AND    act_event   = @sCevent
         
		IF @@ROWCOUNT  =  0
		begin
            set @sChk = N'5'
            return
        end
    END
END

create procedure O7CVMAIN_ALTEREXTSTRUCTURE @nPid           numeric(38),
                                            @sSrctable      nvarchar(30)
as
    SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @sAltersql_template     nvarchar(1000)
    declare @sAltersql              nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sCreatesql_template    nvarchar(1000)
    declare @sCreatesql             nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sTriggersql_template   nvarchar(1000)
    declare @sTriggersql            nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sSrcexttable           nvarchar(64)
    declare @sExistssql             nvarchar(1000)
    declare @nCount                 int
    declare @nReturn                int

    declare @sNewextfield           nvarchar(30)
    declare @sSyntax                nvarchar(128)
    declare @sPrefix                nvarchar(3)
    declare @sDatatablespace        nvarchar(64)
    declare @sIndextablespace       nvarchar(64)

    set @sAltersql_template = N'alter table :srcexttable add (:fieldname :fieldsyntax)'
    set @sCreatesql_template = N'create table :srcexttable (:prefix_uprecnum integer, :prefix_upcode integer, :fieldname :fieldsyntax, constraint r5fok1_:prefix' + N'_EXT' + ' foreign key (:prefix_uprecnum) references :srctable (:prefix_uprecnum) on delete cascade, constraint r5prik_:prefix' + N'_EXT' + ' primary key (:prefix_uprecnum)'
    set @sTriggersql_template = N'create trigger posins_:prefix on :srctable for insert as insert into :srcexttable (:prefix_uprecnum, :prefix_upcode) select :prefix_uprecnum, :prefix_upcode from inserted go'
    set @sSrcexttable = dbo.o7cvmain_getexttablename( @sSrctable )

    declare c_c1 cursor local for SELECT ded_newextfield,
                                         (CASE WHEN a.data_type = N'NVARCHAR' THEN a.data_type + N'(' + cast(data_length as nvarchar(38)) + N')' WHEN a.data_type = N'NUMERIC' AND a.data_precision IS NOT NULL THEN a.data_type + N'(' + cast(a.data_precision as nvarchar(38)) + N',' + cast(coalesce(a.data_scale,0) as nvarchar(38)) + N')' ELSE a.data_type END),
                                         dct_desttableprefix,
                                         b.tablespace_name,
                                         d.tablespace_name
                                    FROM user_tab_columns a, user_tables b, user_constraints c, user_indexes d, r5dataconvextdef, r5dataconvlist
                                   WHERE dct_srcproductid = @nPid
                                     AND dct_desttable = @sSrctable
                                     AND ded_srcproductid = dct_srcproductid
                                     AND ded_srctable = dct_desttable
                                     AND ded_srcfields = N'-'
                                     AND a.table_name = ded_reftable
                                     AND a.column_name = ded_reffields
                                     AND b.table_name = a.table_name
                                     AND c.constraint_type = N'P'
                                     AND c.table_name = b.table_name
                                     AND d.table_name = c.table_name
                                     AND d.index_name = c.constraint_name
                                     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                            FROM user_tab_columns
                                           WHERE table_name = dbo.o7cvmain_getexttablename(@sSrctable)
                                             AND column_name = ded_newextfield)
                                  UNION
                                  SELECT a.ded_newextfield, b.syntax, dct_desttableprefix,
                                         c.tablespace_name, e.tablespace_name
                                    FROM r5dataconvextdef a, (SELECT ded_srcproductid, ded_srctable, ded_reffields, (CASE WHEN data_type = 'NVARCHAR' THEN data_type + N'(' + cast(data_length as nvarchar(38)) + N')' WHEN data_type = 'NUMERIC' AND data_precision IS NOT NULL THEN data_type + N'(' + cast(data_precision as nvarchar(38)) + N',' + cast(coalesce(data_scale, 0) as nvarchar(38)) + N')' ELSE data_type END)
                                                                FROM user_tab_columns, r5dataconvextdef
                                                               WHERE ded_srcfields = N'-'
                                                                 AND table_name = ded_reftable
                                                                 AND column_name = ded_reffields) b, r5dataconvlist, user_tables c, user_constraints d, user_indexes e
                                   WHERE dct_srcproductid = @nPid
                                     AND dct_desttable = @sSrctable
                                     AND a.ded_srcproductid = dct_srcproductid
                                     AND a.ded_srctable = dct_desttable
                                     AND a.ded_srcfields <> N'-'
                                     AND a.ded_srcproductid = b.ded_srcproductid
                                     AND a.ded_reftable = b.ded_srctable
                                     AND a.ded_refextfield = b.ded_reffields
                                     AND c.table_name = dct_desttable
                                     AND d.constraint_type = N'P'
                                     AND d.table_name = c.table_name
                                     AND e.table_name = d.table_name
                                     AND e.index_name = d.constraint_name
                                     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                            FROM user_tab_columns
                                           WHERE table_name = dbo.o7cvmain_getexttablename(@sSrctable)
                                             AND column_name = ded_newextfield)
                                   ORDER BY 1
    open c_c1
    fetch next from c_c1 into @sNewextfield, @sSyntax, @sPrefix, @sDatatablespace, @sIndextablespace
    while @@fetch_status = 0
        begin
            set @sExistssql = N'select @count = count(*) from SYSOBJECTS where NAME = ''' + @sSrcexttable + N''' and TYPE = ''U'''
            execute @nReturn = sp_executesql @sExistssql, N'@count int OUTPUT', @nCount OUTPUT
            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                begin
                    close c_c1
                    deallocate c_c1
                    return -1
                end

            if @nCount = 0
                begin
                    set @sCreatesql = REPLACE(@sCreatesql_template,    N':srcexttable',        @sSrcexttable)
                    set @sCreatesql = REPLACE(@sCreatesql,             N':prefix',             @sPrefix)
                    set @sCreatesql = REPLACE(@sCreatesql,             N':fieldname',          @sNewextfield)
                    set @sCreatesql = REPLACE(@sCreatesql,             N':fieldsyntax',        @sSyntax)
                    set @sCreatesql = REPLACE(@sCreatesql,             N':srctable',           @sSrctable)
                    set @sCreatesql = REPLACE(@sCreatesql,             N':indextablespace',    @sIndextablespace)
                    set @sCreatesql = REPLACE(@sCreatesql,             N':datatablespace',     @sDatatablespace)
                    exec (@sCreatesql)
                    if @@ERROR <> 0
                        begin
                            close c_c1
                            deallocate c_c1
                            return -1
                        end

                    set @sTriggersql = REPLACE(@sTriggersql_template, ':srcexttable', @sSrcexttable)
                    set @sTriggersql = REPLACE(@sTriggersql, ':prefix', @sPrefix)
                    set @sTriggersql = REPLACE(@sTriggersql, ':srctable', @sSrctable)
                    exec (@sTriggersql)
                    if @@ERROR <> 0
                        begin
                            close c_c1

create procedure O7CVMAIN_ANALYZEDATA @nUploadid    numeric(38),
                                      @sUserid      nvarchar(30),
                                      @sChklength   nvarchar(128),
                                      @sChkspecial  nvarchar(128),
                                      @sChkpk       nvarchar(128),
                                      @sChkresult   nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
as
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sStatement             nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sExttableclause        nvarchar(40)
    declare @sExtwhere              nvarchar(1000)
    declare @sSrcexttable           nvarchar(30)
    declare @nLogid                 numeric(38)
    declare @sOldstatus             nvarchar(4)
    declare @sMespk                 nvarchar(255)
    declare @sMeslength             nvarchar(255)
    declare @sMesspecial            nvarchar(255)
    declare @sMesemail              nvarchar(255)
    declare @nReturn                int
    declare @sSpecchars             nvarchar(20)
    declare @sTranschars            nvarchar(20)

    declare @nDtcSrcproductid       numeric(38)
    declare @sDtcCvrstatus          nvarchar(4)

    declare @nDsqSeqid              numeric(38)
    declare @sDsqDesttable          nvarchar(30)
    declare @sDsqSourcetable        nvarchar(30)
    declare @sDsqDesttableprefix    nvarchar(3)
    declare @sDsqIgnorepk           nvarchar(1)
    declare @sDsqSourcecondition    nvarchar(1000)
    declare @sDsqUpdatecvtotals     nvarchar(1)

    declare @sDxpDestfield          nvarchar(30)
    declare @sDxpExpression         nvarchar(500)
    declare @sDxpChkspecchar        nvarchar(1)
    declare @nDxpChar_length        int

    declare @sDxp2Column_name       nvarchar(30)
    declare @nDxp2Position          int
    declare @sDxp2Destfield         nvarchar(30)
    declare @sDxp2Expression        nvarchar(500)
    declare @sDxp2Active            nvarchar(1)


    declare @sUtaOutput             nvarchar(64)

    declare @sErrorMessage          nvarchar(2000)

    declare @sParamlistXML          nvarchar(max)
    declare @sStmtparmXML           nvarchar(max)
    declare @sCuststmt              nvarchar(max)
    declare @bStopped               bit  -- 1=true, 0=false
    declare @bSkiptable             bit  -- 1=true, 0=false

    --constants
    declare @sCUSTSTMTTYPE_BEFORESTMT    nvarchar(2)
    declare @sCUSTSTMTTYPE_AFTERSTMT     nvarchar(2)
    declare @sOPERATIONTYPE_PREANALYSIS  nvarchar(1)

    set @sCUSTSTMTTYPE_BEFORESTMT   = N'BS'
    set @sCUSTSTMTTYPE_AFTERSTMT    = N'AS'
    set @sOPERATIONTYPE_PREANALYSIS = N'P'
    set @bStopped           = 0
    set @bSkiptable         = 0

    SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON

    begin try
        --create the paramlist temp table

        set @sChkresult = N'0'

        --since we are in a try..catch, standard error handling doesn't apply
        execute o7intgem @sMespk OUTPUT, N'O7CVMAIN', N'PROC', 11
        set @sMespk = replace( @sMespk,'''','''''')

        execute o7intgem @sMeslength OUTPUT, N'O7CVMAIN', N'PROC', 12
        set @sMeslength = replace( @sMeslength,'''','''''')

        execute o7intgem @sMesspecial OUTPUT, N'O7CVMAIN', N'PROC', 13
        set @sMesspecial = replace( @sMesspecial,'''','''''')

        execute o7intgem @sMesemail OUTPUT, N'O7CVMAIN', N'PROC', 4
        set @sMesemail = replace( @sMesemail,'''','''''')

        if dbo.o7cvmain_anyinprogress() = 1
            begin
                set @sChkresult = N'1'
                if @@TRANCOUNT > 0
                    commit transaction
                return
            end

        create table #to7cvmain_analyzedata_parms ( col_index   nvarchar(30)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN  not null,
                                                    col_value   nvarchar(4000)  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN      null )

        create table #to7cvmain_analyzedata_custexpr ( col_index   nvarchar(30)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN  not null,
                                                       col_value   nvarchar(4000)  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN      null )

        create table #to7cvmain_analyzedata_stmtparm ( col_index   nvarchar(30)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN  not null,
                                                       col_value   nvarchar(4000)  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN      null )


        --commit the temp table creation
        if @@TRANCOUNT > 0
            commit transaction

        declare c_dtc cursor local for SELECT dtc_srcproductid, dtc_cvrstatus
                                         FROM r5dataconversion
                                        WHERE dtc_upcode = @nUploadid

create procedure O7CVMAIN_ASSERTSPECCHAR @sSqlstmt      nvarchar(4000),
                                         @nUprecnum     numeric(38),
                                         @nLogid        numeric(38),
                                         @sSpeccharlist nvarchar(20),
                                         @nViolations   numeric(38)   OUTPUT
as
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sSpcchrerr     nvarchar(255)
    declare @sEmailerr      nvarchar(255)
    declare @sLowercaseerr  nvarchar(255)
    declare @sSQL           nvarchar(max)
    declare @sXML           nvarchar(max)
    declare @nHandle        int
    declare @nJ             int
    declare @sSpecchar      nvarchar(1)
    declare @sError         nvarchar(2000)

    declare @sColumnValue   nvarchar(max)
    declare @sColumnName    nvarchar(128)

    set @nViolations = 0

    set @sSQL = N'set @sDoc = (' + @sSqlstmt + N' FOR XML AUTO)'
    execute sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@sDoc nvarchar(max) OUTPUT, @uprecnum numeric(38)', @sXML OUTPUT, @nUprecnum
    set @sXML = N'<DATA>' + @sXML + N'</DATA>'

    execute sp_xml_preparedocument @nHandle OUTPUT, @sXML
    select * into #tXMLResults from openxml(@nHandle, '/DATA/') order by id


    declare c_violations cursor local for select c.text, p.localname
                                            from #tXMLResults c, #tXMLResults p
                                           where c.localname = N'#text'
                                             and c.parentid  = p.id
    open c_violations
    fetch next from c_violations into @sColumnValue, @sColumnName
    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        begin
            if charindex( N'EMAIL', @sColumnName ) > 0
                begin
                    if dbo.o7cvmain_validemail(@sColumnValue) = N'-'
                        begin
                            if @sEmailerr is null
                                execute o7intgem @sEmailerr OUTPUT, N'O7CVMAIN', N'PROC', 4
                            set @sError = @sEmailerr
                            execute o7cvmain_logrecordstatus @nLogid, @nUprecnum, N'O', @sError
                            set @nViolations = @nViolations + 1
                        end
                end
            else
                begin
                    set @nJ = 1
                    while @nJ <= len( @sSpeccharlist )
                        begin
                            set @sSpecchar = substring( @sSpeccharlist, @nJ, 1 )
                            if charindex( @sSpecchar, @sColumnValue ) > 0
                                begin
                                    if @sSpcchrerr is null
                                        execute o7intgem @sSpcchrerr OUTPUT, N'O7CVMAIN', N'PROC', 13
                                    set @sError = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@sSpcchrerr, N':PARAM1', @sColumnValue), N':PARAM2', @sColumnName), N':PARAM3', @sSpecchar)
                                    execute o7cvmain_logrecordstatus @nLogid, @nUprecnum, N'SP', @sError
                                    set @nViolations = @nViolations + 1
                                end
                            set @nJ = @nJ + 1
                        end
                end

            fetch next from c_violations into @sColumnValue, @sColumnName
        end
    close c_violations
    deallocate c_violations

    execute sp_xml_removedocument @nHandle

                                      @sChk         nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
as

    declare @nI                 numeric(38)

    declare @bRecordkeyvals     bit  -- 1=true, 0=false
    declare @sErrormsg          nvarchar(2000)
    declare @sConvuser          nvarchar(255)
    declare @nTotalreccount     numeric(38)
    declare @nSuccessfulrecs    numeric(38)

    declare @sTranschars        nvarchar(20)

    declare @sErrorMessage      nvarchar(2000)

    declare @nSQLErrorSeverity   int
    declare @nSQLErrorState      int
    declare @nSQLErrorLine       int

    declare @sTmSrcexttable     nvarchar(64)

    declare @sTmExtexists       nvarchar(1)

    declare @sSQL               nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sCuststmt          nvarchar(4000)

    declare @sInsExpr           nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sDelExpr           nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sUpdExpr           nvarchar(4000)

    --constants
    declare @sCUSTSTMTTYPE_BEFORESTMT   nvarchar(2)
    declare @sCUSTSTMTTYPE_BEFOREROW    nvarchar(2)
    declare @sCUSTSTMTTYPE_AFTERROW     nvarchar(2)
    declare @sCUSTSTMTTYPE_AFTERSTMT    nvarchar(2)
    declare @sOPERATIONTYPE_CONVERSION  nvarchar(1)

    declare @sProcessstatus     nvarchar(4)
    declare @nSrcreccount       numeric(38)
    declare @nMoredestinations  numeric(38)

    declare @sTempKeyName       nvarchar(30)
    declare @sSqlexprXML        nvarchar(max)
    declare @sParamlistXML      nvarchar(max)
    declare @sRowparmXML        nvarchar(max)
    declare @sStmtparmXML       nvarchar(max)

    declare @bTemp              bit
    declare @sTempSQL1          nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sTempSQL2          nvarchar(4000)
    declare @nAssertTemp        numeric(38)
    declare @dGetdate           datetime

    set @sCUSTSTMTTYPE_BEFORESTMT   = N'BS'
    set @sCUSTSTMTTYPE_BEFOREROW    = N'BR'
    set @sCUSTSTMTTYPE_AFTERROW     = N'AR'
    set @sCUSTSTMTTYPE_AFTERSTMT    = N'AS'
    set @sOPERATIONTYPE_CONVERSION  = N'C'

    set @nI                 = 0
    set @bStopped           = 0
    set @bSkiprow           = 0
    set @bSkiptable         = 0
    set @bValueinsertion    = 0
    set @bNewrowcreated     = 0
    set @bRecordkeyvals     = 0
    set @nTotalreccount     = 0
    set @nSuccessfulrecs    = 0

    set @sChk = N'0'

    create table #to7cvmain_convertdata_sqlexpr ( col_index   nvarchar(30)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN  not null,
                                                  col_value   nvarchar(4000)  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN      null )

    create table #to7cvmain_convertdata_paramlist ( col_index   nvarchar(30)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN  not null,
                                                    col_value   nvarchar(4000)  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN      null )

    create table #to7cvmain_convertdata_custexpr ( col_index   nvarchar(30)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN  not null,
                                                   col_value   nvarchar(4000)  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN      null )

    create table #to7cvmain_convertdata_rowparm ( col_index   nvarchar(30)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN  not null,
                                                  col_value   nvarchar(4000)  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN      null )

    create table #to7cvmain_convertdata_stmtparm ( col_index   nvarchar(30)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN  not null,
                                                   col_value   nvarchar(4000)  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN      null )

    create table #to7cvmain_srcrecordids ( src_record_id    numeric(38) not null )

    begin try
        if dbo.o7cvmain_anyinprogress() = 1
            begin
                set @sChk = N'1'
                return
            end

        set @nProductid = dbo.o7cvmain_getproductid( @nUploadid )
        if @nProductid is null
            begin
                set @sChk = N'2'
                return
            end

        if dbo.o7cvmain_optionsreviewed(@nUploadid) = 0
            begin
                set @sChk = N'3'
                return
            end
        set @sMap2Udf = dbo.o7cvmain_map2udf(@nUploadid)

        SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON

        UPDATE r5dataconvsumdetails
           SET dsl_include = '-'
         WHERE dsl_upcode = @nUploadid
           AND dsl_rtype = @sOPERATIONTYPE_CONVERSION
           AND dsl_include = '+'
           AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM r5dataconvsummary
                        WHERE dsu_upcode = dsl_upcode
                          AND dsu_sourcetable = dsl_sourcetable

                                  AND dxp_seqid = dsq_seqid
                                  AND dxp_upcode = dsl_upcode
                                  AND dxp_active = '+'
                                  AND dxp_expression IS NOT NULL))

        UPDATE r5dataconversion
        SET dtc_cvrstatus = N'I', dtc_cvinprogress = N'+', dtc_cvstarted = GetDate(), dtc_cvcompleted = NULL, dtc_cvstopped = NULL, dtc_cvscheduled = N'-', dtc_cvscheduledtime = NULL
        WHERE dtc_upcode = @nUploadid

        commit transaction

        execute o7cvmain_setspecialchars @nUploadid, @sSpecchars OUTPUT, @sTranschars OUTPUT

        select @sConvuser = dtc_cvuser from r5dataconversion where dtc_upcode = @nUploadid

        insert into #to7cvmain_convertdata_paramlist values ( N'uploadid', cast( @nUploadid as nvarchar(38)) )
        insert into #to7cvmain_convertdata_paramlist values ( N'productid', cast( @nProductid as nvarchar(38)) )
        insert into #to7cvmain_convertdata_paramlist values ( N'user', @sConvuser )
        insert into #to7cvmain_convertdata_paramlist values ( N'processtype', @sOPERATIONTYPE_CONVERSION )
        insert into #to7cvmain_convertdata_paramlist values ( N'specchars', @sSpecchars )
        insert into #to7cvmain_convertdata_paramlist values ( N'transchars', @sTranschars )
        insert into #to7cvmain_convertdata_paramlist values ( N'map2udf', @sMap2Udf )

        insert into #to7cvmain_convertdata_stmtparm values ( N'uploadid', cast( @nUploadid as nvarchar(38)) )
        insert into #to7cvmain_convertdata_stmtparm values ( N'productid', cast( @nProductid as nvarchar(38)) )
        insert into #to7cvmain_convertdata_stmtparm values ( N'user', @sConvuser )
        insert into #to7cvmain_convertdata_stmtparm values ( N'specchars', @sSpecchars )

create procedure O7CVMAIN_DELETEROW @sDesttable         nvarchar(30),
                                    @sSrctable          nvarchar(30),
                                    @sSrcexttable       nvarchar(30),
                                    @sSrcprefix         nvarchar(3),
                                    @sKeyfieldlist      nvarchar(4000),
                                    @sIgnorepk          nvarchar(1),
                                    @sRolbackcondition  nvarchar(4000),
                                    @nUprecnum          numeric(38),
                                    @nPid               numeric(38)
as
    SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @sRollbacksql_template  nvarchar(150)
    declare @sRollbacksql           nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sUpdatesql_template1   nvarchar(200)
    declare @sUpdatesql_template2   nvarchar(100)
    declare @sUpdatesql             nvarchar(4000)

    declare @sSQLErrorMessage       nvarchar(4000)
    declare @nSQLErrorNumber        int
    declare @nSQLErrorSeverity      int
    declare @nSQLErrorState         int
    declare @nSQLErrorLine          int
    declare @sSQLErrorProcedure     nvarchar(200)

    declare @nI                     int
    declare @sDepextfields          nvarchar(1000)

    declare @nReturn                int

    declare @sCurDepexttable        nvarchar(64)
    declare @sCurDepreffields       nvarchar(300)
    declare @sCurDepprefix          nvarchar(3)
    declare @sCurDepextfield        nvarchar(30)
    declare @sCurSrcextfield        nvarchar(30)

    declare @sRefDepexttable        nvarchar(64)
    declare @sRefDepreffields       nvarchar(300)
    declare @sRefDepprefix          nvarchar(3)
    declare @sRefSetlist            nvarchar(2000)
    declare @sRefJoincondition      nvarchar(2000)

    declare @nIndex                 int

    declare @sCur2Depextfield       nvarchar(300)

    declare @tRefdata table ( ref_index         int,
                              ref_depexttable   nvarchar(64),
                              ref_depreffields  nvarchar(300),
                              ref_depprefix     nvarchar(3),
                              ref_setlist       nvarchar(2000),
                              ref_joincondition nvarchar(2000) )

    set @sRollbacksql_template = N'delete from :desttable where exists (select 1 from :srcexttable where :srcexttable.:srcprefix_uprecnum = @uprecnum and :rollbackcondition)'
    set @sUpdatesql_template1 = N'update :depexttable set :setlist from :srcexttable where :srcprefix_uprecnum = @uprecnum and :srcprefix_upcode = :depprefix_upcode and :joincondition'
    set @sUpdatesql_template2 = N'update :srcexttable set :keyfieldlist where :srcprefix_uprecnum = @uprecnum'

    set @nI = 0

    declare c_c1 cursor local for SELECT dbo.o7cvmain_getexttablename(ded_srctable), dct_desttableprefix, ded_srcfields, ded_newextfield, ded_refextfield srcextfield
                                    FROM r5dataconvextdef, r5dataconvlist, user_tables
                                   WHERE ded_srcproductid = @nPid
                                     AND ded_reftable = @sSrctable
                                     AND dct_srcproductid = ded_srcproductid
                                     AND dct_desttable = ded_srctable
                                     AND dct_desttable = table_name COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN
                                   ORDER BY ded_srctable, ded_srcfields
    open c_c1
    fetch next from c_c1 into @sCurDepexttable, @sCurDepprefix, @sCurDepreffields, @sCurDepextfield, @sCurSrcextfield
    while @@fetch_status = 0
        begin
            select @nIndex = ref_index from @tRefdata where ref_depexttable = @sCurDepexttable and ref_depreffields = @sCurDepreffields
            if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
                begin
                    set @nI = @nI + 1
                    insert into @tRefdata values ( @nI, @sCurDepexttable, @sCurDepreffields, @sCurDepprefix,
                                                   @sCurDepextfield + N' = null',
                                                   N':depexttable.' + @sCurDepextfield + N' = :srcexttable.' + @sCurSrcextfield)
                end
            else
                update @tRefdata
                   set ref_depexttable = @sCurDepexttable,
                       ref_depreffields = @sCurDepreffields,
                       ref_depprefix = @sCurDepprefix,
                       ref_setlist = ref_setlist + N', ' + @sCurDepextfield + N' = null',
                       ref_joincondition = ref_joincondition + N' and :depexttable.' + @sCurDepextfield + N' = :srcexttable.' + @sCurSrcextfield
                 where ref_index = @nIndex

            fetch next from c_c1 into @sCurDepexttable, @sCurDepprefix, @sCurDepreffields, @sCurDepextfield, @sCurSrcextfield
        end
    close c_c1
    deallocate c_c1

    declare c_refdata cursor local for select ref_depexttable, ref_depreffields, ref_depprefix, ref_setlist, ref_joincondition
                                       from @tRefdata
                                       order by ref_index
    open c_refdata
    fetch next from c_refdata into @sRefDepexttable, @sRefDepreffields, @sRefDepprefix, @sRefSetlist, @sRefJoincondition
    while @@fetch_status = 0
        begin
            set @sUpdatesql = replace( @sUpdatesql_template1, N':joincondition',    @sRefJoincondition)
            set @sUpdatesql = replace( @sUpdatesql          , N':srcexttable',      @sSrcexttable)
            set @sUpdatesql = replace( @sUpdatesql          , N':srcprefix',        @sSrcprefix)
            set @sUpdatesql = replace( @sUpdatesql          , N':depexttable',      @sRefDepexttable)
            set @sUpdatesql = replace( @sUpdatesql          , N':depprefix',        @sRefDepprefix)
            set @sUpdatesql = replace( @sUpdatesql          , N':setlist',          @sRefSetlist)

            execute @nReturn = sp_executesql @sUpdatesql, N'@uprecnum numeric(38)', @nUprecnum
            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                begin
                    close c_refdata
                    deallocate c_refdata
                    return -1
                end

            fetch next from c_refdata into @sRefDepexttable, @sRefDepreffields, @sRefDepprefix, @sRefSetlist, @sRefJoincondition
        end
    close c_refdata
    deallocate c_refdata

    begin try
        set @sRollbacksql = replace( @sRollbacksql_template, N':rollbackcondition', @sRolbackcondition )
        set @sRollbacksql = replace( @sRollbacksql,          N':desttable',         @sDesttable )
        set @sRollbacksql = replace( @sRollbacksql,          N':srcexttable',       coalesce( @sSrcexttable, N'') )
        set @sRollbacksql = replace( @sRollbacksql,          N':srcprefix',         @sSrcprefix )
        execute sp_executesql @sRollbacksql, N'@uprecnum numeric(38)', @nUprecnum
    end try
    begin catch
       select @nSQLErrorNumber     = ERROR_NUMBER(),
              @nSQLErrorSeverity   = ERROR_SEVERITY(),
              @nSQLErrorState      = ERROR_STATE(),
              @nSQLErrorLine       = ERROR_LINE(),
              @sSQLErrorProcedure  = coalesce(ERROR_PROCEDURE(), '-')

        if @nSQLErrorNumber = 547
            begin
                if @sIgnorepk = N'-'
                    begin
                        set @sSQLErrorMessage = N'Error %d, Level %d, State %d, Procedure %s, Line %d, ' + 'Message: '+ ERROR_MESSAGE();
                        RAISERROR ( @sSQLErrorMessage, @nSQLErrorSeverity, 1, @nSQLErrorNumber, @nSQLErrorSeverity, @nSQLErrorState, @sSQLErrorProcedure, @nSQLErrorLine )
                    end
            end
    end catch

    set @sDepextfields = null
    declare c_c2 cursor local for SELECT DISTINCT a.ded_newextfield
                                    FROM r5dataconvextdef a
                                   WHERE a.ded_srcproductid = @nPid

returns nvarchar(1)

    return @sReturn
end

create procedure O7CVMAIN_EXTRACTXMLTABLE @sXML nvarchar(max)
as
    SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @nHandle        int
    declare @sRowPattern    nvarchar(256)

    create table #tTemplate ( col_index   nvarchar(30)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN  not null,
                              col_value   nvarchar(4000)  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN      null )

    execute sp_xml_preparedocument @nHandle OUTPUT, @sXML
    begin try
        --The second row from the call below has the table name that we need to extract in it
        select top 2 @sRowPattern = N'/DATA/' + localname from openxml(@nHandle, '/DATA/') order by id
        --This call gets teh data from the XML
        select * from openxml(@nHandle, @sRowPattern) WITH #tTemplate
    end try
    begin catch
        --do nothing, just catch the error so that the cleanup below will run
    end catch

    --Cleanup the handle and temp table
    drop table #tTemplate
    execute sp_xml_removedocument @nHandle

create procedure O7CVMAIN_GETBOTFIELDID @sBotfunction   nvarchar(6),
                                        @sTagname       nvarchar(61),
                                        @sPrefix        nvarchar(3),
                                        @nFieldtextid   numeric(4) OUTPUT
as
begin
    declare @sBotfld nvarchar(128)

    set @nFieldtextid = null
    set @sBotfld = REPLACE(@sTagname, @sPrefix + N'_', N'')

    SELECT @nFieldtextid = bot_number
      FROM r5boilertexts
     WHERE bot_function = @sBotfunction
       AND bot_fld1 = @sBotfld

    if @nFieldtextid is null
        begin
            select @nFieldtextid = max(bot_number)+1
              FROM r5boilertexts
             WHERE bot_function = @sBotfunction
               AND bot_number >= 200

            if @nFieldtextid is null
                set @nFieldtextid = 200

            INSERT INTO r5boilertexts (bot_function, bot_number, bot_length, bot_xpos, bot_ypos, bot_lang, bot_text, bot_dest, bot_fld1, bot_pool)
                SELECT distinct bot_function, @nFieldtextid, 80, 0, 0, bot_lang, @sBotfld, N'F', @sBotfld, 0
                FROM r5boilertexts
                WHERE bot_function = @sBotfunction
                AND bot_number = 1
        end
end

create function O7CVMAIN_GETCUSTOMSTATEMENTS ( @nUploadid   numeric(38),
                                               @nSeqid      numeric(38),
                                               @sOptype     nvarchar(4) )
returns @tReturn table( col_index   nvarchar(30)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN  not null,
                        col_value   nvarchar(4000)  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN      null )
as
begin
    declare @sType  nvarchar(4)
    declare @sStmt  nvarchar(max)

    insert into @tReturn values ( N'BS', null )
    insert into @tReturn values ( N'BR', null )
    insert into @tReturn values ( N'AR', null )
    insert into @tReturn values ( N'AS', null )

    declare c_stmts cursor local for SELECT dcc_stmtrtype, dcc_stmt
                                       FROM r5dataconvcustomstmts
                                      WHERE dcc_upcode = @nUploadid
                                        AND dcc_seqid = @nSeqid
                                        AND dcc_operationrtype = @sOptype
                                        AND dcc_stmt IS NOT NULL
                                        AND dcc_active = N'+'
    open c_stmts
    fetch next from c_stmts into @sType, @sStmt
    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        begin
            if exists ( select 1 from @tReturn where col_index = @sType )
                update @tReturn set col_value = @sStmt where col_index = @sType
            else
                insert into @tReturn values ( @sType, @sStmt )

            fetch next from c_stmts into @sType, @sStmt
        end
    close c_stmts
    deallocate c_stmts

    return
end

create function O7CVMAIN_GETLOGGEDSTATEMENT( @nLogid    numeric(38),
                                             @nUprecnum numeric(38),
                                             @sStmttype nvarchar(4) )
returns nvarchar(4000)
as
begin
    declare @sInsstmt   nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sDelstmt   nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sStmt      nvarchar(4000)
    declare @nPid       numeric(38)

    SELECT @sInsstmt = dlg_insstmt,
           @sDelstmt = dlg_delstmt,
           @nPid = dtc_srcproductid
      FROM r5dataconvlogdetails, r5dataconvlog, r5dataconversion
     WHERE dlg_id = @nLogid
       AND dlg_upcode = dtc_upcode
       AND dlg_id = dld_logid
       AND dld_uprecnum = @nUprecnum


    if @sStmttype = N'I'
        set @sStmt = @sInsstmt
    else if @sStmttype = N'D'
        set @sStmt = replace( @sDelstmt, '@productid', @nPid)

    if @nUprecnum is not null
        set @sStmt = replace( @sStmt, N'@uprecnum', cast( @nUprecnum as nvarchar(38)) )

    return @sStmt
end

    set @nFieldcount = 0

    set @sSelectsql_template2 = N'select :srctable.:srcprefix_uprecnum from :srctable, :srcexttable where :srctable.:srcprefix_uprecnum = :srcexttable.:srcprefix_uprecnum and :srctable.:srcprefix_upcode = @uploadid and coalesce(:srctable.:srcprefix_cvignore, N''-'') <> N''+'' and dbo.o7cvmain_priorerrors(:srctable.:srcprefix_upcode, @seqid, N'':operation'', :srctable.:srcprefix_uprecnum) = 0'
    set @sInsertsql_template  = N'insert into :desttable (:fieldlist) '
    set @sInsselect_template  = N'select :explist from :srctable '
    set @sInswhere_template1  = N'where :srcprefix_uprecnum = @uprecnum'
    set @sInswhere_template2  = N', :srcexttable where :srctable.:srcprefix_uprecnum = :srcexttable.:srcprefix_uprecnum and :srctable.:srcprefix_uprecnum = @uprecnum'

    set @sRollbacksql_template = N'execute o7cvmain_deleterow N'':desttable'', N'':srctable'', N'':srcexttable'', N'':srcprefix'', N'':keyfieldlist'', N'':ignorepk'', N'':rollbackcondition'', @uprecnum, @productid'
    set @sKeyupdatesql_template = N'update :desttable set :setlist from :srctable where :srctable.:srcprefix_uprecnum = :desttable.:srcprefix_uprecnum and :desttable.:srcprefix_uprecnum = @uprecnum'


    create table #to7cvmain_getsqlexpressions_expr ( col_index   nvarchar(30)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN  not null,
                                                     col_value   nvarchar(4000)  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN      null )

    create table #to7cvmain_keys (    DED_REFFIELDS          nvarchar( 300 )    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN    NULL,
                                      DED_NEWEXTFIELD        nvarchar( 30 )     COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN    NULL )
    insert into #to7cvmain_keys SELECT ded_reffields, ded_newextfield
                                FROM r5dataconvextdef
                               WHERE ded_srcproductid = @nPid
                                 AND ded_srctable = @sSrctable
                                 AND ded_srcfields = N'-'
                                 AND ded_reftable = @sDesttable

    declare c_mapping cursor local for SELECT dxp_destfield, dxp_expression, dxp_chkspecchar
                                        FROM r5dataconvexpressions

                end
            else
                begin
                    set @sExplist = @sExplist + N'dbo.o7cv_chrtran(' + @sMapExpression + N',N'':specchars'',N'':transchars'')'

create function O7CVMAIN_GETSUBEXP( @nUploadid      numeric(38),
                                    @nSeqid         numeric(38),
                                    @sDestfield     nvarchar(30) )
returns nvarchar(500)
as
begin
    declare @sExpression    nvarchar(500)
    declare @sPrefix        nvarchar(10)
    declare @sSrcfield      nvarchar(30)
    declare @nStart         numeric(5)
    declare @nLength        numeric(5)
    declare @sSuffix        nvarchar(10)

    if @sDestfield = N'OBJ_CODE'
      return N'dbo.o7cvmp2_getlocation2(:uploadid,zcf_location,zcf_sublocation1,zcf_sublocation2,zcf_sublocation3,zcf_siteid,org_code)'

    declare c_c1 cursor local for SELECT dsx_prefix, dsx_srcfield, dsx_start, dsx_length, dsx_suffix
                                    FROM r5dataconvsubexps
                                   WHERE dsx_upcode = @nUploadid
                                     AND dsx_seqid = @nSeqid
                                     AND dsx_destfield = @sDestfield
                                     AND dsx_srcfield IS NOT NULL
                                   ORDER BY dsx_order
    open c_c1
    fetch next from c_c1 into @sPrefix, @sSrcfield, @nStart, @nLength, @sSuffix
    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        begin
            if @sExpression is not null
                set @sExpression = @sExpression + N' + '
            else
                set @sExpression = N''

            if @sPrefix is not null
                set @sExpression = @sExpression + N'''' + @sPrefix + N'''+'

            set @sExpression = @sExpression + replace( replace( replace( N'isnull(substring(:srcfield,:start,:length),N'''')', N':srcfield', @sSrcfield), N':start', cast( @nStart as nvarchar(38))), N':length', cast( @nLength as nvarchar(38)))

            if @sSuffix is not null
                set @sExpression = @sExpression + N'+''' + @sSuffix + N''''

            fetch next from c_c1 into @sPrefix, @sSrcfield, @nStart, @nLength, @sSuffix
        end
    close c_c1
    deallocate c_c1

    return @sExpression
end

create procedure O7CVMAIN_LOGRECORDSTATUS @nLogid           numeric(38),
                                          @nUprecnum        numeric(38),
                                          @sProcessstatus   nvarchar(4),
                                          @sErrormsg        nvarchar(2000)
as
    SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @bNewlog bit

    if @nUprecnum <> -1
        set @bNewlog = 1
    else
        set @bNewlog = 0

    if @bNewlog = 0
        begin
            UPDATE r5dataconvlogdetails
               SET dld_rstatus = @sProcessstatus, dld_errormessage = @sErrormsg
             WHERE dld_logid = @nLogid
               AND dld_uprecnum = @nUprecnum

            if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
                set @bNewlog = 1
            else
                set @bNewlog = 0
        end

    if @bNewlog = 1
        INSERT INTO r5dataconvlogdetails
            (dld_logid, dld_uprecnum, dld_rstatus, dld_errormessage)
        VALUES
            (@nLogid, @nUprecnum, @sProcessstatus, @sErrormsg)

    else
