create procedure O7CVMAIN_PARSEERROR @sReturn       nvarchar(2000) OUTPUT,
                                     @nErrorcode    numeric(38),
                                     @sErrormsg     nvarchar(4000)
as
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @nI             bigint
    declare @tErrinfo       table( split_id        numeric(38)                                 NOT NULL,
                                   split_value     nvarchar(max)   COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN      NULL )
    declare @sErrtext       nvarchar(255)
    declare @sErrSource     nvarchar(32)
    declare @sErrtype       nvarchar(4)
    declare @nErrnnumber    numeric(4)
    declare @sErrInfo       nvarchar(255)

    declare @nReturn        int

    --Assume that if this is called then we need to parse it (we don't have error numbers -20001, etc)

    set @nI = charindex( N'~ S=', @sErrormsg)
    if @nI = 0
        set @nI = charindex( N'- S=', @sErrormsg)

    if @nI > 0
        begin
            set @nI = @nI + 2
            set @sErrInfo = substring( @sErrormsg, @nI, charindex ( N' C=', @sErrormsg) - @nI)
            insert into @tErrinfo select * from dbo.o7cvmain_split( @sErrInfo, N' ' )
            if @@ROWCOUNT = 3
                begin
                    select @sErrSource = REPLACE(split_value, N'S=', N'') from @tErrinfo where split_id = 1
                    select @sErrtype = REPLACE(split_value, N'T=', N'') from @tErrinfo where split_id = 2
                    select @nErrnnumber = cast( REPLACE(split_value, N'N=', N'') as numeric(4)) from @tErrinfo where split_id = 3
                    execute @nReturn = o7intgem @sErrtext OUTPUT, @sErrSource, @sErrtype, @nErrnnumber
                end
        end

    if @sErrtext is null or @sErrtext = N''
        set @sReturn = substring( @sErrormsg, 1, 2000)
    else
        set @sReturn = @sErrtext

create function O7CVMAIN_PRIORERRORS( @nUploadid    numeric(38),
                                      @nSeqid       numeric(38),
                                      @sOperation   nvarchar(4),
                                      @nUprecnum    numeric(38) )
returns int
as
begin
    declare @nReturn int

    set @nReturn = 0
    if exists ( SELECT 1
                  FROM r5dataconvseq a
                   WHERE a.dsq_seqid = @nSeqid
                     AND EXISTS (select 1
                                   FROM r5dataconvseq b, r5dataconvlogdetails, r5dataconvlog
                                  WHERE dlg_upcode = @nUploadid
                                    AND dlg_rtype = @sOperation
                                    AND dlg_seqid = b.dsq_seqid
                                    AND dlg_id = dld_logid
                                    AND dld_uprecnum = @nUprecnum
                                    AND b.dsq_srcproductid = a.dsq_srcproductid
                                    AND b.dsq_sourcetable = a.dsq_sourcetable
                                    AND ((b.dsq_convseq = a.dsq_convseq AND b.dsq_seqid < a.dsq_seqid) OR b.dsq_convseq < b.dsq_convseq)
                                    AND dld_rstatus <> N'S') )
        set @nReturn = 1

    return @nReturn
end

        begin
            execute @nReturn = o7cvmain_rollbackconversion @nUpcode
            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                begin
                    close c_conversions
                    deallocate c_conversions
                    return -1
                end

            fetch next from c_conversions into @nUpcode
        end
    close c_conversions
    deallocate c_conversions

create procedure O7CVMAIN_ROLLBACKCONVERSION @nUploadid numeric(38)
as
    SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @nProductid                 numeric(38)
    declare @bSkiptable                 bit  --1=true, 0=false
    declare @nReccount                  numeric(38)

    declare @nSeqid                     numeric(38)
    declare @nLogid                     numeric(38)
    declare @sSrctable                  nvarchar(30)
    declare @sDesttable                 nvarchar(30)
    declare @sRollbacksql               nvarchar(4000)

    declare @sCuststmt                  nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sSQL                       nvarchar(4000)
    declare @nUprecnum                  numeric(38)

    declare @sChk                       nvarchar(4)

    declare @sXML                       nvarchar(max)

    declare @sCUSTSTMTTYPE_BEFORESTMT   nvarchar(2)
    declare @sCUSTSTMTTYPE_BEFOREROW    nvarchar(2)
    declare @sCUSTSTMTTYPE_AFTERROW     nvarchar(2)
    declare @sCUSTSTMTTYPE_AFTERSTMT    nvarchar(2)

    set @sCUSTSTMTTYPE_BEFORESTMT   = N'BS'
    set @sCUSTSTMTTYPE_BEFOREROW    = N'BR'
    set @sCUSTSTMTTYPE_AFTERROW     = N'AR'
    set @sCUSTSTMTTYPE_AFTERSTMT    = N'AS'

    set @bSkiptable = 0

    set @sChk = N'999'

    begin try
        SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON

        create table #to7cvmain_rollbackconversion_expr ( col_index   nvarchar(30)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN  not null,
                                                          col_value   nvarchar(4000)  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN      null )

        create table #to7cvmain_rollbackconversion_rowparms ( col_index   nvarchar(30)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN  not null,
                                                              col_value   nvarchar(4000)  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN      null )

        create table #to7cvmain_rollbackconversion_stmtparms ( col_index   nvarchar(30)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN  not null,
                                                               col_value   nvarchar(4000)  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN      null )

        --commit temp table creation
        commit transaction

        if dbo.o7cvmain_anyinprogress() = 1
            begin
                set @sChk = N'1'
                RAISERROR( 'db_error', 16, 1)
            end

        set @nProductid = dbo.o7cvmain_getproductid( @nUploadid )
        if @nProductid is null
            begin
                set @sChk = N'2'
                RAISERROR( 'db_error', 16, 1)
            end

        insert into #to7cvmain_rollbackconversion_stmtparms values ( N'uploadid', cast( @nUploadid as nvarchar(38)) )
        insert into #to7cvmain_rollbackconversion_stmtparms values ( N'productid', cast( @nProductid as nvarchar(38)) )
        insert into #to7cvmain_rollbackconversion_rowparms values ( N'uploadid', cast( @nUploadid as nvarchar(38)) )
        insert into #to7cvmain_rollbackconversion_rowparms values ( N'productid', cast( @nProductid as nvarchar(38)) )

        --default these for now
        insert into #to7cvmain_rollbackconversion_stmtparms values ( N'logid', '0' )
        insert into #to7cvmain_rollbackconversion_stmtparms values ( N'seqid', '0' )
        insert into #to7cvmain_rollbackconversion_rowparms values ( N'logid', '0' )
        insert into #to7cvmain_rollbackconversion_rowparms values ( N'seqid', '0' )
        insert into #to7cvmain_rollbackconversion_rowparms values ( N'uprecnum', '0' )

        declare c_tablemappings cursor local for SELECT dsq_seqid, dlg_id, dsq_sourcetable, dsq_desttable, dlg_delstmt
                                                   FROM r5dataconvlog, r5dataconvseq
                                                  WHERE dlg_upcode = @nUploadid
                                                    AND dlg_seqid = dsq_seqid
                                                    AND dlg_rtype = N'C'
                                                  ORDER BY dsq_convseq DESC, dsq_seqid DESC
        open c_tablemappings
        fetch next from c_tablemappings into @nSeqid, @nLogid, @sSrctable, @sDesttable, @sRollbacksql
        while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            begin
                set @nReccount = 0
                set @bSkiptable = 0

                update #to7cvmain_rollbackconversion_stmtparms set col_value = cast( @nLogid as nvarchar(38)) where col_index = N'logid'
                update #to7cvmain_rollbackconversion_stmtparms set col_value = cast( @nSeqid as nvarchar(38)) where col_index = N'seqid'
                update #to7cvmain_rollbackconversion_rowparms set col_value = cast( @nLogid as nvarchar(38)) where col_index = N'logid'
                update #to7cvmain_rollbackconversion_rowparms set col_value = cast( @nSeqid as nvarchar(38)) where col_index = N'seqid'

                truncate table #to7cvmain_rollbackconversion_expr

                if exists ( select 1 FROM r5dataconvlogdetails WHERE dld_logid = @nLogid )
                    begin
                        insert into #to7cvmain_rollbackconversion_expr select * from dbo.o7cvmain_getcustomstatements( @nUploadid, @nSeqid, N'R' )
                        commit transaction  --for temp table

                        --generate XML for passed table
                        set @sXML = (select * from #to7cvmain_rollbackconversion_stmtparms FOR XML AUTO)
                        set @sXML = N'<DATA>' + @sXML + N'</DATA>'

                        if exists ( select 1 from #to7cvmain_rollbackconversion_expr where col_index = @sCUSTSTMTTYPE_BEFORESTMT and col_value is not null )
                            begin
                                begin try
                                    select @sCuststmt = col_value from #to7cvmain_rollbackconversion_expr where col_index = @sCUSTSTMTTYPE_BEFORESTMT
                                    execute o7cvmain_executecustomstmt @sCuststmt, @sXML, @sCUSTSTMTTYPE_BEFORESTMT

                                    if @@TRANCOUNT > 0
                                        commit transaction
                                end try
                                begin catch
                                    if @@TRANCOUNT > 0
                                        rollback transaction
                                    set @bSkiptable = 1
                                end catch
                            end

                        if @bSkiptable = 0
                            begin
                                declare c_recids cursor local for SELECT distinct dld_uprecnum
                                                                    FROM r5dataconvlogdetails
                                                                   WHERE dld_logid = @nLogid
                                open c_recids
                                fetch next from c_recids into @nUprecnum
                                while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                                    begin
                                        update #to7cvmain_rollbackconversion_rowparms set col_value = cast( @nUprecnum as nvarchar(38)) where col_index = N'uprecnum'
                                        --generate XML for passed table
                                        set @sXML = (select * from #to7cvmain_rollbackconversion_rowparms FOR XML AUTO)
                                        set @sXML = N'<DATA>' + @sXML + N'</DATA>'

                                        if exists ( select 1 from #to7cvmain_rollbackconversion_expr where col_index = @sCUSTSTMTTYPE_BEFOREROW and col_value is not null )
                                            begin
                                                select @sCuststmt = col_value from #to7cvmain_rollbackconversion_expr where col_index = @sCUSTSTMTTYPE_BEFOREROW
                                                execute o7cvmain_executecustomstmt @sCuststmt, @sXML, @sCUSTSTMTTYPE_BEFOREROW
                                            end

create procedure O7CVMAIN_SETDEPENDENTFIELDVALUES @nUploadid    numeric(38),
                                                  @nPid         numeric(38),
                                                  @sSrctable    nvarchar(30)
as
    SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @sUpdatesql_template    nvarchar(550)
    declare @sUpdatesql             nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sJoincondition         nvarchar(1000)

    declare @tReffields table( split_id        numeric(38)                                 NOT NULL,
                               split_value     nvarchar(max)   COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN      NULL )
    declare @sRefextfields          nvarchar(300)
    declare @sRefprefix             nvarchar(3)

    declare @tSrcfields table( split_id        numeric(38)                                 NOT NULL,
                               split_value     nvarchar(max)   COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN      NULL )
    declare @sSrcextfields          nvarchar(600)
    declare @sSrcprefix             nvarchar(3)

    declare @sSetextfields          nvarchar(1000)

    declare @sDedSrctable           nvarchar(30)
    declare @sDedSrcfields          nvarchar(300)
    declare @sDedReftable           nvarchar(30)
    declare @sDedReffields          nvarchar(300)

    declare @sDedNewextfield        nvarchar(30)
    declare @sDedRefextfield        nvarchar(30)

    declare @nSrcCount              int
    declare @nRefCount              int

    declare @bFirst                 bit
    declare @nID                    numeric(38)

    declare @nReturn                int

    set @sUpdatesql_template = N'update :srcexttable set :setextfields from :reftable, :refexttable, :srctable where :reftable.:refprefix_upcode = :srcexttable.:srcprefix_upcode and :reftable.:refprefix_uprecnum = :refexttable.:refprefix_uprecnum and :srctable.:srcprefix_upcode = :srcexttable.:srcprefix_upcode and :srctable.:srcprefix_uprecnum = :srcexttable.:srcprefix_uprecnum and :joincondition and :srcexttable.:srcprefix_upcode = @uploadid and :srcextclause'

    declare c_c1 cursor local for SELECT distinct ded_srctable, ded_srcfields, ded_reftable, ded_reffields
                                  FROM r5dataconvextdef, user_tables
                                 WHERE ded_srcproductid = @nPid
                                   AND ded_srctable = @sSrctable
                                   AND ded_reftable = table_name COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN
                                   AND ded_srcfields <> N'-'
    open c_c1
    fetch next from c_c1 into @sDedSrctable, @sDedSrcfields, @sDedReftable, @sDedReffields
    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        begin
            set @sSrcextfields = N''  --use empty string for later concatentation
            set @sRefextfields = N''  --use empty string for later concatentation
            set @sJoincondition = N'' --use empty string for later concatentation
            set @sSetextfields = N'' --use empty string for later concatentation

            delete from @tSrcfields
            delete from @tReffields

            insert into @tSrcfields select * from dbo.o7cvmain_split( @sDedSrcfields, N',' )
            insert into @tReffields select * from dbo.o7cvmain_split( @sDedReffields, N',' )

            select @nSrcCount = count(*) from @tSrcfields
            select @nRefCount = count(*) from @tReffields

            if @nSrcCount > 0 and @nSrcCount = @nRefCount
                begin
                    set @bFirst = 1
                    declare c_src cursor local for select split_id from @tSrcfields order by split_id
                    open c_src
                    fetch next from c_src into @nID
                    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin
                            if @bFirst = 0
                                set @sJoincondition = @sJoincondition + N' and '
                            else
                                begin
                                    select @sSrcprefix = substring( split_value, 1, 3 ) from @tSrcfields where split_id = @nID
                                    select @sRefprefix = substring( split_value, 1, 3 ) from @tReffields where split_id = @nID
                                    set @bFirst = 0
                                end
                            select @sJoincondition = @sJoincondition + N'ltrim(rtrim(:reftable.' + split_value + N'))' from @tReffields where split_id = @nID
                            select @sJoincondition = @sJoincondition + N' = ltrim(rtrim(:srctable.' + split_value + N'))' from @tSrcfields where split_id = @nID

                            fetch next from c_src into @nID
                        end
                    close c_src
                    deallocate c_src

                    set @bFirst = 1
                    declare c_c2 cursor local for SELECT ded_newextfield, ded_refextfield
                                                    FROM r5dataconvextdef
                                                   WHERE ded_srcproductid = @nPid
                                                     AND ded_srctable = @sSrctable
                                                     AND ded_srcfields = @sDedSrcfields
                                                     AND ded_reftable = @sDedReftable
                                                     AND ded_reffields = @sDedReffields
                    open c_c2
                    fetch next from c_c2 into @sDedNewextfield, @sDedRefextfield
                    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin
                            if @bFirst = 0
                                begin
                                    set @sRefextfields = @sRefextfields + N','
                                    set @sSrcextfields = @sSrcextfields + N','
                                    set @sSetextfields = @sSetextfields + N','
                                end

                            set @sRefextfields = @sRefextfields + N':refexttable.' + @sDedRefextfield
                            set @sSrcextfields = @sSrcextfields + N':srcexttable.' + @sDedNewextfield
                            set @sSetextfields = @sSetextfields + @sDedNewextfield + N' = :refexttable.' + @sDedRefextfield

                            set @bFirst = 0
                            fetch next from c_c2 into @sDedNewextfield, @sDedRefextfield
                        end
                    close c_c2
                    deallocate c_c2

                    set @sUpdatesql = replace( @sUpdatesql_template, N':joincondition', @sJoincondition)
                    set @sUpdatesql = replace( @sUpdatesql, N':srcextclause', replace( @sSrcextfields, N',', N' is null and ' ) + N' is null' )
                    set @sUpdatesql = replace( @sUpdatesql, N':setextfields', @sSetextfields )
                    set @sUpdatesql = replace( @sUpdatesql, N':srctable', @sDedSrctable )
                    set @sUpdatesql = replace( @sUpdatesql, N':srcprefix', @sSrcprefix )
                    set @sUpdatesql = replace( @sUpdatesql, N':srcexttable', dbo.o7cvmain_getexttablename( @sDedSrctable ) )
                    set @sUpdatesql = replace( @sUpdatesql, N':reftable', @sDedReftable )
                    set @sUpdatesql = replace( @sUpdatesql, N':refprefix', @sRefprefix )
                    set @sUpdatesql = replace( @sUpdatesql, N':refexttable', dbo.o7cvmain_getexttablename( @sDedReftable ) )

                    execute @nReturn = sp_executesql @sUpdatesql, N'@uploadid numeric(38)', @nUploadid
                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                        begin
                            close c_c1
                            deallocate c_c1
                            return -1
                        end
                end

            fetch next from c_c1 into @sDedSrctable, @sDedSrcfields, @sDedReftable, @sDedReffields
        end
    close c_c

create procedure O7CVMAIN_SETMAPPINGPARAMS @sParamlistXML   nvarchar(max),
                                           @sStmt           nvarchar(4000) OUTPUT
as
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sParam nvarchar(30)
    declare @sValue nvarchar(4000)

    create table #to7cvmain_setmappingparams_parms ( col_index   nvarchar(30)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN  not null,
                                                     col_value   nvarchar(4000)  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN      null )

    insert into #to7cvmain_setmappingparams_parms execute o7cvmain_extractxmltable @sParamlistXML

    declare c_params cursor local for select col_index, coalesce(col_value,N'') from #to7cvmain_setmappingparams_parms
    open c_params
    fetch next from c_params into @sParam, @sValue
    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        begin
            if charindex( N':' + @sParam, @sStmt ) > 0
                begin
                    if charindex( N'''', @sValue ) > 0
                      set @sStmt = replace( @sStmt, N':' + @sParam, replace(@sValue, N'''',N'''''') )
                    else
                      set @sStmt = replace( @sStmt, N':' + @sParam, @sValue )
                end

            fetch next from c_params into @sParam, @sValue
        end
    close c_params
    deallocate c_params
    drop table #to7cvmain_setmappingparams_parms

create procedure O7CVMAIN_SETSPECIALCHARS @nUploadId   numeric(38),
                                          @sSpecchars  nvarchar(20) OUTPUT,
                                          @sTranschars nvarchar(20) OUTPUT
as
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sOldchars nvarchar(20)
    declare @sNewchars nvarchar(20)
    declare @sSrcvalue1 nvarchar(100)
    declare @sDestvalue1 nvarchar(100)

    set @sOldchars = ''
    set @sNewchars = ''

    declare c_chrlist cursor local for select dxv_srcvalue1, (case when dxv_skip = N'+' then dxv_srcvalue1 else dxv_destvalue1 end)
                                         from r5dataconvxrefvalue
                                        where dxv_upcode = @nUploadId 
                                          and dxv_option = N'SPCTRANS'
                                        order by (case when dxv_destvalue1 is not null or dxv_skip = N'+' then 0 else 1 end)
    open c_chrlist
    fetch next from c_chrlist into @sSrcvalue1, @sDestvalue1
    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        begin
            set @sOldchars = @sOldchars + substring(@sSrcvalue1, 1, 1)
            if @sDestvalue1 is not null and LEN( @sDestvalue1 ) > 0
                set @sNewchars = @sNewchars + substring(@sDestvalue1, 1, 1)

            fetch next from c_chrlist into @sSrcvalue1, @sDestvalue1
        end
    close c_chrlist
    deallocate c_chrlist

    set @sSpecchars = @sOldchars
    set @sTranschars = @sNewchars

create procedure O7CVMAIN_SETSUMMARYCOLUMNS @nUploadid      numeric(38),
                                            @nProductid     numeric(38),
                                            @sSourcetable   nvarchar(30),
                                            @sSrcprefix     nvarchar(3),
                                            @sRype          nvarchar(4)

as
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sSQL   nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sParms nvarchar(1000)

    set @sSQL = REPLACE(REPLACE(N'UPDATE r5dataconvsumdetails
         SET dsl_duperr =
            (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(dld_uprecnum))
               FROM r5dataconvlog, r5dataconvseq, r5dataconvlogdetails, :srctable
              WHERE dlg_id = dld_logid
                AND dlg_seqid = dsq_seqid
                AND dlg_upcode = dsl_upcode
                AND dsq_sourcetable = dsl_sourcetable
                AND dlg_rtype = @rtype
                AND dld_rstatus = @index_error
                AND dsq_srcproductid = @productid
                AND dld_uprecnum = :srcprefix_uprecnum
                AND :srcprefix_cvignore = ''-''),
             dsl_lengtherr =
            (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(dld_uprecnum))
               FROM r5dataconvlog, r5dataconvseq, r5dataconvlogdetails, :srctable
              WHERE dlg_id = dld_logid
                AND dlg_seqid = dsq_seqid
                AND dlg_upcode = dsl_upcode
                AND dsq_sourcetable = dsl_sourcetable
                AND dlg_rtype = @rtype
                AND dld_rstatus = @fieldlen_error
                AND dsq_srcproductid = @productid
                AND dld_uprecnum = :srcprefix_uprecnum
                AND :srcprefix_cvignore = ''-''),
             dsl_spcharerr =
           (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(dld_uprecnum))
              FROM r5dataconvlog, r5dataconvseq, r5dataconvlogdetails, :srctable
             WHERE dlg_id = dld_logid
               AND dlg_seqid = dsq_seqid
               AND dlg_upcode = dsl_upcode
               AND dsq_sourcetable = dsl_sourcetable
               AND dlg_rtype = @rtype
               AND dld_rstatus = @specchar_error
               AND dsq_srcproductid = @productid
               AND dld_uprecnum = :srcprefix_uprecnum
               AND :srcprefix_cvignore = ''-''),
             dsl_othererr =
           (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(dld_uprecnum))
              FROM r5dataconvlog, r5dataconvseq, r5dataconvlogdetails LEFT JOIN :srctable ON (:srcprefix_uprecnum = dld_uprecnum AND :srcprefix_cvignore = ''-'')
             WHERE dlg_id = dld_logid
               AND dlg_seqid = dsq_seqid
               AND dlg_upcode = dsl_upcode
               AND dsq_sourcetable = dsl_sourcetable
               AND dlg_rtype = @rtype
               AND dld_rstatus IN (@other_error, @check_error, @fk_error, @notnull_error )
               AND dsq_srcproductid = @productid
               AND (:srcprefix_uprecnum IS NOT NULL OR dld_uprecnum = -1)),
             dsl_success = dsl_attempt -
           (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(dld_uprecnum))
              FROM r5dataconvlog, r5dataconvseq, r5dataconvlogdetails, :srctable
             WHERE dlg_id = dld_logid
               AND dlg_seqid = dsq_seqid
               AND dlg_upcode = dsl_upcode
               AND dsq_sourcetable = dsl_sourcetable
               AND dlg_rtype = @rtype
               AND dsq_updatecvtotals = ''+''
               AND dld_rstatus <> @success
               AND dsq_srcproductid = @productid
               AND dld_uprecnum = :srcprefix_uprecnum
               AND :srcprefix_cvignore = ''-'')
       WHERE dsl_upcode = @uploadid
         AND dsl_sourcetable = @tablename
         AND dsl_rtype = @rtype
         AND dsl_attempt > 0', ':srctable', @sSourcetable), ':srcprefix', @sSrcprefix)

    set @sParms = N'@rtype nvarchar(4), @index_error nvarchar(2), @productid numeric(38), @fieldlen_error nvarchar(2), @specchar_error nvarchar(2), @other_error nvarchar(2), @check_error nvarchar(2), @fk_error nvarchar(2), @notnull_error nvarchar(2), @uploadid numeric(38), @tablename nvarchar(30), @success nvarchar(2)'

    execute sp_executesql @sSQL, @sParms, @sRype, N'I', @nProductid, N'L', N'SP', N'O', N'C', N'F', N'N', @nUploadid, @sSourcetable, N'S'

create procedure O7CVMAIN_SETUPJOB  @nUploadid              numeric(38),
                                    @sOperation             nvarchar(4),
                                    @dScheduletime          datetime,
                                    @bTerminatejob          bit, --1=true, 0=false
                                    @sChklengthviolation    nvarchar(1025),
                                    @sChkspecialchar        nvarchar(1025),
                                    @sChkuprecords          nvarchar(1025),
                                    @sUserid                nvarchar(1025)
as
    SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @sMonthofyear   nvarchar(40)
    declare @sDayofmonth    nvarchar(40)
    declare @sHour          nvarchar(40)
    declare @sMinute        nvarchar(40)
    declare @sActive        nvarchar(1)
    declare @sJobvalue      nvarchar(1025)

    set @sMinute = N'*/1'
    set @sActive = N'+'

    if @bTerminatejob = 1
        set @sActive = N'-'
    else
        begin
            set @sJobvalue = cast( @nUploadid as nvarchar(38) )
            if @dScheduletime is not null
                begin
                    set @sMonthofyear   = cast( datepart( mm, @dScheduletime ) - 1 as nvarchar(2) )
                    set @sDayofmonth    = cast( datepart( dd, @dScheduletime ) as nvarchar(2) )
                    set @sHour          = cast( datepart( hh, @dScheduletime ) as nvarchar(2) )
                    set @sMinute        = cast( datepart( mi, @dScheduletime ) as nvarchar(2) )
                end
        end

    UPDATE r5schedules
       SET sch_month = @sMonthofyear, sch_dayofmonth = @sDayofmonth, sch_hour = @sHour, sch_minute = @sMinute
     WHERE sch_code = N'25'
       AND sch_name = N'CONV'

    UPDATE r5jobparamvalue
       SET jpv_value = CASE
                         WHEN jpv_line = 1 THEN @sJobvalue
                         WHEN jpv_line = 2 THEN @sOperation
                         WHEN jpv_line = 3 THEN @sChklengthviolation
                         WHEN jpv_line = 4 THEN @sChkspecialchar
                         WHEN jpv_line = 5 THEN @sChkuprecords
                         WHEN jpv_line = 6 THEN @sUserid
                       END
     WHERE jpv_code = N'25'
       AND jpv_line IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6)

    UPDATE r5scheduledjobs
       SET scj_active = @sActive, scj_lastrun = NULL, scj_nextrun = NULL
     WHERE scj_code = N'25'

create function O7CVMAIN_SHOULDSKIPROW( @nLogid     numeric(38),
                                        @nUprecnum  numeric(38),
                                        @sDesttable nvarchar(30))
returns bit --1 = true, 0 = false
as
begin
    declare @bReturn    bit -- 1=true, 0=false

    if (@sDesttable = N'R5ENTITYPARTS')
        set @bReturn = 1
    else
        begin
            set @bReturn = 0

create function O7CVMAIN_SPLIT (@sList nvarchar(max), @sDelimeter nvarchar(64))
returns @tReturn table( split_id        numeric(38)                                 NOT NULL,
                        split_value     nvarchar(max)   COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN      NULL )
as
begin
    declare @sStr   nvarchar(max)
    declare @nN     int
    declare @nI     int

    set @sStr = @sList + @sDelimeter
    set @nI   = 0

    set @nN = charindex( @sDelimeter, @sStr )
    while coalesce( @nN, 0 ) > 0
        begin
            set @nI = @nI + 1
            insert into @tReturn values (  @nI, ltrim( rtrim( substring( @sStr, 1, @nN - 1 ) ) )  )
            set @sStr = substring( @sStr, @nN + 1, len( @sStr ) )
            set @nN = charindex( @sDelimeter, @sStr )
        end

    return
end

create procedure O7CVMAIN_STARTSEQUENCELOG @nLogid          numeric(38) OUTPUT,
                                           @nUploadid       numeric(38),
                                           @nSeqid          numeric(38),
                                           @sInsstmt        nvarchar(4000),
                                           @sDelstmt        nvarchar(4000),
                                           @sOperation      nvarchar(4)
as
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sLogid   nvarchar(30)
    declare @sChk       nvarchar(6)
    declare @nReturn  int

    select @nLogid = dlg_id
      FROM r5dataconvlog
     WHERE dlg_upcode = @nUploadid
       AND dlg_seqid = @nSeqid
       AND dlg_rtype = @sOperation

    if @nLogid is not null
        begin
            UPDATE r5dataconvlog
            SET dlg_started = GetDate(), dlg_completed = NULL,
                dlg_insstmt = coalesce( @sInsstmt, dlg_insstmt),
                dlg_delstmt = coalesce( @sDelstmt, dlg_delstmt),
                dlg_skip = N'-'
            WHERE dlg_id = @nLogid

          if @sOperation = N'C'
              DELETE FROM r5dataconvlogdetails
               WHERE dld_logid = @nLogid
                 AND dld_uprecnum = -1
        end
    else
        begin
            execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sLogid OUTPUT, N'DLG', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                return -1
            INSERT INTO r5dataconvlog (dlg_id, dlg_upcode, dlg_seqid, dlg_rtype, dlg_started, dlg_insstmt, dlg_delstmt)
                VALUES (cast(@sLogid as numeric(38)), @nUploadid, @nSeqid, @sOperation, GetDate(), @sInsstmt, @sDelstmt)
            set @nLogid = cast(@sLogid as numeric(38))
        end

    declare @sOptionid      nvarchar(30)

create procedure O7CVMAIN_SYNCXREFVALUES @nUploadid     numeric(38),
                                         @nPid          numeric(38),
                                         @sOptionid     nvarchar(30),
                                         @sSrctable     nvarchar(30),
                                         @sSrcexttable  nvarchar(30),
                                         @sSrcprefix    nvarchar(3),
                                         @sSrcfields    nvarchar(100),
                                         @sDesttable    nvarchar(30),
                                         @sDestfields   nvarchar(100)
as
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sDeletesql_template    nvarchar(300)
    declare @sDeletesql             nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sUpdatesql_template    nvarchar(400)
    declare @sUpdatesql             nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sInsertsql_template    nvarchar(450)
    declare @sInsertsql             nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sUpdateSetlist         nvarchar(4000)  --SQL Server only for update statement

    declare @tSrckeys table( split_id        numeric(38)                                 NOT NULL,
                             split_value     nvarchar(max)   COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN      NULL )

    declare @tDestkeys table( split_id        numeric(38)                                 NOT NULL,
                              split_value     nvarchar(max)   COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN      NULL )

    declare @sJoincondition         nvarchar(200)
    declare @sOptionxreffields      nvarchar(100)
    declare @sDestfield             nvarchar(30)

    declare @nCount                 int
    declare @nId                    int
    declare @nReturn                int

    set @sDeletesql_template = N'DELETE FROM r5dataconvxrefvalue WHERE dxv_option = @optionid AND dxv_upcode = @uploadid AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM :srctable WHERE :srcprefix_upcode = dxv_upcode AND :joincondition)'
    set @sUpdatesql_template = N'UPDATE :srcexttable SET :updatesetlist FROM :srctable, r5dataconvxrefvalue WHERE dxv_upcode = :srctable.:srcprefix_upcode AND dxv_option = @optionid AND :srcexttable.:srcprefix_uprecnum = :srctable.:srcprefix_uprecnum AND :joincondition AND :srcexttable.:srcprefix_upcode = @uploadid'
    set @sInsertsql_template = N'INSERT INTO r5dataconvxrefvalue(dxv_upcode, dxv_option, :optionxreffields) SELECT :srcprefix_upcode, @optionid, :srcfields FROM :srctable WHERE :srcprefix_upcode = @uploadid AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5dataconvxrefvalue WHERE dxv_upcode = :srcprefix_upcode AND dxv_option = @optionid AND :joincondition)'

    set @sJoincondition = N'dxv_srcvalue1'
    set @sOptionxreffields = N'dxv_srcvalue1'
    set @sUpdateSetlist = N''

    insert into @tSrckeys select * from dbo.o7cvmain_split( @sSrcfields, N',' )

    select @nCount = count(*) from @tSrckeys
    if @nCount = 0
        return

    select @sJoincondition = @sJoincondition + N' = ' + split_value from @tSrckeys where split_id = 1
    set @nId = 2
    while @nId <= @nCount
        begin
            set @sOptionxreffields = @sOptionxreffields + N',dxv_srcvalue' + cast( @nId as nvarchar(38))
            select @sJoincondition = @sJoincondition + N' AND coalesce( rtrim( ltrim( dxv_srcvalue'  + cast( @nId as nvarchar(38)) + N')), N'''') = coalesce( rtrim( ltrim(' + split_value + N')), N'''')'
              from @tSrckeys
             where split_id = @nId
            set @nId = @nId + 1
        end

    set @sDeletesql = replace( @sDeletesql_template, N':joincondition'  , @sJoincondition )
    set @sDeletesql = replace( @sDeletesql         , N':srctable'       , @sSrctable )
    set @sDeletesql = replace( @sDeletesql         , N':srcprefix'      , @sSrcprefix )

    execute sp_executesql @sDeletesql, N'@optionid nvarchar(30), @uploadid numeric(38)', @sOptionid, @nUploadid
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        return -1

    if @sDestfields is not null
        begin
            insert into @tDestkeys select * from dbo.o7cvmain_split( @sDestfields, N',' )
            select @nCount = count(*) from @tDestkeys
            set @nId = 1
            while @nId <= @nCount
                begin
                    select @sDestfield = split_value from @tDestkeys where split_id = @nId
                    if @nId > 1
                        set @sUpdateSetlist = @sUpdateSetlist + N','
                    select @sUpdateSetlist = @sUpdateSetlist + @sDestfield + N' = (CASE dxv_skip WHEN N''+'' THEN null ELSE dxv_destvalue' + cast( @nId as nvarchar(38)) + N' END )'
                    set @nId = @nId + 1
                end

            set @sUpdatesql = replace( @sUpdatesql_template, N':joincondition'      , @sJoincondition )
            set @sUpdatesql = replace( @sUpdatesql         , N':srcexttable'        , @sSrcexttable )
            set @sUpdatesql = replace( @sUpdatesql         , N':updatesetlist'      , @sUpdateSetlist )
            set @sUpdatesql = replace( @sUpdatesql         , N':srctable'           , @sSrctable )
            set @sUpdatesql = replace( @sUpdatesql         , N':srcprefix'          , @sSrcprefix )

            execute sp_executesql @sUpdatesql, N'@optionid nvarchar(30), @uploadid numeric(38)', @sOptionid, @nUploadid
            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                return -1
        end

    set @sInsertsql = replace( @sInsertsql_template, N':joincondition'      , @sJoincondition )
    set @sInsertsql = replace( @sInsertsql         , N':optionxreffields'   , @sOptionxreffields )
    set @sInsertsql = replace( @sInsertsql         , N':srcfields'          , @sSrcfields )
    set @sInsertsql = replace( @sInsertsql         , N':srctable'           , @sSrctable )
    set @sInsertsql = replace( @sInsertsql         , N':srcprefix'          , @sSrcprefix )

    execute sp_executesql @sInsertsql, N'@optionid nvarchar(30), @uploadid numeric(38)', @sOptionid, @nUploadid
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        return -1

create function O7CVMP2_GETAVGSTOREPRICE( @sPart        nvarchar(64),
                                          @sStore       nvarchar(15),
                                          @nUploadid    numeric(38) )
returns float
as
begin
    declare @nTotalcost float
    declare @nTotalqty  float
    declare @nPrice     float

    declare @nReturn    float

    --NOTE: The call to o7cvmain.getexttablename has been replaced with the contents of that function here

    if object_id( 'r5mp2invcost') is not null or object_id( 'r5mp2invcost_EXT' ) is not null
        begin
            SELECT @nTotalcost = SUM(a.zbv_unitcost * a.zbv_availableqty), @nTotalqty = SUM(a.zbv_availableqty)
              FROM r5mp2invcost a, r5mp2invcost_EXT b
             WHERE a.zbv_uprecnum = b.zbv_uprecnum
               AND a.zbv_upcode = @nUploadid
               AND a.zbv_itemnum = @sPart
               AND b.str_code = @sStore
               AND isnull( a.zbv_unitcost, 0 ) > 0
               AND isnull( a.zbv_availableqty, 0 ) > 0
               AND isnull( a.zbv_cvignore, N'-' ) = N'-'

            if coalesce( @nTotalcost, 0 ) > 0 and coalesce( @nTotalqty, 0 ) > 0
                set @nPrice = @nTotalcost / @nTotalqty
        end

    set @nReturn = @nPrice
    if coalesce( @nReturn, -1 ) < 0
        set @nReturn = 0

    return @nReturn
end

create function O7CVMP2_GETCRAFTINSTRUCTION( @nUploadid    numeric(38),
                                      @sCraft       nvarchar(10),
                                      @sTask        nvarchar(256),
                                      @sSiteid      nvarchar(256),
                                      @sProcesstype nvarchar(1),
                                      @sSpecchars   nvarchar(20),
                                      @sTranschars  nvarchar(20) )
returns nvarchar(256)
as
begin
    declare @sReturn        nvarchar(20)
    declare @sTheCraft      nvarchar(10)
    declare @sEAMTask       nvarchar(20)
    declare @nInstrOrder    int
    declare @nCraftOrder    int
    set @nInstrOrder =0
    set @nCraftOrder =0
    set @sReturn = null

    --NOTE: The call to o7cvmain.getexttablename has been replaced with the contents of that function here

    if @sTask is null or @sSiteid is null or object_id( 'r5mp2tskinstr') is null or object_id( 'r5mp2instr') is null or object_id( 'r5mp2instr_EXT') is null
        set @sReturn = null
    else
        begin
            -- first find the order of the craft code
            declare c_craft cursor local for SELECT  zfh_craft
                                           FROM  r5mp2tskcraft a 
                                           WHERE a.zfh_upcode = @nUploadid 
                                           AND   a.zfh_tasknum = @sTask 
                                           AND   a.zfh_siteid = @sSiteid 
                                           AND   coalesce(a.zfh_cvignore,'-') = '-' 
                                           ORDER BY a.zfh_sequencenum, a.zfh_craft
            open c_craft
            fetch next from c_craft into @sTheCraft
            
            while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            begin
                set @nCraftOrder = @nCraftOrder +1 
                if @sTheCraft = @sCraft
                begin
                    break
                end
                fetch next from c_craft into @sTheCraft
            end
            close c_craft
            deallocate c_craft
        
            -- now find the trade code
            declare c_task cursor local for SELECT (case when b.tsk_code is not null or @sProcesstype='P' then b.tsk_code when a.zfi_instrcode is not null then upper(dbo.o7cv_chrtran(a.zfi_instrcode,@sSpecchars,@sTranschars)) end)
              from r5mp2tskinstr a left join (r5mp2instr_ext b inner join r5mp2instr c on (c.zbs_uprecnum = b.zbs_uprecnum)) on (a.zfi_instrcode = c.zbs_instrcode and a.zfi_upcode = c.zbs_upcode)
             where a.zfi_upcode = @nUploadid
               and a.zfi_tasknum = @sTask
               and a.zfi_siteid = @sSiteid
               and isnull(a.zfi_cvignore,N'-') = N'-'
             order by a.zfi_sequencenum, a.zfi_instrcode
             
             open c_task
             fetch next from c_task into @sEAMTask
             while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
             begin
                 set @nInstrOrder = @nInstrOrder +1 
                 if @nCraftOrder = @nInstrOrder
                 begin
                    set @sReturn = @sEAMTask
                    break
                 end
                 fetch next from c_task into @sEAMTask
             end
             close c_task
             deallocate c_task
             
        end

    return @sReturn
end

create function O7CVMP2_GETLOCATION( @nUploadid       numeric(38),
                                     @sLocation       nvarchar(30),
                                     @sSubloc1        nvarchar(30),
                                     @sSubloc2        nvarchar(30),
                                     @sSubloc3        nvarchar(30),
                                     @sSite           nvarchar(15),
                                     @sOrgcode        nvarchar(15))
returns nvarchar(40)
as
begin
    declare @sReturn        nvarchar(40)
    declare @sSkip          nvarchar(1)
    declare @sExpression    nvarchar(500)
    declare @sSQL           nvarchar(600)
    declare @sParms         nvarchar(128)
    declare @sDatabase      varchar(128)

    if isnull(@sLocation, N'-') = N'-' and isnull(@sSubloc1, N'-') = N'-' and isnull(@sSubloc2, N'-') = N'-' and isnull(@sSubloc2, N'-') = N'-'
        return null

    SELECT @sSkip = dsu_cvskip
      FROM r5dataconvsummary, r5dataconvseq, r5dataconvsubexpsetup, r5dataconversion
     WHERE dtc_upcode = @nUploadid
       AND dss_srcproductid = dtc_srcproductid
       AND dss_option = N'LOCSUBX'
       AND dss_seqid = dsq_seqid
       AND dsu_sourcetable = dsq_sourcetable
       AND dsu_upcode = dtc_upcode

    if coalesce( @sSkip, N'-' ) = N'+'
        return null

    return dbo.o7cvmp2_getlocation2(@nUploadid, @sLocation, @sSubloc1, @sSubloc2, @sSubloc3, @sSite, @sOrgcode)
end

create function O7CVMP2_GETLOCATION2( @nUploadid       numeric(38),
                                      @sLocation       nvarchar(30),
                                      @sSubloc1        nvarchar(30),
                                      @sSubloc2        nvarchar(30),
                                      @sSubloc3        nvarchar(30),
                                      @sSite           nvarchar(15),
                                      @sOrgcode        nvarchar(15))
returns nvarchar(40)
as
begin
    declare @sPrefix        nvarchar(10)
    declare @sSrcfield      nvarchar(30)
    declare @nStart         int
    declare @nLength        int
    declare @sSuffix        nvarchar(10)

    declare @sReturn        nvarchar(30)
    declare @sFieldvalue    nvarchar(50)
    declare @sLastsuffix    nvarchar(10)

    set @sReturn = N''
    set @sLastsuffix = N''

    declare c_subexps cursor local for select dsx_prefix, dsx_srcfield, dsx_start, dsx_length, dsx_suffix
                                        from r5dataconvsubexps, r5dataconvsubexpsetup, r5dataconversion
                                       where dtc_upcode = @nUploadid
                                         and dss_srcproductid = dtc_srcproductid
                                         and dss_option = N'LOCSUBX'
                                         and dsx_upcode = dtc_upcode
                                         and dsx_seqid = dss_seqid
                                         and dsx_destfield = dss_destfield
                                         and dsx_srcfield is not null
                                       order by dsx_order
    open c_subexps
    fetch next from c_subexps into @sPrefix, @sSrcfield, @nStart, @nLength, @sSuffix
    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        begin
            set @sFieldvalue = N''
            if @sPrefix is null
                set @sPrefix = N''

            if @sSrcfield = N'ZCF_LOCATION'
                set @sFieldvalue = @sLocation
            else if @sSrcfield = N'ZCF_SUBLOCATION1'
                set @sFieldvalue = @sSubloc1
            else if @sSrcfield = N'ZCF_SUBLOCATION2'
                set @sFieldvalue = @sSubloc2
            else if @sSrcfield = N'ZCF_SUBLOCATION3'
                set @sFieldvalue = @sSubloc3
            else if @sSrcfield = N'ZCF_SITEID'
                set @sFieldvalue = @sSite
            else if @sSrcfield = N'ORG_CODE'
                set @sFieldvalue = @sOrgcode

            set @sFieldvalue = ltrim( rtrim (substring(@sFieldvalue, @nStart, @nLength)))
            if @sFieldvalue is not null and LEN( @sFieldvalue ) > 0 and @sFieldvalue <> N'-'
                begin
                    set @sReturn = @sReturn + @sLastsuffix + @sPrefix + @sFieldvalue
                    if @sSuffix is not null and LEN( @sSuffix ) > 0
                        set @sLastsuffix = @sSuffix
                    else
                        set @sLastsuffix = N''
                end

            fetch next from c_subexps into @sPrefix, @sSrcfield, @nStart, @nLength, @sSuffix
        end
    close c_subexps
    deallocate c_subexps

    if @sReturn is not null and LEN( @sReturn ) = 0
        set @sReturn = null

    return @sReturn
end

create function O7CVMP2_GETMETER( @nUploadid numeric(38),
                                  @nUprecnum numeric(38) )
returns nvarchar(20)
as
begin
    declare @sMetcode       nvarchar(20)
    declare @sExpression    nvarchar(500)
    declare @sSQL           nvarchar(2000)
    declare @sParms         nvarchar(128)
    declare @sDatabase      varchar(128)

    if dbo.o7cvmp2_isseqmetergenenabled( @nUploadid ) = 0
        begin
            set @sExpression = dbo.o7cvmain_getsubexp2( @nUploadid, N'METSUBX' )
            if @sExpression is not null
                begin
                    set @sDatabase = cast( DB_NAME() as varchar(128) )
                    set @sSQL = N'select @sOutput = ' + @sExpression + N' from r5mp2meter where zch_uprecnum = @uprecnum'
                    set @sParms = N'@sOutput nvarchar(20) OUTPUT, @uprecnum numeric(38)'
                    execute master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'O7CVMP2_GETMETER_SQL', @sSQL, @sParms, @sMetcode OUTPUT, @nUprecnum
                end
        end
    else
        set @sMetcode = dbo.o7cv_getnextseq( N'R5METERS', N'MET_CODE' )

    return @sMetcode
end

name: O7CVMP2_GETTASKHOURS
body:
create function O7CVMP2_GETTASKHOURS( @nUploadid    numeric(38),
                                      @sInstrCode   nvarchar(11),
                                      @sTask        nvarchar(256),
                                      @sSiteid      nvarchar(256),
                                      @sProcesstype nvarchar(1),
                                      @sSpecchars   nvarchar(20),
                                      @sTranschars  nvarchar(20) )
returns numeric(24,6)
as
begin
    declare @nReturn        numeric(12,2)
    declare @nEstHours      numeric(12,2)
    declare @sTheInstrCode  nvarchar(11)
    declare @nInstrOrder    int
    declare @nCraftOrder    int
    set @nInstrOrder =0
    set @nCraftOrder =0
    

    --NOTE: The call to o7cvmain.getexttablename has been replaced with the contents of that function here

    if @sTask is null or @sSiteid is null or object_id( 'r5mp2tskcraft') is null or object_id( 'r5mp2crafts') is null or object_id( 'r5mp2crafts_EXT') is null
        set @nReturn = 0
    else
        begin
            -- first find the order of the instruction code
            declare c_instr cursor local for SELECT  zfi_instrcode 
                                           FROM r5mp2tskinstr a 
                                           WHERE a.zfi_upcode = @nUploadid 
                                           AND   a.zfi_tasknum = @sTask 
                                           AND   a.zfi_siteid = @sSiteid 
                                           AND   coalesce(a.zfi_cvignore,'-') = '-' 
                                           ORDER BY a.zfi_sequencenum, a.zfi_instrcode
            open c_instr
            fetch next from c_instr into @sTheInstrCode
            
            while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            begin
                set @nInstrOrder = @nInstrOrder +1 
                if @sTheInstrCode = @sInstrCode
                begin
                    break
                end
                fetch next from c_instr into @sTheInstrCode
            end
            close c_instr
            deallocate c_instr
        
            -- now find the estimated hours        
            declare c_esthours cursor local for SELECT  zfh_estlaborhours
              from r5mp2tskcraft a left join (r5mp2crafts_ext b inner join r5mp2crafts c on (c.zam_uprecnum = b.zam_uprecnum)) on (a.zfh_craft = c.zam_craft and a.zfh_upcode = c.zam_upcode)
             where a.zfh_upcode = @nUploadid
               and a.zfh_tasknum = @sTask
               and a.zfh_siteid = @sSiteid
               and isnull(a.zfh_cvignore,N'-') = N'-'
             order by a.zfh_sequencenum, a.zfh_craft
             
             open c_esthours
             fetch next from c_esthours into @nEstHours
             while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
             begin
                 set @nCraftOrder = @nCraftOrder +1 
                 if @nCraftOrder = @nInstrOrder
                 begin
                    set @nReturn = @nEstHours
                    break
                 end
                 fetch next from c_esthours into @nEstHours
             end
             close c_esthours
             deallocate c_esthours             

            if @nReturn is null
                set @nReturn = 0
        end

    return @nReturn
end

        set @sReturn = null
    else
        SELECT @sReturn = f.uom_code
          FROM r5mp2taskeq a, r5mp2tskmeter b, r5mp2task c, r5mp2task_EXT d, r5mp2meter e, r5mp2meter_EXT f
         WHERE a.zey_uprecnum = @nUprecnum
           AND a.zey_upcode = b.zfj_upcode
           AND a.zey_siteid = b.zfj_siteid
           AND a.zey_tasknum = b.zfj_tasknum
           AND a.zey_eqnum = b.zfj_eqnum
           AND a.zey_location = b.zfj_location
           AND a.zey_sublocation1 = b.zfj_sublocation1
           AND a.zey_sublocation2 = b.zfj_sublocation2
           AND a.zey_sublocation3 = b.zfj_sublocation3
           AND a.zey_upcode = c.zew_upcode
           AND a.zey_siteid = c.zew_siteid
           AND a.zey_tasknum = c.zew_tasknum
           AND c.zew_uprecnum = d.zew_uprecnum
           AND d.ppm_code IS NOT NULL
           AND d.ppm_revision IS NOT NULL
           AND b.zfj_eqnum = e.zch_eqnum
           AND b.zfj_meternum = e.zch_meternum
           AND b.zfj_upcode = e.zch_upcode
           AND e.zch_uprecnum = f.zch_uprecnum
           AND f.met_code IS NOT NULL
           AND isnull(b.zfj_cvignore, N'-') = N'-'
           ORDER BY b.zfj_meternum desc

    return @sReturn
end

body:
create function O7CVMP2_GETTASKPEOPLE( @nUploadid    numeric(38),
                                       @sInstrCode   nvarchar(11),
                                       @sTask        nvarchar(256),
                                       @sSiteid      nvarchar(256),
                                       @nDuration    numeric(8),
                                       @sProcesstype nvarchar(1),
                                       @sSpecchars   nvarchar(20),
                                       @sTranschars  nvarchar(20) )
returns numeric(8)
as
begin
    declare @nReturn    numeric(8)
    declare @nEstlaborhrs numeric(12,2)
    declare @nNumofpeople numeric(8)
    declare @sTheInstrCode  nvarchar(11)
    declare @nInstrOrder    int
    declare @nCraftOrder    int
    set @nInstrOrder =0
    set @nCraftOrder =0    

    --NOTE: The call to o7cvmain.getexttablename has been replaced with the contents of that function here
    if coalesce(@nDuration, 0) = 0 or @sTask is null or @sSiteid is null or object_id( 'r5mp2tskcraft') is null or object_id( 'r5mp2crafts') is null or object_id( 'r5mp2crafts_EXT') is null
        set @nReturn = 1
    else
        begin
            -- first find the order of the instruction code
            declare c_instr cursor local for SELECT  zfi_instrcode 
                                           FROM r5mp2tskinstr a 
                                           WHERE a.zfi_upcode = @nUploadid 
                                           AND   a.zfi_tasknum = @sTask 
                                           AND   a.zfi_siteid = @sSiteid 
                                           AND   coalesce(a.zfi_cvignore,'-') = '-' 
                                           ORDER BY a.zfi_sequencenum, a.zfi_instrcode
            open c_instr
            fetch next from c_instr into @sTheInstrCode
            
            while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            begin
                set @nInstrOrder = @nInstrOrder +1 
                if @sTheInstrCode = @sInstrCode
                begin
                    break
                end
                fetch next from c_instr into @sTheInstrCode
            end
            close c_instr
            deallocate c_instr
        
            -- now find the estimated hours        
            declare c_peoples cursor local for SELECT a.zfh_numofpeople, a.zfh_estlaborhours
              from r5mp2tskcraft a left join (r5mp2crafts_ext b inner join r5mp2crafts c on (c.zam_uprecnum = b.zam_uprecnum)) on (a.zfh_craft = c.zam_craft and a.zfh_upcode = c.zam_upcode)
             where a.zfh_upcode = @nUploadid
               and a.zfh_tasknum = @sTask
               and a.zfh_siteid = @sSiteid
               and isnull(a.zfh_cvignore,N'-') = N'-'
             order by a.zfh_sequencenum, a.zfh_craft
             
             open c_peoples
             fetch next from c_peoples into @nNumofpeople,@nEstlaborhrs
             while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
             begin
                 set @nCraftOrder = @nCraftOrder +1 
                 if @nCraftOrder = @nInstrOrder
                 begin
                    if @nEstlaborhrs is null
                      set @nEstlaborhrs = 0
                    if coalesce(@nNumofpeople, 0) < 1
                      set @nNumofpeople = 1

                    if @nEstlaborhrs > 24 * @nDuration * @nNumofpeople
                      set @nReturn = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER(CEILING((@nEstlaborhrs / @nDuration) / 8), 1)
                    else
                    set @nReturn = @nNumofpeople
                    break
                 end
                 fetch next from c_peoples into @nNumofpeople,@nEstlaborhrs
             end
             close c_peoples
             deallocate c_peoples   
            if coalesce(@nReturn, 0) < 1
              set @nReturn = 1
              
        end

    return @nReturn
end

create function O7CVMP2_GETTASKTRADE( @nUploadid    numeric(38),
                                      @sInstrCode   nvarchar(11),
                                      @sTask        nvarchar(256),
                                      @sSiteid      nvarchar(256),
                                      @sProcesstype nvarchar(1),
                                      @sSpecchars   nvarchar(20),
                                      @sTranschars  nvarchar(20) )
returns nvarchar(256)
as
begin
    declare @sReturn        nvarchar(15)
    declare @sTheInstrCode  nvarchar(11)
    declare @sTrade         nvarchar(15)
    declare @nInstrOrder    int
    declare @nCraftOrder    int
    set @nInstrOrder =0
    set @nCraftOrder =0

    --NOTE: The call to o7cvmain.getexttablename has been replaced with the contents of that function here

    if @sTask is null or @sSiteid is null or object_id( 'r5mp2tskcraft') is null or object_id( 'r5mp2crafts') is null or object_id( 'r5mp2crafts_EXT') is null
        set @sReturn = N'*'
    else
        begin
            -- first find the order of the instruction code
            declare c_instr cursor local for SELECT  zfi_instrcode 
                                           FROM r5mp2tskinstr a 
                                           WHERE a.zfi_upcode = @nUploadid 
                                           AND   a.zfi_tasknum = @sTask 
                                           AND   a.zfi_siteid = @sSiteid 
                                           AND   coalesce(a.zfi_cvignore,'-') = '-' 
                                           ORDER BY a.zfi_sequencenum, a.zfi_instrcode
            open c_instr
            fetch next from c_instr into @sTheInstrCode
            
            while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            begin
                set @nInstrOrder = @nInstrOrder +1 
                if @sTheInstrCode = @sInstrCode
                begin
                    break
                end
                fetch next from c_instr into @sTheInstrCode
            end
            close c_instr
            deallocate c_instr
        
            -- now find the trade code
            declare c_trade cursor local for SELECT (case when b.trd_code is not null or @sProcesstype='P' then b.trd_code when a.zfh_craft is not null then upper(dbo.o7cv_chrtran(a.zfh_craft,@sSpecchars,@sTranschars)) end)
              from r5mp2tskcraft a left join (r5mp2crafts_ext b inner join r5mp2crafts c on (c.zam_uprecnum = b.zam_uprecnum)) on (a.zfh_craft = c.zam_craft and a.zfh_upcode = c.zam_upcode)
             where a.zfh_upcode = @nUploadid
               and a.zfh_tasknum = @sTask
               and a.zfh_siteid = @sSiteid
               and isnull(a.zfh_cvignore,N'-') = N'-'
             order by a.zfh_sequencenum, a.zfh_craft
             
             open c_trade
             fetch next from c_trade into @sTrade
             while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
             begin
                 set @nCraftOrder = @nCraftOrder +1 
                 if @nCraftOrder = @nInstrOrder
                 begin
                    set @sReturn = @sTrade
                    break
                 end
                 fetch next from c_trade into @sTrade
             end
             close c_trade
             deallocate c_trade

            if @sReturn is null
                set @sReturn = N'*'
        end

    return @sReturn
end

create function O7CVMP2_GETVENDORID( @nUploadid       numeric(38),
                                     @sVendorid       nvarchar(15),
                                     @sVendorBranchid nvarchar(15))
returns nvarchar(30)
as
begin
    declare @sPrefix        nvarchar(10)
    declare @sSrcfield      nvarchar(30)
    declare @nStart         int
    declare @nLength        int
    declare @sSuffix        nvarchar(10)

    declare @sReturn        nvarchar(30)
    declare @sFieldvalue    nvarchar(15)
    declare @sLastsuffix    nvarchar(10)

    set @sReturn = N''
    set @sLastsuffix = N''

    declare c_subexps cursor local for select dsx_prefix, dsx_srcfield, dsx_start, dsx_length, dsx_suffix
                                        from r5dataconvsubexps, r5dataconvsubexpsetup, r5dataconversion
                                       where dtc_upcode = @nUploadid
                                         and dss_srcproductid = dtc_srcproductid
                                         and dss_option = N'COMPSUBX'
                                         and dsx_upcode = dtc_upcode
                                         and dsx_seqid = dss_seqid
                                         and dsx_destfield = dss_destfield
                                         and dsx_srcfield is not null
                                       order by dsx_order
    open c_subexps
    fetch next from c_subexps into @sPrefix, @sSrcfield, @nStart, @nLength, @sSuffix
    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        begin
            set @sFieldvalue = N''
            if @sPrefix is null
                set @sPrefix = N''

            if @sSrcfield = N'ZFU_VENDORID'
                set @sFieldvalue = @sVendorid
            else if @sSrcfield = N'ZFU_VENDORBRANCHID'
                set @sFieldvalue = @sVendorBranchid

            set @sFieldvalue = ltrim( rtrim (substring(@sFieldvalue, @nStart, @nLength)))
            if @sFieldvalue is not null and LEN( @sFieldvalue ) > 0 and @sFieldvalue <> N'-'
                begin
                    set @sReturn = @sReturn + @sLastsuffix + @sPrefix + @sFieldvalue
                    if @sSuffix is not null and LEN( @sSuffix ) > 0
                        set @sLastsuffix = @sSuffix
                    else
                        set @sLastsuffix = N''
                end

            fetch next from c_subexps into @sPrefix, @sSrcfield, @nStart, @nLength, @sSuffix
        end
    close c_subexps
    deallocate c_subexps

    if @sReturn is not null and LEN( @sReturn ) = 0
        set @sReturn = null

    return @sReturn
end

create procedure O7CVMP2_INSERTSPARES    @nUprecnum  numeric(38,0),
                                         @nLogid     numeric(38,0),
                                         @sInsstmt   nvarchar(4000)
as
begin
    SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @nI              int
    declare @sNewstmt        nvarchar(4000)

    if object_id('r5mp2equip') is null or object_id('r5mp2equip_ext') is null
        return

    set @nI = charindex('r5mp2spares_ext where', lower(@sInsstmt))
    set @sNewstmt = replace(substring( @sInsstmt, 1, @nI-1), ''':epacode''', 'obj_code + ''#'' + obj_org') + 'r5mp2equip,r5mp2equip_ext,' + substring( @sInsstmt, @nI, len(@sInsstmt)) +
      ' and r5mp2equip.zbh_uprecnum=r5mp2equip_ext.zbh_uprecnum and obj_org is not null and org_code is not null and r5mp2equip.zbh_sparecode=r5mp2spares.zep_sparecode' +
      ' and not exists (select 1 from r5entityparts where epa_part=par_code and epa_part_org=par_org and epa_code=obj_code + ''#'' + obj_org and epa_rentity=dbo.o7cv_sysobjentity())'

    execute sp_executesql @sNewstmt, N'@uprecnum numeric(38)', @nUprecnum

    if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
        execute o7cvmain_logrecordstatus @nLogid, @nUprecnum, N'S', null

    UPDATE r5dataconvlog
       SET dlg_insstmt = @sNewstmt
     WHERE dlg_id = @nLogid
       AND charindex('r5mp2equip', dlg_insstmt) = 0
end

                set @sReturn = N'-'

create procedure O7CVMP2_POSPPO @nUploadid     numeric(38),
                                @nSeqid        numeric(38),
                                @sOperation    nvarchar(1)
as
begin
    SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @nI              int
    declare @sNewstmt        nvarchar(4000)

    if object_id('r5mp2taskeq') is null or object_id('r5mp2tskmeter') is null
        return

    if @sOperation = N'C'
        begin
            UPDATE r5dataconvsumdetails
               SET dsl_attempt = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(dld_uprecnum))
                                    FROM r5dataconvlog, r5dataconvlogdetails, r5mp2taskeq, r5mp2tskmeter, r5dataconvseq a, r5dataconvseq b
                                   WHERE a.dsq_seqid = @nSeqid
                                     AND a.dsq_srcproductid = b.dsq_srcproductid
                                     AND a.dsq_sourcetable = b.dsq_sourcetable
                                     AND dlg_upcode = dsl_upcode
                                     AND dlg_seqid = b.dsq_seqid
                                     AND dlg_rtype = dsl_rtype
                                     AND dlg_id = dld_logid
                                     AND dld_uprecnum = zey_uprecnum
                                     AND zey_tasknum = zfj_tasknum
                                     AND zey_eqnum = zfj_eqnum
                                     AND zey_location = zfj_location
                                     AND zey_sublocation1 = zfj_sublocation1
                                     AND zey_sublocation2 = zfj_sublocation2
                                     AND zey_sublocation3 = zfj_sublocation3
                                     AND zey_siteid = zfj_siteid
                                     AND zey_upcode = zfj_upcode
                                     AND coalesce(zfj_cvignore,N'-') = N'-'),
                   dsl_success = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(dld_uprecnum))
                                    FROM r5dataconvlog, r5dataconvlogdetails, r5mp2taskeq, r5mp2tskmeter, r5dataconvseq a, r5dataconvseq b
                                   WHERE a.dsq_seqid = @nSeqid
                                     AND a.dsq_srcproductid = b.dsq_srcproductid
                                     AND a.dsq_sourcetable = b.dsq_sourcetable
                                     AND dlg_upcode = dsl_upcode
                                     AND dlg_seqid = b.dsq_seqid
                                     AND dlg_rtype = dsl_rtype
                                     AND dlg_id = dld_logid
                                     AND dld_uprecnum = zey_uprecnum
                                     AND zey_tasknum = zfj_tasknum
                                     AND zey_eqnum = zfj_eqnum
                                     AND zey_location = zfj_location
                                     AND zey_sublocation1 = zfj_sublocation1
                                     AND zey_sublocation2 = zfj_sublocation2
                                     AND zey_sublocation3 = zfj_sublocation3
                                     AND zey_siteid = zfj_siteid
                                     AND zey_upcode = zfj_upcode
                                     AND coalesce(zfj_cvignore,N'-') = N'-'
                                     AND dld_rstatus = N'S')
             WHERE dsl_upcode = @nUploadid
               AND dsl_sourcetable = N'R5MP2TSKMETER'
               AND dsl_rtype = N'C'
        end
    else if @sOperation = N'P'
        begin
            UPDATE r5dataconvsumdetails
               SET dsl_attempt = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r5mp2taskeq
                                   WHERE zey_upcode = dsl_upcode
                                     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                                   FROM r5mp2tskmeter
                                                  WHERE zey_tasknum = zfj_tasknum
                                                    AND zey_eqnum = zfj_eqnum
                                                    AND zey_location = zfj_location
                                                    AND zey_sublocation1 = zfj_sublocation1
                                                    AND zey_sublocation2 = zfj_sublocation2
                                                    AND zey_sublocation3 = zfj_sublocation3
                                                    AND zey_siteid = zfj_siteid
                                                    AND zey_upcode = zfj_upcode
                                                    AND coalesce(zfj_cvignore,N'-') = N'-'))
             WHERE dsl_upcode = @nUploadid
               AND dsl_sourcetable = N'R5MP2TSKMETER'
               AND dsl_rtype = N'P'

            UPDATE r5dataconvsumdetails
               SET dsl_success = (case when dsl_attempt = 0 then 0
                                  else dsl_attempt - (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(dld_uprecnum))
                                                        FROM r5dataconvlog, r5dataconvlogdetails, r5mp2taskeq, r5mp2tskmeter, r5dataconvseq a, r5dataconvseq b
                                                       WHERE a.dsq_seqid = @nSeqid
                                                         AND a.dsq_srcproductid = b.dsq_srcproductid
                                                         AND a.dsq_sourcetable = b.dsq_sourcetable
                                                         AND dlg_upcode = dsl_upcode
                                                         AND dlg_seqid = b.dsq_seqid
                                                         AND dlg_rtype = dsl_rtype
                                                         AND dlg_id = dld_logid
                                                         AND dld_uprecnum = zey_uprecnum
                                                         AND zey_tasknum = zfj_tasknum
                                                         AND zey_eqnum = zfj_eqnum
                                                         AND zey_location = zfj_location
                                                         AND zey_sublocation1 = zfj_sublocation1
                                                         AND zey_sublocation2 = zfj_sublocation2
                                                         AND zey_sublocation3 = zfj_sublocation3
                                                         AND zey_siteid = zfj_siteid
                                                         AND zey_upcode = zfj_upcode
                                                         AND coalesce(zfj_cvignore,N'-') = N'-'
                                                         AND dld_rstatus <> N'S')
                                  end)
             WHERE dsl_upcode = @nUploadid
               AND dsl_sourcetable = N'R5MP2TSKMETER'
               AND dsl_rtype = N'P'
        end

end

create procedure O7CVMP2_PRECAT @nUploadid     numeric(38),
                                @sSpecchars    nvarchar(20),
                                @sTranschars   nvarchar(20),
                                @sOperation    nvarchar(1)
as
begin
    SET NOCOUNT ON

    if object_id('r5mp2invvend') is null or object_id('r5mp2invvend_ext') is null or object_id('r5mp2vendor') is null or object_id('r5mp2vendor_ext') is null
        return

    if @sOperation = N'C'
        begin
            if dbo.o7cvmp2_skipvendor(@nUploadid) = N'-' AND dbo.o7cvmp2_consolidatevendorcatalog(@nUploadid) = N'+'
                begin
                    update r5mp2invvend_ext
                       set com_code = b.com_code,
                           com_org = b.com_org,
                           com_curr = b.com_curr
                      from r5companies b, r5mp2invvend c, r5mp2vendor d, r5mp2vendor_ext e
                     where r5mp2invvend_ext.zby_upcode = @nUploadid
                       and r5mp2invvend_ext.com_code is null
                       and r5mp2invvend_ext.com_org is null
                       and r5mp2invvend_ext.com_curr is null
                       and b.com_code = upper(dbo.o7cv_chrtran(dbo.o7cvmp2_getvendorid(c.zby_upcode, c.zby_vendorid, c.zby_vendorbranchid), @sSpecchars, @sTranschars))
                       and b.com_org = dbo.o7cvmp2_getvendororg(c.zby_upcode)
                       and c.zby_uprecnum = r5mp2invvend_ext.zby_uprecnum
                       and isnull(c.zby_cvignore, N'-') = N'-'
                       and d.zfu_upcode = c.zby_upcode
                       and d.zfu_vendorid = c.zby_vendorid
                       and d.zfu_vendorbranchid = c.zby_vendorbranchid
                       and isnull(d.zfu_cvignore, N'-') = N'-'
                       and d.zfu_uprecnum = e.zfu_uprecnum
                       and e.com_code is null
                       and e.com_org is null
                       and e.com_org is null
                end
        end
end

create procedure O7CVMP2_SETNEXTMETER @nUploadid     numeric(38)
as
    SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @sSeqenabled    nvarchar(100)
    declare @sFirstseq      nvarchar(100)
    declare @nNextseq       numeric(38)
    declare @bGeneratemeter bit
    declare @nReturn        int

    SELECT @sSeqenabled = CASE dxv_destvalue1 WHEN N'+' THEN N'+' ELSE N'-' END,
           @sFirstseq = dxv_destvalue2
      FROM r5dataconvxrefvalue
     WHERE dxv_upcode = @nUploadid
       AND dxv_option = N'METSUBX'
       AND dxv_srcvalue1 = N'METER'

    if @@ROWCOUNT > 0 and @sSeqenabled = N'+'
        set @bGeneratemeter = 1
    else
        set @bGeneratemeter = 0

    if @bGeneratemeter = 1
        begin
            if @sFirstseq is null
                DELETE FROM r5dataconvseqgenerator
                WHERE dsg_table = N'R5METERS'
                AND dsg_field = N'MET_CODE'
            else
                begin
                    execute @nReturn = o7cv_setnextseq N'R5METERS', N'MET_CODE', @sFirstseq, N'+'
                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                        return -1

                    UPDATE r5dataconvxrefvalue
                       SET dxv_destvalue2 = dbo.o7cv_getnextseq(N'R5METERS', N'MET_CODE')
                     WHERE dxv_upcode = @nUploadid
                       AND dxv_option = N'METSUBX'
                       AND dxv_srcvalue1 = N'METER'
                end
        end

body:
create procedure O7CVMP2_SETUPUDFS @nUploadid  numeric(38),
                                   @sMap2Udf   nvarchar(1),
                                   @sRentity   nvarchar(4)
as
    SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @sUdfprefix     nvarchar(100)
    declare @sPropertycode  nvarchar(100)
    declare @sClass         nvarchar(8)
    declare @sClassorg      nvarchar(15)
    declare @sClassdesc     nvarchar(80)
    declare @bProperties    bit
    declare @bClass         bit
    declare @nI             int

    set @sClass = N'*'
    set @sClassorg = N'*'
    set @sClassdesc = N'All Classes'
    
    if @sMap2Udf = N'+'
        return    

    if @sRentity = dbo.o7cv_sysobjentity()
        set @sUdfprefix = N'EQUD'
    else
        begin
            if @sRentity = dbo.o7cv_syscompanyentity()
                set @sUdfprefix = N'VENUD'
            else
                begin
                    if @sRentity = dbo.o7cv_syspartentity()
                        set @sUdfprefix = N'INVYUD'
                    else
                        return
                end
        end

    set @bClass = dbo.o7cvmp2_classexists( @sRentity, @sClass, @sClassorg )

    set @nI = 1
    while @nI < 11
        begin
            if dbo.o7cvmain_processudf( @nUploadid, N'UDF' + cast(@nI as nvarchar(38)) + N'#' + @sRentity, N'PROMENT') = N'+'
                begin
                    set @sPropertycode = @sUdfprefix + cast(@nI as nvarchar(38))

                    set @bProperties = 0
                    if dbo.o7cvmp2_propertyexists( @sPropertycode ) = 0
                        INSERT INTO r5properties(pro_code, pro_type, pro_text) VALUES (@sPropertycode, N'CHAR', @sPropertycode)
                    else
                        begin
                            if @bClass = 1
                                set @bProperties = dbo.o7cvmp2_propertyassociationexists( @sPropertycode, @sRentity, @sClass, @sClassorg )
                        end

                    if @bClass = 0
                        begin
                            set @bClass = 1
                            INSERT INTO r5classes(cls_rentity, cls_entity, cls_code, cls_org, cls_desc)
                            VALUES (@sRentity, dbo.o7cv_getuentity(@sRentity), @sClass, @sClassorg, @sClassdesc);
                        end

                    if @bProperties = 0
                        INSERT INTO r5addproperties(apr_property, apr_rentity, apr_class, apr_class_org, apr_line, apr_list, apr_listvalid, apr_required, apr_nonupdcat, apr_wodisp)
                        VALUES (@sPropertycode, @sRentity, @sClass, @sClassorg, dbo.o7cv_getnextpropertyline(@sClass, @sClassorg, @sRentity), N'-', N'+', N'-', N'-', N'-')
                end
            set @nI = @nI + 1
        end
