body:
create procedure O7CVMP2_STOREUDFS @nUploadid  numeric(38),
                                    @sMap2Udf   nvarchar(1),
                                    @sRentity   nvarchar(4),
                                    @nUprecnum  numeric(38)
as
    SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @sSrctable              nvarchar(30)
    declare @sSrcexttable           nvarchar(64)
    declare @sUdfprefix             nvarchar(8)
    declare @sUdfprefix_temp        nvarchar(16)
    declare @sCodefield             nvarchar(30)
    declare @sOrgfield              nvarchar(30)
    declare @sSelectsql_template    nvarchar(500)
    declare @sSelectsql             nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sSelectsql_save        nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sPropertyvaluecode     nvarchar(100)
    declare @sClass                 nvarchar(8)
    declare @sClassorg              nvarchar(15)
    declare @nPostfix               int
    declare @nReturn                int
    declare @sUdf                   nvarchar(20)
    
    -- check to see if we need to convert udf to custom fields
    if @sMap2Udf = N'+'
        return

    --set @sSelectsql_template = N'select :srcprefix_ud1, :srcprefix_ud2, :srcprefix_ud3, :srcprefix_ud4, :srcprefix_ud5, :srcprefix_ud6, :srcprefix_ud7, :srcprefix_ud8, :srcprefix_ud9, :srcprefix_ud10, :codefield + N''#'' + :orgfield from :srctable, :srcexttable where :srctable.:srcprefix_uprecnum = @uprecnum and :srctable.:srcprefix_uprecnum = :srcexttable.:srcprefix_uprecnum and :codefield + N''#'' + :orgfield <> N''#'''
    set @sSelectsql_template = N'select @udf = :srcprefix_ud:postfix, @prop = :codefield + N''#'' + :orgfield from :srctable, :srcexttable where :srctable.:srcprefix_uprecnum = @uprecnum and :srctable.:srcprefix_uprecnum = :srcexttable.:srcprefix_uprecnum and :codefield + N''#'' + :orgfield <> N''#'''
    set @sClass = N'*'
    set @sClassorg = N'*'

    if @sRentity = dbo.o7cv_sysobjentity()
        begin
            set @sSrctable = N'R5MP2EQUIP'
            set @sUdfprefix = N'EQUD'
            set @sCodefield = N'obj_code'
            set @sOrgfield = N'obj_org'
        end
    else
        begin
            if @sRentity = dbo.o7cv_syscompanyentity()
                begin
                    set @sSrctable = N'R5MP2VENDOR'
                    set @sUdfprefix = N'VENUD'
                    set @sCodefield = N'com_code'
                    set @sOrgfield = N'com_org'
                end
            else
                begin
                    if @sRentity = dbo.o7cv_syspartentity()
                        begin
                            set @sSrctable = N'R5MP2INVY'
                            set @sUdfprefix = N'INVYUD'
                            set @sCodefield = N'par_code'
                            set @sOrgfield = N'par_org'
                        end
                    else
                        return
                end
        end

    set @sSrcexttable = dbo.o7cvmain_getexttablename(@sSrctable)
    set @sSelectsql = REPLACE(@sSelectsql_template,    ':srctable',    @sSrctable)
    set @sSelectsql = REPLACE(@sSelectsql,             ':srcexttable', @sSrcexttable)
    set @sSelectsql = REPLACE(@sSelectsql,             ':srcprefix',   dbo.o7cvmp2_gettableprefix(@nUploadid, @sSrctable))
    set @sSelectsql = REPLACE(@sSelectsql,             ':codefield',   @sCodefield)
    set @sSelectsql = REPLACE(@sSelectsql,             ':orgfield',    @sOrgfield)

    set @sSelectsql_save = @sSelectsql

    if object_id(@sSrctable) is not null and object_id(@sSrcexttable) is not null
        begin
            set @nPostfix = 1
            while @nPostfix < 11
                begin
                    set @sSelectsql = REPLACE(@sSelectsql_save,    ':postfix',    cast(@nPostfix as nvarchar(38)))
                    execute @nReturn = sp_executesql @sSelectsql, N'@udf nvarchar(20) OUTPUT, @prop nvarchar(100) OUTPUT, @uprecnum numeric(38)', @sUdf OUTPUT, @sPropertyvaluecode OUTPUT, @nUprecnum
                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                        return -1

                    if @sPropertyvaluecode is not null
                        begin
                            if dbo.o7cvmain_processudf( @nUploadid, N'UDF' + cast( @nPostfix as nvarchar(38)) + N'#' + @sRentity, N'PROMENT') = N'+'
                                begin
                                    set @sUdfprefix_temp = @sUdfprefix + cast( @nPostfix as nvarchar(38))
                                    execute @nReturn = o7prop_store_value @sUdfprefix_temp, @sRentity, @sUdf, @sClass, @sClassorg, @sPropertyvaluecode, N'CHAR', null
                                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                        return -1
                                end
                        end

                    set @nPostfix = @nPostfix + 1
                end
        end

create function O7CV_CHRTRAN( @sText        nvarchar(4000),
                              @sFindchrs    nvarchar(20),
                              @sReplacechrs nvarchar(20))
returns nvarchar(4000)
as
begin
    declare @sReturn   nvarchar(4000)
    declare @nI        int
    declare @sSpecchar nvarchar(1)

    if @sText is null or LEN( @sText ) = 0 or @sFindchrs is null or LEN( @sFindchrs ) = 0
        set @sReturn = @sText
    else
        begin
            set @sReturn = @sText 
            set @nI = 1

            while @nI <= len( @sFindchrs )
                begin
                    set @sSpecchar = substring( @sFindchrs, @nI, 1 )
                    if charindex( @sSpecchar, @sReturn ) > 0
                        set @sReturn = replace(@sReturn, @sSpecchar, coalesce( substring(@sReplacechrs, @nI, 1), '') )
                    set @nI = @nI + 1
                end
        end

    return @sReturn
end

            if @dDatein is null
                set @dReturn = null

                    set @dReturn = DateAdd( hh, DatePart( hh, @dTimein ), @dReturn )
                    set @dReturn = DateAdd( mi, DatePart( mi, @dTimein ), @dReturn )
                    set @dReturn = DateAdd( ss, DatePart( ss, @dTimein ), @dReturn )
                end
        end
 
    return @dReturn

create procedure O7CV_DELETEEVENTS
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sCode  nvarchar(30)

    --We have to assume that a temporary table named #tCVEvents was created by the calling procedure
    if exists ( select 1 from #tCVEvents )
        begin
            begin try
                exec( N'ALTER TABLE R5EVENTS DISABLE TRIGGER PREDEL_EVT' )
                declare c_cv_events cursor local for select evt_code from #tCVEvents
                open c_cv_events
                fetch next from c_cv_events into @sCode
                while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                    begin
                        UPDATE r5events
                           SET evt_rstatus = N'A'
                         WHERE evt_code = @sCode

                        DELETE FROM r5customerrequesthistory 
                        WHERE crh_event = @sCode

                        DELETE FROM r5events WHERE evt_code = @sCode
        
                        fetch next from c_cv_events into @sCode
                    end
                close c_cv_events
                deallocate c_cv_events

                exec( N'ALTER TABLE R5EVENTS ENABLE TRIGGER PREDEL_EVT' )
            end try 
            begin catch
                declare @sErrorMessage  nvarchar(4000)
                declare @nErrorSeverity int
                declare @nErrorState    int

                select @sErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(),
                       @nErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(),
                       @nErrorState = ERROR_STATE()

                close c_cv_events
                deallocate c_cv_events
                exec( N'ALTER TABLE R5EVENTS ENABLE TRIGGER PREDEL_EVT' )

                RAISERROR(@sErrorMessage, @nErrorSeverity, @nErrorState)
            end catch
        end

name: O7CV_FORMATADDRESS
body:
create function O7CV_FORMATADDRESS( @sAddr1     nvarchar(500),
                                    @sAddr2     nvarchar(500),
                                    @sAddr3     nvarchar(500),
                                    @sCity      nvarchar(500),
                                    @sState     nvarchar(500), 
                                    @sZip       nvarchar(500),
                                    @sCountry   nvarchar(500) )
returns nvarchar(2000)
as
begin
    declare @sAddrtext  nvarchar(2000)

    if @sAddr1 is null and @sAddr2 is null and @sAddr3 is null and @sCity is null and 
       @sState is null and @sZip is null and @sCountry is null
        set @sAddrtext = null
    else
        begin
            set @sAddrtext = coalesce( @sAddr1, N'' )
            if @sAddr1 is not null
                set @sAddrtext = @sAddrtext + char(10)

            set @sAddrtext = @sAddrtext + coalesce( @sAddr2, N'' )
            if @sAddr2 is not null
                set @sAddrtext = @sAddrtext + char(10)

            set @sAddrtext = @sAddrtext + coalesce( @sAddr3, N'' )
            if @sAddr3 is not null
                set @sAddrtext = @sAddrtext + char(10)

            set @sAddrtext = @sAddrtext + coalesce( @sCity, N'' )
            if @sCity is not null
                set @sAddrtext = @sAddrtext + N' '

            set @sAddrtext = @sAddrtext + coalesce( @sState, N'' )
            if @sState is not null
                set @sAddrtext = @sAddrtext + N' '

            set @sAddrtext = @sAddrtext + coalesce( @sZip, N'' )
            if @sCity is not null or @sState is not null or @sZip is not null
                set @sAddrtext = @sAddrtext + char(10)

            set @sAddrtext = @sAddrtext + coalesce( @sCountry, N'' )
        end
    
    return @sAddrtext
end

create procedure O7CV_POSPPO    @nCode      int,
                                @nRevision  numeric(4),
                                @sOperation nvarchar(4)
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sPpoPpm        nvarchar(20)
    declare @nPpoRevision   numeric(4)
    declare @nPpoPk         int
    declare @nReturn        int

    create table #tCVEvents ( evt_code nvarchar(30) NOT NULL )

    if @sOperation = N'R'
        begin
            declare c_cv_posppo cursor local for select ppo_ppm, ppo_revision, ppo_pk
                                                   FROM r5ppmobjects 
                                                  WHERE ppo_pk = @nCode AND ppo_revision = @nRevision
            open c_cv_posppo
            fetch next from c_cv_posppo into @sPpoPpm, @nPpoRevision, @nPpoPk
            while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                begin
                    insert into #tCVEvents select evt_code FROM r5events
                                            WHERE evt_ppm = @sPpoPpm
                                              AND evt_ppmrev = @nPpoRevision
                                              AND evt_ppopk = @nPpoPk
                    execute @nReturn = o7cv_deleteevents
                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                        begin
                            close c_cv_posppo
                            deallocate c_cv_posppo
                            drop table #tCVEvents
                            return -1
                        end
                    truncate table #tCVEvents
                    fetch next from c_cv_posppo into @sPpoPpm, @nPpoRevision, @nPpoPk
                end
            close c_cv_posppo
            deallocate c_cv_posppo
        end

    if @sOperation = N'C'
        begin
            declare c_cv_posppo cursor local for select ppo_ppm, ppo_revision, ppo_pk
                                                   FROM r5ppmobjects 
                                                  WHERE ppo_pk = @nCode AND ppo_revision = @nRevision
            open c_cv_posppo
            fetch next from c_cv_posppo into @sPpoPpm, @nPpoRevision, @nPpoPk
            while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                begin
                    UPDATE r5ppmobjects
                       SET ppo_changed = '+'
                     WHERE ppo_pk = @nPpoPk
                       AND ppo_revision = @nPpoRevision
                       AND ppo_changed <> '+'

                    execute @nReturn = o7pmappr null, @sPpoPpm, @nPpoRevision, @nPpoPk, null, null
                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                        begin
                            close c_cv_posppo
                            deallocate c_cv_posppo
                            drop table #tCVEvents
                            return -1
                        end

                    UPDATE r5ppmobjects
                       SET ppo_changed = '-'
                     WHERE ppo_pk = @nPpoPk
                       AND ppo_revision = @nPpoRevision
                       AND ppo_changed <> '-'

                    fetch next from c_cv_posppo into @sPpoPpm, @nPpoRevision, @nPpoPk
                end
            close c_cv_posppo
            deallocate c_cv_posppo
        end

    drop table #tCVEvents

create procedure O7CV_POSSTC    @sChild         nvarchar(30),
                                @sChildorg      nvarchar(15),
                                @sParent        nvarchar(30),
                                @sParentorg     nvarchar(15)
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @nReturn            int
    declare @sChk               nvarchar(4)
    declare @sEventno           nvarchar(30)
    declare @sEtype             nvarchar(4)
    declare @sErtype            nvarchar(4)
    declare @sEstatus           nvarchar(4)
    declare @sErstatus          nvarchar(4)

    declare @sRecChildrtype     nvarchar(4)
    declare @sRecChildtype      nvarchar(4)
    declare @sRecChild          nvarchar(30)
    declare @sRecChild_org      nvarchar(15)
    declare @sRecParentrtype    nvarchar(4)
    declare @sRecParenttype     nvarchar(4)
    declare @sRecParent         nvarchar(30)
    declare @sRecParent_org     nvarchar(15)
    declare @sRecRolldown       nvarchar(1)
    declare @dRecUpdated        datetime
    declare @sRecCode           nvarchar(30)
    declare @sRecLang           nvarchar(2)

    declare @sTempUpdated       datetime

    declare c_cv_posstc_rec cursor local for SELECT stc_child, stc_child_org, stc_childtype, stc_childrtype, stc_parent, stc_parent_org, stc_parenttype, stc_parentrtype, stc_updated, stc_rolldown, usr_code, usr_lang
                                              FROM r5structures, r5objects, r5users
                                             WHERE stc_child = @sChild
                                               AND stc_child_org = @sChildorg
                                               AND stc_parent = @sParent
                                               AND stc_parent_org = @sParentorg
                                               AND obj_code = stc_child
                                               AND obj_org = stc_child_org
                                               AND usr_code = obj_user
    open c_cv_posstc_rec
    fetch next from c_cv_posstc_rec into @sRecChild, @sRecChild_org, @sRecChildtype, @sRecChildrtype, 
                                         @sRecParent, @sRecParent_org, @sRecParenttype, @sRecParentrtype,
                                         @dRecUpdated, @sRecRolldown, @sRecCode, @sRecLang
    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        begin
            set @sErstatus = N'C'
            if @sRecParentrtype = N'L'
                begin
                    if @sRecChildrtype = N'L'
                        set @sErtype = N'LL'
                    else
                        set @sErtype = N'PL'
                end
            else
                set @sErtype = N'AO'

            if @dRecUpdated is not null
                set @sTempUpdated = @dRecUpdated 
            else
                begin
                  	execute @nReturn = o7gttime @sTempUpdated OUTPUT, @sRecChild_org
                  	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                        begin
                            close c_cv_posstc_rec
                            deallocate c_cv_posstc_rec
                            return -1
                        end
                end

            execute @nReturn = o7crevtx @sEventno OUTPUT, @sTempUpdated, @sRecCode, @sEtype OUTPUT, @sErtype OUTPUT,
                                        @sEstatus OUTPUT, @sErstatus OUTPUT, null, N'*', null, null, null,
                                        @sRecLang, @sRecParent OUTPUT, @sRecParenttype OUTPUT, @sRecParentrtype OUTPUT, @sRecChild, @sRecChild_org, 
                                        @sRecChildtype OUTPUT, @sRecChildrtype OUTPUT, 1, N'+', null, null, null, @sChk OUTPUT
            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                begin
                    close c_cv_posstc_rec
                    deallocate c_cv_posstc_rec
                    return -1
                end

            if @sChk <> N'0'
                begin
                    execute o7rae N'O7CREVTX', N'PROC', @sChk, @@ERROR
                    close c_cv_posstc_rec
                    deallocate c_cv_posstc_rec
                    return -1
                end

            execute @nReturn = o7creob1 @sEventno, @sErtype, @sRecParent, @sRecParent_org, @sRecParenttype OUTPUT, @sRecParentrtype OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                begin
                    close c_cv_posstc_rec
                    deallocate c_cv_posstc_rec
                    return -1
                end

            if @sChk <> N'0'
                begin
                    execute o7rae N'O7CREOB1', N'PROC', @sChk, @@ERROR
                    close c_cv_posstc_rec
                    deallocate c_cv_posstc_rec
                    return -1
                end

            execute @nReturn = o7creob1 @sEventno, @sErtype, @sRecChild, @sRecChild_org, @sRecChildtype OUTPUT, @sRecChildrtype OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                begin
                    close c_cv_posstc_rec
                    deallocate c_cv_posstc_rec
                    return -1
                end

            if @sChk <> N'0'
                begin
                    execute o7rae N'O7CREOB1', N'PROC', @sChk, @@ERROR
                    close c_cv_posstc_rec
                    deallocate c_cv_posstc_rec
                    return -1
                end

            execute @nReturn = o7upobj3 N'INS', @sRecChildtype, @sRecChild, @sRecChild_org, @sRecParenttype, @sRecParent, @sRecParent_org, null, @sRecRolldown, @sChk OUTPUT
            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                begin
                    close c_cv_posstc_rec
                    deallocate c_cv_posstc_rec
                    return -1
                end

            if @sChk <> N'0'
                begin
                    execute o7rae N'O7UPOBJ3', N'PROC', @sChk, @@ERROR
                    close c_cv_posstc_rec
                    deallocate c_cv_posstc_rec
                    return -1
                end

            fetch next from c_cv_posstc_rec into @sRecChild, @sRecChild_org, @sRecChildtype, @sRecChildrtype, 
                                                 @sRecParent, @sRecParent_org, @sRecParenttype, @sRecParentrtype,
                                                 @dRecUpdated, @sRecRolldown, @sRecCode, @sRecLang
        end
    close c_cv_posstc_rec
    deallocate c_cv_posstc_rec

create procedure O7CV_PREBIS    @sPart      nvarchar(30),
                                @sPartOrg   nvarchar(15),
                                @sStore     nvarchar(15),
                                @sBin       nvarchar(15),
                                @sLot       nvarchar(12),
                                @sOperation nvarchar(4)
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sTranscode    nvarchar(30)
    declare @sTransstatus  nvarchar(4)

    if @sOperation = N'R'
        begin
            declare c_trl cursor local for select trl_trans, tra_rstatus from r5translines, r5transactions where trl_part = @sPart and trl_part_org = @sPartOrg and trl_store = @sStore and trl_bin = @sBin and trl_lot = @sLot and trl_trans = tra_code
            open c_trl
            fetch next from c_trl into @sTranscode, @sTransstatus
            while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                begin
                    if @sTransstatus <> N'U'
                        begin
                            begin try
                                exec( N'ALTER TABLE R5TRANSACTIONS DISABLE TRIGGER PREUPD_TRA' )

                                UPDATE r5transactions
                                   SET tra_rstatus = N'U'
                                 WHERE tra_code = @sTranscode

                                exec( N'ALTER TABLE R5TRANSACTIONS ENABLE TRIGGER PREUPD_TRA' )
                            end try 
                            begin catch
                                declare @sErrorMessage  nvarchar(4000)
                                declare @nErrorSeverity int
                                declare @nErrorState    int
                
                                select @sErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(),
                                       @nErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(),
                                       @nErrorState = ERROR_STATE()
                
                                close c_trl
                                deallocate c_trl
                                exec( N'ALTER TABLE R5TRANSACTIONS ENABLE TRIGGER PREUPD_TRA' )
                
                                RAISERROR(@sErrorMessage, @nErrorSeverity, @nErrorState)
                            end catch
                        end

                    DELETE FROM r5translines
                     WHERE trl_trans = @sTranscode

                    DELETE FROM r5transactions
                     WHERE tra_code = @sTranscode

                    fetch next from c_trl into @sTranscode, @sTransstatus
                end
            close c_trl
            deallocate c_trl

            UPDATE r5binstock 
               SET bis_qty = 0 
             WHERE bis_part = @sPart
               AND bis_part_org = @sPartOrg
               AND bis_store = @sStore
               AND bis_bin = @sBin
               AND bis_lot = @sLot
        end

create procedure O7CV_PRESTC    @nUprecnum numeric(38,0),
                                @nLogid     numeric(38,0),
                                @sInsstmt   nvarchar(4000)
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @sChk           nvarchar(4)
    declare @sChildrtype    nvarchar(4)
    declare @sChildtype     nvarchar(4)
    declare @sChild         nvarchar(30)
    declare @sChild_org     nvarchar(15)
    declare @sParentrtype   nvarchar(4)
    declare @sParenttype    nvarchar(4)
    declare @sParent        nvarchar(30)
    declare @sParent_org    nvarchar(15)
    declare @sRolldown      nvarchar(1)
    declare @sRollup        nvarchar(1)
    
    declare @sSQL           nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sParms         nvarchar(1000)
    declare @sDoc           nvarchar(max)
    declare @nHandle        int    
    declare @sColumnValue   nvarchar(max)
    declare @sColumnName    nvarchar(128)    
    declare @nReturn        int
    declare @nI             int
    
    --format passed in SQL for SQL Server
    
    set @nI = charindex('select', @sInsstmt)
    set @sSQL = substring( @sInsstmt, @nI, len(@sInsstmt) - @nI + 1)
    set @sSQL = replace( @sSQL, N':uprecnum', N'@uprecnum')    
    set @sSQL = N'set @sDoc = (' + @sSQL + N' FOR XML AUTO)'
    
    execute sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@sDoc nvarchar(max) OUTPUT, @uprecnum numeric(38)', @sDoc OUTPUT, @nUprecnum
    set @sDoc = N'<DATA>' + @sDoc + N'</DATA>'

    execute sp_xml_preparedocument @nHandle OUTPUT, @sDoc
    select * into #tXMLResults from openxml(@nHandle, '/DATA/') order by id
    
    
    declare c_c1 cursor local for select c.text, p.localname
                                    from #tXMLResults c, #tXMLResults p
                                   where c.localname = N'#text'
                                     and c.parentid  = p.id
    open c_c1 
    fetch next from c_c1 into @sColumnValue, @sColumnName
    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        begin
            if @sColumnName = N'STC_CHILDRTYPE'
                set @sChildrtype = @sColumnValue
            else if @sColumnName = N'STC_CHILDTYPE'
                set @sChildtype = @sColumnValue
            else if @sColumnName = N'STC_CHILD_ORG'
                set @sChild_org = @sColumnValue
            else if @sColumnName = N'STC_CHILD'
                set @sChild = @sColumnValue
            else if @sColumnName = N'STC_PARENTRTYPE'
                set @sParentrtype = @sColumnValue
            else if @sColumnName = N'STC_PARENTTYPE'
                set @sParenttype = @sColumnValue
            else if @sColumnName = N'STC_PARENT_ORG'
                set @sParent_org = @sColumnValue
            else if @sColumnName = N'STC_PARENT'
                set @sParent = @sColumnValue
            else if @sColumnName = N'STC_ROLLDOWN'
                set @sRolldown = @sColumnValue
            else if @sColumnName = N'STC_ROLLUP'
                set @sRollup = @sColumnValue            
            
            fetch next from c_c1 into @sColumnValue, @sColumnName
        end
    close c_c1
    deallocate c_c1
    execute sp_xml_removedocument @nHandle    
    
    execute @nReturn = o7prestc N'INS', @sChildrtype, @sChildtype, @sChild, @sChild_org, @sParentrtype, @sParenttype, @sParent, @sParent_org, @sRolldown, @sRollup, N'-', N'-', @sChk OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        return -1

    if @sChk <> N'0'
        begin
            execute o7rae N'O7PRESTC', N'PROC', @sChk, @@ERROR
            return -1
        end

create procedure O7CV_SETNEXTSEQ    @sTablename     nvarchar(30), 
                                    @sFieldname     nvarchar(30), 
                                    @nNextval       numeric(38,0),
                                    @sMakeunique    nvarchar(1)
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    
    declare @nNextseq   numeric(38,0)
    declare @nReccnt    int
    declare @sConcat    nvarchar(4000)
    declare @nReturn    int

    select @nNextseq = dsg_next
      FROM r5dataconvseqgenerator
     WHERE dsg_table = @sTablename
       AND dsg_field = @sFieldname

    if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
        begin
            if @nNextval is null
                INSERT INTO r5dataconvseqgenerator
                    (dsg_table, dsg_field)
                VALUES
                    (@sTablename, @sFieldname) 
            else
                begin
                    INSERT INTO r5dataconvseqgenerator
                        (dsg_table, dsg_field, dsg_next)
                    VALUES
                        (@sTablename, @sFieldname, @nNextval)

                    if @sMakeunique <> N'+'
                        return
                end

            select @nNextseq = dsg_next
              FROM r5dataconvseqgenerator
             WHERE dsg_table = @sTablename
               AND dsg_field = @sFieldname
        end

    if @sMakeunique = N'+'
        begin
            set @sConcat = N'where ' + @sFieldname + N'=''' + cast(@nNextseq as nvarchar(38)) + N''''
            execute @nReturn = o7reccnt @sTablename, @sConcat, @nReccnt OUTPUT
            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                return -1

            while @nReccnt > 0
                begin
                    set @nNextseq = @nNextseq + 1
                    set @sConcat = N'where ' + @sFieldname + N'=''' + cast(@nNextseq as nvarchar(38)) + N''''
                    execute @nReturn = o7reccnt @sTablename, @sConcat, @nReccnt OUTPUT
                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                        return -1
                end
        end
    else
        set @nNextseq = @nNextval

    UPDATE r5dataconvseqgenerator
       SET dsg_next = @nNextseq
     WHERE dsg_table = @sTablename
       AND dsg_field = @sFieldname

create procedure O7CV_UPDATESTOCK   @sPart      nvarchar(30),
                                    @sPartorg   nvarchar(15),
                                    @sStore     nvarchar(15),
                                    @sBin       nvarchar(15),
                                    @sLot       nvarchar(12)
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @nReturn        int
    declare @sCpstor        nvarchar(15)
    declare @nMinlev        numeric(24,6)
    declare @nOrdlev        numeric(24,6)
    declare @nOrdqty        numeric(24,6)
    declare @sPrefstore     nvarchar(15)
    declare @sPrefsup       nvarchar(30)
    declare @sPrefsup_org   nvarchar(15)

    UPDATE r5binstock
       SET bis_qty = coalesce(bis_qty, 0) + 1
     WHERE bis_part = @sPart
       AND bis_part_org = @sPartorg
       AND bis_store = @sStore
       AND bis_bin = @sBin
       AND bis_lot = @sLot
    if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
        begin
            if not exists( select 1 from r5stock
                             WHERE sto_part = @sPart
                               AND sto_part_org = @sPartorg
                               AND sto_store = @sStore )
                begin
                    if upper( dbo.o7cv_getinstallparam( N'DEFSTOCK')) in (N'+', N'YES', N'Y', N'ON')
                        begin
                            execute @nReturn = o7cpstor @sCpstor OUTPUT, @sStore
                            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                return -1

                            SELECT @nMinlev = sto_minlev, @nOrdlev = sto_ordlev, @nOrdqty = sto_ordqty, 
                                   @sPrefstore = sto_prefstore, @sPrefsup = sto_prefsup, @sPrefsup_org = sto_prefsup_org
                              FROM r5stock
                             WHERE sto_part = @sPart
                               AND sto_part_org = @sPartorg
                               AND sto_store = @sCpstor
                        end

                    INSERT INTO r5stock
                        (sto_part, sto_part_org, sto_store, sto_qty, sto_minlev, sto_ordlev, sto_ordqty, sto_prefstore, sto_prefsup, sto_prefsup_org, sto_pricetype)
                    SELECT @sPart, @sPartorg, @sStore, 0, @nMinlev, @nOrdlev, @nOrdqty, @sPrefstore, @sPrefsup, @sPrefsup_org, str_pricetype
                    FROM r5stores
                    WHERE str_code = @sStore
                    
                end
            INSERT INTO r5binstock
              (bis_part, bis_part_org, bis_store, bis_qty, bis_lot, bis_bin)
            VALUES
              (@sPart, @sPartorg, @sStore, 1, @sLot, @sBin)
        end

create function O7DATECLOSED(	 @dChkDate datetime )
returns bit
as
begin
    declare @dLastDate		datetime 
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @nBit			bit
		
	SELECT @dLastDate = MAX(c.clp_closed), @nCountit = COUNT(*)
	FROM   r5closedperiods c

	if @nCountit = 0 
		set @nBit = 0
	else
		begin
			if @dLastDate>= @dChkDate
				set @nBit = 1
			else
				set @nBit = 0
		end
	RETURN (@nBit)

end

name: [dbo].[O7DEACTIVATEMPEQUIP]
body:
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[O7DEACTIVATEMPEQUIP]
@sMP              nvarchar(30),
@sMP_org          nvarchar(15),
@nMP_rev          numeric(4),
@sMP_obj          nvarchar(30),
@sMP_obj_org      nvarchar(15),
@schk             nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
as

SET NOCOUNT ON
declare @sWorkorder         nvarchar(30)
declare @sWorstatus         nvarchar(4)
declare @sEquipstatus        nvarchar(4)
declare @allowdup             nvarchar( 1 );
declare @cnt                  numeric;


/* set some initial values */
set @schk = N'0'

IF @nMP_rev IS NULL OR @sMP IS NULL OR @sMP_obj IS NULL
BEGIN
	set @schk = N'1'
	RETURN
END

/* Check equipment status. */

SELECT @sEquipstatus=peq_status, @allowdup = mtp_allowduplicatewo
FROM   r5maintenancepatterns, r5patternequipment
WHERE  mtp_code       = peq_mp
AND    mtp_org        = peq_mp_org
AND    mtp_revision   = peq_revision
AND    peq_mp         = @sMP
AND    peq_mp_org     = @sMP_org
AND    peq_revision   = @nMP_rev
AND    peq_object     = @sMP_obj
AND    peq_object_org = @sMP_obj_org

IF @sEquipstatus IS NULL
BEGIN
/* IF equipment is invalid then throw invalid equipment exception*/
	set @schk = N'3'
	RETURN
END

IF @sEquipstatus = N'I'
BEGIN
	set @schk = N'2'
	RETURN
END

IF @allowdup = '-'
  BEGIN
	SELECT @sWorkorder=evt_code, @sWorstatus=evt_rstatus
	FROM   r5events
	WHERE  evt_mp         = @sMP
	AND    evt_mp_org     = @sMP_org
	AND    evt_mp_rev     = @nMP_rev
	AND    evt_object     = @sMP_obj
	AND    evt_object_org = @sMP_obj_org
	AND    evt_rstatus   <> N'C'

	IF @sWorkorder IS NULL OR @sWorstatus IS NULL
	BEGIN
	/* IF Work order is invalid then throw invalid WO exception*/
		set @schk = N'4'
		RETURN
	END

	/* delete the awaiting WO. */
	IF @sWorstatus =N'A'
		DELETE FROM r5events
		WHERE  evt_code = @sWorkorder
  END
ELSE
  BEGIN
  /* For duplicates, get number of Released WOs. */
    SELECT @cnt=COUNT(*)
    FROM   r5events
    WHERE  evt_mp         = @sMP
    AND    evt_mp_org     = @sMP_org 
    AND    evt_mp_rev     = @nMP_rev
    AND    evt_object     = @sMP_obj 
    AND    evt_object_org = @sMP_obj_org
    AND    evt_rstatus    = N'R';
    IF @cnt = 0 
      SET @sWorstatus = N'A';
    ELSE
      SET @sWorstatus = N'R';
  END

/* update equipment status to (Pending) Inactive. */
UPDATE r5patternequipment
SET    peq_status = CASE @sWorstatus WHEN N'A' THEN  N'I' ELSE N'P' END
WHERE  peq_mp         = @sMP
AND    peq_mp_org     = @sMP_org
AND    peq_revision   = @nMP_rev
AND    peq_object     = @sMP_obj
AND    peq_object_org = @sMP_obj_org

CREATE PROCEDURE O7DEADD1 
	@sRentity   nvarchar(4),
	@sEnttype   nvarchar(4),
	@sEntcode   nvarchar(100),
	@sChk       nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
   
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nCount             integer
BEGIN
	set @sChk      = N'0'
	set @nCount  =  0

	IF @sRentity IS NULL
	OR @sEnttype IS NULL
	OR @sEntcode IS NULL  
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end


	SELECT @nCount = COUNT(*)
	FROM   r5entities e
	WHERE  e.ent_rentity = @sRentity
	IF @nCount < 1 
		begin
			set @sChk     = N'2'
			RETURN
		end

	select @nCount = count(*) 
	FROM r5addetails
	WHERE  add_rentity = @sRentity
	AND    add_type    = @sEnttype
	AND    add_code    = @sEntcode

	if @nCount > 0 
		DELETE FROM r5addetails
		WHERE  add_rentity = @sRentity
		AND    add_type    = @sEnttype
		AND    add_code    = @sEntcode

END

create PROCEDURE O7DEBDT1  @sBudget      nvarchar(17),
                                       @sYear        nvarchar(8),
                                       @nLevel       numeric(1),
                                       @sPeriod      nvarchar(4),
                                       @sMrc         nvarchar(15),
                                       @sLocation    nvarchar(30),
                                       @sLocationorg nvarchar(15),
                                       @sObject      nvarchar(30),
                                       @sObjectorg   nvarchar(15),
                                       @sJobtype     nvarchar(8),
                                       @sCosttype    nvarchar(4),
									   @sCostcode	 nvarchar(30),
                                       @sProject      nvarchar(20),
                                       @sMrcgr       nvarchar(5),
                                       @sLocationgr  nvarchar(5),
                                       @sObjectgr    nvarchar(5),
                                       @sJobtypegr   nvarchar(5),
                                       @sCosttypegr  nvarchar(5),
									   @sCostcodegr   nvarchar(5),
                                       @sProjectgr    nvarchar(5),
                                       @sChk         nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
AS SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sSQL nvarchar(3000)  
	declare @sPerclause nvarchar(200) 
	declare @sMrcclause nvarchar(200) 
	declare @sLocclause nvarchar(200) 
	declare @sObjclause nvarchar(200) 
	declare @sJbtclause nvarchar(200) 
	declare @sCstclause nvarchar(200) 

	declare @sCscclause nvarchar(200) 
	declare @sPrjclause nvarchar(200) 



BEGIN
	set @sChk = N'0'
	set @sPerclause = N''
	set @sMrcclause = N''
	set @sLocclause = N''
	set @sObjclause = N''
	set @sJbtclause = N''
	set @sCstclause = N''
	set @sCscclause = N''
	set @sPrjclause = N''

	set @sSQL = N' DELETE FROM r5budgetdetails WHERE  bdt_budget = N''' + @sBudget + 
				N''' AND    bdt_year   = N''' + @sYear +
				N''' AND    bdt_level  > N''' + cast( @nLevel as nvarchar(38) ) + ''''

	IF @sPeriod IS NOT NULL 
		set @sPerclause = N' AND bdt_period = N''' + @sPeriod + N''''
	IF @sMrc IS NOT NULL 
		set @sMrcclause = N' AND bdt_mrc = N''' + @sMrc + N''''
	IF @sMrcgr IS NOT NULL 
		set @sMrcclause = N' AND bdt_mrcgr = N''' + @sMrcgr + N''''
	IF @sLocation IS NOT NULL 
		set @sLocclause = N' AND bdt_location     = N''' + @sLocation + N'''' + N' AND bdt_location_org = N''' + @sLocationorg + N''''
	IF @sLocationgr IS NOT NULL 
		set @sLocclause = N' AND bdt_locationgr = N''' + @sLocationgr + N''''
	IF @sObject IS NOT NULL 
		set @sObjclause = N' AND bdt_object     = N''' + @sObject + N'''' + N' AND bdt_object_org = N''' + @sObjectorg + N''''
	IF @sObjectgr IS NOT NULL 
		set @sObjclause = N' AND bdt_objectgr = N''' + @sObjectgr + N''''
	IF @sJobtype IS NOT NULL 
		set @sJbtclause = N' AND bdt_jobtype = N''' + @sJobtype + N''''
	IF @sJobtypegr IS NOT NULL 
		set @sJbtclause = N' AND bdt_jobtypegr = N''' + @sJobtypegr + N''''
	IF @sCosttype IS NOT NULL 
		set @sCstclause = N' AND bdt_costtype = N''' + @sCosttype + N''''
	IF @sCosttypegr IS NOT NULL 
		set @sCstclause = N' AND bdt_costtypegr = N''' + @sCosttypegr + N''''

	IF @sCostcode IS NOT NULL 
		set @sCscclause = N' AND bdt_costcode = N''' + @sCostcode + N''''
	IF @sCostcodegr IS NOT NULL 
		set @sCscclause = N' AND bdt_costcodegr = N''' + @sCostcodegr + N''''
	IF @sProject IS NOT NULL 
		set @sPrjclause = N' AND bdt_project = N''' + @sProject + N''''
	IF @sProjectgr IS NOT NULL 
		set @sPrjclause = N' AND bdt_projectgr = N''' + @sProjectgr + N''''
	
	set @sSQL = @sSQL + @sPerclause + @sMrcclause + @sLocclause + @sObjclause + @sJbtclause + @sCstclause + @sCscclause + @sPrjclause


	execute sp_executesql @sSQL
	if @@ERROR <> 0
		return -1

	RETURN

END

create procedure O7DEDOC1		@sEntity        nvarchar(6),
								@sEnttype     nvarchar(4),
								@sEntcode        nvarchar(100),
								@sChk			nvarchar(4)		OUTPUT
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON 
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare	@sX				nvarchar(50)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sDocType  		nvarchar(4)	--r5documents.doc_rtype%TYPE
	declare @sDaeDocument	nvarchar(30)


	
	/* Initialize */
	set @sChk = N'0'
	set @nCountit = 0
	set @sCheckresult = N'0'
	set @sX = null

   /* Check that all mandatory parameters are supplied   */
	if @sEntity IS NULL OR @sEnttype IS NULL or @sEntcode IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			return
		end

	/* Does rentity exist ? */
	select @nCountit = count(*) 
	from   r5entities e
	where  e.ent_rentity = @sEntity
	if @nCountit < 1
		begin  
			set @sChk = N'2'
			return
		end

	declare c_DocsToDelete cursor local for 
	select   DAE_DOCUMENT
	from r5docentities
	where dae_rentity = @sEntity
	AND dae_code = @sEntcode;

	open c_DocsToDelete
	fetch next from c_DocsToDelete into @sDaeDocument

	while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		begin
			SELECT @sDocType = doc_rtype 
			FROM r5documents
			WHERE doc_code = @sDaeDocument

			if  @sDocType = N'D'
				begin
					DELETE
					FROM r5documents
					WHERE doc_code = @sDaeDocument
				end 
			fetch next from c_DocsToDelete into @sDaeDocument
		end
		
		DELETE
		FROM   r5docentities
		WHERE  dae_rentity  = @sEntity
		AND    dae_type     = @sEnttype
		AND    dae_code     = @sEntcode

	close c_DocsToDelete
	deallocate c_DocsToDelete

CREATE PROCEDURE O7DELDPS              @sCmrc          nvarchar(15),
                                       @sCprovider     nvarchar(30),
                                       @sCproviderorg  nvarchar(15),
                                       @sCsercat       nvarchar(30),
                                       @sCsercatorg    nvarchar(15),
                                       @sCserprob      nvarchar(30),
                                       @sCserproborg   nvarchar(15),
                                       @sChk           nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
AS
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sSQL           nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sParm          nvarchar(2000)

    declare @sDelclause nvarchar(500) 
    declare @sProviderclause nvarchar(100) 
    declare @sProviderorgclause nvarchar(100) 
    declare @sSercatclause   nvarchar(100) 
    declare @sSercatorgclause nvarchar(100) 
    declare @sSerprobclause  nvarchar(100) 
    declare @sSerproborgclause nvarchar(100) 

    set @sProviderclause = ''
    set @sProviderorgclause = ''
    set @sSercatclause   = ''
    set @sSercatorgclause = ''
    set @sSerprobclause  = ''
    set @sSerproborgclause = ''
    set @sChk = '0'
                                   
    IF @sCprovider IS NULL AND @sCsercat IS NULL AND @sCserprob IS NULL 
        DELETE FROM r5departmentstructure
        WHERE dps_mrc = @sCmrc
        AND   (dps_supplier IS NOT NULL
        OR   dps_servicecategory IS NOT NULL
        OR   dps_serviceproblem  IS NOT NULL)
    ELSE
        begin
            /* using dynamic sql */
            set @sDelclause = N' DELETE FROM r5departmentstructure WHERE  dps_mrc = @sCmrc '
            IF @sCprovider IS NOT NULL 
                set @sProviderclause = N' AND dps_supplier = @sCprovider'
            IF @sCproviderorg IS NOT NULL 
                set @sProviderorgclause = ' AND dps_supplier_org = @sCproviderorg '
            IF @sCsercat IS NOT NULL 
                set @sSercatclause = ' AND dps_servicecategory = @sCsercat '
            IF @sCsercatorg IS NOT NULL 
                set @sSercatorgclause = ' AND dps_servicecategory_org = @sCsercatorg '
            IF @sCserprob IS NOT NULL 
                set @sSerprobclause = ' AND dps_serviceproblem = @sCserprob '
            IF @sCserproborg IS NOT NULL 
                set @sSerproborgclause = ' AND dps_serviceproblem_org = @sCserproborg '

            set @sSQL = @sDelclause + @sProviderclause + @sProviderorgclause + @sSercatclause + @sSercatorgclause + @sSerprobclause + @sSerproborgclause

            set @sParm = N'@sCmrc nvarchar(15), @sCprovider nvarchar(30), ' + 
                     N'@sCproviderorg nvarchar(15), @sCsercat nvarchar(30), ' +
                     N'@sCsercatorg nvarchar(15), @sCserprob nvarchar(30), @sCserproborg nvarchar(15) '

            execute sp_executesql @sSQL, @sParm, @sCmrc, @sCprovider, @sCproviderorg, @sCsercat, @sCsercatorg, @sCserprob, @sCserproborg

        end

create PROCEDURE O7DELETEUSERTAB  @sFunction nvarchar(6),
                                 @sTabname  nvarchar(6)

AS
BEGIN
	declare @sCode          nvarchar(12)
	declare @sChk          nvarchar(4)
	set @sChk = '0'
    	if not exists( select 'x' from r5functiontabs where ftb_function=@sFunction and ftb_tab=@sTabname )
        begin
            set @sChk = '1'
            return
        end

	delete from r5functiontabs where ftb_function=@sFunction and ftb_tab=@sTabname
    	declare c_groups cursor local for select UGR_CODE from R5GROUPS WHERE ugr_login=N'+' and ugr_code <> N'*' and ugr_code <> N'R5DEFAULT'
    	open c_groups
	    fetch next from c_groups into @sCode
    		while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    		    begin
			delete from r5tabpermissions where trp_function=@sFunction and trp_tab=@sTabname and trp_group=@sCode
            fetch next from c_groups into @sCode
       end
    	close c_groups
    	deallocate c_groups
	delete from r5boilertexts where bot_function=@sFunction and bot_dest=N'TB' and bot_fld1=@sTabname
END

create procedure O7DELPRV		@smode        nvarchar(6),
								@srentity     nvarchar(4),
								@scode        nvarchar(100),
								@sold_class   nvarchar(8),
								@snew_class   nvarchar(8),
								@sold_clsorg  nvarchar(15),
								@snew_clsorg  nvarchar(15)


as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nCount		int
	declare @sDeforg	nvarchar(15)        --    r5propertyvalues.prv_class_org%TYPE ; 
	declare @sChk     	nvarchar(3)        
	declare @sNull    	nvarchar(1)        
	declare @nContinue 	int
	declare @nReturn	int

	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	

	set @nContinue = 1
	IF @smode IS NULL OR @srentity IS NULL OR @scode    IS NULL 
		BEGIN
			execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7DELPRV', N'PROC', 1
			set @nContinue = 0
			return -1
		END

	IF @smode = N'INS' 
		BEGIN
			SET @nContinue = 0
			SET @sNull = null
		END 

	IF @smode = N'UPD' 
		BEGIN
			IF @sold_class <> N'*' AND ( ISNULL (@snew_class, N'*') <> @sold_class OR ISNULL(@snew_clsorg, @sDeforg) <> @sold_clsorg) 
				BEGIN
					select @nCount = count(*) 
					FROM   r5propertyvalues
					WHERE  prv_rentity   = @srentity
					AND    prv_code      = @scode
					AND    prv_class     = @sold_class
					AND    prv_class_org = @sold_clsorg

					IF @nCount > 0
						BEGIN  
							execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7DELPRV', N'PROC', 3
							return -1
						END
				END
			SET @nContinue = 0
		END
	IF @smode = N'DEL' 
		BEGIN
			DELETE r5propertyvalues
			WHERE  prv_rentity = @srentity
			AND    prv_code = @scode
			AND    prv_class   = @sold_class
			AND    prv_class_org = @sold_clsorg
		END
		SET @nContinue = 0
	IF @nContinue = 1 
		BEGIN
			execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7DELPRV', N'PROC', 2
			return -1
		END

CREATE FUNCTION O7DELUCO

               ,@sEnt  NVARCHAR(8)) RETURNS NVARCHAR(1)
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE @sReturn NVARCHAR(1)
SET @sReturn = N'X'
IF @sEnt = N'JBTP'
   BEGIN
   IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5events WHERE evt_jobtype = @sCode)
      RETURN @sReturn
   IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5arcevents WHERE ave_jobtype = @sCode)
      RETURN @sReturn
   IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5arrjobs WHERE ajo_jobtype = @sCode)
      RETURN @sReturn
   IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5budgetdetails WHERE bdt_jobtype = @sCode)
      RETURN @sReturn
   IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5eventsinterface WHERE evi_jobtype = @sCode)
      RETURN @sReturn
   IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5jobtypeauth WHERE jta_jobtype = @sCode)
      RETURN @sReturn
   IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5mpevents WHERE mpe_jobtype = @sCode)
      RETURN @sReturn
   IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5mpprojects WHERE mpj_jobtype = @sCode)
      RETURN @sReturn
   IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5ppms WHERE ppm_jobtype = @sCode)
      RETURN @sReturn

create procedure O7DEMlP1
   @sEventNo	    nvarchar(100),
   @sChk            nvarchar(4)		OUTPUT 
   
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nReturn				int
	declare @sCheckresult           nvarchar(4)	


	/* Initialize */
	set @sChk         = N'0'

	/* Check mandatory parameters */
	IF @sEventNo IS NULL  
		Begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		End

	--SCR#15557 -- The following if statement was a performance enhancement.  
	--The Delete statements below could take up to .3 seconds to call even with no rows in any of the tables.
	--In some cases when the following procedure is called multiple times this slows processing down.
	--Yet, when we wrap the delete statements with an EXISTS clause the processing time is reduce significantly.

	If exists (select 1 from r5matlists WHERE  mtl_event   = @sEventNo)
	begin
		/*	 W10363- Delete Variable Materialslist (r5matlparts, r5matlists)  */
		DELETE r5matlparts
		FROM r5matlparts p, r5matlists l
		where p.mlp_matlist =  l.mtl_code
		and   l.mtl_event = @sEventNo
		and   l.mtl_code like N'V-%'
		AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
						FROM   r5activities
						WHERE  act_matlist = p.mlp_matlist
						AND    act_event <> @sEventNo )
		AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
						FROM   r5ppmacts
						WHERE  ppa_matlist = p.mlp_matlist )
		AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
						FROM   r5standwacts
						WHERE  wac_matlist = p.mlp_matlist )
		AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
						FROM   r5deferredact
						WHERE  dfa_matlist = p.mlp_matlist )

		DELETE FROM r5matlists
		WHERE  mtl_event   = @sEventNo
		AND    mtl_code LIKE N'V-%'
		AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
						FROM   r5activities
						WHERE  act_matlist = mtl_code
						AND    act_event <> @sEventNo )
		AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
						FROM   r5ppmacts
						WHERE  ppa_matlist = mtl_code )
		AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
						FROM   r5standwacts
						WHERE  wac_matlist = mtl_code )
		AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
						FROM   r5deferredact
						WHERE  dfa_matlist = mtl_code )
	end

create function O7DENORMCUSTOMFIELD(@pCustomField nvarchar(24)) returns nvarchar(8)
as
begin
  declare @sCustomField nvarchar(24)   

  -- Get just the custom field name
  set @sCustomField = substring(@pCustomField, 3, len(@pCustomField) - 2 - charindex('_', reverse(@pCustomField)))

  -- Now denormalize
  set @sCustomField = REPLACE(@sCustomField, '_aa', ' ')
  set @sCustomField = REPLACE(@sCustomField, '_vv', ':') -- This should never happen because of duplication in GenericUtility.normalizeSQLFieldName()
  set @sCustomField = REPLACE(@sCustomField, '_ww', '$')
  set @sCustomField = REPLACE(@sCustomField, '_xx', '#')
  set @sCustomField = REPLACE(@sCustomField, '_yy', '|')
  set @sCustomField = REPLACE(@sCustomField, '_zz', '}')
  set @sCustomField = REPLACE(@sCustomField, '_z', '{')
  set @sCustomField = REPLACE(@sCustomField, '_y', ']')
  set @sCustomField = REPLACE(@sCustomField, '_x', '[')
  set @sCustomField = REPLACE(@sCustomField, '_w', '.')
  set @sCustomField = REPLACE(@sCustomField, '_v', ',')
  set @sCustomField = REPLACE(@sCustomField, '_u', '''')
  set @sCustomField = REPLACE(@sCustomField, '_t', '"')
  set @sCustomField = REPLACE(@sCustomField, '_s', ':')
  set @sCustomField = REPLACE(@sCustomField, '_r', '\')
  set @sCustomField = REPLACE(@sCustomField, '_q', '/')
  set @sCustomField = REPLACE(@sCustomField, '_p', '?')
  set @sCustomField = REPLACE(@sCustomField, '_o', '>')
  set @sCustomField = REPLACE(@sCustomField, '_n', '<')
  set @sCustomField = REPLACE(@sCustomField, '_m', '~')
  set @sCustomField = REPLACE(@sCustomField, '_l', '`')
  set @sCustomField = REPLACE(@sCustomField, '_k', '=')
  set @sCustomField = REPLACE(@sCustomField, '_j', '+')
  set @sCustomField = REPLACE(@sCustomField, '_i', '-')
  set @sCustomField = REPLACE(@sCustomField, '_h', ')')
  set @sCustomField = REPLACE(@sCustomField, '_g', '(')
  set @sCustomField = REPLACE(@sCustomField, '_f', '*')
  set @sCustomField = REPLACE(@sCustomField, '_e', '&')
  set @sCustomField = REPLACE(@sCustomField, '_d', '^')
  set @sCustomField = REPLACE(@sCustomField, '_c', '@')
  set @sCustomField = REPLACE(@sCustomField, '_b', '!')
  set @sCustomField = REPLACE(@sCustomField, '_a', '%')
  
  RETURN @sCustomField
end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7DEPCL2
   @sProject	nvarchar(20),
   @sProjbud	nvarchar(20),
   @sChk       	nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
   
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sProjectPrj	nvarchar(20)

	set @sChk = N'0'
	if @sProject is null or @sProjbud is null 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			return
		end

	declare @tProjects table (	 ProjectCode nvarchar(20), LevelId int )
	insert into @tProjects  execute o7depcl2_get_hierarchy_1  @sProject

	declare cProject cursor local for select ProjectCode from @tProjects 

	OPEN cProject
	FETCH NEXT FROM cProject INTO @sProjectPrj
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
			BEGIN
				if exists ( select 1 FROM r5projbudclasses
							WHERE  pcl_project = @sProjectPrj
							AND    pcl_projbud = @sProjbud )
					DELETE FROM r5projbudclasses
					WHERE  pcl_project = @sProjectPrj
					AND    pcl_projbud = @sProjbud
				else
					break

				FETCH NEXT FROM cProject INTO @sProjectPrj
			END
	CLOSE cProject
	DEALLOCATE cProject

CREATE PROCEDURE O7DEPCL2_GET_HIERARCHY_1 (	@sCode	nvarchar(20))
as
SET NOCOUNT ON
begin
	declare @nLevel			int

	CREATE TABLE #tReturn ( prj_child nvarchar(20), LevelID int )
	CREATE TABLE #tStack( prj_child		nvarchar(20), LevelID int )		
	
	INSERT INTO #tStack 
		select	prj_code, 
				1 
		  from	r5projects
		 where	prj_parent		= @sCode	

	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM #tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select	@sCode	= prj_child
					  from	#tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into #tReturn values ( @sCode, @nLevel )
					delete from #tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND prj_child = @sCode 
					insert into #tStack	select	prj_code,
												@nLevel + 1
										  from	r5projects
										 where	prj_parent		= @sCode	
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	DROP TABLE #tStack
	SELECT * FROM #tReturn 
end

create procedure O7DEPMOB	@sObject	nvarchar(30)	OUTPUT,
							@sOrg		nvarchar(15),
							@sDepType	nvarchar(4)
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nTemp		        integer
	declare @sObdOrg		    nvarchar(15)	
    declare @sObdObject		    nvarchar(30)	
    declare @sObdDeptype		nvarchar(4)	
    declare @nNumber            numeric(38,12)
    declare @sChk               nvarchar(4)
    declare @nReturn            integer

	declare c_properties cursor local for   SELECT DISTINCT obd_object, obd_object_org, obd_deptype
                                            FROM   r5objdeptypes
                                            WHERE  obd_object  LIKE @sObject
                                            AND    obd_object_org = @sOrg
                                            AND    obd_deptype LIKE @sDepType
	open c_properties
	fetch next from c_properties into @sObdObject, @sObdOrg, @sObdDeptype
	while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		begin
			execute @nReturn = o7depobj @sObdObject, @sObdOrg, @sObdDeptype, N'F', N'NO', @nNumber OUTPUT, @nNumber OUTPUT, @nNumber OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				begin
					close c_properties
					deallocate c_properties
					rollback transaction
					return
				end

			execute @nReturn = o7depobj @sObdObject, @sObdOrg, @sObdDeptype, N'M', N'NO', @nNumber OUTPUT, @nNumber OUTPUT, @nNumber OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				begin
					close c_properties
					deallocate c_properties
					rollback transaction
					return
				end

			fetch next from c_properties into @sObdObject, @sObdOrg, @sObdDeptype
		end
	close c_properties
	deallocate c_properties

CREATE PROCEDURE O7DEPOBJ 
  @sObject    nvarchar(30),
  @sOrg       nvarchar(15),
  @sDeptype   nvarchar(4),
  @sDepmode   nvarchar,
  @sOutput    nvarchar(256),
  @nExptot    numeric(38,12) OUTPUT,
  @nBookval   numeric(38,12) OUTPUT,
  @nExptoday  numeric(38,12) OUTPUT,
  @sChk       nvarchar(4)    OUTPUT
AS
  SET NOCOUNT ON
  declare @dDate              datetime           -- death date of piece of equipment
  declare @dSdate             datetime           -- start date
  declare @dEdate             datetime           -- end date
  declare @dYdate             datetime           -- period end date
  declare @dNextsdate         datetime           -- next start date
  declare @dYears             datetime           -- year start date, used with SYD
  declare @dYeare             datetime           -- year end date, used with SYD
  declare @nRec               integer            -- record number
  declare @nExpense           numeric(38,12)     -- expense of a certrain period
  declare @nBookvalue         numeric(38,12)     -- book value at the end of a certain period
  declare @dEnddate           datetime           -- enddate of a certain period
  declare @nSyd               numeric(24,6)      -- sum of years digits
  declare @nVal               numeric(38,12)     -- value
  declare @nOldval            numeric(38,12)     -- old value
  declare @nDayval            numeric(38,12)     -- dayly value
  declare @nUnitval           numeric(38,12)     -- value per unit
  declare @nDdbval            numeric(38,12)     -- value for double declining balance
  declare @nExp               numeric(38,12)     -- expense
  declare @nTot               numeric(38,12)     -- total expenses
  declare @nRem               numeric(24,6)      -- used in calculation od syd
  declare @nNumber            numeric(38,12)     -- used in calculation od syd
  declare @nUnits             numeric(38,12)     -- used in the Unit Of Output method
  declare @nUnits2            numeric(38,12)     -- used in the Unit Of Output method
  declare @nDdb               numeric(38,12)     -- used in the Double Declining Balance method

  declare @nObd_pk            numeric
  declare @nObd_origvalue     numeric(24, 6)
  declare @nObd_estlife       numeric(8, 2)
  declare @sObd_estlifeuom    nvarchar(1)
  declare @dObj_solddate      datetime
  declare @nObd_residual      numeric(24, 6)
  declare @sObd_deprmethod    nvarchar(4)
  declare @nObd_estoutput     numeric(24, 0)
  declare @dObd_transfer      datetime
  declare @sObd_deptype       nvarchar(4)
  declare @dObd_startdate     datetime
  declare @sObd_glflag        nvarchar(2)
  declare @sObd_Depcategory   nvarchar(4)
  declare @dEnddate2          datetime
  declare @dTempDate          datetime
  declare @dClpclosed         datetime
  declare @nReturn            integer
  declare @sNewobd            nvarchar(1)

  set @nRec = 0 

  SELECT @dClpclosed = MAX( clp_closed )
  FROM   r5closedperiods
  SET @dClpclosed = ISNULL( @dClpclosed, getdate() - 42000 )

  /* Delete old results. */
  IF @sOutput <> N'ONLY' 
    DELETE FROM r5objdepreciation
    WHERE  odp_object     = @sObject
    AND    odp_object_org = @sOrg
    AND    odp_deptype LIKE @sDeptype
    AND    odp_mode       = @sDepmode
    AND    odp_startdate  > @dClpclosed
    AND    ISNULL( odp_gltransferflag, N'-' ) <> N'+'
    AND    NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
                        FROM   r5objdeptypes
                        WHERE  obd_pk = odp_parent
                        AND    ISNULL( obd_gltransferflag, N'-' ) = N'+' )

  IF @sOutput <> N'NO' 
    begin
      /* Get expense and book value. */
      set @dTempDate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( GETDATE(), N'DD')
      execute @nReturn = o7objdep @sObject, @sOrg, @sDeptype, @dTempDate, @nExptot OUTPUT, @nBookval OUTPUT
      if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
        begin
          close c_obd
          deallocate c_obd
          RETURN -1
        end
    end

  declare c_obd cursor local for 
    SELECT obd_pk,
           obd_origvalue,
           obd_estlife,
           obd_estlifeuom,
           obj_solddate,
           coalesce( obd_residual, 0 ) obd_residual,
           obd_deprmethod,
           obd_estoutput,
           obd_deptype,
           obd_startdate,
           obd_gltransferflag,
           obd_depcategory
    FROM   r5objects,
           r5objdeptypes t1
    WHERE  obj_code       = obd_object
    AND    obj_org        = obd_object_org
    AND    obd_object     = @sObject
    AND    obd_object_org = @sOrg
    AND    obd_deptype LIKE @sDeptype
    AND    obj_commiss    IS NOT NULL
    AND    obd_origvalue  IS NOT NULL
    AND    obd_estlife    IS NOT NULL
    AND    obd_estlifeuom IS NOT NULL
    AND    obd_deprmethod   IS NOT NULL
    AND  ( obd_deprmethod <> N'UOO' OR obd_estoutput IS NOT NULL )
    AND    obd_depcategory NOT IN ( N'ED', N'PPEA' )
    AND    NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
                        FROM   r5objdeptypes t2
                        WHERE  t2.obd_object     = t1.obd_object
                        AND    t2.obd_object_org = t1.obd_object_org
                        AND    t2.obd_deptype    = t1.obd_deptype
                        AND    t2.obd_startdate  = t1.obd_startdate
                        AND    t2.obd_pk         > t1.obd_pk )
    ORDER BY obd_deptype, obd_pk
  open c_obd 
  fetch next from c_obd into @nObd_pk, @nObd_origvalue, @nObd_estlife, @sObd_estlifeuom, @dObj_solddate, 
                             @nObd_residual, @sObd_deprmethod, @nObd_estoutput, @sObd_deptype, @dObd_startdate, @sObd_glflag, @sObd_Depcategory
  while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    begin
      set @sNewobd = N'+'
      set @nTot = 0
      IF @nObd_estlife   IS NOT NULL AND
        @sObd_estlifeuom IS NOT NULL 
        begin
          IF @sObd_Depcategory IN ( N'C', N'IL', N'DL' )
            begin
              /* Calculate date of death, for Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Quartly and Yearly UOMs. */
              IF @sObd_estlifeuom = N'D' 
                set @dDate = @dObd_startdate + CEILING(@nObd_estlife) - 1
              ELSE
                begin
                  IF @sObd_estlifeuom = N'W' 
                    begin
                      IF @nObd_estlife > 250000 
                        begin
                          set @sChk = N'26'
                          close c_obd
                          deallocate c_obd
                          RETURN
                        end
                      set @dDate = @dObd_startdate + CEILING( @nObd_estlife * 7.0 ) - 1
                    end
                  ELSE
                    begin
                      IF @sObd_estlifeuom = N'M' 
                        begin
                          IF @nObd_estlife > 60000 
                            begin
                              set @sChk = N'26'
                              close c_obd
                              deallocate c_obd
                              RETURN
                            end
                          set @dDate = dbo.O7ADD_MONTHS( @dObd_startdate , CEILING(@nObd_estlife) ) - 1
                        end
                      ELSE
                        begin
                          IF @sObd_estlifeuom = N'Q' 
                            begin
                              IF @nObd_estlife > 20000 
                                begin
                                  set @sChk = N'26'
                                  close c_obd
                                  deallocate c_obd
                                  RETURN
                                end
                              set @dDate = dbo.O7ADD_MONTHS( @dObd_startdate, CEILING(@nObd_estlife * 3.0)  ) - 1
                            end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7DEQUL1
   @sQuotation     nvarchar(30),
   @sSeqno         nvarchar(2),
   @nOldqty        numeric(24,6) ,
   @nOldprice      numeric(24,6) ,
   @sChk           nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nSubtotal      numeric(24,6) 
	declare @nCount		integer
BEGIN
	set @sChk = N'0'
	set @nSubtotal = 0

	IF @sQuotation IS NULL
	OR @sSeqno     IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk  = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

	select @nCount = count(*)
	from   r5quotations
	where  quo_code  = @sQuotation and
			quo_seqno = @sSeqno

	if @nCount > 0 
		select @nSubtotal = quo_total
		from   r5quotations
		where  quo_code  = @sQuotation and
				quo_seqno = @sSeqno
	else
		begin
			set @sChk  = N'2'
			RETURN
		end
		
	set @nSubtotal =  ( coalesce( @nOldqty,0 )* coalesce( @nOldprice,0 ) )


	UPDATE r5quotations
	SET    quo_total = CASE coalesce( quo_total,0 )- @nSubtotal WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE coalesce( quo_total,0 ) - @nSubtotal END
	WHERE  quo_code  = @sQuotation
	AND    quo_seqno = @sSeqno
END

create procedure  O7DESC
	@sReturnValue nvarchar(80) OUTPUT,
   @sEntCode  nvarchar(100),
   @sUtype    nvarchar(4),
   @sRtype    nvarchar(4),
   @sRentity  nvarchar(4),
   @sLang     nvarchar(2),
   @sChk      nvarchar(4) OUTPUT


AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sRetdesc        nvarchar(80)-- r5descriptions.des_text%type    /* Returned description    */
	declare @sLangwork        nvarchar(2) --r5languages.lan_code%type    /* Language of description */
	declare @sDumm             nvarchar( 4 )    /* @sDummy to get language   */
	declare @nReturn int
	declare @sTempLang nvarchar(2)
	declare @nCount 	int

	/* Initialize */
	set @sChk      = N'0'
	set @sRetdesc = NULL

	/* Check that all parameters are supplied */
	IF ( @sUtype     IS NULL       AND @sRtype   IS NULL )    OR @sEntCode     IS NULL    OR @sRentity     IS NULL
	   begin
		/* Mandatory parameter is missing */
		  set @sChk = N'1'
		  set @sReturnValue = @sRetdesc
		  RETURN
	   end

	/* Get default language (if @sLang was not specified) */
	execute @nReturn = O7LANG @sTempLang OUTPUT, @sDumm OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		RETURN -1

	set @sLangwork = coalesce( @sLang,@sTempLang)

   /* Get the descriptive text */
	IF @sUtype IS NOT NULL
		begin
			select @nCount = count(*)
			FROM   r5descriptions d
			WHERE  d.des_type    = @sUtype
			AND    d.des_rentity = @sRentity
			AND    d.des_code    = @sEntCode
			AND    d.des_lang    = @sLangwork

			if @nCount = 1
				SELECT @sRetdesc = d.des_text
				FROM   r5descriptions d
				WHERE  d.des_type    = @sUtype
				AND    d.des_rentity = @sRentity
				AND    d.des_code    = @sEntCode
				AND    d.des_lang    = @sLangwork
			else
				begin
					if @nCount > 0
						set @sChk = N'4'
					else
						set @sChk = N'3'
				end
		end

	ELSE
		begin
			select @nCount = count(*)
			FROM   r5descriptions d
			WHERE  d.des_rtype   = @sRtype
			AND    d.des_rentity = @sRentity
			AND    d.des_code    = @sEntCode
			AND    d.des_lang    = @sLangwork

			if @nCount = 1
				SELECT @sRetdesc = d.des_text
				FROM   r5descriptions d
				WHERE  d.des_rtype   = @sRtype
				AND    d.des_rentity = @sRentity
				AND    d.des_code    = @sEntCode
				AND    d.des_lang    = @sLangwork
			else
				begin
					if @nCount > 0
						set @sChk = N'4'
					else
						set @sChk = N'3'
				end
		end

   set @sReturnValue = @sRetdesc

   RETURN

create procedure O7DESCS	@sDowhat	nvarchar(3),
							@sInentity	nvarchar(4),
							@sInrentity	nvarchar(4),
							@sInutype	nvarchar(8),
							@sInrtype	nvarchar(4),
							@sEntcode	nvarchar(100),
							@sInorg		nvarchar(15),
							@sDesctext	nvarchar(255),
							@sChkresult	nvarchar(8)	OUTPUT
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sEntity	nvarchar(4)		--r5addetails.add_entity%TYPE
	declare @sRentity	nvarchar(4)		--r5descriptions.des_rentity%TYPE
	declare @sUtype		nvarchar(8)		--r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE
	declare @sRtype		nvarchar(4)		--r5ucodes.uco_rcode%TYPE
	declare @sDeflang	nvarchar(2)		--r5descriptions.des_lang%TYPE
	declare @sOrg		nvarchar(15)	--r5descriptions.des_org%TYPE
	declare @sChk		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sMultilang	nvarchar(1)		--r5entities.ent_multilang%TYPE
	declare @nRlangs	int
	declare @nRecs		int
	declare @sCode		nvarchar(100)	--r5addetails.add_code%TYPE
	declare	@sDeforg	nvarchar(15)	--r5descriptions.des_org%TYPE
	declare @sChk1		nvarchar(3)
	declare @nChk		int
	declare @nReturn	int
	declare @sLincode	nvarchar(2)

    declare @sOldtext   nvarchar(255)
    declare @sTrnslopt  nvarchar(200)
    declare @sR5user    nvarchar(255)
    declare @sUsr_lang  nvarchar(2)
    declare @sRevision  nvarchar(4)
   	declare @nPos		int
    
	
	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk1 OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	set @sChkresult	= N'0'
	set @sEntity	= @sInentity
	set @sRentity	= @sInrentity
	set @sUtype		= @sInutype
	set @sRtype		= @sInrtype
	set @sOrg		= @sInorg

	if @sDowhat not in ( N'INS', N'UPD', N'DEL' )	OR ( @sEntity is null and @sRentity is null )
												OR ( @sUtype is null and @sRtype is null )
												OR @sEntcode is null
		begin
			execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', 1
			return -1
		end

	if @sEntity is null OR @sRentity is null
		begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sRentity OUTPUT, @sEntity OUTPUT, N'ENT', @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @sChk <> N'0'
				begin
					select @sChkresult = CASE @sChk	WHEN N'1' THEN N'8'
													WHEN N'2' THEN N'2'
													WHEN N'3' THEN N'5'
													WHEN N'4' THEN N'6'
													WHEN N'5' THEN N'7'
													ELSE N'9'
												END
					set @nChk = CONVERT( int, @sChkresult )
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @nChk
					return -1
				end
		end

	if @sRentity in ( N'CLAS', N'UCOD' )
		begin
			if @sUtype is null OR @sRtype is null
				begin
					execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sRtype OUTPUT, @sUtype OUTPUT, N'ENT', @sChk OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1

					if @sChk <> N'0'
						begin
							set @nChk = CONVERT( int, @sChk )
							execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @nChk
							return -1
						end
				end
		end
	else
		begin
			if @sUtype is null OR @sRtype is null
				begin
					execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sRtype OUTPUT, @sUtype OUTPUT, @sRentity, @sChk OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1

					if @sChk <> N'0'
						begin
							execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', 3
							return -1
						end
				end
		end

	set @sOrg = coalesce( @sOrg, @sDeforg )

	if @sDowhat = 'DEL'
		begin
			if @sInrentity in ( N'PORD', N'PART', N'COMP', N'INV', N'OBJ', N'RMA', N'CLAS', N'EIV', N'FCUS', N'FBLC', N'FMRK' ) 
				set @sCode = @sEntcode + N'#' + @sOrg
			else
				set @sCode = @sEntcode

			if @sRentity = N'PREQ'
				begin
					SET @nPos = charindex( N'#', @sEntcode )
					if @nPos > 0
					begin
						SET @sCode = substring( @sEntcode, 1, @nPos - 1 )
						SET @sRevision = substring( @sEntcode, @nPos + 1, 4 )
						/* delete description if and only if the production request has revision '0'*/
						if(@sRevision = 0)
						begin
							DELETE FROM r5descriptions
							 WHERE  des_rentity  = @sRentity

			else

					 AND    des_rtype    = @sRtype

			if @sRentity <> N'DOCU'
				begin

											 WHERE	dae_rentity = @sRentity	AND

													dae_code    = @sCode		)	AND
							doc_rtype = N'D'
							
					DELETE from r5docentities
					 WHERE  dae_rentity = @sRentity
					 AND    dae_rtype   = @sRtype
					 AND    dae_code    = @sCode

					DELETE	from r5documents
					 where	doc_code in (	SELECT	dae_document
											  FROM	r5docentities
											 WHERE  dae_rentity = @sRentity
											 AND    dae_rtype   = @sRtype
											 AND    dae_code like @sCode + N'#%'	)	AND
							doc_rtype = N'D'

					DELETE from r5docentities
					 WHERE  dae_rentity = @sRentity
					 AND    dae_rtype   = @sRtype
					 AND    dae_code like @sCode + N'#%'
				end

			DELETE from r5addetails
			WHERE  add_rentity = @sRentity
			AND    add_type   = CASE @sInrentity WHEN N'OBJ' THEN N'*' ELSE @sUtype END
			AND    add_code   = @sCode

			DELETE from r5addetails
			WHERE  add_rentity = @sRentity
			AND    add_type   = CASE @sInrentity WHEN N'OBJ' THEN N'*' ELSE @sUtype END
			AND    add_code LIKE @sCode + N'#%'

			if @sRentity <> N'PROM'
				begin
					DELETE from r5propertyvalues
					 WHERE  prv_rentity = @sRentity
					 AND    prv_code    = @sCode
					
					DELETE from r5propertyvalues
					 WHERE  prv_rentity = @sRentity

			DELETE from r5address

			DELETE from r5entityparts
			WHERE  epa_rentity = @sRentity
			AND    epa_code    = @sCode
			
			return
		end

	if @sDesctext is null
		return

	select	@sDeflang = i.ins_desc
	  FROM  r5install i
	 WHERE  i.ins_code = N'DEFLANG'

	select @nRlangs = count(*) from r5langinst

	select	@sMultilang = ent_multilang

				 @sEntity,	@sRentity,	@sUtype,	@sRtype,	@sOrg,

create procedure O7DESCS1	@sInentity	nvarchar(4),
							@sInrentity	nvarchar(4),
							@sInutype	nvarchar(8),
							@sInrtype	nvarchar(4),
							@sInorg		nvarchar(15),
							@sEntcode	nvarchar(100),
							@sEvtppm	nvarchar(20),
							@sEvtppmrev    nvarchar(4)
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sEntity	nvarchar(4)		--r5addetails.add_entity%TYPE
	declare @sRentity	nvarchar(4)		--r5descriptions.des_rentity%TYPE
	declare @sUtype		nvarchar(8)		--r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE
	declare @sRtype		nvarchar(4)		--r5ucodes.uco_rcode%TYPE
	declare @sDeflang	nvarchar(2)		--r5descriptions.des_lang%TYPE
	declare @sOrg		nvarchar(15)	--r5descriptions.des_org%TYPE
	declare @sChk		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sMultilang	nvarchar(1)		--r5entities.ent_multilang%TYPE
	declare @nRlangs	int
	declare @nRecs		int
	declare @sCode		nvarchar(100)	--r5addetails.add_code%TYPE
	declare @sChk1		nvarchar(3)
	declare @nChk		int
	declare @nReturn	int
    declare @sPpmorg    nvarchar(15)
    declare @sEvtdesc   nvarchar(80)
    declare @sLinCode   nvarchar(2)


	set @sEntity	= @sInentity
	set @sRentity	= @sInrentity
	set @sUtype		= @sInutype
	set @sRtype		= @sInrtype
	set @sOrg		= @sInorg




	/*Get missing (r)entity code, if required */
	IF  @sEntity IS NULL OR @sRentity IS NULL 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sRentity OUTPUT, @sEntity OUTPUT, N'ENT', @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			IF @sChk <> N'0' 
				begin
					IF @sChk    =   N'1' 
						begin
							execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', N'8'
							return -1
						end
					IF @sChk    =   N'2' 
						begin
							execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', N'2'
							return -1
						end
					IF @sChk    =   N'3' 
						begin
							execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', N'5'
							return -1
						end
					IF @sChk    =   N'4' 
						begin
							execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', N'6'
							return -1
						end
					IF @sChk    =   N'5' 
						begin
							execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', N'7'
							return -1
						end
					else
						begin
							execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', N'9'
							return -1
						end
				end
		end
	IF @sUtype IS NULL OR @sRtype IS NULL 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sRtype OUTPUT, @sUtype OUTPUT, @sRentity, @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1			
			IF @sChk <> N'0' 
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', N'3'
					return -1
				end
		end


    /* Get number of  languages */
    SELECT @nRlangs = COUNT(*)
    FROM   r5langinst

    SELECT @sMultilang = ent_multilang
    FROM   r5entities
    WHERE  ent_rentity = @sRentity



/* Get the description of event from PPM */
	if @nRlangs > 1 AND @sMultilang = N'+' AND @sEvtppm IS NOT NULL AND @sEvtppmrev IS NOT NULL
		begin
            SELECT @sPpmorg = ppm_org
            FROM   r5ppms
            WHERE  ppm_code     = @sEvtppm
            AND    ppm_revision = @sEvtppmrev

            declare c_installedlang cursor local for SELECT lin_code FROM   r5langinst
            open c_installedlang
            fetch next from c_installedlang into	@sLinCode

            while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	            begin
                    SELECT  @sEvtdesc = des_text
                    FROM    r5descriptions
                    WHERE   des_code    = @sEvtppm
                    AND     des_lang    = @sLinCode
                    AND     des_org     = @sPpmorg
                    AND     des_rentity = N'PPM'
                    AND     des_rtype   = N'*'

                    if not exists (select 1 from r5descriptions where 
								DES_RENTITY = @sRentity and
								DES_CODE = @sEntcode and
								DES_ORG = @sOrg and
								DES_LANG = @sDeflang and
    							DES_RTYPE = @sRtype ) 
                        INSERT INTO r5descriptions  (
                        des_entity, des_rentity, des_type, des_rtype, des_org,
                        des_code,   des_lang,    des_text, des_trans )
                        VALUES(
                        @sEntity,     @sRentity,      @sUtype,    @sRtype,     @sOrg,
                        @sEntcode,    @sLinCode, @sEvtdesc, N'-')


		            fetch next from c_installedlang into	@sLinCode
	            end
            close c_installedlang
            deallocate c_installedlang
    end

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7DMDATE
               (@sObjectOrg NVARCHAR(15)
               ,@dDormEnd   DATETIME
               ,@dDormDate  DATETIME) RETURNS DATETIME
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE @dEnd  DATETIME
       ,@dDate DATETIME

SET @dEnd = @dDormEnd
SET @dDate = @dDormDate

IF @dDormEnd < dbo.O7GTTIME2(@sObjectOrg)
   WHILE @dEnd < dbo.O7GTTIME2(NULL)
         BEGIN
         SELECT @dDate = dbo.O7ADD_MONTHS( @dDate, 12 )
               ,@dEnd  = dbo.O7ADD_MONTHS( @dEnd, 12 )
         END
RETURN @dDate
END
