CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DOCINT
                 @nTranId       NUMERIC(38)
                ,@sDocument     NVARCHAR(30)
                ,@sProfile      NVARCHAR(30)
                ,@sObject       NVARCHAR(30)
                ,@sObjectOrg    NVARCHAR(15)
                ,@sObjectRType  NVARCHAR(4)
                ,@sObjectType   NVARCHAR(4)
                ,@dStartDate    DATETIME
                ,@sErrorMessage NVARCHAR(200) OUTPUT
                ,@sErrorCheck   NVARCHAR(200) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @sINEErrSource NVARCHAR(32)
       ,@sINEErrType   NVARCHAR(10)
       ,@sErrFunc      NVARCHAR(10)
       ,@sErrParm1     NVARCHAR(30)
       ,@sErrParm2     NVARCHAR(30)
       ,@sUCOCode      NVARCHAR(8)
       ,@sCheck        NVARCHAR(4)
       ,@sCheck1       NVARCHAR(3)
       ,@sDefOrg       NVARCHAR(15)
       ,@sDOCCode      NVARCHAR(30)
       ,@sDOCRType     NVARCHAR(4)
       ,@sDummy        NVARCHAR(250)
       ,@nError        INT
       ,@nReturn       INT

SELECT @sINEErrSource = N'O7DOCINT'
      ,@sINEErrType = N'ORACLE'
      ,@sErrParm1 = NULL
      ,@sErrParm2 = NULL
      ,@sErrorMessage = N''

set @sErrFunc = N'OTHER'

EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7DFLT @sDefOrg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sCheck1 OUTPUT
if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
   GOTO RAISE_ERROR

EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.R5O7_O7UCODE @sUCOCode OUTPUT, N'OBJ', N'ENT', @sCheck OUTPUT
if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
   GOTO RAISE_ERROR

set @sErrFunc = N'INS DAE'
set @sINEErrType = N'ORACLE'

SELECT @sDOCRType = doc_rtype
  FROM r5documents
 WHERE doc_code = @sDocument
IF @@ROWCOUNT != 1
   BEGIN
       set @sErrorMessage = N'Too many rows'
       GOTO RAISE_ERROR
   END

IF @sDOCRType IN (N'F', N'S')
   BEGIN
   INSERT INTO r5docentities
              (dae_document
              ,dae_entity
              ,dae_rentity
              ,dae_type
              ,dae_rtype
              ,dae_code
              ,dae_copytowo
              ,dae_printonwo
              ,dae_copytopo
              ,dae_printonpo)
   SELECT @sDocument
         ,@sUCOCode
         ,N'OBJ'
         ,@sObjectType
         ,@sObjectRType
         ,@sObject + N'#' + @sObjectOrg
         ,dae_copytowo
         ,dae_printonwo
         ,dae_copytopo
         ,dae_printonpo
     FROM r5docentities
    WHERE dae_document = @sDocument
      AND dae_rentity = N'OBJ'
      AND dae_code = @sProfile
   SET @nError = @@ERROR
   IF @nError != 0
      GOTO RAISE_ERROR
   END
ELSE
   BEGIN
   EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sDOCCode OUTPUT, N'DOCS', N'1', @sDummy OUTPUT
   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
       GOTO RAISE_ERROR

   INSERT INTO r5documents
              (doc_code
              ,doc_desc
              ,doc_rtype
              ,doc_type
              ,doc_filetype
              ,doc_filename
              ,doc_filesize
              ,doc_org)
   SELECT @sDOCCode
         ,N'OBJ' + @sObject + N'#' + @sObjectOrg
         ,doc_rtype
         ,doc_type
         ,doc_filetype
         ,@sDOCCode + N'-' + doc_filename
         ,doc_filesize
         ,doc_org
     FROM r5documents
    WHERE doc_code = @sDocument
   SET @nError = @@ERROR
   IF @nError != 0
      GOTO RAISE_ERROR

   EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7DUPBODY @sDocument, @sDOCCode
   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
       GOTO RAISE_ERROR

   INSERT INTO r5docentities
              (dae_document
              ,dae_entity
              ,dae_rentity
              ,dae_type
              ,dae_rtype
              ,dae_code
              ,dae_copytowo
              ,dae_printonwo
              ,dae_copytopo
              ,dae_printonpo)
   SELECT @sDOCCode
         ,@sUCOCode
         ,N'OBJ'
         ,@sObjectType
         ,@sObjectRType
         ,@sObject + N'#' + @sObjectOrg
         ,dae_copytowo
         ,dae_printonwo
         ,dae_copytopo
         ,dae_printonpo
     FROM r5docentities
    WHERE dae_document = @sDocument
      AND dae_rentity = N'OBJ'
      AND dae_code = @sProfile
   SET @nError = @@ERROR
   IF @nError != 0
      GOTO RAISE_ERROR
   END

set @sErrFunc = N'INS OUD'

INSERT INTO r5objusagedefs
           (oud_object
           ,oud_object_org
           ,oud_uom
           ,oud_standardlife
           ,oud_recalc
           ,oud_savedays
           ,oud_lastreaddate
           ,oud_dfltdailyusg
           ,oud_calcdailyusg
           ,oud_totalpurged
           ,oud_totalstored
           ,oud_totpurcur
           ,oud_totstrcur
           ,oud_totpurprv
           ,oud_totstrprv
           ,oud_calcdays
           ,oud_totalusage
           ,oud_parent
           ,oud_child
           ,oud_meter
           ,oud_sinceinstall
           ,oud_sincelastwork)
SELECT @sObject
      ,@sObjectOrg
      ,o.oud_uom
      ,o.oud_standardlife
      ,o.oud_recalc
      ,o.oud_savedays
      ,o.oud_lastreaddate
      ,o.oud_dfltdailyusg
      ,o.oud_calcdailyusg
      ,o.oud_totalpurged
      ,o.oud_totalstored
      ,o.oud_totpurcur
      ,o.oud_totstrcur
      ,o.oud_totpurprv
      ,o.oud_totstrprv
      ,o.oud_calcdays
      ,o.oud_totalusage
      ,o.oud_parent
      ,o.oud_child
      ,o.oud_meter
      ,o.oud_sinceinstall
      ,o.oud_sincelastwork
  FROM r5objusagedefs o
 WHERE o.oud_object = @sProfile
   AND o.oud_object_org = @sDefOrg
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                     FROM r5objusagedefs p
                    WHERE p.oud_object = @sObject
                      AND p.oud_object_org = @sObjectOrg
                      AND p.oud_uom = o.oud_uom)
SET @nError = @@ERROR
IF @nError <> 0  --DUP_VAL_ON_INDEX is handled by the not exists clause
   GOTO RAISE_ERROR

IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5documents WHERE doc_code = @sDocument AND doc_warranty = N'+')
   BEGIN
   SET @sErrFunc = N'INS WCV'
   INSERT INTO r5warcoverages
              (wcv_warranty
              ,wcv_object
              ,wcv_object_org
              ,wcv_obtype
              ,wcv_obrtype
              ,wcv_uom
              ,wcv_duration
              ,wcv_expiration
              ,wcv_expirationdate
              ,wcv_nearthreshold
              ,wcv_startusage)
   SELECT @sDocument
         ,@sObject
         ,@sObjectOrg
         ,@sObjectType
         ,@sObjectRType
         ,WCV.wcv_uom
         ,WCV.wcv_duration
         ,WCV.wcv_expiration
         ,@dStartDate + (WCV.wcv_duration / OUD.oud_dfltdailyusg)
         ,WCV.wcv_nearthreshold
         ,WCV.wcv_startusage
     FROM r5warcoverages WCV
         ,r5objusagedefs OUD
    WHERE OUD.oud_object = WCV.wcv_object
      AND OUD.oud_object_org = WCV.wcv_object_org
      AND OUD.oud_uom = WCV.wcv_uom
      AND WCV.wcv_object = @sProfile
      AND WCV.wcv_object_org = @sDefOrg
      AND WCV.wcv_warranty = @sDocument
   SET @nError = @@ERROR
   IF @nError != 0
      GOTO RAISE_ERROR      
   END
RETURN

RAISE_ERROR:
SET @sErrorCheck = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(200), @nError)
IF @nTranId = -1
   SET @sErrorMessage = SUBSTRING((@sINEErrSource + N'-' + @sErrorMessage), 1, 200)
ELSE
   EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nTranId, @sErrorCheck, @sINEErrSource, @sINEErrType, @sErrFunc, @sErrParm1, @sErrParm2, @sErrorMessage
   IF @@ERROR != 0 AND @nReturn != 0
     RETURN -1
RETURN
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7DOREAD
   @sInsdel        nvarchar(3),
   @sMeter         nvarchar(20),
   @sUom           nvarchar(30),
   @sObject        nvarchar(30),
   @sObjectorg     nvarchar(15),
   @nDiff          numeric(24,6),
   @dDate          DATETIME,
   @sChk            nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
      
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nTotalusage			numeric(24,6)
	declare @sCheckresult			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sStatus				nvarchar(8)	--r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE
	declare @nCountit				INT
	declare @dLastdate				datetime	--r5readings.rea_date%TYPE
	declare @dEnddate				datetime	--r5readings.rea_date%TYPE
	declare @nEndreading			INT
	declare @nAvgread				numeric(24,6)
	declare @nLastdiff				NUMERIC(24,6)
	declare @nTempDiff				NUMERIC(24,6)
	declare @sInspflag				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nActAct				numeric(8)
	declare @sActEvent				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sReacode				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sActMatlist			nvarchar(20)
	declare	@dReaDate				datetime
	declare	@nReaDiff				numeric(24,6)
	declare @sEvtcode				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sEvtmrc				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sEvtrtype				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sEvtobject				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sEvtobject_org			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sEvtobtype				nvarchar(4)
	declare @sEvtobrtype			nvarchar(4)	
	declare @sEvtroute				nvarchar(20)
	declare @sRoutemplate			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sOUDObject				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOUDObjectOrg			nvarchar(15)	
	declare @sOUDObtype				nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOUDObrtype			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOUDUom				nvarchar(30)
	declare @nOUDCaldays			numeric(3)
	declare @nOUDTotalUsage			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nReturn				int
	declare @sUom1           		nvarchar(30)	
	declare @sReatype				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sRelatedEvent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sEvent					nvarchar(30)
	declare @nLaterreadings         int
	declare @sCalcuom          		nvarchar(30)	
	declare @sChildmeter            nvarchar(20)
	declare @sChildmeteruom         nvarchar(30)



BEGIN

	set @sCheckresult = N'0'
	set @sChk         = N'0'
    set @sChildmeteruom  = null

	execute @nReturn = R5O7CONS_VALUE_OF @sInspflag OUTPUT, N'MODULE', N'I'
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	IF ( @sMeter IS  NULL AND @sUom IS NULL )
	OR @sObject  IS  NULL
	OR @nDiff    IS  NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

	SELECT @sReacode = MAX( rea_code )
	FROM   r5readings
	WHERE  rea_object     = @sObject
	AND    rea_object_org = @sObjectorg
	AND    rea_date       = @dDate
	AND    rea_diff       = ABS( @nDiff )
	AND    rea_calcuom    = Coalesce( @sUom, ( SELECT met_uom FROM r5meters WHERE met_code = @sMeter ) )

    SELECT @sReatype = rea_type,
           @sCalcuom = rea_calcuom,
           @sEvent   = rea_event,
           @sRelatedEvent = rea_relatedevent
    FROM   r5readings
    WHERE  rea_code = @sReacode

    SELECT @nLaterreadings = COUNT( * )
    FROM   r5readings
    WHERE  rea_object     = @sObject
    AND    rea_object_org = @sObjectorg
    AND    rea_calcuom    = @sCalcuom
    AND    rea_date       > @dDate


	IF @sInsdel = N'INS' 	
	begin
	DECLARE cLogicalMeters CURSOR local STATIC FOR  SELECT o.oud_object,
													  o.oud_object_org,
													  j.obj_obtype,
													  j.obj_obrtype,
													  o.oud_uom,
													  o.oud_calcdays,
													  Coalesce( o.oud_totalusage, 0 ) oud_totalusage,
													  oud_meter
												FROM  r5objusagedefs o,
													  r5objects j
												WHERE  o.oud_object     = j.obj_code
												AND    o.oud_object_org = j.obj_org
												AND  ( o.oud_uom      = ( SELECT m.met_uom
																		 FROM   r5meters m
																		 WHERE  m.met_code = @sMeter ) OR
													  o.oud_uom   = @sUom )
												AND   o.oud_child = N'+'
												AND   o.oud_updownmeter = '-'
												AND  ( o.oud_object + '#' + o.oud_object_org ) IN ( SELECT  child + '#' + child_org
																			  FROM   dbo.o7doread_get_hierarchy_1 (@sObject,@sObjectorg) )
												AND    EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
															   FROM   r5objusagedefs o2
															   WHERE  o2.oud_uom        = o.oud_uom
															   AND    o2.oud_object     = @sObject
															   AND    o2.oud_object_org = @sObjectorg
															   AND    o2.oud_parent     = N'+' )
												UNION
												SELECT o.oud_object,
													  o.oud_object_org,
													  j.obj_obtype,
													  j.obj_obrtype,
													  o.oud_uom,
													  o.oud_calcdays,
													  Coalesce( o.oud_totalusage, 0 ) oud_totalusage,
													  oud_meter
												FROM   r5objusagedefs o,
													  r5objects j
												WHERE  o.oud_object     = j.obj_code
												AND    o.oud_object_org = j.obj_org
												AND  ( o.oud_uom      = ( SELECT m.met_uom
																		 FROM   r5meters m
																		 WHERE  m.met_code = @sMeter ) OR
													  o.oud_uom   = @sUom )
												AND    o.oud_updownmeter = '-'
												AND    o.oud_object     = @sObject
												AND    o.oud_object_org = @sObjectorg


	OPEN cLogicalMeters
	FETCH NEXT FROM cLogicalMeters INTO @sOUDObject, @sOUDObjectOrg, @sOUDObtype, @sOUDObrtype, @sOUDUom, @nOUDCaldays, @nOUDTotalUsage, @sChildmeter
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
            set @sChildmeteruom  = null
			IF ( @sObject    <> @sOUDObject OR @sObjectorg <> @sOUDObjectOrg ) 
			begin
				
				IF @sChildmeter IS NULL
					set @sChildmeteruom = @sOUDUom
					
					INSERT INTO r5readings (rea_meter, rea_date, rea_object, rea_object_org,rea_obtype, rea_obrtype, rea_diff, rea_uom, rea_calcuom, rea_parent, rea_type, rea_event, rea_relatedevent )
					VALUES (@sChildmeter, @dDate, @sOUDObject, @sOUDObjectOrg, @sOUDObtype,  @sOUDObrtype, @nDiff, @sChildmeteruom, @sOUDUom, @sReacode, @sReatype, @sEvent, @sRelatedEvent )
				
			end

		set @nAvgread = null
		IF @nOUDCaldays IS NOT NULL AND @nOUDCaldays > 1
			begin
				set @nCountit = 1
				set @nTempDiff    = 0
				DECLARE cReading CURSOR local FOR SELECT rea_date,
														  rea_diff
													FROM   r5readings
													WHERE  rea_object     = @sOUDObject
													AND    rea_object_org = @sOUDObjectOrg
													AND    rea_calcuom    = @sOUDUom
													ORDER BY rea_date DESC


				OPEN cReading
				FETCH NEXT FROM cReading INTO @dReaDate, @nReaDiff
				WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
					BEGIN
						IF @nCountit <= @nOUDCaldays + 1 
							begin
								IF @nCountit = 1 
								set @dEnddate = @dReaDate
								set @nTempDiff     = @nTempDiff + @nReaDiff
								set @dLastdate = @dReaDate
								set @nLastdiff = @nReaDiff
								set @nCountit  = @nCountit + 1
							end
						FETCH NEXT FROM cReading INTO @dReaDate, @nReaDiff
					END
				CLOSE cReading
				DEALLOCATE cReading


				set @nTempDiff = @nTempDiff - @nLastdiff
				IF @dEnddate <> @dLastdate 
					set @nAvgread = ROUND( @nTempDiff /(Datediff(mi, @dLastdate, @dEnddate) / CAST (24.0*60.0 AS DECIMAL)) , 6 )
			end
		ELSE
		  set @nAvgread = null  

		set @nTotalusage = @nOUDTotalUsage + @nDiff


		IF @nLaterreadings = 0
			/* If last reading, update total usage and average. */
			UPDATE r5objusagedefs 
			SET    oud_totalusage   = @nTotalusage,
					oud_lastreaddate = @dDate,
					oud_calcdailyusg = @nAvgread
			WHERE  oud_object       = @sOUDObject
			AND    oud_object_org   = @sOUDObjectOrg
			AND    oud_uom          = @sOUDUom
		ELSE
			/* If later readings, only update the average. */
			UPDATE r5objusagedefs 
			SET    oud_calcdailyusg = @nAvgread
			WHERE  oud_object       = @sOUDObject
			AND    oud_object_org   = @sOUDObjectOrg
			AND    oud_uom          = @sOUDUom


		IF @nDiff > 0 AND @nLaterreadings = 0
		begin
			


			execute @nReturn = o7upevt3 @nOUDTotalUsage, @nTotalusage, @sOUDObject, @sOUDObjectOrg, @sOUDUom, @sStatus OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				begin

create function O7DOREAD_GET_HIERARCHY_1 (	@sCode	nvarchar(30),
											@sOrg	nvarchar(15) )
returns @tReturn table( child		nvarchar(30)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						child_org	nvarchar(15)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
	declare @nLevel			int
	declare @sCurrentType	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sCurrentRtype	nvarchar(4)
		
	declare @tStack table ( stc_child		nvarchar(30), 
							stc_child_org	nvarchar(15), 
							LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack 
		select	stc_child, 
				stc_child_org, 
				1 
		  from	r5structures
		 where	stc_parent		= @sCode	and 
				stc_parent_org	= @sOrg		

	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select	@sCode	= stc_child,
							@sOrg	= stc_child_org
					  from	@tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sCode, @sOrg )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_child = @sCode and stc_child_org = @sOrg
					insert into @tStack	select	stc_child, 
												stc_child_org, 
												@nLevel + 1
										  from	r5structures
										 where	stc_parent		= @sCode	and 
												stc_parent_org	= @sOrg		
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7DRDOWN
               (@sFunction NVARCHAR(6)
               ,@sItem     NVARCHAR(24)) RETURNS NVARCHAR(6)
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE @sDrillDown NVARCHAR(6)

SELECT @sDrillDown = hel_drilldown
  FROM r5helptexts
 WHERE hel_function = @sFunction
   AND hel_item = @sItem
   AND hel_drilldown IS NOT NULL

IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
   RETURN @sDrillDown

SELECT @sDrillDown = hel_drilldown
  FROM r5helptexts
 WHERE hel_function = 'ATTRIB'
   AND hel_item = SUBSTRING(@sItem, CHARINDEX('.', @sItem) + 1, 24)
   AND hel_drilldown IS NOT NULL

IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
   RETURN @sDrillDown

SELECT @sDrillDown = hel_drilldown
  FROM r5helptexts
 WHERE hel_function = 'ENTITY'
   AND hel_item = SUBSTRING(@sItem, CHARINDEX('_', @sItem) + 1, 24)
   AND hel_drilldown IS NOT NULL

IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
   RETURN @sDrillDown
RETURN NULL
END

create procedure O7DROPMAILTRG	@sTable		nvarchar(30)
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sSQL       nvarchar(1000)
    declare @sTenant    nvarchar(30)
    declare @nI         int
    declare @sTrigger   nvarchar(128)
    declare @sTemplate  nvarchar(1000)
    declare @sDummy     nvarchar(1)

    if @sTable is null 
        return
    
    set @sTenant = dbo.o7getten()

    if @sTenant is null
        set @sTenant = ''
    else
        set @sTenant = N'_' + @sTenant

    set @sTemplate = N'if exists (select NAME from SYSOBJECTS where NAME = ''<trigger>'' and TYPE = ''TR'') drop trigger <trigger>'

    set @nI = 1
    while @nI <= 6
        begin
            set @sTrigger = N'UMA_' + cast( @nI as nvarchar(1) ) + N'_' + @sTable + @sTenant
            set @sSQL = replace( @sTemplate, N'<trigger>', @sTrigger)
            begin try 
                execute( @sSQL )
            end try
            begin catch
                set @sDummy = null
            end catch

            set @sTrigger = N'IMA_' + cast( @nI as nvarchar(1) ) + N'_' + @sTable + @sTenant
            set @sSQL = replace( @sTemplate, N'<trigger>', @sTrigger)
            begin try 
                execute( @sSQL )
            end try
            begin catch
                set @sDummy = null
            end catch

            set @sTrigger = N'DMA_' + cast( @nI as nvarchar(1) ) + N'_' + @sTable + @sTenant
            set @sSQL = replace( @sTemplate, N'<trigger>', @sTrigger)
            begin try 
                execute( @sSQL )
            end try
            begin catch
                set @sDummy = null
            end catch
            
            set @nI = @nI + 1
        end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7DRVCTL_DRIVER_ACT
          @sCdriver     nvarchar(10) OUTPUT,
          @sCqueue      nvarchar(2) OUTPUT,
          @sCaction     nvarchar(1) 
AS

-- This procedure submits the local integration adapter to the job queue.

	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @nNqueue       int
    declare @nNmaxqueues   int
    declare @sCupdqueue    nvarchar(2)     /* r5driverctrl.drv_queue%TYPE */
	declare @nDrvnum	   int
	declare @nReturn	   int

    IF @sCqueue IS NULL OR @sCqueue = N'%' 
        set @sCqueue = N'%'
   
    IF @sCdriver IS NULL OR @sCdriver = N'ALL'
        set @sCdriver = N'%'
  
    IF (@sCdriver = N'ODRV' OR @sCdriver = N'%') 
	begin
		execute @nReturn = O7DRVCTL_DRIVER_UPD N'ODRV', N'%', @sCaction
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
    end
    IF (@sCdriver = N'XDRV'  OR @sCdriver = N'%')
	begin
		execute @nReturn = O7DRVCTL_DRIVER_UPD N'XDRV', N'%', @sCaction
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
    end
    IF (@sCdriver = N'ADRV'  OR @sCdriver = N'%')
	begin
		execute @nReturn = O7DRVCTL_DRIVER_UPD N'ADRV', N'%', @sCaction
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
    end
    /*06/05/2000 Navneet #6931 Added code for KPI driver*/
    IF (@sCdriver = N'KDRV'  OR @sCdriver = N'%') 
	begin
		execute @nReturn = O7DRVCTL_DRIVER_UPD N'KDRV', N'%', @sCaction
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
    end

 	/*06/25/2000 sangeeta #6947 Added code for FDRV driver*/

    IF (@sCdriver = N'FDRV' OR @sCdriver = N'%') 
	begin
		execute @nReturn = O7DRVCTL_DRIVER_UPD N'FDRV', N'%', @sCaction
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
    end

    /* #16779 added WDRV driver */
    IF (@sCdriver = N'WDRV' OR @sCdriver = N'%') 
	begin
		execute @nReturn = O7DRVCTL_DRIVER_UPD N'WDRV', N'%', @sCaction
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
    end

    SELECT @nNmaxqueues = (cast(isnull(ins_desc,0) as int)) + 1
    FROM   r5install
    WHERE  ins_code = N'~QUEUES~'
	if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
    	set @nNmaxqueues = 2

    IF @sCqueue = N'%'
	begin
		set @nDrvnum = 1
		While(@nDrvnum < @nNmaxqueues)
		begin
	        set @sCupdqueue  = cast((@nDrvnum -1) as nvarchar(2))
	        IF @sCdriver = N'%'
			begin
				execute @nReturn = O7DRVCTL_DRIVER_UPD N'TDRV', N'%', @sCaction
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1
				execute @nReturn = O7DRVCTL_DRIVER_UPD N'BDRV', N'%', @sCaction
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1
	        end
	        IF @sCdriver = N'TDRV'
			begin
				execute @nReturn = O7DRVCTL_DRIVER_UPD N'TDRV', N'%', @sCaction
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1
	        end
	        IF @sCdriver = N'BDRV'
			begin
				execute @nReturn = O7DRVCTL_DRIVER_UPD N'BDRV', N'%', @sCaction
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1
	        end
			set @nDrvnum = @nDrvnum + 1
		end
	end
    ELSE
	begin
	    SELECT @nNqueue = cast(@sCqueue as int)
		IF @sCdriver = N'%' AND @nNqueue <= @nNmaxqueues
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7DRVCTL_DRIVER_UPD N'TDRV', N'%', @sCaction
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
			execute @nReturn = O7DRVCTL_DRIVER_UPD N'BDRV', N'%', @sCaction
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
	    end
	    IF @sCdriver = N'TDRV' AND @nNqueue <= @nNmaxqueues
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7DRVCTL_DRIVER_UPD N'TDRV', N'%', @sCaction
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
	    end
	    IF @sCdriver = N'BDRV' AND @nNqueue <= @nNmaxqueues
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7DRVCTL_DRIVER_UPD N'BDRV', N'%', @sCaction
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
	    end
    end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7DRVCTL_DRIVER_OFF
         @sCdriver     nvarchar(10) OUTPUT,
         @sCqueue      nvarchar(2) OUTPUT

--
-- This procedure turns off the local integration adapter. If it is running
-- then send the alert signal. The job is removed from the job queue when
-- it is done because we specify no interval. If the job has been submitted
-- to the queue but is not running then remove from queue.
--
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
  	declare @nNjob      INT    		/* user_jobs.job%TYPE */
  	declare @dDate      datetime		/* user_jobs.this_date%TYPE */
  	declare @sCfound    nvarchar(8) 	/* r5install.ins_code%TYPE */
  	declare @sCinstall  nvarchar(8)		/* r5install.ins_code%TYPE */
  	declare @sCstop     nvarchar(8)		/* r5install.ins_code%TYPE */
  	declare @sV_driver  nvarchar(200)
  	declare @sCalert   	nvarchar(50)
	declare @sV_tenant  nvarchar(30)
	declare @nJob		int
	declare @sWhat		nvarchar(40) 
	declare @dThis_date datetime
	declare @nStatus    int

	set @sV_driver = @sCdriver
    set @sV_tenant = dbo.O7GETTEN()
    IF @sCqueue IS NULL OR @sCqueue =N'%'
        set @sCqueue =N'%'
    ELSE
        set @sCqueue = @sCqueue+N'%'

    IF @sCdriver IS NULL OR @sCdriver =N'%' 
        set @sV_driver =N'%DRV('''+@sV_tenant+''')%'
    ELSE
        set @sV_driver = @sCdriver+REPLACE(@sCqueue,N'%', NULL)+'('''+@sV_tenant+''')%'

	DECLARE cCur_jobs CURSOR LOCAL FOR
  	SELECT j.job_id
        	,replace(js.command,'',null) what
	from
		msdb.dbo.sysusers u, 
		msdb.dbo.sysjobs j,
		msdb.dbo.sysjobsteps js
	where
		u.sid = j.owner_sid and
		permissions(u.uid) != 0 and
		js.job_id = j.job_id and 
		js.step_id = '1' and
		js.subsystem = 'TSQL' and
		js.command LIKE @sV_driver
		

	OPEN cCur_jobs
	FETCH NEXT FROM cCur_jobs INTO @nJob, @sWhat
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	begin
	    set @sCalert   =N'R5'+substring(@sWhat, 1, 4)
	    set @sCstop    =N'~S'+substring(@sWhat, 1, 4)+'~'
	    set @sCinstall = N'~'+REPLACE(substring(@sWhat, 1, 5),N'(', NULL)+'~'
		/*execute sp_help_jobs to determine the status (status = 4 will be similar to the This_date not null
			3 Job is waiting on a job step retry attempt. 
			1 Job is executing. 
			4 Job is idle, awaiting next scheduled execution. 
			7 All executable job steps have completed. Job history logging is being performed. 
			5 Job is suspended. 
			0 State cannot be determined. 
			6 Job is waiting on the outcome of a step. 
			2 Job is blocked, unable to obtain a thread resource. 
		*/
		CREATE TABLE #Jobs (		job_id	integer,
									originating_server	nvarchar(30),
									name	sysname,
									enabled	tinyint,
									description	nvarchar(512),
									start_step_id	int,
									category	sysname,
									owner	sysname,
									notify_level_eventlog	int,
									notify_level_email	int,
									notify_level_netsend	int,
									notify_level_page	int,
									notify_email_operator	sysname,
									notify_netsend_operator	sysname,
									notify_page_operator	sysname,
									delete_level	int,
									date_created	datetime,
									date_modified	datetime,
									version_number	int,
									last_run_date	int,
									last_run_time	int,
									last_run_outcome	int,
									next_run_date	int,
									next_run_time	int,
									next_run_schedule_id	int,
									current_execution_status	int,
									current_execution_step	sysname,
									current_retry_attempt	int,
									has_step	int,
									has_schedule	int,
									has_target	int,
									Type	int )

		INSERT INTO #Jobs
		EXEC msdb..sp_help_job @nJob
		if @@ERROR <> 0 
		begin
			drop table #Jobs
			close cCur_jobs
			deallocate cCur_jobs
			return - 1
		end

		SELECT @nStatus = current_execution_status FROM #Jobs

		drop table #Jobs


	    IF @nStatus <> 4
			BEGIN
				SELECT @sCfound = ins_code
				FROM r5install
				WHERE ins_code = @sCstop
				if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
				begin
					INSERT INTO r5install (ins_code, ins_desc
										,ins_comment, ins_fixed)
					VALUES (@sCstop,N'STOP DRIVERN'+REPLACE(substring(@sWhat, 1, 5),N'(', NULL)
								,N'Stop Request',N'-')
				end
			END
	    ELSE
			BEGIN
				IF @sCinstall =N'~KDRV~'
				BEGIN
					DELETE FROM r5install
					WHERE  ins_code =N'KPIDATE'
				END
				DELETE FROM r5install
				WHERE ins_code = @sCinstall
				execute DBMS_JOB_REMOVE @nJob
				if @@ERROR <> 0 
				begin
					close cCur_jobs
					deallocate cCur_jobs
					return - 1
				end
			END 
		FETCH NEXT FROM cCur_jobs INTO @nJob, @sWhat
	end--end of while
	close cCur_jobs
	deallocate cCur_jobs

CREATE PROCEDURE O7DRVCTL_DRIVER_ON
          @sCdriver     nvarchar(10) OUTPUT,
          @sCqueue      nvarchar(2) OUTPUT 
AS
--
-- This procedure submits the local integration adapter to the job queue.
--
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @nNqueue       int
    declare @nNmaxqueues   int
    declare @sCrundriver   nvarchar(10)
	declare @nReturn	   int
	declare @nDrvnum	   int
	declare @sChk		   nvarchar(5)

    declare @sProducts          nvarchar(200)
    declare @sAspjobs           nvarchar(200)

	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sProducts OUTPUT, N'PRODUCTS', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sAspjobs OUTPUT, N'ASPJOBS', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

    set @sProducts = upper(@sProducts)
    set @sAspjobs = coalesce(upper(@sAspjobs), N'OFF')

	IF @sProducts <> N'D7I' or @sAspjobs <> N'ON' AND @sCdriver NOT IN ( N'ODRV', N'XDRV' )
    /* Don't start drivers, if also extended running, except BAIM drivers. */
    	RETURN

	IF @sCqueue IS NULL OR @sCqueue = N'%' 
	    set @sCqueue = N'%'

	IF @sCdriver IS NULL OR @sCdriver = N'ALL'
	    set @sCdriver = N'%'

	IF (@sCdriver =N'ODRV' OR @sCdriver =N'%')
	begin
		execute @nReturn = O7DRVCTL_DRIVER_RUN N'ODRV'
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
	end
	IF (@sCdriver = N'XDRV'  OR @sCdriver = N'%')
	begin
		execute @nReturn = O7DRVCTL_DRIVER_RUN N'XDRV'
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
	end
	IF (@sCdriver =N'ADRV'  OR @sCdriver =N'%')
	begin
		execute @nReturn = O7DRVCTL_DRIVER_RUN N'ADRV'
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
	end
    /*06/05/2000 Navneet #6931 Added code for KPI driver*/
    IF (@sCdriver =N'KDRV'  OR @sCdriver =N'%')
	begin
		execute @nReturn = O7DRVCTL_DRIVER_RUN N'KDRV'
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
    end

    /*06/05/2000 Sangeeta #6947 Added code for FDRV driver*/
    IF (@sCdriver =N'FDRV'  OR @sCdriver =N'%')
	begin
		execute @nReturn = O7DRVCTL_DRIVER_RUN N'FDRV'
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
    end
    /* #16779 added WDRV driver */
    IF (@sCdriver =N'WDRV'  OR @sCdriver =N'%')
	begin
		execute @nReturn = O7DRVCTL_DRIVER_RUN N'WDRV'
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
    end
  
    SELECT @nNmaxqueues = (cast(isnull(ins_desc,0)as int)) + 1
    FROM   r5install
    WHERE  ins_code = N'~QUEUES~'
    if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
    	set @nNmaxqueues = 2
  
	IF @sCqueue = N'%'
	begin
		set @nDrvnum = 1
		While(@nDrvnum < @nNmaxqueues)
		begin
	        IF @sCdriver = N'%'
			begin
		        set @sCrundriver = N'TDRV'+(@nDrvnum -1)+''
				execute @nReturn = O7DRVCTL_DRIVER_RUN @sCrundriver
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1

		        set @sCrundriver =N'BDRV'+(@nDrvnum -1)+''
				execute @nReturn = O7DRVCTL_DRIVER_RUN @sCrundriver
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1
	        end
	        IF @sCdriver =N'TDRV' 
			begin
	            set @sCrundriver =N'TDRV'+(@nDrvnum -1)+''
				execute @nReturn = O7DRVCTL_DRIVER_RUN @sCrundriver
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1
	        end
	        IF @sCdriver =N'BDRV'
			begin
	            set @sCrundriver =N'BDRV'+(@nDrvnum -1)+''
				execute @nReturn = O7DRVCTL_DRIVER_RUN @sCrundriver
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1
	        end
			set @nDrvnum = @nDrvnum + 1
		end
	end
	ELSE
	begin
	    SELECT @nNqueue = cast(@sCqueue as int)
	    IF @sCdriver =N'%' AND @nNqueue <= @nNmaxqueues
		begin
	        set @sCrundriver =N'TDRV'+@sCqueue+''
			execute @nReturn = O7DRVCTL_DRIVER_RUN @sCrundriver
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
	        set @sCrundriver =N'BDRV'+@sCqueue+''
			execute @nReturn = O7DRVCTL_DRIVER_RUN @sCrundriver
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
	    end
	    IF @sCdriver =N'TDRV' AND @nNqueue <= @nNmaxqueues
		begin
	        set @sCrundriver =N'TDRV'+@sCqueue+''
			execute @nReturn = O7DRVCTL_DRIVER_RUN @sCrundriver
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
	    end
	    IF @sCdriver =N'BDRV' AND @nNqueue <= @nNmaxqueues
		begin
	        set @sCrundriver =N'BDRV'+@sCqueue+''
			execute @nReturn = O7DRVCTL_DRIVER_RUN @sCrundriver
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
	    end
	end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7DRVCTL_DRIVER_RUN @sCdriver nvarchar(10)
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @nNcount         int
    declare @nNexists        int
    declare @nNjob           int
    declare @nChk            int
    declare @sV_tenant       nvarchar(30)
    declare @sV_driver       nvarchar(50)
    declare @dRealstarttime  datetime
    declare @sStarttime      nvarchar(5)
	declare @dSysdate		 datetime

	set @sV_tenant = dbo.O7GETTEN()

    select 1 
	from
		msdb.dbo.sysusers u, 
		msdb.dbo.sysjobs j,
		msdb.dbo.sysjobsteps js
	where
		u.sid = j.owner_sid and
		permissions(u.uid) != 0 and
		js.job_id = j.job_id and 
		js.step_id = '1' and
		js.subsystem = 'TSQL' and
		js.command LIKE replace(@sCdriver,'',null)+'('''+@sV_tenant+''')'


    set @nNcount = @@ROWCOUNT
    

	SELECT 1
    FROM   user_objects
    WHERE  object_name = replace(@sCdriver,'',null)
    set @nNexists = @@ROWCOUNT

	IF @nNcount  = 0 AND @nNexists = 1
	begin
		set @sV_driver = replace(@sCdriver,'',null)+'('''+@sV_tenant+''')'
	    IF @sCdriver LIKE N'%WDRV%' 
		begin
	        SELECT @sStarttime = SUBSTRING(ins_desc,1,5)
    		FROM   r5install
    		WHERE  ins_code = N'WHSTART'
    		if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1 or ( @sStarttime is not null and ( isnumeric(SUBSTRING(@sStarttime,1,1)) = 0 or
                                                                  isnumeric(SUBSTRING(@sStarttime,4,1)) = 0 ) )
      			set @sStarttime =N'02:00'

    		IF @sStarttime NOT LIKE N'__:__'          OR
       		   cast(( SUBSTRING(@sStarttime,1,1) ) as int) > 2 OR
       		   cast(( SUBSTRING(@sStarttime,4,1) ) as int) > 5
    		begin
       			set @sStarttime =N'02:00'
    		end

			if cast(DATEPART(hour, GETDATE()) as nvarchar(2) ) + N':' + cast(DATEPART(minute, GETDATE()) as nvarchar(2)) > @sStarttime
	            set @dRealstarttime = convert(datetime, (cast(dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(getdate()+1, 'dd') as nvarchar(80)) + N' ' + @sStarttime), 113) 
	        ELSE
	            set @dRealstarttime = convert(datetime, (cast(dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(getdate(), 'dd') as nvarchar(80)) + N' ' + @sStarttime), 113)
			execute DBMS_JOB_SUBMIT @nNjob, @sV_driver, @dRealstarttime 
			if @@ERROR <> 0 
				return -1
		end
	    ELSE
		begin
			set @dSysdate = getdate()
	        execute DBMS_JOB_SUBMIT @nNjob, @sV_driver, @dSysdate
			if @@ERROR <> 0 
				return -1
		end
	end

create function O7DUPORG( @sFunction nvarchar(6),
							@sR5user nvarchar(255),
							@sOrg    nvarchar(15) )
returns bit
as
begin
	declare @bResult		bit
	declare @nCount			integer

	select @nCount = count(*)
	FROM	r5permissions p,
		r5userorganization u
	WHERE  u.uog_user     = @sR5user
	AND    p.prm_group    = u.uog_group
	AND    p.prm_function = @sFunction
	AND    p.prm_insert   = N'+'
	AND    u.uog_org      = @sOrg;

	if @nCount > 0 
		set @bResult = 1
	else
		set @bResult = 0


	return (@bResult)
end

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7DWETLDM_CALCEXTRACOST(@nExtra numeric(30,6), @nExch numeric(30,6), @nOrdqty numeric(30,6))
returns numeric(30,6)
as
begin
	declare @nEexhRate numeric(30,6)
	if @nOrdqty is null or @nOrdqty = 0
        return 0

    set @nEexhRate = isnull(@nExch, 1)

    if @nEexhRate = 0
        set @nEexhRate = 1
    return isnull(@nExtra / @nEexhRate / @nOrdqty, 0)

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7DWETLDM_GETCOSTTYPE(@sBoo_event nvarchar(30), @sBoo_act nvarchar(30), @sBoo_order nvarchar(30), @sAct_order nvarchar(30))
returns int
as
begin
    declare @nNum int
	set @nNum = 0
    -- In-house labor?
    if @sBoo_order is null and @sAct_order is null
        return 1

    select @nNum = count(1)
    from   r5orderlines
    where  orl_event = @sBoo_event
    and    orl_act   = cast(@sBoo_act as numeric(8,0))
    and    orl_rtype = N'SF'

    -- fixed cost contractor labor (SF)?
    if @nNum > 0
        return 5

    -- ST and SH (the other two types) are lumped into costtype 3
    return 3
end

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7DWETLDM_GETEARLIESTDATE()
    returns numeric(38,0)
    as
    begin
	    declare @nComdays numeric(38,0)
	    declare @nIssdays numeric(38,0)
	    
	    
         -- Get number of days that can be  booked after the completion of job
         select @nComdays = coalesce(cast(ins_desc as numeric(38,0)), 30) 
         from   r5install
         where  ins_code = N'COMDAYS'

         select @nIssdays = coalesce(cast(ins_desc as numeric(38,0)), 30) 
         from   r5install
         where  ins_code = N'ISSDAYS'

         return dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER (@nComdays, @nIssdays)

    	declare @sUnkCode	 nvarchar(30)
    	declare @sSql		 nvarchar(2000)
    
           -- Get the search string for the table column
    	select @sSearchdesc = 'select @sEntitydata = '+column_name+' from '+table_name
    	from  user_tab_columns
    	where table_name = @sTablename
    	and   substring(column_name,5,len(column_name)) = @sSearchcol
    
    	-- Get the search string for the entity code column
    	select @sSearchCode = ' where '+column_name+' = @sCode '
    	from  user_tab_columns
    	where table_name = @sTablename
    	and   substring(column_name,5,len(column_name)) = N'CODE'
    
    	set @sSql = @sSearchdesc + @sSearchCode 
    	
            EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSql, N'@sEntitydata nvarchar(80) OUTPUT, @sCode nvarchar(255)',  @sEntitydata OUTPUT, @sSearchval 
    		
    		If @@ERROR <> 0 or @sEntitydata is null
    		begin
    			execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'unkCode', @sUnkCode OUTPUT
    			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
    				return - 1			
    			set @sEntitydata = @sUnkCode			
    		end

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETLDM_GETSTATUSDIMENSIONKEY 
						@sStatus nvarchar(250), 
						@sStatusentity nvarchar(45), 
						@sFieldlabel nvarchar(45), 
						@sUnkCode nvarchar(30),
						@nKeyVal int OUTPUT
--returns number
as
begin
	SET NOCOUNT ON
   SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS OFF
	declare @sSequenceNum nvarchar(30)
	declare @sChk nvarchar(3)
	declare @nError int
	declare @nRowCount int
	declare @nReturn int

	select @nKeyVal = zst_key 
	from   r5dwstatuses 
	where  isnull(zst_code, @sUnkCode) = @sStatus
	and    zst_statusentity = @sStatusEntity
	
	select @nError = @@ERROR, @nRowcount = @@ROWCOUNT
	if @nError <> 0
		goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	if @nRowcount = 0
	begin
		-- Create a status dimension record
		execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sSequenceNum OUTPUT, N'ZST', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
		set @nError = @@ERROR
		if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			goto ERROR_HANDLER

		set @nKeyVal = cast(@sSequenceNum as int)
        BEGIN TRANSACTION
		insert into r5dwstatuses
				 (zst_key,
				  zst_code,
				  zst_desc,
				  zst_atrb,
				  zst_statusentity)
		values (@nKeyVal,
				  @sStatus,
				  '-',
				  @sFieldlabel,
				  @sStatusentity)
		COMMIT TRANSACTION
        
		set @nError = @@ERROR
		if @nError <> 0
			goto ERROR_HANDLER
	end

ERROR_HANDLER:		
	IF @@TRANCOUNT >=1
		rollback
		
	return @nError
end

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETLDM_INSERTSTORESDAILYSNAPSHOTRECS @nRet int OUTPUT, @tN_runNumber numeric(18,0),
									@tS_tenantID           nvarchar(50),
									@tS_loadFlag           nvarchar(1),   /* r5dwetlrunctrl.run_loadFlag%TYPE, */
									@tS_loadType           nvarchar(255),
									@tD_loadFromDate       datetime,
									@tD_loadToDate         datetime,
									@tD_nextStartDate      datetime,
									@tD_minWarehouseDate   datetime,
									@tS_purgeFlag          nvarchar(1),   /*r5dwetlrunctrl.run_purgeflag%TYPE, */
									@tD_purgeToDate        datetime,
									@tS_defaultLanguage    nvarchar(2),   /* r5languages.lan_code%TYPE, */
									@tS_defaultCurrency    nvarchar(200),   /* r5install.ins_desc%TYPE, */
									@tS_oldDefaultCurrency nvarchar(3),   /* r5dwetlrunctrl.run_defcur%TYPE, */
									@tB_debug              bit,
									@tB_isRepair           bit,
									@tD_originalLoadFromDate datetime,
									@tD_originalLoadToDate datetime,
									@tB_hasObjectType2SCDChanges bit,
									@tB_hasSupplierType2SCDChanges bit,
									@tD_loadFirstDate      datetime,
									@dWorkDate datetime
as
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS OFF
declare @nDateKey numeric(18,0) --number
declare @nNumInserts       int
declare @nExistingRecordCount int --pls_integer = 0
declare @nReturn int
declare @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD nvarchar(30)
declare @sCommitFreq nvarchar(30)
declare @nCommitFreq int
declare @rNfact_zss_datekey                 numeric(18,0) 
declare @rNfact_zss_storekey                numeric(18,0) 
declare @rNfact_zss_orgkey                  numeric(18,0) 
declare @rNfact_zss_partclasskey            numeric(18,0) 
declare @rSfact_zss_defcur                  nvarchar(4)   
declare @rSfact_zss_orgcur                  nvarchar(4)   
declare @rNfact_zss_valueonhanddefcur       numeric(24,6) 
declare @rNfact_zss_valueonhandorgcur       numeric(24,6) 
declare @rNfact_zss_valuetoberepaireddefcur numeric(24,6) 
declare @rNfact_zss_valuetoberepairedorgcur numeric(24,6) 
declare @rNfact_zss_valueintransitdefcur    numeric(24,6) 
declare @rNfact_zss_valueintransitorgcur    numeric(24,6) 
declare @rNfact_zss_valueatshopdefcur       numeric(24,6) 
declare @rNfact_zss_valueatshoporgcur       numeric(24,6) 
declare @rNfact_zss_valueatsupplierdefcur   numeric(24,6) 
declare @rNfact_zss_valueatsupplierorgcur   numeric(24,6) 
declare @nValueissuedwodefcur       numeric(24,6)
declare @nValueissuedwoorgcur       numeric(24,6)
declare @nValueretnwodefcur         numeric(24,6)
declare @nValueretnwoorgcur         numeric(24,6)
declare @nValuerecvsupplierdefcur   numeric(24,6)
declare @nValuerecvsupplierorgcur   numeric(24,6)
declare @nValueretnsupplierdefcur   numeric(24,6)
declare @nValueretnsupplierorgcur   numeric(24,6)
declare @sMustTruncStoresDailySnap nvarchar(1)
begin

	set @nRet = 0
	set @nNumInserts = 0
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETLDM_PACKAGE_INIT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	begin
		return -1
	end
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_PACKAGE_INIT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	begin
		return -1
	end
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'commitFreq', @sCommitFreq OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 or ( @sCommitFreq is not null and isnumeric(@sCommitFreq) = 0 )
		return -1
	set @nCommitFreq = cast(@sCommitFreq as int)

	set @dWorkDate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dWorkDate, N'DD')
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETLDM_GETDATEDIMENSIONKEY @nDateKey OUTPUT, @dWorkDate
	if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD', @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		begin
			return -1	
		end

	declare cSource cursor local for
	select @nDateKey,
               zts_storekey,
               zts_orgkey,
               zts_partclasskey,
               @tS_defaultCurrency,
               zts_orgcur,
               dbo.O7DWETLDM_TODEFCURR(zts_valueonhand, zts_orgcur, @tS_defaultCurrency, null, @dWorkDate),
               zts_valueonhand,
               dbo.O7DWETLDM_TODEFCURR(zts_valuetoberepaired, zts_orgcur, @tS_defaultCurrency, null, @dWorkDate),
               zts_valuetoberepaired,
               dbo.O7DWETLDM_TODEFCURR(zts_valueintransit, zts_orgcur, @tS_defaultCurrency, null, @dWorkDate),
               zts_valueintransit,
               dbo.O7DWETLDM_TODEFCURR(zts_valueatshop, zts_orgcur, @tS_defaultCurrency, null, @dWorkDate),
               zts_valueatshop,
               dbo.O7DWETLDM_TODEFCURR(zts_valueatsupplier, zts_orgcur, @tS_defaultCurrency, null, @dWorkDate),
               zts_valueatsupplier
        from  r5dwtmpstoresdailysnap

	begin
            if not exists ( select 1 
                        from  r5dwtmpinventoryturns
                        where zti_storekey      = @rNfact_zss_storekey
                        and   zti_partclasskey  = @rNfact_zss_partclasskey
                        and   zti_orgkey        = @rNfact_zss_orgkey
                        and   zti_datekey       = @rNfact_zss_datekey )
                begin
                    set @nValueissuedwodefcur      = 0.0
                    set @nValueissuedwoorgcur      = 0.0
                    set @nValueretnwodefcur        = 0.0
                    set @nValueretnwoorgcur        = 0.0
                    set @nValuerecvsupplierdefcur  = 0.0
                    set @nValuerecvsupplierorgcur  = 0.0
                    set @nValueretnsupplierdefcur  = 0.0
                    set @nValueretnsupplierorgcur  = 0.0
                end
            else
                select @nValueissuedwoorgcur      = coalesce(t.zti_valueissuedwo,0.0), 
                       @nValueretnwoorgcur        = coalesce(abs(t.zti_valueretnwo),0.0), 
                       @nValuerecvsupplierorgcur  = coalesce(t.zti_valuerecvsupplier,0.0), 
                       @nValueretnsupplierorgcur  = coalesce(t.zti_valueretnsupplier,0.0)
                from    r5dwtmpinventoryturns t

            set @nValueissuedwodefcur      = dbo.o7dwetldm_toDefCurr(@nValueissuedwoorgcur, @rSfact_zss_orgcur, @rSfact_zss_defcur, N' ', @dWorkDate)

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETLDM_LOADAVAILLABORDAILYSNAP  @tN_runNumber numeric(18,0),
						    @tS_tenantID           nvarchar(50),
						    @tS_loadFlag           nvarchar(1),   /* r5dwetlrunctrl.run_loadFlag%TYPE, */
						    @tS_loadType           nvarchar(255),
						    @tD_loadFromDate       datetime,
						    @tD_loadToDate         datetime,
						    @tD_nextStartDate      datetime,
						    @tD_minWarehouseDate   datetime,
						    @tS_purgeFlag          nvarchar(1),   /*r5dwetlrunctrl.run_purgeflag%TYPE, */
						    @tD_purgeToDate        datetime,
						    @tS_defaultLanguage    nvarchar(2),   /* r5languages.lan_code%TYPE, */
						    @tS_defaultCurrency    nvarchar(200),   /* r5install.ins_desc%TYPE, */
						    @tS_oldDefaultCurrency nvarchar(3),   /* r5dwetlrunctrl.run_defcur%TYPE, */
						    @tB_debug              bit,
						    @tB_isRepair           bit,
						    @tD_originalLoadFromDate datetime,
						    @tD_originalLoadToDate datetime,
						    @tB_hasObjectType2SCDChanges bit,
						    @tB_hasSupplierType2SCDChanges bit,
						    @tD_loadFirstDate      datetime
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS OFF
declare  @nNumRecs  int
declare  @nNumDimensionRecs int
declare  @sSequenceNum      nvarchar(30)
declare  @sChk              nvarchar(6)
declare  @nSurrogateKey     numeric(18,0)
declare  @bSurrogateFound   bit
declare  @bDimensionFound   bit
declare  @sOP_FULL_LOAD     nvarchar(30)
declare  @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD     nvarchar(30)
declare  @sSTATUS_EXECUTING nvarchar(9)
--declare  @sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION nvarchar(30)
declare  @sSTEP_LOAD_FACTS nvarchar(30)
declare  @sSTATUS_COMPLETED nvarchar(9)
declare  @sSTATUS_ABORTED nvarchar(9)
declare  @nUnkKey		int
declare  @nNewKey		int
declare @nReturn int
declare @sErrorMsg nvarchar(2000)
declare @sCommitFreq nvarchar(30)
declare @nCommitFreq int
declare @sUnkCode nvarchar(30)
declare @nNumInserts int --         pls_integer = 0
declare @nExistingRecordCount int --number = 0
declare @rD_zla_date           datetime --r5availability.avl_date%TYPE,
declare @rS_zla_org            nvarchar(15) --r5mrcs.mrc_org%TYPE,
declare @rS_zla_mrc            nvarchar(15) --r5availability.avl_mrc%TYPE,
declare @rS_zla_trade          nvarchar(15) --r5availability.avl_trade%TYPE,
declare @rN_zla_personnelhours numeric(24,6) --r5availability.avl_ownhours%TYPE,
declare @rN_zla_hiredhours     numeric(24,6) --r5availability.avl_hirhours%TYPE)
declare @rNfact_zla_datekey        numeric(18,0) --r5dwavaillabordailysnap.zla_datekey%TYPE,
declare @rNfact_zla_orgkey         numeric(18,0) --r5dwavaillabordailysnap.zla_orgkey%TYPE,
declare @rNfact_zla_mrckey         numeric(18,0) --r5dwavaillabordailysnap.zla_mrckey%TYPE,
declare @rNfact_zla_tradekey       numeric(18,0) --r5dwavaillabordailysnap.zla_tradekey%TYPE,
declare @rNfact_zla_personnelhours numeric(24,6) --r5dwavaillabordailysnap.zla_personnelhours%TYPE,
declare @rNfact_zla_hiredhours     numeric(24,6) --r5dwavaillabordailysnap.zla_hiredhours%TYPE)
declare @sKeyvalues nvarchar(4000)
declare @sQuotes nvarchar(5)
declare @nError int
declare @nRowcount int
begin
	set @sQuotes = N''''
	set @nNumRecs = 0
	set @nNumInserts = 0
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETLDM_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_ABORTED', @sSTATUS_ABORTED OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STEP_LOAD_FACTS', @sSTEP_LOAD_FACTS OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_EXECUTING', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD', @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_FULL_LOAD', @sOP_FULL_LOAD OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'commitFreq', @sCommitFreq OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 or ( @sCommitFreq is not null and isnumeric(@sCommitFreq) = 0 )
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	set @nCommitFreq = cast(@sCommitFreq as int)

	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_INITIALIZEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber, @tS_loadType,
							@sSTEP_LOAD_FACTS, N'r5dwavaillabordailysnap', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	
	declare cSource cursor local for
	select   avl_date,
                 mrc_org,
                 avl_mrc,
                 avl_trade,
                 isnull(sum(avl_ownhours),0),
                 isnull(sum(avl_hirhours),0)
        from     r5mrcs,
                 r5availability
        where    avl_date between @tD_loadFromDate and @tD_loadToDate
        and      mrc_code = avl_mrc
        group by avl_date,
                 mrc_org,
                 avl_mrc,
                 avl_trade
 
    open cSource 
 	fetch next from cSource into      @rD_zla_date           ,
					  @rS_zla_org            ,
					  @rS_zla_mrc            ,
					  @rS_zla_trade          ,
					  @rN_zla_personnelhours ,
					  @rN_zla_hiredhours  
	while @@fetch_status = 0
	begin     
         -- Find all dimension keys corresponding to the fact
		execute @nReturn = O7DWETLDM_GETDATEDIMENSIONKEY @rNfact_zla_datekey OUTPUT, @rD_zla_date
		set @nError = @@ERROR
		if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		begin
			set @sKeyvalues = 'r5availability.avl_date ='+@sQuotes+cast(@rD_zla_date as nvarchar(80))+@sQuotes+
			  '; r5mrcs.mrc_org ='+@sQuotes+@rS_zla_org+@sQuotes+
			  '; r5availability.avl_mrc ='+@sQuotes+@rS_zla_mrc +@sQuotes+
			  '; r5availability.avl_trade ='+@sQuotes+@rS_zla_trade+@sQuotes


			execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_LOADETLERRORLOG @tN_runNumber, @nError, 'r5dwavaillabordailysnap', @sKeyvalues
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			begin
				close cSource
				deallocate cSource
				goto ERROR_HANDLER
			end
			GOTO fetch_again
		end
     	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'unkCode', @sUnkCode OUTPUT
		set @nError = @@ERROR
		if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		begin
			set @sKeyvalues = 'r5availability.avl_date ='+@sQuotes+cast(@rD_zla_date as nvarchar(80))+@sQuotes+
					  '; r5mrcs.mrc_org ='+@sQuotes+@rS_zla_org+@sQuotes+
					  '; r5availability.avl_mrc ='+@sQuotes+@rS_zla_mrc +@sQuotes+
					  '; r5availability.avl_trade ='+@sQuotes+@rS_zla_trade+@sQuotes


			execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_LOADETLERRORLOG @tN_runNumber, @nError, 'r5dwavaillabordailysnap', @sKeyvalues
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			begin
				close cSource
				deallocate cSource
				goto ERROR_HANDLER
			end
			GOTO fetch_again
		end
		select @rNfact_zla_orgkey = zor_key from r5dworganizations 
		where isnull(zor_code, @sUnkCode) = @rS_zla_org
		select @nError = @@ERROR, @nRowcount = @@ROWCOUNT
		if @nError <> 0
		begin
			set @sKeyvalues = 'r5availability.avl_date ='+@sQuotes+cast(@rD_zla_date as nvarchar(80))+@sQuotes+
			  '; r5mrcs.mrc_org ='+@sQuotes+@rS_zla_org+@sQuotes+
			  '; r5availability.avl_mrc ='+@sQuotes+@rS_zla_mrc +@sQuotes+
			  '; r5availability.


-- ========================================

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETLDM_LOADDATEDIMENSION   	   @tN_runNumber numeric(18,0),
						   @tS_tenantID           nvarchar(50),
						   @tS_loadFlag           nvarchar(1),   
						   @tS_loadType           nvarchar(255),
						   @tD_loadFromDate       datetime,
						   @tD_loadToDate         datetime,
						   @tD_nextStartDate      datetime,
						   @tD_minWarehouseDate   datetime,
						   @tS_purgeFlag          nvarchar(1),   
						   @tD_purgeToDate        datetime,
						   @tS_defaultLanguage    nvarchar(2),   
						   @tS_defaultCurrency    nvarchar(200), 
						   @tS_oldDefaultCurrency nvarchar(3),   
						   @tB_debug              bit,
						   @tB_isRepair           bit,
						   @tD_originalLoadFromDate datetime,
						   @tD_originalLoadToDate datetime,
						   @tB_hasObjectType2SCDChanges bit,
						   @tB_hasSupplierType2SCDChanges bit,
						   @tD_loadFirstDate      datetime
AS
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS OFF
    declare @nSurrogateKey     numeric(18,0)
    declare @sSequenceNum      nvarchar(30)
    declare @sChk              nvarchar(6)
    declare @nDateRange        int		--pls_integer
    declare @bNoDatesExist     bit		--boolean
    declare @dMinExistingDate  datetime
    declare @dMaxExistingDate  datetime
    declare @dEndDate          datetime
    declare @dDt               datetime
    declare @nJulianDay        numeric(18,0)
    declare @nNumInserts       int		--pls_integer = 0
    declare @nNumRecs          int		--pls_integer = 0
    declare @nNumDimensionRecs int		--pls_integer = 0
    declare @sMinDate	       nvarchar(50)
    declare @sInvDate          nvarchar(50)
    declare @sMaxDate	       nvarchar(50)
    declare @dMinDate	       datetime
    declare @dInvDate          datetime
    declare @dMaxDate	       datetime
    declare @nReturn	       int
    declare @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD     nvarchar(30)
    declare @sOP_FULL_LOAD     nvarchar(30)
    declare @sSTATUS_EXECUTING nvarchar(9)
    declare @sSTATUS_ABORTED nvarchar(9)
    declare @sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION nvarchar(30)
    declare @sSTATUS_COMPLETED nvarchar(9)
    declare @nUnkKey	int
    declare @sUnkKey	nvarchar(30)
    declare @sInvKey	nvarchar(30)
    declare @nInvKey	int
    declare @sSafetyDays nvarchar(30) 
    declare @nSafetyDays int
    declare @sCommitFreq nvarchar(30)
    declare @nCommitFreq int
    declare @sMinWarehouseDate nvarchar(50)
    declare @dMinWarehouseDate datetime
    declare @nDateCounter int
    declare @dTmpDate datetime
    declare @dTmpDate1 datetime
    declare @nJulianDayfinal int
    declare @dTmpJulianDate datetime
    declare @nTmpJulianDate bigint
    declare @sKeyvalues nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sQuotes nvarchar(5)
    declare @nError int
    declare @dStartDate datetime
    declare @sStartDate nvarchar(50)
    declare @dOriginalStartDate datetime
    declare @sOriginalStartDate nvarchar(50)
begin
	set @sQuotes = N''''
	set @nNumRecs = 0
	set @nNumInserts = 0
	set @nNumDimensionRecs = 0

	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETLDM_PACKAGE_INIT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_PACKAGE_INIT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_ABORTED', @sSTATUS_ABORTED OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STEP_LOAD_DIMENSION', @sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_EXECUTING', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER	

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'commitFreq', @sCommitFreq OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 or ( @sCommitFreq is not null and isnumeric( @sCommitFreq ) = 0 )
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	

	set @nCommitFreq = cast(@sCommitFreq as int)
	
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_INITIALIZEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber, @tS_loadType, @sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION, N'r5dwdates', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
      -- What are the minimum and maximum dates in r5dwdates?
        execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'minDate', @sMinDate OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 or ( @sMinDate is not null and isdate( @sMinDate ) = 0 )
	goto ERROR_HANDLER	
	
	set @dMinDate = cast(@sMinDate as datetime)
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'maxDate', @sMaxDate OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 or ( @sMaxDate is not null and isdate( @sMaxDate ) = 0 )
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
		
	set @dMaxDate = cast(@sMaxDate as datetime)
	
	select @dMinExistingDate = isnull(min(zdt_date),@dMinDate),
               @dMaxExistingDate = isnull(max(zdt_date),@dMaxDate)
        from   r5dwdates
        where  zdt_key > 0	
		
	if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
		
    -- Do any valid dates exist in the table?
	if @dMinExistingDate = @dMinDate
	begin
    	set @bNoDatesExist = 0
	end
	else 
	begin
		set @bNoDatesExist = 1
	end
		select @nNumDimensionRecs = count(1) from r5dwdates
    
    if @nNumDimensionRecs = 0
	begin
		execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'unkKey', @sUnkKey OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 or ( @sUnkKey is not null and isnumeric(@sUnkKey) = 0 )
		goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
		set @nUnkKey = cast(@sUnkKey as int)
		execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'invKey', @sInvKey OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 or ( @sInvKey is not null and isnumeric(@sInvKey) = 0 )
		goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
		set @nInvKey = cast(@sInvKey as int)
        -- Insert a 'no date' dimension record
        BEGIN TRANSACTION
        insert into r5dwdates
                (zdt_key, zdt_date)
        values (@nUnkKey, @dMinDate)
        COMMIT TRANSACTION
		if @@ERROR <> 0
		goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
        -- Insert an 'out of range date' dimension record
		execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'invDate', @sInvDate OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		goto ERROR_HANDLER
        
        BEGIN TRANSACTION
        insert into r5dwdates
                (zdt_key, zdt_date)
        values (@sInvKey, @sInvDate)
        COMMIT TRANSACTION

		if @@ERROR <> 0
		goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
        set @nNumRecs = 2
        set @nNumInserts = 2
     end
      -- If we are doing a full load, then load safetyDays days of dates prior to
      -- the start date. For work order and purchase order handling.
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'safetyDays', @sSafetyDays OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 or ( @sSafetyDays is not null and isnumeric(@sSafetyDays) = 0 )
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	set @nSafetyDays = cast(@sSafetyDays as int)
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_FULL_LOAD', @sOP_FULL_LOAD OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
    if @tS_loadType = @sOP_FULL_LOAD
    begin
        set @dStartDate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@tD_loadFromDate,'DD') - @nSafetyDays
        set @dOriginalStartDate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@tD_originalLoadFromDate, N'DD') - @nSafetyDays
    end
    else
    begin
        set @dStartDate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@tD_loadFromDate,'DD')
        set @dOriginalStartDate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@tD_originalLoadFromDate, N'DD')
    end

    -- Extend the date dimension's ending date record to 20 years. This
    -- should be sufficient to cover all future dates entered into the system

   -- set @dEndDate = convert(datetime, (convert(datetime,'12/31/' + cast(datepart(YYYY, getdate()) as nvarchar(10)),101) + 20), 101)
	set @dEndDate =

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETLDM_LOADENTITIESDIMENSION @tN_runNumber numeric(18,0),
						    @tS_tenantID           nvarchar(50),
						    @tS_loadFlag           nvarchar(1),   /* r5dwetlrunctrl.run_loadFlag%TYPE, */
						    @tS_loadType           nvarchar(255),
						    @tD_loadFromDate       datetime,
						    @tD_loadToDate         datetime,
						    @tD_nextStartDate      datetime,
						    @tD_minWarehouseDate   datetime,
						    @tS_purgeFlag          nvarchar(1),   /*r5dwetlrunctrl.run_purgeflag%TYPE, */
						    @tD_purgeToDate        datetime,
						    @tS_defaultLanguage    nvarchar(2),   /* r5languages.lan_code%TYPE, */
						    @tS_defaultCurrency    nvarchar(200),   /* r5install.ins_desc%TYPE, */
						    @tS_oldDefaultCurrency nvarchar(3),   /* r5dwetlrunctrl.run_defcur%TYPE, */
						    @tB_debug              bit,
						    @tB_isRepair           bit,
						    @tD_originalLoadFromDate datetime,
						    @tD_originalLoadToDate datetime,
						    @tB_hasObjectType2SCDChanges bit,
						    @tB_hasSupplierType2SCDChanges bit,
						    @tD_loadFirstDate      datetime
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS OFF
declare  @nNumRecs  int
declare  @nNumInserts int
declare  @nNumDimensionRecs int
declare  @sSequenceNum      nvarchar(30)
declare  @sChk              nvarchar(6)
declare  @nSurrogateKey     numeric(18,0)
declare  @bDimensionFound   bit
declare  @sOP_FULL_LOAD     nvarchar(30)
declare  @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD     nvarchar(30)
declare  @sSTATUS_EXECUTING nvarchar(9)
declare  @sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION nvarchar(30)
declare  @sSTATUS_COMPLETED nvarchar(9)
declare  @sSTATUS_ABORTED nvarchar(9)
declare  @nUnkKey		int
declare  @sUnkKey  nvarchar(30)
declare  @sUnkCode nvarchar(30)
declare  @nNewKey		int
declare  @nReturn int
declare @sEntitydesc  nvarchar(80)
declare @rS_ent_code  nvarchar(80)  --r5audvalues.ava_primaryid%TYPE,
declare	@rS_ent_secd  nvarchar(180)  --r5audvalues.ava_secondaryid%TYPE,
declare @rS_ent_text  nvarchar(45)
declare @rS_ent_table nvarchar(30)  --r5audvalues.ava_table%TYPE);
declare @rS_ent_entity nvarchar(4)
declare @rS_dms_entity nvarchar(4)  --r5dwmetastatuses.dms_entity%Type
declare @rN_zen_key  numeric(38,0)  --r5dwentities.zen_key%TYPE,
declare @rS_zen_code nvarchar(80)  -- r5dwentities.zen_code%TYPE,
declare @rS_zen_desc nvarchar(80) -- r5dwentities.zen_desc%TYPE,
declare @rS_zen_type nvarchar(45)  -- r5dwentities.zen_type%TYPE);
declare @rS_zen_secondary nvarchar(180) --r5dwentities.zen_secondary%TYPE);
declare @rS_zen_entity nvarchar(4)
declare @sKeyvalues nvarchar(4000)
declare @sQuotes nvarchar(5)
declare @nError int
declare @sCommitFreq nvarchar(30)
declare @nCommitFreq int
begin
	set @sQuotes = N''''
	set @nNumRecs = 0
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETLDM_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_ABORTED', @sSTATUS_ABORTED OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STEP_LOAD_DIMENSION', @sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_EXECUTING', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD', @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'commitFreq', @sCommitFreq OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 or ( @sCommitFreq is not null and isnumeric( @sCommitFreq ) = 0 )
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	set @nCommitFreq = cast(@sCommitFreq as int)

	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_INITIALIZEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber, @tS_loadType,
							    @sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION, N'r5dwentities', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	select @nNumDimensionRecs = count(1) from r5dwentities

	if @nNumDimensionRecs = 0 
	begin
        -- Insert the special dimension record
		execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'unkKey', @sUnkKey OUTPUT
		set @nError = @@ERROR
		if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 or ( @sUnkKey is not null and isnumeric(@sUnkKey) = 0 )
		goto ERROR_HANDLER
		set @nUnkKey = cast(@sUnkKey as int)
		execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'unkCode', @sUnkCode OUTPUT

		set @nError = @@ERROR
		if @nError <> 0
		goto ERROR_HANDLER
        set @nNumRecs = 1
    end

	 -- Now process the source records
	declare cSource cursor local for
	select distinct ava_primaryid,
			 ava_secondaryid,
			 substring(dbo.r5o7_o7get_text(N'BSWHSE',@tS_defaultLanguage, dms_statusentitybot), 1, 45),
			 ava_table,
			 dms_entity
			from   r5audvalues,
					 r5audattribs,
					 r5dwmetastatuses
			where  ava_attribute = aat_code
			and    ava_table     = aat_table
			and    dms_table		= aat_table
			and	 dms_field		= aat_column
			and	 (ava_changed >= @tD_loadFromDate or dms_updated >= @tD_loadFromDate)

	open cSource
	fetch next from cSource into     
					 @rS_ent_code, --nvarchar(80)  --r5audvalues.ava_primaryid%TYPE,
					 @rS_ent_secd, --nvarchar(180)  --r5audvalues.ava_secondaryid%TYPE,
					 @rS_ent_text, --nvarchar(45)  --r5audattribs.aat_text%TYPE,
					 @rS_ent_table, -- nvarchar(30)  --r5audvalues.ava_table%TYPE);
					 @rS_dms_entity -- nvarchar(4)
	while @@fetch_status = 0
	begin
		execute @nReturn = O7DWETLDM_GETENTITYDATA @sEntitydesc OUTPUT, @rS_ent_table, @rS_ent_code, N'DESC' 
		set @nError = @@ERROR
		if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		begin
			set @sKeyvalues = 'r5audvalues.ava_primaryid = '+@sQuotes+isnull(@rS_ent_code, '')+@sQuotes+
							  '; r5audvalues.ava_table = '+@sQuotes+isnull(@rS_ent_table, '')+@sQuotes
			execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_LOADETLERRORLOG @tN_runNumber, @nError, 'r5dwentities', @sKeyvalues
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			begin
                rollback
				close cSource
				deallocate cSource
				goto ERROR_HANDLER
			end
			GOTO fetch_again
		end 
		
		-- Look for an existing dimension record only if doing an incremental
		-- load. Normally we would also select the dimension record if
		-- repairing the dimension, but in this case we truncate the dimension
		-- table before doing the repair, so there is no need to fetch it.
		
		if @tS_loadType = @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD and @tB_isRepair = 0
		begin			
			-- Added '~' to secondary check because these can be null
			-- under SQL92 we could have done used a where-clause something like this:
			-- where (zen_code = :code and zen_secondary = :secondary) IS TRUE
			declare cDimension cursor local for
				select zen_key, zen_code, zen_desc, zen_type, zen_secondary, zen_entity
				from   r5dwentities  
				where  zen_code = @rS_ent_code 
				and    zen_secondary + N'~' = @rS_ent_secd + N'~'
			
			open  cDimension
			fetch next from cDimension into
						 @rN_zen_key,    --r5dwentities.zen_key%TYPE,
						 @rS_zen_code,   -- r5dwentities.zen_code%TYPE,
						 @rS_zen_desc,  -- r5dwentities.zen_desc%TYPE,
						 @rS_zen_type,
						 @rS_zen_se

						    @tD_loadFromDate       datetime,
						    @tD_loadToDate         datetime,
						    @tD_nextStartDate      datetime,
						    @tD_minWarehouseDate   datetime,
						    @tS_purgeFlag          nvarchar(1),   /*r5dwetlrunctrl.run_purgeflag%TYPE, */
						    @tD_purgeToDate        datetime,
						    @tS_defaultLanguage    nvarchar(2),   /* r5languages.lan_code%TYPE, */
						    @tS_defaultCurrency    nvarchar(200),   /* r5install.ins_desc%TYPE, */
						    @tS_oldDefaultCurrency nvarchar(3),   /* r5dwetlrunctrl.run_defcur%TYPE, */
						    @tB_debug              bit,
						    @tB_isRepair           bit,
						    @tD_originalLoadFromDate datetime,
						    @tD_originalLoadToDate datetime,
						    @tB_hasObjectType2SCDChanges bit,
						    @tB_hasSupplierType2SCDChanges bit,
						    @tD_loadFirstDate      datetime
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS OFF
declare  @nNumRecs  int
declare  @nNumDimensionRecs int
declare  @sSequenceNum      nvarchar(30)
declare  @sChk              nvarchar(6)
declare  @nSurrogateKey     numeric(18,0)
declare  @bSurrogateFound   bit
declare  @bDimensionFound   bit
declare  @sOP_FULL_LOAD     nvarchar(30)
declare  @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD     nvarchar(30)
declare  @sSTATUS_EXECUTING nvarchar(9)
declare  @sSTEP_LOAD_FACTS nvarchar(30)
declare  @sSTATUS_COMPLETED nvarchar(9)
declare  @sSTATUS_ABORTED nvarchar(9)
declare  @nUnkKey		int
declare  @nNewKey		int
declare @nReturn int
declare @sUnkCode nvarchar(30)
declare @sErrorMsg nvarchar(2000)
declare @sCommitFreq nvarchar(30)
declare @nCommitFreq int
declare @nNumInserts int --          pls_integer = 0
declare @nExistingRecordCount int--number = 0
declare @sSrcSelect nvarchar(2000) 
declare @rD_zlb_date        datetime     --r5bookedhours.boo_date%TYPE,
declare @rS_zlb_wo          nvarchar(30) --r5bookedhours.boo_event%TYPE,
declare @rS_zlb_personnel   nvarchar(15) --r5bookedhours.boo_person%TYPE,
declare @rS_zlb_trade       nvarchar(15) --r5bookedhours.boo_trade%TYPE,
declare @rS_zlb_mrc         nvarchar(15) --r5bookedhours.boo_mrc%TYPE,
declare @rS_zlb_octype      nvarchar(4) --r5bookedhours.boo_octype%TYPE,
declare @rS_zlb_org         nvarchar(15) --r5organization.org_code%TYPE,
declare @rN_zlb_hours       numeric(24,6) --r5dwlabordailysnap.zlb_hours%TYPE,
declare @rN_zlb_costdefcur  numeric(24,6) --r5dwlabordailysnap.zlb_costdefcur%TYPE,
declare @rS_zlb_defcur      nvarchar(4)   --r5dwlabordailysnap.zlb_defcur%TYPE,
declare @rN_zlb_costorgcur  numeric(24,6) --r5dwlabordailysnap.zlb_costorgcur%TYPE,
declare @rS_zlb_orgcur      nvarchar(4)   --r5dwlabordailysnap.zlb_orgcur%TYPE)
declare @rNfact_zlb_datekey       numeric(18,0) --r5dwlabordailysnap.zlb_datekey%TYPE,
declare @rNfact_zlb_wokey         numeric(18,0) --r5dwlabordailysnap.zlb_wokey%TYPE,
declare @rNfact_zlb_personnelkey  numeric(18,0) --r5dwlabordailysnap.zlb_personnelkey%TYPE,
declare @rNfact_zlb_tradekey      numeric(18,0) --r5dwlabordailysnap.zlb_tradekey%TYPE,
declare @rNfact_zlb_mrckey        numeric(18,0) --r5dwlabordailysnap.zlb_mrckey%TYPE,
declare @rNfact_zlb_octypekey     numeric(18,0) --r5dwlabordailysnap.zlb_octypekey%TYPE,
declare @rNfact_zlb_orgkey        numeric(18,0) --r5dwlabordailysnap.zlb_orgkey%TYPE,
declare @rNfact_zlb_hours         numeric(24,6) --r5dwlabordailysnap.zlb_hours%TYPE,
declare @rNfact_zlb_costdefcur    numeric(24,6) --r5dwlabordailysnap.zlb_costdefcur%TYPE,
declare @rSfact_zlb_defcur        nvarchar(4)   --r5dwlabordailysnap.zlb_defcur%TYPE,
declare @rNfact_zlb_costorgcur    numeric(24,6) --r5dwlabordailysnap.zlb_costorgcur%TYPE,
declare @rSfact_zlb_orgcur        nvarchar(4)   --r5dwlabordailysnap.zlb_orgcur%TYPE)
declare @sKeyvalues nvarchar(4000)
declare @sQuotes nvarchar(5)
declare @nError int
declare @nRowcount int
begin
	set @sQuotes = N''''
	set @nNumRecs = 0
	set @nNumInserts = 0
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETLDM_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_ABORTED', @sSTATUS_ABORTED OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STEP_LOAD_FACTS', @sSTEP_LOAD_FACTS OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_EXECUTING', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD', @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_FULL_LOAD', @sOP_FULL_LOAD OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'commitFreq', @sCommitFreq OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 or ( @sCommitFreq is not null and isnumeric(@sCommitFreq) = 0 )
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	set @nCommitFreq = cast(@sCommitFreq as int)

	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_INITIALIZEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber, @tS_loadType,
								    @sSTEP_LOAD_FACTS, N'r5dwlabordailysnap', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'unkCode', @sUnkCode OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	  declare cSource cursor local for
	  select   boo_date,
                   isnull(boo_event, @sUnkCode),
                   isnull(boo_person, @sUnkCode),
                   isnull(boo_trade, @sUnkCode),
                   isnull(boo_mrc, @sUnkCode),
                   boo_octype,
                   isnull(org_code, @sUnkCode),
                   sum(boo_hours),
                   sum(dbo.O7DWETLDM_TODEFCURR(boo_cost, org_curr, @tS_defaultCurrency, null, boo_date)),
                   @tS_defaultCurrency,
                   sum(boo_cost),
                   isnull(org_curr, @sUnkCode)
          from     r5bookedhours b left outer join r5organization on org_code = dbo.O7DWETLDM_GETBOOKINGORG(boo_event, boo_person) 
          where    boo_date in (select distinct boo_date 
          		        from r5bookedhours where dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(boo_entered, 'DD') between @tD_loadFromDate 
          		        and @tD_loadToDate and boo_event = b.boo_event)
          group by boo_date,
                   isnull(boo_event, @sUnkCode),
                   isnull(boo_person, @sUnkCode),
                   isnull(boo_trade, @sUnkCode),
                   isnull(boo_mrc, @sUnkCode),
                   boo_octype,
                   isnull(org_code, @sUnkCode),
                 --  @tS_defaultCurrency,
                   isnull(org_curr, @sUnkCode)
	open cSource
	fetch next from cSource into @rD_zlb_date       ,
					  @rS_zlb_wo          ,
					  @rS_zlb_personnel   ,
					  @rS_zlb_trade       ,
					  @rS_zlb_mrc         ,
					  @rS_zlb_octype      ,
					  @rS_zlb_org         ,
					  @rN_zlb_hours       ,
