declare @rS_uco_code      nvarchar(8)    --  r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE,
declare @rS_uco_desc      nvarchar(80)   --  r5ucodes.uco_desc%TYPE)
declare @rS_rco_code      nvarchar(8)    --  r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE,
declare @rS_rco_desc      nvarchar(80)   --  r5ucodes.uco_desc%TYPE)
declare @rN_zmt_key   numeric(18,0) --r5dwmatltranstypes.zmt_key%TYPE,
declare @rS_zmt_code  nvarchar(8)   --r5dwmatltranstypes.zmt_code%TYPE,
declare @rS_zmt_desc  nvarchar(80)  --r5dwmatltranstypes.zmt_desc%TYPE)   
declare @rS_zmt_rcode nvarchar(8)   --r5dwmatltranstypes.zmt_rcode%TYPE,
declare @rS_zmt_rdesc nvarchar(80)   --r5dwmatltranstypes.zmt_rdesc%TYPE);
declare @sKeyvalues nvarchar(4000)
declare @sQuotes nvarchar(5)
declare @nError int
declare @nHasUnknownRec numeric(18, 0)
begin
	set @sQuotes = N''''
	set @nNumRecs = 0
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETLDM_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_ABORTED', @sSTATUS_ABORTED OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STEP_LOAD_DIMENSION', @sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_EXECUTING', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_INITIALIZEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber, @tS_loadType,
						 @sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION, N'r5dwmatltranstypes', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	select @nNumDimensionRecs = count(1) from r5dwmatltranstypes

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'unkKey', @sUnkKey OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 or ( @sUnkKey is not null and isnumeric(@sUnkKey) = 0 )
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	set @nUnkKey = cast(@sUnkKey as int)

	if @tB_isRepair = 1
	begin
		select @nHasUnknownRec = count(1) from r5dwmatltranstypes where zmt_key = @nUnkKey
	end

   if @nNumDimensionRecs = 0 or (@tB_isRepair = 1 and @nHasUnknownRec = 0)
	begin
        -- Insert the special dimension record
		execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'unkCode', @sUnkCode OUTPUT
		set @nError = @@ERROR
		if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		goto ERROR_HANDLER
        BEGIN TRANSACTION
        insert into r5dwmatltranstypes (zmt_key) values (@nUnkKey)
        COMMIT TRANSACTION
		set @nError = @@ERROR
		if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		goto ERROR_HANDLER
         set @nNumRecs = 1
    end

    -- Now process the source records
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_FULL_LOAD', @sOP_FULL_LOAD OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD', @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
        if @tS_loadType = @sOP_FULL_LOAD or @tB_isRepair = 1
	begin
		declare cSource cursor local for
   			select uco_code,
			       uco_desc,
			       rco_rcode,
			       rco_desc
			from    r5ucodes,r5rcodes
			where   uco_rentity = rco_rentity
			and     uco_rcode   = rco_rcode
			and     uco_rentity = N'TRTP'
    end
    else
	begin
		declare cSource cursor local for
   			select 	uco_code, 
			       	uco_desc,
                  		rco_rcode,
                  		rco_desc
			from    r5ucodes,r5rcodes
			where   uco_rentity = rco_rentity
			and     uco_rcode   = rco_rcode
			and     uco_rentity = N'TRTP'
			and (uco_created >= @tD_loadFromDate or uco_updated >= @tD_loadFromDate)
    end
	open cSource
	fetch next from cSource into 	@rS_uco_code,
					@rS_uco_desc,
					@rS_rco_code,
					@rS_rco_desc      								       

	while @@fetch_status = 0
	begin
		if @tS_loadType = @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD
		begin
            	select @nSurrogateKey = zmt_key from r5dwmatltranstypes where zmt_code = @rS_uco_code
			if @@rowcount > 0
				set @bSurrogateFound = 0
			else
				set @bSurrogateFound = 1
		end
        else
            set @bSurrogateFound = 1
        
		if @bSurrogateFound  = 0
		begin
			select 	@rN_zmt_key = zmt_key   ,
				@rS_zmt_code	= zmt_code  ,
				@rS_zmt_desc	= zmt_desc,
				@rS_zmt_rcode = zmt_rcode,
				@rS_zmt_rdesc = zmt_rdesc
			from r5dwmatltranstypes 
			where zmt_key = @nSurrogateKey

			if @@rowcount > 0
				set @bDimensionFound = 0
			else
				set @bDimensionFound = 1
  
            if @bDimensionFound = 0
			begin 
                -- Check SCD type 1 fields for changes

			if isnull(@rS_uco_desc,N'~') != isnull(@rS_zmt_desc,N'~') or
			   isnull(@rS_rco_desc,N'~') != isnull(@rS_zmt_rdesc,N'~') 

		begin
                  -- Update all the SCD type 1 fields for each dimension record
                  -- whose natural key matches the changed source record.
                    BEGIN TRANSACTION
                    update r5dwmatltranstypes
                    set    zmt_desc = @rS_uco_desc,
                           zmt_rdesc = @rS_rco_desc
                    where  zmt_code = @rS_uco_code
                    COMMIT TRANSACTION
					
			set @nError = @@ERROR
			if @nError <> 0
			begin
				set @sKeyvalues = 'r5ucodes.uco_code = '+@sQuotes+@rS_uco_code+@sQuotes
				execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_LOADETLERRORLOG @tN_runNumber, @nError, 'r5dwmatltranstypes', @sKeyvalues
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				begin
					close cSource
					deallocate cSource


-- ========================================

name: dbo.O7DWETLDM_LOADMETERSDAILYSNAP

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETLDM_LOADMETERSDAILYSNAP  @tN_runNumber numeric(18,0),
						    @tS_tenantID           nvarchar(50),
						    @tS_loadFlag           nvarchar(1),
						    @tS_loadType           nvarchar(255),
						    @tD_loadFromDate       datetime,
						    @tD_loadToDate         datetime,
						    @tD_nextStartDate      datetime,
						    @tD_minWarehouseDate   datetime,
						    @tS_purgeFlag          nvarchar(1),
						    @tD_purgeToDate        datetime,
						    @tS_defaultLanguage    nvarchar(2),
						    @tS_defaultCurrency    nvarchar(200), 
						    @tS_oldDefaultCurrency nvarchar(3),
						    @tB_debug              bit,
						    @tB_isRepair           bit,
						    @tD_originalLoadFromDate datetime,
						    @tD_originalLoadToDate datetime,
						    @tB_hasObjectType2SCDChanges bit,
						    @tB_hasSupplierType2SCDChanges bit,
						    @tD_loadFirstDate      datetime
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS OFF
declare  @nNumRecs  int
declare  @nNumDimensionRecs int
declare  @sSequenceNum      nvarchar(30)
declare  @sChk              nvarchar(6)
declare  @nSurrogateKey     numeric(18,0)
declare  @bSurrogateFound   bit
declare  @bDimensionFound   bit
declare  @sOP_FULL_LOAD     nvarchar(30)
declare  @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD     nvarchar(30)
declare  @sSTATUS_EXECUTING nvarchar(9)
declare  @sSTEP_LOAD_FACTS nvarchar(30)
declare  @sSTATUS_COMPLETED nvarchar(9)
declare  @sSTATUS_ABORTED nvarchar(9)
declare  @nUnkKey		int
declare  @nNewKey		int
declare @nReturn int
declare @sErrorMsg nvarchar(2000)
declare @sCommitFreq nvarchar(30)
declare @nCommitFreq int
declare @sUnkCode nvarchar(30)
declare @nNumInserts int 
declare @nExistingRecordCount int 
declare @rD_zmr_date           datetime
declare @rS_zmr_meter          nvarchar(20) 
declare @rS_zmr_org            nvarchar(15) 
declare @rS_zmr_object         nvarchar(30) 
declare @rS_zmr_uom            nvarchar(30) 
declare @rN_zmr_reading        numeric(24,6) 
declare @rN_zmr_difference     numeric(24,6) 
declare @rNfact_zmr_datekey    numeric(18,0)
declare @rNfact_zmr_meterkey   numeric(18,0) 
declare @rNfact_zmr_orgkey     numeric(18,0) 
declare @rNfact_zmr_objectkey  numeric(18,0) 
declare @rNfact_zmr_uomkey     numeric(18,0) 
declare @rNfact_zmr_reading    numeric(24,6) 
declare @rNfact_zmr_difference numeric(24,6) 
declare @sKeyvalues nvarchar(4000)
declare @sQuotes nvarchar(5)
declare @nError int
declare @nRowcount int
declare @dStDate datetime
declare @sOriginalStartDate nvarchar(50)
declare @sStartDate nvarchar(50)
declare @sObjectHasType2SCDChanges nvarchar(5)
declare @sMustTruncMetersDailySnap nvarchar(5)
begin
	set @sQuotes = N''''
	set @nNumRecs = 0
	set @nNumInserts = 0
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETLDM_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_ABORTED', @sSTATUS_ABORTED OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STEP_LOAD_FACTS', @sSTEP_LOAD_FACTS OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_EXECUTING', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD', @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_FULL_LOAD', @sOP_FULL_LOAD OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'commitFreq', @sCommitFreq OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 or ( @sCommitFreq is not null and isnumeric(@sCommitFreq) = 0 )
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'unkCode', @sUnkCode OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        GOTO ERROR_HANDLER
	
	set @nCommitFreq = cast(@sCommitFreq as int)

	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_INITIALIZEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber, @tS_loadType,
							@sSTEP_LOAD_FACTS, N'r5dwmetersdailysnap', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	 -- Don't fetch older repair records if there are type 2 SCD records in
	 -- the Objects dimension; instead use the original load-from date
	 -- meant for an incremental load 

	 execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'ObjectHasType2SCDChanges', @sObjectHasType2SCDChanges OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	 goto ERROR_HANDLER

	 execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'MustTruncMetersDailySnap', @sMustTruncMetersDailySnap OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	 goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	 if @tB_isRepair = 1 and @sObjectHasType2SCDChanges = N'true' and @sMustTruncMetersDailySnap = N'false'
    begin
	 	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'originalStartDate', @soriginalStartDate OUTPUT
		set @nError = @@ERROR
		if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	 	goto ERROR_HANDLER

    	set @dStDate = cast(@sOriginalStartDate as datetime)
    end
	 else
	 begin
	 	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'startDate', @sStartDate OUTPUT
		set @nError = @@ERROR
		if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	 	goto ERROR_HANDLER

		set @dStDate = cast(@sStartDate as datetime)
	 end

	declare cSource cursor local for
	select dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(rea_date, N'DD'),
		isnull(rea_meter,@sUnkCode),
		rea_object,
		rea_object_org,
		isnull(rea_uom,rea_calcuom),       
		sum(rea_reading),
		sum(rea_diff)
	 from   r5readings
	 where  rea_date between @dStDate and @tD_loadToDate 	 
	 group by dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(rea_date, N'DD'),
		rea_meter,
		rea_object,
		rea_object_org,
	        isnull(rea_uom,rea_calcuom)
 
        open cSource 
 	fetch next from cSource into      @rD_zmr_date ,
 					  @rS_zmr_meter,					  
					  @rS_zmr_object,
					  @rS_zmr_org  ,
					  @rS_zmr_uom ,
					  @rN_zmr_reading ,
					  @rN_zmr_difference  
	while @@fetch_status = 0
	begin     
         -- Find all dimension keys corresponding to the fact
		execute @nReturn = O7DWETLDM_GETDATEDIMENSIONKEY @rNfact_zmr_datekey OUTPUT, @rD_zmr_date
		set @nError = @@ERROR
		if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		begin
			set @sKeyvalues = 'r5readings.rea_date ='+@sQuotes+cast(@rD_zmr_date as nvarchar(80))+@sQuotes+
			  '; r5readings.rea_meter ='+@sQuotes+@rS_zmr_meter+@sQuotes+
			  '; r5readings.rea_object_org ='+@sQuotes+@rS_zmr_org+@sQuotes+
			  '; r5readings.rea_object ='+@sQuotes+@rS_zmr_object +@sQuotes


			execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_LOADETLERRORLOG @tN_runNumber, @nError, 'r5dwmetersdailysnap', @sKeyvalues
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			begin
				close cSource
				deallocate cSource
				goto ERROR_HANDLER
			end
			GOTO fetch_again
		end
     	        		
		select @rNfact_zmr_meterkey = zme_key from r5dwmeters
		where isnull(zme_code, @sUnkCode) = @rS_zmr_meter
		select @nError = @@ERROR, @nRowcount = @@ROWCOUNT
		if @nError <> 0
		begin
			set @sKeyvalues = 'r5readings.rea_date ='+@sQuotes+cast(@rD_zmr_date as nvarchar(80))+@sQuotes+
					  '; r5readings.rea_meter ='+@sQuotes+@rS_zmr_meter+@s


-- ========================================

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETLDM_LOADMETERSDIMENSION @tN_runNumber numeric(18,0),
						   @tS_tenantID           nvarchar(50),
						   @tS_loadFlag           nvarchar(1),
						   @tS_loadType           nvarchar(255),
						   @tD_loadFromDate       datetime,
						   @tD_loadToDate         datetime,
						   @tD_nextStartDate      datetime,
						   @tD_minWarehouseDate   datetime,
						   @tS_purgeFlag          nvarchar(1),
						   @tD_purgeToDate        datetime,
						   @tS_defaultLanguage    nvarchar(2),
						   @tS_defaultCurrency    nvarchar(200), 
						   @tS_oldDefaultCurrency nvarchar(3), 
						   @tB_debug              bit,
						   @tB_isRepair           bit,
						   @tD_originalLoadFromDate datetime,
						   @tD_originalLoadToDate datetime,
						   @tB_hasObjectType2SCDChanges bit,
						   @tB_hasSupplierType2SCDChanges bit,
						   @tD_loadFirstDate      datetime
as
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS OFF
declare  @nNumRecs  int 
declare  @nNumDimensionRecs int
declare  @sSequenceNum      nvarchar(30)
declare  @sChk              nvarchar(6)
declare  @nSurrogateKey     numeric(18,0)
declare  @bSurrogateFound   bit
declare  @bDimensionFound   bit
declare  @sOP_FULL_LOAD     nvarchar(30)
declare  @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD     nvarchar(30)
declare  @sSTATUS_EXECUTING nvarchar(9)
declare  @sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION nvarchar(30)
declare  @sSTATUS_COMPLETED nvarchar(9)
declare  @sSTATUS_ABORTED nvarchar(9)
declare  @nUnkKey	  int
declare  @sUnkKey	  nvarchar(30)
declare @rS_mtr_code 	  nvarchar(20)
declare @rS_mtr_desc      nvarchar(80)
declare @rS_mtr_classcode nvarchar(8)
declare @rS_mtr_classorg  nvarchar(15)
declare @rS_mtr_classdesc nvarchar(80)
declare @rS_mtr_parent    nvarchar(30)
declare @rN_zme_key       numeric(18,0)
declare @rS_zme_code      nvarchar(20)
declare @rS_zme_desc      nvarchar(80)
declare @rS_zme_classcode nvarchar(8)
declare @rS_zme_classorg  nvarchar(15)
declare @rS_zme_classdesc nvarchar(80)
declare @rS_zme_readtype  nvarchar(30)
declare @rS_zme_parent    nvarchar(30)
declare @nReturn int
declare @sKeyvalues nvarchar(4000)
declare @sQuotes nvarchar(5)
declare @nError int
declare @MET_LOGICAL nvarchar(30)
declare @MET_PHYSICAL nvarchar(30)
declare @nHasUnknownRec numeric(18, 0)
begin
	set @sQuotes = N''''
	set @nNumRecs = 0
	set @MET_LOGICAL  = dbo.r5o7_o7get_text(N'BSWHSE',@tS_defaultLanguage,798)
	set @MET_PHYSICAL = dbo.r5o7_o7get_text(N'BSWHSE',@tS_defaultLanguage,799)
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETLDM_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_ABORTED', @sSTATUS_ABORTED OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STEP_LOAD_DIMENSION', @sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_EXECUTING', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_INITIALIZEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber, @tS_loadType,
							@sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION, N'r5dwmeters', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	select @nNumDimensionRecs = count(1) from r5dwmeters

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'unkKey', @sUnkKey OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 or ( @sUnkKey is not null and isnumeric(@sUnkKey) = 0 )
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	set @nUnkKey = cast(@sUnkKey as int)

	if @tB_isRepair = 1
	begin
		select @nHasUnknownRec = count(1) from r5dwmeters where zme_key = @nUnkKey
	end

   if @nNumDimensionRecs = 0 or (@tB_isRepair = 1 and @nHasUnknownRec = 0)
	begin
        -- Insert the special dimension record
      BEGIN TRANSACTION  
      insert into r5dwmeters (zme_key, zme_readtype) values (@nUnkKey, @MET_LOGICAL)
      COMMIT TRANSACTION
		set @nError = @@ERROR
		if @nError <> 0
		goto ERROR_HANDLER
         set @nNumRecs = 1
    end

    -- Now process the source records
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_FULL_LOAD', @sOP_FULL_LOAD OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD', @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
    if @tS_loadType = @sOP_FULL_LOAD or @tB_isRepair = 1
	begin
	    declare cSource cursor local for
	    select met_code,
                   met_desc,
                   met_class,
                   met_class_org,
                   dbo.R5O7_O7GET_DESC(@tS_defaultLanguage, N'CLAS', met_class + N'#' + met_class_org, N'MET', null),
                   met_parent
            from   r5meters
    end
    else
	begin
	    declare cSource cursor local for
	    select met_code,
                   met_desc,
                   met_class,
                   met_class_org,
                   dbo.R5O7_O7GET_DESC(@tS_defaultLanguage, N'CLAS', met_class + N'#' + met_class_org, N'MET', null),
                   met_parent
            from   r5meters	
	    where (met_created >= @tD_loadFromDate or met_updated >= @tD_loadFromDate)
    end  
	open cSource
	fetch next from cSource into  @rS_mtr_code, @rS_mtr_desc, @rS_mtr_classcode, @rS_mtr_classorg, @rS_mtr_classdesc, @rS_mtr_parent
	while @@fetch_status = 0
	begin
		if @tS_loadType = @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD
		begin
			select @nSurrogateKey = zme_key 
			from r5dwmeters

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETLDM_LOADMRCSDIMENSION    @tN_runNumber numeric(18,0),
						@tS_tenantID           nvarchar(50),
						@tS_loadFlag           nvarchar(1),   /* r5dwetlrunctrl.run_loadFlag%TYPE, */
						@tS_loadType           nvarchar(255),
						@tD_loadFromDate       datetime,
						@tD_loadToDate         datetime,
						@tD_nextStartDate      datetime,
						@tD_minWarehouseDate   datetime,
						@tS_purgeFlag          nvarchar(1),   /*r5dwetlrunctrl.run_purgeflag%TYPE, */
						@tD_purgeToDate        datetime,
						@tS_defaultLanguage    nvarchar(2),   /* r5languages.lan_code%TYPE, */
						@tS_defaultCurrency    nvarchar(200),   /* r5install.ins_desc%TYPE, */
						@tS_oldDefaultCurrency nvarchar(3),   /* r5dwetlrunctrl.run_defcur%TYPE, */
						@tB_debug              bit,
						@tB_isRepair           bit,
						@tD_originalLoadFromDate datetime,
						@tD_originalLoadToDate datetime,
						@tB_hasObjectType2SCDChanges bit,
						@tB_hasSupplierType2SCDChanges bit,
						@tD_loadFirstDate      datetime
AS

SET NOCOUNT ON
SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS OFF
declare  @nNumRecs int    --      pls_integer = 0
declare  @nNumDimensionRecs int
declare  @sSequenceNum      nvarchar(30)
declare  @sChk              nvarchar(6)
declare  @nSurrogateKey     numeric(18,0)
declare  @bSurrogateFound   bit
declare  @bDimensionFound   bit
declare  @sOP_FULL_LOAD     nvarchar(30)
declare  @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD     nvarchar(30)
declare  @sSTATUS_EXECUTING nvarchar(9)
declare  @sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION nvarchar(30)
declare  @sSTATUS_COMPLETED nvarchar(9)
declare  @sSTATUS_ABORTED nvarchar(9)
declare  @nUnkKey	int
declare  @sUnkKey	nvarchar(30)
declare  @nReturn	int      
declare  @rS_mrc_code 	   nvarchar(15)  
declare  @rS_mrc_desc      nvarchar(80)   	
declare  @rS_mrc_classcode nvarchar(8)	
declare  @rS_mrc_classorg  nvarchar(15)
declare  @rS_mrc_classdesc nvarchar(80)
declare  @rN_zmr_key  	numeric(18,0)
declare  @rS_zmr_code 	nvarchar(15)
declare  @rS_zmr_desc 	nvarchar(80)
declare  @rS_zmr_classcode nvarchar(8)
declare  @rS_zmr_classorg  nvarchar(15)
declare  @rS_zmr_classdesc nvarchar(80)
declare  @sKeyvalues 	nvarchar(4000)
declare  @sQuotes 	nvarchar(5)
declare  @nError 	int
declare  @nHasUnknownRec numeric(18, 0)
begin
	set @sQuotes = N''''
	set @nNumRecs = 0
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETLDM_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_ABORTED', @sSTATUS_ABORTED OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STEP_LOAD_DIMENSION', @sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_EXECUTING', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_INITIALIZEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber, @tS_loadType,
							    @sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION, N'r5dwmrcs', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING

	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

   select @nNumDimensionRecs = count(1) from r5dwmrcs
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'unkKey', @sUnkKey OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 or ( @sUnkKey is not null and isnumeric(@sUnkKey) = 0 )
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	set @nUnkKey = cast(@sUnkKey as int)

	if @tB_isRepair = 1
	begin
		select @nHasUnknownRec = count(1) from r5dwmrcs where zmr_key = @nUnkKey
	end

	if @nNumDimensionRecs = 0 or (@tB_isRepair = 1 and @nHasUnknownRec = 0)
	begin
        -- Insert the special dimension record
      BEGIN TRANSACTION  
      insert into r5dwmrcs (zmr_key) values (@nUnkKey)
      COMMIT TRANSACTION
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0
		goto ERROR_HANDLER

        set @nNumRecs = 1
    end

    -- Now process the source records
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_FULL_LOAD', @sOP_FULL_LOAD OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD', @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	if @tS_loadType = @sOP_FULL_LOAD or @tB_isRepair = 1
	begin
		declare cSource cursor local for
			select  mrc_code,
					mrc_desc,
					mrc_class,
					mrc_class_org,
					dbo.R5O7_O7GET_DESC(@tS_defaultLanguage, N'CLAS', mrc_class + N'#' + mrc_class_org, N'MRC', null)
			from    r5mrcs
	end
    else
	begin
		declare cSource cursor local for
			select  mrc_code,
					mrc_desc,
					mrc_class,
					mrc_class_org,
					dbo.R5O7_O7GET_DESC(@tS_defaultLanguage, N'CLAS', mrc_class + N'#' + mrc_class_org, N'MRC', null)
			from    r5mrcs
			where (mrc_created >= @tD_loadFromDate or mrc_updated >= @tD_loadFromDate)
    end
	
	open cSource
    fetch next from cSource into @rS_mrc_code, @rS_mrc_desc, @rS_mrc_classcode, @rS_mrc_classorg,@rS_mrc_classdesc
	while @@fetch_status = 0
	begin
		if @tS_loadType = @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD
		begin
			select @nSurrogateKey = zmr_key from r5dwmrcs where zmr_code = @rS_mrc_code
			if @@rowcount > 0
				set @bSurrogateFound = 0
			else
				set @bSurrogateFound = 1
		end
        else
            set @bSurrogateFound = 1
        
		if @bSurrogateFound  = 0
		begin
			select @rN_zmr_key = zmr_key, @rS_zmr_code = zmr_code, @rS_zmr_desc = zmr_desc, 
				   @rS_zmr_classcode = zmr_classcode,@rS_zmr_classorg = zmr_classorg,@rS_zmr_classdesc = zmr_classdesc 
			from r5dwmrcs 
			where zmr_key = @nSurrogateKey	
            
			if @@rowcount > 0
				set @bDimensionFound = 0
  
            if @bDimensionFound = 0
		begin
		-- Check SCD type 1 fields for changes
                if (isnull(@rS_mrc_desc,N'~')     != isnull(@rS_zmr_desc,N'~') or
                   isnull(@rS_mrc_classcode,N'~') != isnull(@rS_zmr_classcode,N'~') or
                   isnull(@rS_mrc_classorg,N'~')  != isnull(@rS_zmr_classorg,N'~') or
                   isnull(@rS_mrc_classdesc,N'~') != isnull(@rS_zmr_classdesc,N'~'))
                begin
		    -- Update all the SCD type 1 fields for each dimension record
                    -- whose natural key matches the changed source record.
            
			BEGIN TRANSACTION
            update r5dwmrcs
			set    zmr_desc      = @rS_mrc_desc,
			zmr_classcode = @rS_mrc_classcode,
			zmr_classorg  = @rS_mrc_classorg,
			zmr_classdesc = @rS_mrc_classdesc
			where  zmr_code = @rS_mrc_code
            COMMIT TRANSACTION
            
			set @nError = @@ERROR 
			if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			begin
				set @sKeyvalues = 'r5mrcs.mrc_code = '+@sQuotes+@rS_mrc_code+@sQuotes
				execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_LOADETLERRORLOG @tN_runNumber, @nError, 'r5dwmrcs', @sKeyvalues
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				begin
					close cSource
					deallocate cSource
					goto ERROR_HANDLER
				end
				GOTO fetch_again
			end

                    set @nNumRecs = @nNumRecs + 1
				end
			end -- dimension record found
		end
        else -- Surrogate not found
		begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sSequenceNum OUTPUT, N'ZMR', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
			set @nError = @@ERROR
			if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			goto ERROR_HANDLER
			
            set @nSurrogateKey = cast(@sSequenceNum as int)
            
            BEGI


-- ========================================

						    @tB_hasObjectType2SCDChanges bit,
						    @tB_hasSupplierType2SCDChanges bit,
						    @tD_loadFirstDate      datetime
as
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS OFF

declare @nNumRecs int
declare @nReturn int
declare @sOP_FULL_LOAD     nvarchar(30)
declare @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD     nvarchar(30)
declare @sSTATUS_EXECUTING nvarchar(9)
declare @sSTEP_LOAD_FACTS nvarchar(30)
declare @sSTATUS_COMPLETED nvarchar(9)
declare @sSTATUS_ABORTED nvarchar(9)
declare @nCommitFreq int
declare @sCommitFreq nvarchar(30)
declare @nError int

begin
   --run initialization code if necessary
   execute @nReturn = O7DWETLDM_PACKAGE_INIT
   select @nError = @@ERROR
   if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
   goto ERROR_HANDLER
   --run initialization code if necessary
   execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_PACKAGE_INIT
   select @nError = @@ERROR
   if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
   goto ERROR_HANDLER
   execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_ABORTED', @sSTATUS_ABORTED OUTPUT
   select @nError = @@ERROR
   if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
   goto ERROR_HANDLER
   execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STEP_LOAD_FACTS', @sSTEP_LOAD_FACTS OUTPUT
   select @nError = @@ERROR
   if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
   goto ERROR_HANDLER

   execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_EXECUTING', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING OUTPUT
   select @nError = @@ERROR
   if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
   goto ERROR_HANDLER

   execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD', @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD OUTPUT
   select @nError = @@ERROR
   if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
   goto ERROR_HANDLER

   execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_FULL_LOAD', @sOP_FULL_LOAD OUTPUT

   if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
   goto ERROR_HANDLER

   execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'commitFreq', @sCommitFreq OUTPUT
   select @nError = @@ERROR
   if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 or ( @sCommitFreq is not null and isnumeric(@sCommitFreq) = 0 )
   goto ERROR_HANDLER
   set @nCommitFreq = cast(@sCommitFreq as int)

   execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_INITIALIZEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber, @tS_loadType,
                         @sSTEP_LOAD_FACTS, N'r5dwobjectrollupdailysnap', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING
   select @nError = @@ERROR
   if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
      goto ERROR_HANDLER

   truncate table r5dwobjectrollupdailysnap
   COMMIT TRANSACTION
   
   select @nError = @@ERROR
   if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
      goto ERROR_HANDLER

   BEGIN TRANSACTION
   INSERT INTO R5DWOBJECTROLLUPDAILYSNAP( zvt_datekey, zvt_objectkey, zvt_defcur, zvt_orgcur, zvt_ownlabcostdefcur, zvt_ownlabcostorgcur, zvt_hiredlabcostdefcur,
          zvt_hiredlabcostorgcur, zvt_fixedlabcostdefcur, zvt_fixedlabcostorgcur, zvt_stockmatcostdefcur, zvt_stockmatcostorgcur, zvt_dirmatcostdefcur, zvt_dirmatcostorgcur,
          zvt_toolcostdefcur, zvt_toolcostorgcur, zvt_downtime, zvt_downtimecostdefcur, zvt_downtimecostorgcur )
   SELECT 
          JPC_DATEKEY,
          JPC_OBJECTKEY,
          JPC_DEFCUR,
          JPC_ORGCUR,
          SUM(ISNULL(JPC_OWNLABCOSTDEFCUR,0))  JPC_OWNLABCOSTDEFCUR,
          SUM(ISNULL(JPC_OWNLABCOSTORGCUR,0))  JPC_OWNLABCOSTORGCUR,
          SUM(ISNULL(JPC_HIREDLABCOSTDEFCUR,0)) JPC_HIREDLABCOSTDEFCUR,
          SUM(ISNULL(JPC_HIREDLABCOSTORGCUR,0)) JPC_HIREDLABCOSTORGCUR,
          SUM(ISNULL(JPC_FIXEDLABCOSTDEFCUR,0)) JPC_FIXEDLABCOSTDEFCUR,
          SUM(ISNULL(JPC_FIXEDLABCOSTORGCUR,0)) JPC_FIXEDLABCOSTORGCUR,
          SUM(ISNULL(JPC_STOCKMATCOSTDEFCUR,0)) JPC_STOCKMATCOSTDEFCUR,
          SUM(ISNULL(JPC_STOCKMATCOSTORGCUR,0)) JPC_STOCKMATCOSTORGCUR,
          SUM(ISNULL(JPC_DIRMATCOSTDEFCUR,0)) JPC_DIRMATCOSTDEFCUR,
          SUM(ISNULL(JPC_DIRMATCOSTORGCUR,0)) JPC_DIRMATCOSTORGCUR,
          SUM(ISNULL(JPC_TOOLCOSTDEFCUR,0)) JPC_TOOLCOSTDEFCUR,
          SUM(ISNULL(JPC_TOOLCOSTORGCUR,0)) JPC_TOOLCOSTORGCUR,
          SUM(ISNULL(JPC_DOWNTIME,0)) JPC_DOWNTIME,
          SUM(ISNULL(JPC_DOWNTIMECOSTDEFCUR,0)) JPC_DOWNTIMECOSTDEFCUR,
          SUM(ISNULL(JPC_DOWNTIMECOSTORGCUR,0)) JPC_DOWNTIMECOSTORGCUR
   FROM (SELECT ZWT_DATEKEY JPC_DATEKEY,
                ZOB_KEY JPC_OBJECTKEY,
                ZWT_DEFCUR JPC_DEFCUR,
                ZWT_ORGCUR JPC_ORGCUR,
                ZWT_OWNLABCOSTDEFCUR  JPC_OWNLABCOSTDEFCUR,
                ZWT_OWNLABCOSTORGCUR  JPC_OWNLABCOSTORGCUR,
                ZWT_HIREDLABCOSTDEFCUR JPC_HIREDLABCOSTDEFCUR,

                ZWT_STOCKMATCOSTDEFCUR JPC_STOCKMATCOSTDEFCUR,

                ZWT_DIRMATCOSTDEFCUR JPC_DIRMATCOSTDEFCUR,
                ZWT_DIRMATCOSTORGCUR JPC_DIRMATCOSTORGCUR,
                ZWT_TOOLCOSTDEFCUR JPC_TOOLCOSTDEFCUR,
                ZWT_TOOLCOSTORGCUR JPC_TOOLCOSTORGCUR,
                NULL JPC_DOWNTIME,
                NULL JPC_DOWNTIMECOSTDEFCUR,
                NULL JPC_DOWNTIMECOSTORGCUR
         FROM   R5DWWOCOSTDAILYSNAP,
                R5DWWORKORDERS,
                R5DWOBJECTS,

         WHERE  EOB_ROLLUP = '+'
         AND    EOB_OBJECT = ZOB_CODE

                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                NULL,
                ZWS_DOWNTIME,
                ZWS_DOWNTIMECOSTDEFCUR,
                ZWS_DOWNTIMECOSTORGCUR
         FROM   R5DWWOACCUMSNAP,
                R5DWOBJECTS,
                R5DWWORKORDERS,
                R5EVENTOBJECTS
         WHERE  EOB_DOWNTIME = '+'
         AND    EOB_OBJECT = ZOB_CODE
         AND    EOB_OBJECT_ORG = ZOB_ORGCODE
         AND    EOB_EVENT = ZWO_CODE
         AND    ZWS_WOKEY = ZWO_KEY
         AND    ZWS_ACTUALCOMPDATEKEY <> -1) TBL
         GROUP BY JPC_DATEKEY,
             JPC_OBJECTKEY,
             JPC_DEFCUR,
             JPC_ORGCUR

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETLDM_LOADOCCUPATIONTYPESDIMENSION    @tN_runNumber numeric(18,0),
							   @tS_tenantID           nvarchar(50),
							   @tS_loadFlag           nvarchar(1),   /* r5dwetlrunctrl.run_loadFlag%TYPE, */
							   @tS_loadType           nvarchar(255),
							   @tD_loadFromDate       datetime,
							   @tD_loadToDate         datetime,
							   @tD_nextStartDate      datetime,
							   @tD_minWarehouseDate   datetime,
							   @tS_purgeFlag          nvarchar(1),   /*r5dwetlrunctrl.run_purgeflag%TYPE, */
							   @tD_purgeToDate        datetime,
							   @tS_defaultLanguage    nvarchar(2),   /* r5languages.lan_code%TYPE, */
							   @tS_defaultCurrency    nvarchar(200),   /* r5install.ins_desc%TYPE, */
							   @tS_oldDefaultCurrency nvarchar(3),   /* r5dwetlrunctrl.run_defcur%TYPE, */
							   @tB_debug              bit,
							   @tB_isRepair           bit,
							   @tD_originalLoadFromDate datetime,
							   @tD_originalLoadToDate datetime,
							   @tB_hasObjectType2SCDChanges bit,
							   @tB_hasSupplierType2SCDChanges bit,
							   @tD_loadFirstDate      datetime
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS OFF
declare  @nNumRecs  int 
declare  @nNumDimensionRecs int
declare  @sSequenceNum      nvarchar(30)
declare  @sChk              nvarchar(6)
declare  @nSurrogateKey     numeric(18,0)
declare  @bSurrogateFound   bit
declare  @bDimensionFound   bit
declare  @sOP_FULL_LOAD     nvarchar(30)
declare  @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD     nvarchar(30)
declare  @sSTATUS_EXECUTING nvarchar(9)
declare  @sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION nvarchar(30)
declare  @sSTATUS_COMPLETED nvarchar(9)
declare  @sSTATUS_ABORTED nvarchar(9)
declare  @nUnkKey     int
declare  @sUnkKey     nvarchar(30)
declare @rS_uco_code  nvarchar(8)
declare @rS_uco_desc  nvarchar(80)
declare @rS_rco_code  nvarchar(8)	
declare @rS_rco_desc  nvarchar(80)
declare @rN_zot_key   numeric(18,0)
declare @rS_zot_code  nvarchar(8)
declare @rS_zot_desc  nvarchar(80)
declare @rS_zot_rcode nvarchar(8)
declare @rS_zot_rdesc nvarchar(80)
declare @nReturn int
declare @sKeyvalues nvarchar(4000)
declare @sQuotes nvarchar(5)
declare @nError int
declare @nHasUnknownRec numeric(18, 0)

begin
	set @sQuotes = N''''
	set @nNumRecs = 0
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETLDM_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_ABORTED', @sSTATUS_ABORTED OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STEP_LOAD_DIMENSION', @sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_EXECUTING', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
    execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_INITIALIZEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber, @tS_loadType,
							    @sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION, N'r5dwoccupationtypes', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING

	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	select @nNumDimensionRecs = count(1) from r5dwoccupationtypes
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'unkKey', @sUnkKey OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 or ( @sUnkKey is not null and isnumeric(@sUnkKey) = 0 )
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	set @nUnkKey = cast(@sUnkKey as int)

	if @tB_isRepair = 1
	begin
		select @nHasUnknownRec = count(1) from r5dwoccupationtypes where zot_key = @nUnkKey
	end

   if @nNumDimensionRecs = 0 or (@tB_isRepair = 1 and @nHasUnknownRec = 0)
	begin
        -- Insert the special dimension record
      BEGIN TRANSACTION
      insert into r5dwoccupationtypes (zot_key) values (@nUnkKey)
      COMMIT TRANSACTION
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0
		goto ERROR_HANDLER

         set @nNumRecs = 1
    end

    -- Now process the source records
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_FULL_LOAD', @sOP_FULL_LOAD OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD', @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
    if @tS_loadType = @sOP_FULL_LOAD or @tB_isRepair = 1
	begin
		declare cSource cursor local for
			select  uco_code,
                  		uco_desc,
				rco_rcode,
				rco_desc
			from    r5ucodes,r5rcodes
          		where   uco_rentity = rco_rentity
			and	uco_rcode   = rco_rcode
			and	uco_rentity = N'OCTP'
    end
    else
	begin
		declare cSource cursor local for
			select  uco_code,
                  	        uco_desc,
				rco_rcode,
				rco_desc
			from    r5ucodes,r5rcodes
          		where   uco_rentity = rco_rentity
			and	uco_rcode   = rco_rcode
			and	uco_rentity = N'OCTP'
			and (uco_created >= @tD_loadFromDate or uco_updated >= @tD_loadFromDate)
    end
	open cSource
	fetch next from cSource into @rS_uco_code, @rS_uco_desc, @rS_rco_code, @rS_rco_desc
	while @@fetch_status = 0
	begin
		if @tS_loadType = @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD
		begin
			select @nSurrogateKey = zot_key from r5dwoccupationtypes where zot_code = @rS_uco_code
			if @@rowcount > 0
				set @bSurrogateFound = 0
			else
				set @bSurrogateFound = 1
		end
        else
            set @bSurrogateFound = 1
        
		if @bSurrogateFound  = 0
		begin
 			select  @rN_zot_key = zot_key, @rS_zot_code = zot_code, @rS_zot_desc = zot_desc, @rS_zot_rcode = zot_rcode,  @rS_zot_rdesc = zot_rdesc 
			from r5dwoccupationtypes 
			where zot_key = @nSurrogateKey

			if @@rowcount > 0
				set @bDimensionFound = 0
			else
				set @bDimensionFound = 1
  
            if @bDimensionFound = 0
			begin
			-- Check SCD type 1 fields for changes
			if isnull(@rS_uco_desc,N'~') != isnull(@rS_zot_desc,N'~') or 
			isnull(@rS_rco_desc,N'~') != isnull(@rS_zot_rdesc,N'~')
			begin

                    -- Update all the SCD type 1 fields for each dimension record
                    -- whose natural key matches the changed source record.
                    BEGIN TRANSACTION
                    update r5dwoccupationtypes
                    set	   zot_desc = @rS_uco_desc,
                           zot_rdesc = @rS_rco_desc
                    where  zot_code = @rS_uco_code
                    COMMIT TRANSACTION
		set @nError = @@ERROR 
		if @nError <> 0
		begin
			set @sKeyvalues = 'r5ucodes.uco_code = '+@sQuotes+@rS_uco_code+@sQuotes
			execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_LOADETLERRORLOG @tN_runNumber, @nError, 'r5dwoccupationtypes', @sKeyvalues
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			begin
				close cSource
				deallocate cSource
				goto ERROR_HANDLER
			end
			GOTO fetch_again
		end
                    set @nNumRecs = @nNumRecs + 1
				end
			end -- dimension record found
		end
        else -- Surrogate not found
		begin
		--	r5o7.o7maxseq(@sSequenceNum, 'ZOR', 1, @sChk)
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sSequenceNum OUTPUT, N'ZOT', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
			set @nError = @@ERROR 
			if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			begin
				set @sKeyvalues = 'r5ucodes.uco_code = '+@sQuotes+@rS_uco_code+@sQuotes
				execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_LOADETLERRORLOG @tN_runNumber, @nError, 'r5dwoccupationtypes', @sKeyvalues
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				begin
					close cSource
					deallocate cSource


-- ========================================

						       @tS_tenantID           nvarchar(50),
						       @tS_loadFlag           nvarchar(1),   /* r5dwetlrunctrl.run_loadFlag%TYPE, */

						       @tD_loadFromDate       datetime,
						       @tD_loadToDate         datetime,

						       @tD_minWarehouseDate   datetime,
						       @tS_purgeFlag          nvarchar(1),   /*r5dwetlrunctrl.run_purgeflag%TYPE, */
						       @tD_purgeToDate        datetime,
						       @tS_defaultLanguage    nvarchar(2),   /* r5languages.lan_code%TYPE, */
						       @tS_defaultCurrency    nvarchar(200),   /* r5install.ins_desc%TYPE, */
						       @tS_oldDefaultCurrency nvarchar(3),   /* r5dwetlrunctrl.run_defcur%TYPE, */
						       @tB_debug              bit,
						       @tB_isRepair           bit,
						       @tD_originalLoadFromDate datetime,
						       @tD_originalLoadToDate datetime,
						       @tB_hasObjectType2SCDChanges bit,
						       @tB_hasSupplierType2SCDChanges bit,
						       @tD_loadFirstDate      datetime
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS OFF
declare  @nNumRecs  int
declare  @nNumDimensionRecs int
declare  @sSequenceNum      nvarchar(30)
declare  @sChk              nvarchar(6)
declare  @nSurrogateKey     numeric(18,0)
declare  @bSurrogateFound   bit
declare  @bDimensionFound   bit
declare  @sOP_FULL_LOAD     nvarchar(30)
declare  @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD     nvarchar(30)
declare  @sSTATUS_EXECUTING nvarchar(9)
declare  @sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION nvarchar(30)
declare  @sSTATUS_COMPLETED nvarchar(9)
declare  @sSTATUS_ABORTED nvarchar(9)
declare  @nUnkKey		int
declare  @sUnkKey  nvarchar(30)
declare  @nReturn int
declare  @sUnkCode nvarchar(30)
declare @rS_uco_code      nvarchar(8)    --  r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE,
declare @rS_uco_desc      nvarchar(80)   --  r5ucodes.uco_desc%TYPE)
declare @rS_rco_code      nvarchar(8)    --  r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE,
declare @rS_rco_desc      nvarchar(80)   --  r5ucodes.uco_desc%TYPE)
declare @rN_zol_key   numeric(18,0) --r5dwORDERLINEtypes.zol_key%TYPE,
declare @rS_zol_code  nvarchar(8)   --r5dwORDERLINEtypes.zol_code%TYPE,
declare @rS_zol_desc  nvarchar(80)  --r5dwORDERLINEtypes.zol_desc%TYPE)  
declare @rS_zol_rcode nvarchar(8)   --	  r5dworderlinetypes.zol_rcode%TYPE,
declare @rS_zol_rdesc nvarchar(80)   --	  r5dworderlinetypes.zol_rdesc%TYPE);
declare @sKeyvalues nvarchar(4000)
declare @sQuotes nvarchar(5)
declare @nError int
declare @nHasUnknownRec numeric(18, 0)
begin
	set @sQuotes = N''''
	set @nNumRecs = 0
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETLDM_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_ABORTED', @sSTATUS_ABORTED OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STEP_LOAD_DIMENSION', @sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_EXECUTING', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_INITIALIZEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber, @tS_loadType,
							    @sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION, N'r5dworderlinetypes', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	select @nNumDimensionRecs = count(1) from r5dworderlinetypes

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'unkKey', @sUnkKey OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 or ( @sUnkKey is not null and isnumeric(@sUnkKey) = 0 )
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	set @nUnkKey = cast(@sUnkKey as int)

	if @tB_isRepair = 1
	begin
		select @nHasUnknownRec = count(1) from r5dworderlinetypes where zol_key = @nUnkKey
	end

   if @nNumDimensionRecs = 0 or (@tB_isRepair = 1 and @nHasUnknownRec = 0)
	begin
        -- Insert the special dimension record
		execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'unkCode', @sUnkCode OUTPUT
		set @nError = @@ERROR
		if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		goto ERROR_HANDLER
        BEGIN TRANSACTION
        insert into r5dworderlinetypes (zol_key) values (@nUnkKey)
        COMMIT TRANSACTION
		set @nError = @@ERROR
		if @nError <> 0
		goto ERROR_HANDLER
         set @nNumRecs = 1
    end

    -- Now process the source records
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_FULL_LOAD', @sOP_FULL_LOAD OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD', @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
    if @tS_loadType = @sOP_FULL_LOAD or @tB_isRepair = 1
	begin
		declare cSource cursor local for
			select  uco_code, 
				uco_desc,
				rco_rcode,
				rco_desc
			from    r5ucodes,r5rcodes
			where   uco_rentity = rco_rentity
			and     uco_rcode   = rco_rcode
			and uco_rentity = N'PLTP'
    end
    else
	begin
		declare cSource cursor local for
			select  uco_code, 
				uco_desc,
				rco_rcode,
				rco_desc
			from    r5ucodes,r5rcodes
			where   uco_rentity = rco_rentity
			and     uco_rcode   = rco_rcode
			and uco_rentity = N'PLTP'
			and (uco_created >= @tD_loadFromDate or uco_updated >= @tD_loadFromDate)
    end
	open cSource
	fetch next from cSource into @rS_uco_code,
				     @rS_uco_desc ,
				     @rS_rco_code,
				     @rS_rco_desc       

	while @@fetch_status = 0
	begin
		if @tS_loadType = @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD
		begin
            select @nSurrogateKey = zol_key from r5dworderlinetypes where zol_code = @rS_uco_code
			if @@rowcount > 0

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETLDM_LOADORGANIZATIONSDIMENSION	   @tN_runNumber numeric(18,0),
							   @tS_tenantID           nvarchar(50),
							   @tS_loadFlag           nvarchar(1),   /* r5dwetlrunctrl.run_loadFlag%TYPE, */
							   @tS_loadType           nvarchar(255),
							   @tD_loadFromDate       datetime,
							   @tD_loadToDate         datetime,
							   @tD_nextStartDate      datetime,
							   @tD_minWarehouseDate   datetime,
							   @tS_purgeFlag          nvarchar(1),   /*r5dwetlrunctrl.run_purgeflag%TYPE, */
							   @tD_purgeToDate        datetime,
							   @tS_defaultLanguage    nvarchar(2),   /* r5languages.lan_code%TYPE, */
							   @tS_defaultCurrency    nvarchar(200),   /* r5install.ins_desc%TYPE, */
							   @tS_oldDefaultCurrency nvarchar(3),   /* r5dwetlrunctrl.run_defcur%TYPE, */
							   @tB_debug              bit,
							   @tB_isRepair           bit,
							   @tD_originalLoadFromDate datetime,
							   @tD_originalLoadToDate datetime,
							   @tB_hasObjectType2SCDChanges bit,
							   @tB_hasSupplierType2SCDChanges bit,
							   @tD_loadFirstDate      datetime
AS
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS OFF
    declare  @nNumRecs   int 
    declare  @nNumDimensionRecs int
    declare  @sSequenceNum      nvarchar(30)
    declare  @sChk              nvarchar(6)
    declare  @nSurrogateKey     numeric(18,0)
    declare  @bSurrogateFound   bit
    declare  @bDimensionFound   bit
    declare  @sOP_FULL_LOAD     nvarchar(30)
    declare  @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD     nvarchar(30)
    declare  @sSTATUS_EXECUTING nvarchar(9)
    declare  @sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION nvarchar(30)
    declare  @sSTATUS_COMPLETED nvarchar(9)
    declare  @sSTATUS_ABORTED nvarchar(9)
    declare  @nUnkKey		int
    declare  @sUnkKey		nvarchar(30)
    declare  @rS_org_code  nvarchar(15) 
    declare  @rS_org_desc  nvarchar(80) 
    declare  @rN_zor_key   numeric(18,0) 
    declare  @rS_zor_code  nvarchar(15)  
    declare  @rS_zor_desc  nvarchar(80)  
    declare @nReturn int
    declare @sKeyvalues nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sQuotes nvarchar(5)
    declare @nError int
    declare @nHasUnknownRec numeric(18, 0)
begin
	set @sQuotes = N''''
	set @nNumRecs = 0

	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETLDM_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_ABORTED', @sSTATUS_ABORTED OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STEP_LOAD_DIMENSION', @sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_EXECUTING', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
    execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_INITIALIZEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber, @tS_loadType,
							@sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION, N'r5dworganizations', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING

	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	select @nNumDimensionRecs = count(1) from r5dworganizations

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'unkKey', @sUnkKey OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 or ( @sUnkKey is not null and isnumeric(@sUnkKey) = 0 )
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	set @nUnkKey = cast(@sUnkKey as int)

	if @tB_isRepair = 1
	begin
		select @nHasUnknownRec = count(1) from r5dworganizations where zor_key = @nUnkKey
	end
	
   if @nNumDimensionRecs = 0 or (@tB_isRepair = 1 and @nHasUnknownRec = 0)
	begin
        -- Insert the special dimension record
	  BEGIN TRANSACTION	
      insert into r5dworganizations (zor_key) values (@nUnkKey)
      COMMIT TRANSACTION
		set @nError = @@ERROR
		if @nError <> 0
		goto ERROR_HANDLER
         set @nNumRecs = 1
    end

    -- Now process the source records
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_FULL_LOAD', @sOP_FULL_LOAD OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD', @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
    if @tS_loadType = @sOP_FULL_LOAD or @tB_isRepair = 1
	begin
		declare cSource cursor local for
			select org_code, org_desc from r5organization
	end
    else
	begin
		declare cSource cursor local for
			select org_code, org_desc from r5organization
			where (org_created >= @tD_loadFromDate or org_updated >= @tD_loadFromDate)
    end
	
    open cSource
    fetch next from cSource into @rS_org_code, @rS_org_desc
	while @@fetch_status = 0
	begin
		if @tS_loadType = @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD
		begin
			select @nSurrogateKey = zor_key from r5dworganizations where zor_code = @rS_org_code	
			if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
				set @bSurrogateFound = 0
			else
				set @bSurrogateFound = 1
		end
        else
            set @bSurrogateFound = 1
        
		if @bSurrogateFound  = 0
		begin
			select @rN_zor_key = zor_key, @rS_zor_code = zor_code, @rS_zor_desc = zor_desc 
			from r5dworganizations where zor_key = @nSurrogateKey		
			if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
				set @bDimensionFound = 0

            if @bDimensionFound = 0
		begin
			-- Check SCD type 1 fields for changes
		if @rS_org_desc != @rS_zor_desc 
			begin
				-- Update all the SCD type 1 fields for each dimension record
				-- whose natural key matches the changed source record.
                BEGIN TRANSACTION
				update r5dworganizations
				set    zor_desc = @rS_org_desc
				where  zor_code = @rS_org_code
                COMMIT TRANSACTION
				set @nError = @@ERROR 
				if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				begin
					set @sKeyvalues = 'r5organizations.org_code = '+@sQuotes+@rS_org_code+@sQuotes
					execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_LOADETLERRORLOG @tN_runNumber, @nError, 'r5dworganizations', @sKeyvalues
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					begin
						close cSource
						deallocate cSource
						goto ERROR_HANDLER
					end
					GOTO fetch_again
				end

				set @nNumRecs = @nNumRecs + 1
			end
		end -- dimension record found
		end
        else -- Surrogate not found
		begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sSequenceNum OUTPUT, N'ZOR', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
			set @nError = @@ERROR 
			if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			begin
				set @sKeyvalues = 'r5organizations.org_code ='+@sQuotes+@rS_org_code+@sQuotes
				execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_LOADETLERRORLOG @tN_runNumber, @nError, 'r5dworganizations', @sKeyvalues
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				begin
					close cSource
					deallocate cSource
					goto ERROR_HANDLER
				end
				GOTO fetch_again
			end
			
            set @nSurrogateKey = cast(@sSequenceNum as int)
            BEGIN TRANSACTION
            insert into r5dworganizations( zor_key, zor_code, zor_desc )
            values (@nSurrogateKey,
                    @rS_org_code,
                    @rS_org_desc)
            COMMIT TRANSACTION
			set @nError = @@ERROR 
			if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			begin
				set @sKeyvalues = 'r5organizations.org_code'+'='+@sQuotes+@rS_org_code+@sQuotes
				execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_LOADETLERRORLOG @tN_runNumber, @nError, 'r5dworganizations', @sKeyvalues
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				begin
					close cSource
					deallocate cSource
					goto ERROR_HANDLER
				end
				GOTO fetch_again
			end
		end
		fetch_again:

declare @nError int

	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0

	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_PACKAGE_INIT

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_ABORTED', @sSTATUS_ABORTED OUTPUT

	set @nCommitFreq = cast(@sCommitFreq as int)

	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_INITIALIZEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber, @tS_loadType,

	set @nError = @@ERROR

	select @nNumDimensionRecs = count(1) from r5dwparts

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'unkKey', @sUnkKey OUTPUT

							@tD_originalLoadToDate datetime,
							@tB_hasObjectType2SCDChanges bit,
							@tB_hasSupplierType2SCDChanges bit,

AS

SET NOCOUNT ON
SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS OFF
declare  @nNumRecs  int 
declare  @nNumDimensionRecs int
declare  @sSequenceNum      nvarchar(30)
declare  @sChk              nvarchar(6)
declare  @nSurrogateKey     numeric(18,0)
declare  @bSurrogateFound   bit
declare  @bDimensionFound   bit
declare  @sOP_FULL_LOAD     nvarchar(30)
declare  @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD     nvarchar(30)
declare  @sSTATUS_EXECUTING nvarchar(9)
declare  @sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION nvarchar(30)
declare  @sSTATUS_COMPLETED nvarchar(9)
declare  @sSTATUS_ABORTED nvarchar(9)
declare  @nUnkKey	   int
declare  @sUnkKey	   nvarchar(30)
declare @rS_per_code       nvarchar(15)
declare @rS_per_name       nvarchar(80)
declare @rS_per_classcode  nvarchar(8)
declare @rS_per_classorg   nvarchar(15)
declare @rS_per_classdesc  nvarchar(80)
declare @rS_zpe_key        numeric(18,0)
declare @rS_zpe_code       nvarchar(15)
declare @rS_zpe_name       nvarchar(80)
declare @rS_zpe_classcode  nvarchar(8)
declare @rS_zpe_classorg   nvarchar(15)
declare @rS_zpe_classdesc  nvarchar(80)
declare @nReturn int
declare @sKeyvalues nvarchar(4000)
declare @sQuotes nvarchar(5)
declare @nError int
declare @nHasUnknownRec numeric(18, 0)

begin
	set @sQuotes = N''''
	set @nNumRecs = 0
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETLDM_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_ABORTED', @sSTATUS_ABORTED OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STEP_LOAD_DIMENSION', @sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_INITIALIZEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber, @tS_loadType,
							    @sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION, N'r5dwpersonnel', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING

	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	select @nNumDimensionRecs = count(1) from r5dwpersonnel
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'unkKey', @sUnkKey OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 or ( @sUnkKey is not null and isnumeric(@sUnkKey) = 0 )
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	set @nUnkKey = cast(@sUnkKey as int)

	if @tB_isRepair = 1
	begin
		select @nHasUnknownRec = count(1) from r5dwpersonnel where zpe_key = @nUnkKey
	end

   if @nNumDimensionRecs = 0 or (@tB_isRepair = 1 and @nHasUnknownRec = 0)
	begin
        -- Insert the special dimension record
      BEGIN TRANSACTION  
      insert into r5dwpersonnel (zpe_key) values (@nUnkKey)
      COMMIT TRANSACTION
		set @nError = @@ERROR
		if @nError <> 0
		goto ERROR_HANDLER
         set @nNumRecs = 1
    end

    -- Now process the source records
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_FULL_LOAD', @sOP_FULL_LOAD OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD', @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
    if @tS_loadType = @sOP_FULL_LOAD or @tB_isRepair = 1
	begin
	  declare cSource cursor local for
	  select per_code,
                 per_desc,
                 per_class,
                 per_class_org,
                 dbo.R5O7_O7GET_DESC(@tS_defaultLanguage, N'CLAS', per_class + N'#' + per_class_org, N'PERS', null)
          from   r5personnel
    end
    else
	begin
	  declare cSource cursor local for
	  select per_code,
                 per_desc,
                 per_class,
                 per_class_org,
                 dbo.R5O7_O7GET_DESC(@tS_defaultLanguage, N'CLAS', per_class + N'#' + per_class_org, N'PERS', null)
          from   r5personnel
	  where (per_created >= @tD_loadFromDate or per_updated >= @tD_loadFromDate)		
    end
	open cSource
	fetch next from cSource into @rS_per_code, @rS_per_name, @rS_per_classcode, @rS_per_classorg, @rS_per_classdesc
	while @@fetch_status = 0
	begin
		if @tS_loadType = @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD
		begin
			select @nSurrogateKey = zpe_key from r5dwpersonnel where zpe_code = @rS_per_code
			if @@rowcount > 0
				set @bSurrogateFound = 0
			else
				set @bSurrogateFound = 1
		end
        else
            set @bSurrogateFound = 1
        
		if @bSurrogateFound  = 0
		begin
			select @rS_zpe_key = zpe_key, @rS_zpe_code = zpe_code, @rS_zpe_name = zpe_name, 
				   @rS_zpe_classcode = zpe_classcode,@rS_zpe_classorg = zpe_classorg,@rS_zpe_classdesc = zpe_classdesc 
			from r5dwpersonnel 
			where zpe_key = @nSurrogateKey
				
			if @@rowcount > 0
				set @bDimensionFound = 0
			else
				set @bDimensionFound = 1
  
            if @bDimensionFound = 0
		begin
		-- Check SCD type 1 fields for changes
		if (isnull(@rS_per_name,N'~')     != isnull(@rS_zpe_name,N'~') or
                   isnull(@rS_per_classcode,N'~') != isnull(@rS_zpe_classcode,N'~') or
                   isnull(@rS_per_classorg,N'~')  != isnull(@rS_zpe_classorg,N'~') or
                   isnull(@rS_per_classdesc,N'~') != isnull(@rS_zpe_classdesc,N'~'))
                begin
		    -- Update all the SCD type 1 fields for each dimension record
                    -- whose natural key matches the changed source record.

           BEGIN TRANSACTION 
		   update r5dwpersonnel
                   set   zpe_name      = @rS_per_name,
                         zpe_classcode = @rS_per_classcode,
                         zpe_classorg  = @rS_per_classorg,
                         zpe_classdesc = @rS_per_classdesc
                   where zpe_code      = @rS_per_code
           COMMIT TRANSACTION
            
			set @nError = @@ERROR 
			if @nError <> 0
			begin
				set @sKeyvalues = 'r5personnel.per_code = '+@sQuotes+@rS_per_code+@sQuotes

						    @tD_purgeToDate        datetime,

				     @rS_str_locationcode ,
				     @rS_str_locationorg  ,
